meta.title: BC Practical Exam Scenarios - Set 2 (both levels)
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial practice scenarios modeled on EMALB exam format. Clinical content follows the BC Provincial Examination Guidelines (June 15, 2026).

scenarios.titleEn: Choking in a Restaurant - FBAO That Progresses to Cardiac Arrest
scenarios.titleZh: 餐厅噎食——异物气道梗阻进展为心脏骤停
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1912 hrs. Code 3 to a steakhouse in Langley. A 58-year-old male is choking on food. The server who called says he is coughing, cannot speak properly and is getting worse. Hospital is 11 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 19:12，Code 3 前往兰里一家牛排餐厅。58 岁男性被食物噎住。报警的服务员称他在咳嗽、说不清话、情况越来越糟。医院车程 11 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: the server says the man swallowed a piece of steak, nobody has touched him, and the restaurant has no AED.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：服务员称该男子吞下了一块牛排，尚无人对他施救，餐厅没有 AED。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan the AED, suction, BVM and oxygen to the patient's side from the start (the FBAO guideline names suction, AED and BVM) and anticipate that the obstruction may progress to cardiac arrest
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；从一开始就把 AED、吸引器、球囊面罩和氧气备在患者身边（FBAO 指南列出吸引器、AED 和球囊面罩），并预判梗阻可能进展为心脏骤停

expected.actionEn: Brief the partner before arrival: one rescuer takes the airway and chest, the other the AED, suction and BVM
expected.actionZh: 到场前先与搭档分工：一人负责气道和胸廓，另一人负责 AED、吸引器和球囊面罩

expected.actionEn: Ask dispatch for first responders as extra hands so compression operators can be changed every 2 minutes (p.10, p.42)
expected.actionZh: 请调度派出第一响应者作为额外人手，以便每 2 分钟更换按压操作者（第 10、42 页）

expected.actionEn: Anticipate saliva, vomit and food debris: plan gloves and eye protection before patient contact
expected.actionZh: 预判唾液、呕吐物和食物残渣：接触患者前备好手套和护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Busy steakhouse dining room with music playing; diners stand in a loose circle around a corner table. The patient, a 58-year-old man, is standing beside the table, red-faced, coughing and making high-pitched noises. His wife is beside him, panicking, saying he swallowed a large piece of steak without chewing. The floor is clear tile, the table is cleared and the chairs are pushed back, no spills and no other hazards. One patient. Your partner is with you carrying the AED, suction, BVM and oxygen.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：牛排餐厅用餐区客满，播放着音乐；食客在角落餐桌周围围成松散的一圈。患者是一名 58 岁男性，站在餐桌旁，面色涨红，正在咳嗽并发出尖细的声音。他的妻子在旁边惊慌失措，说他没嚼就吞下了一大块牛排。地面是干净的瓷砖，餐桌已清空、椅子已推开，无洒落物，无其他危险。单一患者。你的搭档与你同行，带着 AED、吸引器、球囊面罩和氧气。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment (busy restaurant, crowd, noise), nature of illness (choking on food, suspected FBAO), number of patients (1) and resources (partner with AED, suction, BVM, oxygen)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无）、环境（客满的餐厅、人群、噪音）、发病性质（被食物噎住，疑似 FBAO）、患者数量（1 名）和资源（搭档带着 AED、吸引器、球囊面罩、氧气）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: standing, red-faced, coughing with high-pitched noises, still moving some air - a partial obstruction; stay with him
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：站立、面色涨红、咳嗽并伴尖细声音，仍有部分气流——部分梗阻；守在他身边

expected.actionEn: Ask the crowd to give space and use the wife as the information source; identify the route out to the ambulance
expected.actionZh: 请围观者让出空间，以妻子作为信息来源；确定通往救护车的路线

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: standing beside the table, red-faced, coughing forcefully, making high-pitched noises, whispers 'steak'. EXAMINER (give each finding only when assessed): STAGE 1 - partial obstruction: alert, forceful cough, noisy high-pitched air movement, radial pulse 120 strong, skin flushed. If the candidate encourages him to cough forcefully and stays with him, after about 30 seconds the cough stops, he can make no sound and grabs his throat with both hands (the universal choking sign): STAGE 2 - complete obstruction: still alert, no voice, no cough, no air movement, lips turning blue. If the candidate thrusts while he is still coughing forcefully, note the error and move straight to stage 2. Abdominal thrusts (or back slaps / chest thrusts, alternating in sets of five) do not dislodge the object; after 2 sets he goes limp: STAGE 3 - collapse: lowered to the floor by the candidate and partner with no head strike; unresponsive to voice and pain; no chest movement; skin dusky. The candidate must start chest compressions at once with NO pulse check. After 30 compressions the airway is opened and looked into: nothing is visible and the breath attempt does not go in. C-spine NOT indicated (choking, no trauma, controlled lowering). AFTER ROSC (give when reassessed): airway open, hoarse voice, no stridor, no food visible; respirations 22, adequate depth, occasional cough, equal air entry; carotid and radial pulse 116 strong regular; skin pale, cool, diaphoretic, lips pink; SpO2 92% on 15 L NRB. RBS: no injury from the lowering, tender over the sternum from compressions, mild upper abdominal tenderness from the thrusts, no vomit, no medical-alert jewelry. UNSTABLE: complete airway obstruction progressing to cardiac arrest; now post-ROSC with altered LOC.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：站在餐桌旁，面色涨红，用力咳嗽并发出尖细的声音，低声说「牛排」。考官（评估时才给出相应发现）：第 1 阶段——部分梗阻：清醒，咳嗽有力，空气流动有杂音、声音尖细，桡动脉 120 次/分、有力，皮肤潮红。若考生鼓励他用力咳嗽并守在他身边，约 30 秒后咳嗽停止，他发不出任何声音，双手抓住喉咙（窒息通用手势）：第 2 阶段——完全梗阻：仍清醒，无声音、无咳嗽、无气流，嘴唇开始发紫。若考生在他仍在用力咳嗽时就做冲击，记录该错误并直接进入第 2 阶段。腹部冲击（或背部拍击/胸部冲击，以五次为一组交替进行）无法排出异物；2 组之后他瘫软：第 3 阶段——倒地：考生与搭档把他平稳放到地上，头部未着地；对言语和疼痛均无反应；胸廓无起伏；皮肤发暗发青。考生必须立即开始胸外按压，不做脉搏检查。30 次按压后打开气道并查看：口中看不到任何异物，尝试吹气吹不进去。无颈椎固定指征（噎食、无外伤、平稳放倒）。ROSC 后（再次评估时给出）：气道开放，声音嘶哑，无喉鸣，口中看不到食物；呼吸 22 次/分，深度足够，偶有咳嗽，双侧进气对称；颈动脉和桡动脉脉搏 116 次/分、有力、规则；皮肤苍白、发凉、出汗，嘴唇红润；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 92%。RBS：无放倒造成的损伤，胸骨处因按压而压痛，冲击所致上腹轻度压痛，无呕吐物，无医疗警示饰品。不稳定：完全性气道梗阻进展为心脏骤停；现为 ROSC 后意识改变。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU on contact (Alert, whispering) and again the moment he collapses (Unresponsive to voice and pain)
expected.actionZh: 接触时评估意识 / AVPU（清醒，能低声说话），倒地的瞬间再次评估（对言语和疼痛均无反应）

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (choking, no trauma); with the partner, catch and lower him to the floor in a controlled way so the head and neck are protected
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（噎食、无外伤）；与搭档一起接住他并平稳放到地上，保护头颈部

expected.actionEn: Separate partial from complete obstruction: while he coughs forcefully, coach him to keep coughing and stay with him; once the cough stops and he cannot speak (universal choking sign) call it a complete obstruction and act at once with abdominal thrusts in sets of five (back slaps or chest thrusts may alternate; chest thrusts if abdominal thrusts are not effective)
expected.actionZh: 区分部分梗阻与完全梗阻：他用力咳嗽时，指导他继续咳嗽并守在身边；咳嗽一停、说不出话（窒息通用手势）即判定为完全梗阻，立即做腹部冲击，每五次一组（背部拍击或胸部冲击可交替；腹部冲击无效时改用胸部冲击）

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: no air movement at stage 2 and no chest movement at stage 3; absent breathing is acted on immediately - thrusts while he is conscious, compressions the moment he collapses
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：第 2 阶段无气流、第 3 阶段胸廓无起伏；呼吸消失必须立即处理——清醒时做冲击、倒地即刻开始按压

expected.actionEn: On collapse start chest compressions at once with NO pulse check, and give 30 compressions before the first airway check
expected.actionZh: 倒地即刻开始胸外按压，不做脉搏检查，先按压 30 次再首次检查气道

expected.actionEn: Note skin: flushed, then blue lips, then dusky; after ROSC pale, cool, diaphoretic, lips pink
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：先潮红，继而嘴唇发紫，再发暗发青；ROSC 后苍白、发凉、出汗，嘴唇红润

expected.actionEn: After ROSC complete the rapid body survey (the FBAO pathway ends with 'Complete RBS'): injury from the lowering, tenderness from compressions and thrusts, vomit, medical-alert jewelry
expected.actionZh: ROSC 后完成快速查体（FBAO 流程以「完成 RBS」收尾）：放倒造成的损伤、按压和冲击所致压痛、呕吐物、医疗警示饰品

expected.actionEn: Oxygen through the BVM during the arrest, then 15 L NRB titrated to SpO2 94% or above
expected.actionZh: 心脏骤停期间球囊面罩连接氧气，ROSC 后改 15 L 非再吸入面罩，按 SpO2 滴定至≥94%

expected.actionEn: Supine on the firm floor for CPR; once he is breathing and drowsy, position to protect the airway (semi-prone / recovery position) with suction ready, and back to supine at once if signs of life are lost
expected.actionZh: CPR 时仰卧于坚硬地面；恢复呼吸且嗜睡后，置于保护气道的体位（半俯卧/恢复体位）并备好吸引器，一旦生命征象消失立即改回仰卧

phases.infoEn: Decision point, then the resuscitation course. EXAMINER: the arrest is worked where he lies. The partner applies the AED while the candidate provides CPR (asphyxial arrest: with two rescuers the AED goes on during one-person CPR, and the first analysis comes after 5 cycles, about 2 minutes). FIRST ANALYSIS: NO SHOCK ADVISED - the candidate resumes compressions at once for 2 minutes and rotates operators if a second rescuer is free. In the second round, at the next airway check, a piece of steak is visible at the back of the mouth, pushed up by the compressions: the candidate removes it under direct vision (no blind sweep), suctions the residue, and the next breath goes in with air entry. SECOND ANALYSIS (about 4 minutes after the collapse): NO SHOCK ADVISED, but he coughs, his eyelids flutter, he takes spontaneous breaths and has a carotid pulse = ROSC (signs of life); CPR stops. Cardiac arrest, unconsciousness and now altered LOC = UNSTABLE, RTC. Do not load during active CPR: CPR is more effective while stationary and the reversible cause was cleared on scene. Packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes of arrival. Delegate the partner and bystanders under direction (cot, doors, wife).
phases.infoZh: 决策点，随后是复苏过程。考官：就地复苏。搭档在考生做 CPR 时贴上 AED（窒息性心脏骤停：两名施救者时，在一人 CPR 的同时上 AED，5 个循环、约 2 分钟后做第一次分析）。第一次分析：AED 提示不需电击——考生立即恢复按压 2 分钟，如有第二名施救者空闲则轮换操作者。第二轮中，下一次检查气道时，可见一块牛排位于口腔后部，是被按压顶上来的：考生在直视下取出（不盲目掏挖），吸引残渣，随后的吹气可以进气。第二次分析（倒地后约 4 分钟）：AED 提示不需电击，但他咳嗽、眼睑颤动、出现自主呼吸并可触及颈动脉搏动=ROSC（生命征象）；停止 CPR。心脏骤停、昏迷及现在的意识改变=不稳定，RTC。活动性 CPR 期间不要装车：CPR 在原地进行效果更好，而且可逆病因已在现场解除。到场后 15 分钟内打包完毕可装载。有序指挥搭档和旁观者（担架床、开门、妻子）。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and name the criterion: cardiac arrest, unconsciousness / altered LOC and difficulty maintaining the airway (Findings in Unstable Adult Patients, p.7)
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并说出依据：心脏骤停、昏迷/意识改变、气道难以维持（成人不稳定患者的表现，第 7 页）

expected.actionEn: Explain why the arrest is worked where he lies: CPR is more effective while stationary, and the reversible cause (airway obstruction) is being cleared on scene, so no loading during active CPR (p.42, p.45)
expected.actionZh: 说明为何就地复苏：CPR 在原地进行效果更好，且可逆病因（气道梗阻）正在现场解除，因此活动性 CPR 期间不装车（第 42、45 页）

expected.actionEn: After ROSC: packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes of arrival (on the cot, straps secured), reassessing ABCs after each move
expected.actionZh: ROSC 后：到场后 15 分钟内打包完毕可装载（躺在担架床上、束带扣好），每次移动后复评 ABC

expected.actionEn: Delegate under direction: partner on AED, suction and BVM; bystanders and staff to clear the space, bring the cot, hold doors and look after the wife; first responders for extra hands
expected.actionZh: 有序指挥：搭档负责 AED、吸引器和球囊面罩；旁观者和店员负责清空场地、推担架床、开门并照看妻子；第一响应者提供额外人手

phases.infoEn: WIFE ANSWERS (the patient is confused after ROSC and repeats 'what happened?'; use the wife as the main source): they were out for their anniversary dinner; he was talking and laughing, swallowed a large piece of steak without chewing, and started coughing at about 1910; he could not clear it, the server called, and nobody touched him before you arrived. He had no loss of consciousness until the collapse. PATIENT (a few words, when asked): chest wall sore over the sternum, 6/10, and upper abdomen sore, 4/10 - constant, worse with deep breaths, no relief. PMHx: hypertension, high cholesterol, no heart or lung disease, no swallowing problems, no previous choking episodes. Meds: ramipril and atorvastatin, no blood thinners. Allergies: penicillin (rash). LOI: bread and salad, then the steak, two glasses of red wine; nothing since the steak.
phases.infoZh: 妻子回答（患者在 ROSC 后意识错乱，反复问「发生什么了？」；以妻子为主要信息来源）：两人在庆祝结婚纪念日晚餐；他边说边笑，没嚼就吞下一大块牛排，约 19:10 开始咳嗽，自己无法清除，服务员报了警，你们到场前没有人碰过他。倒地之前没有意识丧失。患者（被问到时用几个词回答）：胸骨处胸壁酸痛 6/10，上腹酸痛 4/10——持续存在，深呼吸时加重，无缓解。既往史：高血压、高胆固醇，无心脏或肺部疾病，无吞咽问题，以前没有噎食过。用药：雷米普利和阿托伐他汀，无抗凝药。过敏：青霉素（皮疹）。最后进食：面包和沙拉，然后是牛排，两杯红酒；牛排之后没有再吃喝。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint from the wife: choked on a large piece of steak, progressing to collapse
expected.actionZh: 向妻子确立主诉：被一大块牛排噎住，进而倒地

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST / LOTARP: onset about 1910, what he was doing, progression from partial to complete obstruction, who did what before you arrived, loss of consciousness, previous choking episodes, alcohol
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST/LOTARP 采集现病史：约 19:10 起病、当时在做什么、从部分梗阻到完全梗阻的进展、到场前谁做过什么、有无意识丧失、既往噎食史、饮酒

expected.actionEn: Pain score for the sternum and the upper abdomen (6/10 and 4/10) with provoking factor and relief
expected.actionZh: 胸骨和上腹的疼痛评分（6/10 和 4/10），含诱发因素和缓解情况

expected.actionEn: PMHx (hypertension, high cholesterol; no heart or lung disease, no swallowing problems)
expected.actionZh: 既往史（高血压、高胆固醇；无心脏或肺部疾病，无吞咽问题）

expected.actionEn: Medications - ramipril and atorvastatin, no blood thinners (relevant to ibuprofen)
expected.actionZh: 用药史——雷米普利和阿托伐他汀，无抗凝药（与布洛芬相关）

expected.actionEn: Allergies - penicillin (rash)
expected.actionZh: 过敏史——青霉素（皮疹）

expected.actionEn: LOI - bread, salad and the steak, two glasses of red wine
expected.actionZh: 最后进食——面包、沙拉和牛排，两杯红酒

expected.actionEn: Use the wife as the history source because the confused patient cannot give a reliable account, and keep her informed
expected.actionZh: 患者意识错乱、无法提供可靠病史，改以妻子为信息来源，并向她通报情况

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline within 3 minutes of ROSC (no protocol drug is given on this call): GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6, confused, repeats the same question); BP 158/96; pulse 116 strong regular; respirations 22, adequate depth, occasional cough; skin pale, cool, diaphoretic; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 92% on 15 L NRB, rising; BGL 6.4 mmol/L (indicated - altered LOC after the arrest); temperature not indicated. Priority patient: the second set is due within 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——ROSC 后 3 分钟内的基线（本次呼救不给任何协议药物）：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6，意识错乱，反复问同一个问题）；血压 158/96；脉搏 116 有力规则；呼吸 22，深度足够，偶有咳嗽；皮肤苍白、发凉、出汗；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 92%，正在上升；血糖 6.4 mmol/L（有指征——骤停后意识改变）；体温无指征。优先患者：第 2 组应在 5-6 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (13: E3 V4 M6, confused)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（13：E3 V4 M6，意识错乱）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation, repeated with each set to trend a post-arrest patient
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压，每组复测以追踪骤停后患者的趋势

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm at the radial and carotid
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度和节律（桡动脉和颈动脉）

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate, depth and adequacy - confirm they are adequate and no assisted ventilation is needed
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率、深度和是否足够——确认呼吸足够、无需辅助通气

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on: temperature, colour, moisture
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：温度、颜色、湿度

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 on 15 L NRB, target 94% or above
expected.actionZh: 15 L 非再吸入面罩下测 SpO2，目标≥94%

expected.actionEn: BGL - indicated for a decreased LOC without a known cause
expected.actionZh: 血糖——不明原因意识下降，有指征

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, brief, from the patient (now answering in short sentences) with the wife helping: general - well all day, tired now; CNS - confused about the last few minutes, no headache, no weakness; respiratory - sore throat, hoarse voice, cough, no wheeze; cardiovascular - heart racing now, no chest pain before the choking, no palpitations before dinner; GI/GU - nausea, sore upper abdomen, no vomiting; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - chest wall sore over the sternum, no other pain; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - scratchy swollen-feeling throat, no mouth bleeding, no loose teeth.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中从简，由患者（现在能用短句回答）回答、妻子协助：整体——一整天都很好，现在疲倦；中枢神经——对最近几分钟的事情模糊，无头痛，无无力；呼吸——咽痛、声音嘶哑、咳嗽，无喘鸣；心血管——现在心跳快，噎住之前没有胸痛，晚餐前没有心悸；消化/泌尿——恶心、上腹疼痛，无呕吐；皮肤无；肌肉骨骼——胸骨处胸壁酸痛，无其他疼痛；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——喉咙发痒且有肿胀感，口腔无出血，牙齿无松动。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (memory gap after a hypoxic episode)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（缺氧事件后的记忆空白）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (sore throat, hoarse voice, cough, no wheeze)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸（咽痛、声音嘶哑、咳嗽，无喘鸣）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (no chest pain before the choking)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管（噎住之前无胸痛）

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (nausea, sore upper abdomen from the thrusts)

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - hoarse voice, mild redness at the back of the throat, no swelling, no stridor, trachea midline, no JVD, no scalp injury; chest - tender over the sternum, no crepitus or deformity, equal air entry on 6-site auscultation, no wheeze; abdomen - soft, not distended, mild upper tenderness from the thrusts, no guarding; back - nil, no injury from the lowering; lower extremities - nil, pedal pulses present, CSM intact; upper extremities - nil, radial pulses present, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——声音嘶哑，咽后壁轻度发红，无肿胀，无喉鸣，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张，头皮无损伤；胸部——胸骨处压痛，无捻发感或畸形，6 点听诊双侧进气对称，无喘鸣；腹部——软，不胀，冲击所致上腹轻度压痛，无肌紧张；背部——无，放倒时无损伤；下肢——无，足背动脉搏动存在，远端 CSM 完好；上肢——无，桡动脉搏动存在，远端 CSM 完好。

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS, in the order it happens. FBAO (witnessed, conscious to unconscious): partial obstruction - have the patient cough forcefully; complete obstruction - chest thrusts, back slaps and abdominal thrusts are all effective in a conscious adult, alternating two techniques in sets of five is acceptable, and chest thrusts are considered if abdominal thrusts are not effective. When he collapses: start CPR with chest compressions and do NOT check for a pulse; after 30 compressions open the airway and look, never perform blind finger sweeps, attempt 2 breaths and continue the cycles, checking the airway before each ventilation attempt; remove the object only if it is seen (p.46). Adult CPR: 30:2 at 100-120 per minute, depth 5.0-6.0 cm, complete recoil, interruptions under 5 seconds, change operators every 2 minutes where possible, avoid hyperventilation (p.42-43). Asphyxial arrest: the partner applies the AED during the candidate's one-person CPR and the first analysis is after 5 cycles (about 2 minutes); no shock advised - resume CPR at once for 2 minutes and repeat; shock advised - defibrillate and resume CPR at once, compressions continuing while the AED charges (p.40, p.43, p.44). Suction 10-15 seconds in the adult, BVM with oxygen (p.45-46). Signs of life (movement, coughing, breathing) end the CPR (p.40). POST-ROSC: oxygen 15 L NRB titrated to SpO2 of 94% or above (p.50), assist ventilations if breathing becomes inadequate (p.11), position to protect the airway with suction ready, baseline vitals including BGL (p.57), complete the RBS and the assessment en route, and if the signs of life are lost restart CPR and let the AED analyze. ANALGESIA: sternal pain 6/10 and upper abdominal pain 4/10, but Entonox is contraindicated (altered level of consciousness - GCS 13 - and he cannot reliably comply, p.65) and oral acetaminophen / ibuprofen are withheld because a confused patient who has just had a complete airway obstruction cannot be trusted to swallow safely (compare oral glucose, 'only for patients with sufficient mentation to maintain an airway', p.76); document, and reassess the pain with each set. PCP ADDITIONS: vascular access en route as a precaution for re-arrest and any medication (p.38); ongoing airway management with suction at hand; if he re-arrests, a supraglottic airway once high-quality CPR is established (p.42).
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用，按发生顺序：FBAO（目击下清醒转昏迷）：部分梗阻——让患者用力咳嗽；完全梗阻——对清醒成人，胸部冲击、背部拍击和腹部冲击都有效，两种手法每五次一组交替是可以接受的，腹部冲击无效时考虑胸部冲击。他倒地时：用胸外按压开始 CPR，不做脉搏检查；按压 30 次后打开气道并查看，绝不盲目手指掏挖，尝试吹 2 口气并继续循环，每次尝试通气前都检查气道；只有看见异物才取出（第 46 页）。成人 CPR：30:2，频率 100-120 次/分，深度 5.0-6.0 cm，充分回弹，中断少于 5 秒，尽可能每 2 分钟更换操作者，避免过度通气（第 42-43 页）。窒息性心脏骤停：搭档在考生单人 CPR 期间贴上 AED，5 个循环（约 2 分钟）后做第一次分析；提示不需电击——立即恢复 CPR 2 分钟并重复；提示需电击——电击后立即恢复 CPR，AED 充电期间按压不停（第 40、43、44 页）。成人吸引 10-15 秒，球囊面罩连接氧气（第 45-46 页）。出现生命征象（活动、咳嗽、呼吸）即终止 CPR（第 40 页）。ROSC 后：15 L 非再吸入面罩吸氧，按 SpO2 滴定至≥94%（第 50 页），呼吸不足时辅助通气（第 11 页），置保护气道的体位并备好吸引器，完成含血糖在内的基线生命体征（第 57 页），途中完成 RBS 和后续评估；若生命征象再度消失，立即重新开始 CPR 并让 AED 分析。镇痛：胸骨痛 6/10、上腹痛 4/10，但 Entonox 禁用（意识水平改变——GCS 13——且他无法可靠配合，第 65 页），口服对乙酰氨基酚/布洛芬也暂不给，因为刚经历完全性气道梗阻的意识错乱患者无法保证安全吞咽（参照口服葡萄糖「仅用于意识足以维持气道的患者」，第 76 页）；记录并在每组生命体征时复评疼痛。PCP 追加：途中建立静脉通路，作为再次骤停及可能用药的预备（第 38 页）；持续气道管理、吸引器随手可及；若再次骤停，在高质量 CPR 建立后置入声门上气道（第 42 页）。

expected.actionEn: Run the FBAO pathway in order: coach the cough while the obstruction is partial; thrusts in sets of five once it is complete; compressions at once on collapse with no pulse check; open the airway and look after 30 compressions; NEVER a blind finger sweep; remove the object only when seen (p.46)
expected.actionZh: 按顺序执行 FBAO 流程：部分梗阻时指导咳嗽；完全梗阻后每五次一组冲击；倒地即刻按压且不做脉搏检查；按压 30 次后打开气道查看；绝不盲目手指掏挖；只有看见异物才取出（第 46 页）

expected.actionEn: Asphyxial-arrest AED sequence: the partner applies the AED during one-person CPR, first analysis after 5 cycles (about 2 minutes); no shock advised - resume CPR at once for 2 minutes, analyze and repeat (p.44, p.40)
expected.actionZh: 窒息性骤停的 AED 流程：搭档在单人 CPR 期间贴上 AED，5 个循环（约 2 分钟）后首次分析；提示不需电击——立即恢复 CPR 2 分钟，再分析并重复（第 44、40 页）

expected.actionEn: CPR skill to standard: 30:2, rate 100-120 per minute, depth 5-6 cm, complete recoil, interruptions under 5 seconds, compressions continuing while the AED charges, operators changed every 2 minutes where possible
expected.actionZh: CPR 操作符合标准：30:2、频率 100-120 次/分、深度 5-6 cm、充分回弹、中断少于 5 秒、AED 充电期间按压不停、尽可能每 2 分钟更换操作者

expected.actionEn: Airway skill: look in the mouth before each ventilation attempt, reposition the head if the breath does not go in, remove only the object you can see, suction the residue for 10-15 seconds
expected.actionZh: 气道技能：每次尝试通气前先看口腔，吹气吹不进时重新摆正头位，只取出看得见的异物，吸引残渣 10-15 秒

expected.actionEn: Breathing skill: BVM with oxygen attached, 2 breaths after each 30 compressions with air entry confirmed and no hyperventilation; after ROSC assist ventilations only if breathing becomes inadequate
expected.actionZh: 呼吸支持技能：球囊面罩连接氧气，每 30 次按压后吹 2 口气并确认进气，避免过度通气；ROSC 后仅在呼吸变得不足时才辅助通气

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the analgesia decision: Entonox is contraindicated by altered LOC and inability to comply (p.65); no oral acetaminophen or ibuprofen because he cannot safely swallow; document and reassess pain with each set
expected.actionZh: 口述镇痛决定：意识改变且无法配合，Entonox 禁用（第 65 页）；他无法安全吞咽，故不给口服对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬；记录并在每组生命体征时复评疼痛

expected.actionEn: Post-ROSC care and re-arrest plan: oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above, airway-protecting position with suction ready, and if the signs of life are lost restart compressions at once and let the AED analyze
expected.actionZh: ROSC 后处置与再次骤停预案：氧气滴定至 SpO2≥94%，保护气道的体位并备好吸引器，一旦生命征象消失立即重新按压并让 AED 分析

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access en route as a precaution for re-arrest and any medication, without delaying transport, plus ongoing airway management with suction at hand
expected.actionZh: PCP：途中建立静脉通路，作为再次骤停及可能用药的预备，且不延误转运；同时持续气道管理、吸引器随手可及

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the pulse and all interventions after every move (floor to cot, cot to ambulance) and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, about 6 minutes after set 1): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6, still confused about the last few minutes but orienting better); BP 146/88; pulse 102 regular; respirations 18; skin pale, warming, dry; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 96% on 15 L NRB; BGL not repeated. Improving - document the trend; if the signs of life are lost at any reassessment, compressions restart at once and the AED analyzes.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动（地面到担架床、担架床到救护车）后以及至少每 5 分钟复评 ABC、脉搏和全部处置。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组后约 6 分钟）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6，对最近几分钟仍模糊但定向力在好转）；血压 146/88；脉搏 102 规则；呼吸 18；皮肤苍白、渐暖、干燥；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 96%；血糖不需复测。病情好转——记录趋势；若任何一次复评发现生命征象消失，立即重新按压并让 AED 分析。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, the pulse and all interventions after each move and at least every 5 minutes, checking for vomit and keeping suction at hand
expected.actionZh: 每次移动后及至少每 5 分钟复评 ABC、脉搏和全部处置，留意呕吐并让吸引器随手可及

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes, interpret the improving trend and reassess the pain
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，解读好转趋势并复评疼痛

expected.actionEn: Re-check breathing adequacy at every reassessment and assist ventilations with the BVM if the rate or SpO2 falls (p.11, p.50)
expected.actionZh: 每次复评都检查呼吸是否足够，呼吸频率或 SpO2 下降时用球囊面罩辅助通气（第 11、50 页）

expected.actionEn: State the re-arrest plan: if the signs of life are lost at any reassessment, restart compressions at once and let the AED analyze
expected.actionZh: 口述再次骤停预案：任何一次复评发现生命征象消失，立即重新按压并让 AED 分析

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route: post-arrest after an airway obstruction. The hand-off carries exact times: choking onset, arrival, collapse, first analysis, object removal and ROSC, with no shocks delivered, and both sets of vital signs. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院：气道梗阻后的骤停复苏后患者。交接须含精确时间：噎住起病、到场、倒地、首次分析、取出异物和 ROSC，未进行电击，以及两组生命体征。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical post-arrest patient
expected.actionZh: 危重的复苏后患者途中预报

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with times: choking onset, collapse, CPR start, AED analyses (no shock advised), object removal, ROSC and both sets of vital signs
expected.actionZh: 完整交接并含时间：噎住起病、倒地、开始 CPR、AED 分析（均提示不需电击）、取出异物、ROSC 及两组生命体征

expected.actionEn: State that no shock was advised or delivered and that analgesia was withheld because of the altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 说明 AED 未提示电击、也未电击，并说明因意识改变而未给镇痛

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes with all event times and the reason analgesia was withheld
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，记录所有事件时间及暂不镇痛的理由

vitalsSets.timeHint: baseline, within 3 minutes of ROSC
en route, about 6 minutes after set 1

criticalPitfallsEn: Blind finger sweeps - the FBAO guideline says never to perform them; they can push the object deeper and they interrupt the compression cycle - up to 100% (protocols)

Checking a pulse on collapse before starting compressions, or pausing longer than 5 seconds to hunt for the object - delays CPR: 15-25% under the CPR/AED skill, and 100% (circulation) if compressions are not started promptly

Forgetting the AED, or waiting until the object is out - an asphyxial arrest still needs it: the partner applies the AED during CPR and the first analysis comes after 5 cycles, about 2 minutes - up to 100% (protocols)
Thrusting on a patient who is still coughing forcefully instead of coaching the cough, or standing by when the cough stops and he cannot speak - protocol or airway error, up to 100%
Loading him into the ambulance in the middle of the arrest to 'save time' - CPR is more effective while stationary and the reversible cause is cleared on scene; transport-category error, 25%
Hyperventilating with the BVM or moving on without confirming air entry - breathing management deduction, 15-25%

Giving Entonox or oral acetaminophen / ibuprofen to the confused post-ROSC patient for his chest soreness - Entonox is contraindicated by altered LOC (p.65), so failing to rule out the contraindication is a protocol error, up to 100%
criticalPitfallsZh: 盲目手指掏挖——FBAO 指南明确禁止，可能把异物推得更深，还会打断按压节奏——最高扣 100%（protocols）
倒地后先摸脉搏再开始按压，或为寻找异物暂停超过 5 秒——延误 CPR：CPR/AED 技能扣 15-25%，若迟迟不开始按压则按 circulation 项扣 100%
忘记 AED，或等异物取出后才用——窒息性骤停同样需要 AED：搭档在 CPR 期间贴上 AED，5 个循环（约 2 分钟）后做首次分析——最高扣 100%（protocols）
患者仍在用力咳嗽时就冲击而不是指导咳嗽，或咳嗽停止、说不出话时袖手旁观——协议或气道错误，最高扣 100%
为「节省时间」在心脏骤停进行中就把他抬上救护车——CPR 在原地效果更好，可逆病因已在现场解除；转运分类错误，扣 25%
球囊面罩过度通气，或未确认进气就继续——呼吸支持技能扣分，15-25%
因胸壁酸痛给意识错乱的 ROSC 后患者 Entonox 或口服对乙酰氨基酚/布洛芬——意识改变使 Entonox 禁用（第 65 页），未排除禁忌属协议错误，最高扣 100%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR owns the whole call: separating a partial from a complete obstruction, coached coughing, thrusts in sets of five (chest thrusts if abdominal thrusts are not effective), immediate compressions on collapse with no pulse check, airway inspection after 30 compressions with no blind sweeps, suction, 30:2 CPR with a BVM and oxygen, the asphyxial-arrest AED sequence, post-ROSC oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above, airway-protecting positioning and RTC transport. Entonox and oral analgesics are withheld (altered LOC); if his GCS had returned to 15 and he could swallow safely, the Appendix A pain rule would apply again - check each drug's contraindications first. No IV, no supraglottic airway, no Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 负责整个呼救：区分部分与完全梗阻、指导咳嗽、每五次一组的冲击（腹部冲击无效时改胸部冲击）、倒地即刻按压且不做脉搏检查、按压 30 次后检查气道且不盲目掏挖、吸引、球囊面罩加氧气的 30:2 CPR、窒息性骤停的 AED 流程、ROSC 后按 SpO2≥94% 滴定氧气、保护气道的体位以及 RTC 转运。因意识改变，暂不给 Entonox 和口服镇痛药；若他的 GCS 已恢复到 15 且能安全吞咽，则又适用附录 A 的疼痛规则——先逐一核对各药禁忌。无静脉通路、无声门上气道、无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP does everything the EMR does and adds vascular access en route (a precaution for re-arrest and any medication), ongoing airway management with suction at hand (a supraglottic airway only if he re-arrests and high-quality CPR is established), and the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route. (textbook practice - not a BC rubric item) Do not delay compressions, the AED or ventilation to start an IV, and leave the AED pads on and the unit beside the stretcher after ROSC.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 完成 EMR 的全部内容，并增加：途中建立静脉通路（作为再次骤停及可能用药的预备）、持续气道管理且吸引器随手可及（仅在再次骤停且高质量 CPR 已建立时才置入声门上气道），以及途中 9 系统功能问诊。（教科书做法——非 BC 评分项）不要为建立静脉通路而延误按压、AED 或通气；ROSC 后保留 AED 电极片，并让设备留在担架旁。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 58-year-old male who choked on a large piece of steak in a restaurant at about 1910. On our arrival at 1919 he had a partial obstruction and was coughing forcefully; it became complete at about 1920, abdominal thrusts did not clear it and he became unresponsive at 1921. We started compressions immediately with no pulse check, my partner applied the AED during CPR, the first analysis at 1923 advised no shock, a piece of steak was seen and removed under direct vision at about 1924, and at 1925 the second analysis again advised no shock but he had signs of life with a carotid pulse - ROSC after about 4 minutes of CPR, no shocks delivered. Post-ROSC baseline: GCS 13, BP 158/96, pulse 116, resps 22, SpO2 92% on 15 litres, BGL 6.4, pupils equal and reactive. Set 2 about 6 minutes later: GCS 14, BP 146/88, pulse 102, resps 18, SpO2 96%. History from his wife: hypertension and high cholesterol on ramipril and atorvastatin, no blood thinners, allergic to penicillin, ate steak with two glasses of red wine. He has sternal pain 6/10 and upper abdominal pain 4/10 from the compressions and thrusts; no analgesia was given because of his altered LOC. Treatments: abdominal thrusts, CPR with BVM and oxygen, AED, suction, high-flow oxygen and an airway-protecting position; PCP: IV access established en route.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 58 岁男性，约 19:10 在餐厅被一大块牛排噎住。19:19 我们到场时为部分梗阻，咳嗽有力；约 19:20 变为完全梗阻，腹部冲击未能排出异物，19:21 他失去反应。我们立即开始按压，未做脉搏检查，搭档在 CPR 期间贴上 AED，19:23 首次分析提示不需电击，约 19:24 在直视下看到并取出一块牛排，19:25 第二次分析仍提示不需电击，但他出现生命征象并可触及颈动脉搏动——约 4 分钟 CPR 后 ROSC，全程未电击。ROSC 后基线：GCS 13，血压 158/96，脉搏 116，呼吸 22，SpO2 15 升下 92%，血糖 6.4，瞳孔等大有反应。约 6 分钟后第 2 组：GCS 14，血压 146/88，脉搏 102，呼吸 18，SpO2 96%。妻子提供病史：高血压和高胆固醇，服用雷米普利和阿托伐他汀，无抗凝药，青霉素过敏，晚餐吃了牛排并喝了两杯红酒。胸骨痛 6/10、上腹痛 4/10，来自按压和冲击；因意识改变未给镇痛。处置：腹部冲击、球囊面罩加氧气的 CPR、AED、吸引、高流量吸氧、保护气道的体位；PCP：途中已建立静脉通路。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Choking on a large piece of steak, progressing to cardiac arrest with ROSC after about 4 minutes of CPR
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Swallowed steak without chewing and began coughing at about 1910; partial then complete obstruction; abdominal thrusts ineffective; unresponsive at 1921; CPR immediately, no pulse check; object removed about 1924; ROSC 1925; no shocks; sternal pain 6/10, upper abdominal pain 4/10
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Hypertension, high cholesterol; no heart or lung disease, no swallowing problems, no previous choking
treatments: Coached coughing while the obstruction was partial; abdominal thrusts in sets of five once it was complete
Controlled lowering to the floor; chest compressions at once with no pulse check
Airway inspected after 30 compressions, no blind sweeps; steak removed under direct vision; suction
CPR 30:2 with BVM and oxygen; AED applied by the partner during CPR, two analyses, no shock advised
ROSC at 1925: oxygen 15 L NRB titrated to SpO2 94% or above, airway-protecting position, RTC transport
Entonox and oral analgesics withheld (altered LOC); pain reassessed with each set
PCP: vascular access en route; hospital notified en route
findings: Stage 1 partial obstruction, stage 2 complete obstruction, stage 3 collapse with no chest movement
Baseline after ROSC: GCS 13, BP 158/96, pulse 116, resps 22, SpO2 92% on 15 L, BGL 6.4
Set 2: GCS 14, BP 146/88, pulse 102, resps 18, SpO2 96%
Hoarse voice, sternal tenderness from compressions, mild upper abdominal tenderness from thrusts, no injury from the lowering

dispatch.narrativeEn: Dispatch update en route: the server says the man swallowed a piece of steak, nobody has touched him, and the restaurant has no AED.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 途中调度更新：服务员称该男子吞下了一块牛排，尚无人对他施救，餐厅没有 AED。

scene.narrativeEn: Busy steakhouse dining room with music playing. The patient, a 58-year-old man, is standing beside the table, red-faced, coughing and making high-pitched noises.
scene.narrativeZh: 牛排餐厅用餐区客满，播放着音乐。患者是一名 58 岁男性，站在餐桌旁，面色涨红，正在咳嗽并发出尖细的声音。

rows.en: The floor is clear tile, the table is cleared and the chairs are pushed back, no spills and no other hazards
rows.zh: 地面是干净的瓷砖，餐桌已清空、椅子已推开，无洒落物，无其他危险

rows.en: Choking - his wife says he swallowed a large piece of steak without chewing
rows.zh: 噎食——妻子说他没嚼就吞下了一大块牛排

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: Your partner is with you carrying the AED, suction, BVM and oxygen
rows.zh: 你的搭档与你同行，带着 AED、吸引器、球囊面罩和氧气

rows.en: Diners stand in a loose circle around a corner table; his wife is beside him, panicking
rows.zh: 食客在角落餐桌周围围成松散的一圈；他的妻子在旁边惊慌失措

rows.en: Standing beside the table, red-faced, coughing forcefully, making high-pitched noises; whispers 'steak'. Stage 3: lowered to the floor by the candidate and partner with no head strike
rows.zh: 站在餐桌旁，面色涨红，用力咳嗽并发出尖细的声音，低声说「牛排」。第 3 阶段：考生与搭档把他平稳放到地上，头部未着地

rows.en: Stage 1: alert. Stage 2: still alert. Stage 3: unresponsive to voice and pain
rows.zh: 第 1 阶段：清醒。第 2 阶段：仍清醒。第 3 阶段：对言语和疼痛均无反应

rows.en: Stage 1 partial obstruction: noisy high-pitched air movement. Stage 2 complete obstruction: no voice, no cough, no air movement. Stage 3: after 30 compressions the airway is opened and looked into - nothing is visible and the breath attempt does not go in. After ROSC: airway open, hoarse voice, no stridor, no food visible
rows.zh: 第 1 阶段部分梗阻：空气流动有杂音、声音尖细。第 2 阶段完全梗阻：无声音、无咳嗽、无气流。第 3 阶段：30 次按压后打开气道并查看——口中看不到任何异物，尝试吹气吹不进去。ROSC 后：气道开放，声音嘶哑，无喉鸣，口中看不到食物

rows.en: Stage 1: forceful cough. Stage 2: no air movement. Stage 3: no chest movement. After ROSC: 22, adequate depth, occasional cough, equal air entry
rows.zh: 第 1 阶段：咳嗽有力。第 2 阶段：无气流。第 3 阶段：胸廓无起伏。ROSC 后：22 次/分，深度足够，偶有咳嗽，双侧进气对称

rows.en: Stage 1: radial pulse 120, strong. Stage 3: start chest compressions at once - NO pulse check. After ROSC: carotid and radial pulse 116, strong, regular
rows.zh: 第 1 阶段：桡动脉 120 次/分、有力。第 3 阶段：立即开始胸外按压——不做脉搏检查。ROSC 后：颈动脉和桡动脉脉搏 116 次/分、有力、规则

rows.en: Stage 1: flushed. Stage 2: lips turning blue. Stage 3: dusky. After ROSC: pale, cool, diaphoretic, lips pink
rows.zh: 第 1 阶段：潮红。第 2 阶段：嘴唇开始发紫。第 3 阶段：发暗发青。ROSC 后：苍白、发凉、出汗，嘴唇红润

rows.en: After ROSC: 92% on 15 L NRB
rows.zh: ROSC 后：15 L 非再吸入面罩下 92%

rows.en: After ROSC: no injury from the lowering, tender over the sternum from compressions, mild upper abdominal tenderness from the thrusts, no vomit, no medical-alert jewelry
rows.zh: ROSC 后：无放倒造成的损伤，胸骨处因按压而压痛，冲击所致上腹轻度压痛，无呕吐物，无医疗警示饰品

rows.en: NOT indicated (choking, no trauma, controlled lowering)
rows.zh: 无颈椎固定指征（噎食、无外伤、平稳放倒）

initial.noteEn: Give each finding only when assessed. If the candidate encourages him to cough forcefully and stays with him, after about 30 seconds the cough stops and he grabs his throat with both hands (the universal choking sign): stage 2. If the candidate thrusts while he is still coughing forcefully, note the error and move straight to stage 2. Abdominal thrusts (or back slaps / chest thrusts, alternating in sets of five) do not dislodge the object; after 2 sets he goes limp: stage 3. The candidate must start chest compressions at once with NO pulse check. After ROSC, findings are given when reassessed. UNSTABLE: complete airway obstruction progressing to cardiac arrest; now post-ROSC with altered LOC.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。若考生鼓励他用力咳嗽并守在他身边，约 30 秒后咳嗽停止，他双手抓住喉咙（窒息通用手势）：进入第 2 阶段。若考生在他仍在用力咳嗽时就做冲击，记录该错误并直接进入第 2 阶段。腹部冲击（或背部拍击/胸部冲击，以五次为一组交替进行）无法排出异物；2 组之后他瘫软：进入第 3 阶段。考生必须立即开始胸外按压，不做脉搏检查。ROSC 后的发现在再次评估时给出。不稳定：完全性气道梗阻进展为心脏骤停；现为 ROSC 后意识改变。

rows.en: Choked on a large piece of steak
rows.zh: 被一大块牛排噎住

rows.en: Coughing, could not clear it; nobody touched him before you arrived; no loss of consciousness until the collapse
rows.zh: 咳嗽，自己无法清除；你们到场前没有人碰过他；倒地之前没有意识丧失

rows.en: Worse with deep breaths
rows.zh: 深呼吸时加重

rows.en: Constant
rows.zh: 持续存在

rows.en: Chest wall over the sternum; upper abdomen
rows.zh: 胸骨处胸壁；上腹

rows.en: No relief
rows.zh: 无缓解

rows.en: Sternum 6/10, upper abdomen 4/10
Started coughing at about 1910
rows.zh: 约 19:10 开始咳嗽

rows.en: Penicillin (rash)
rows.zh: 青霉素（皮疹）

rows.en: Ramipril and atorvastatin, no blood thinners
rows.zh: 雷米普利和阿托伐他汀，无抗凝药

rows.en: Hypertension, high cholesterol, no heart or lung disease, no swallowing problems, no previous choking episodes
rows.zh: 高血压、高胆固醇，无心脏或肺部疾病，无吞咽问题，以前没有噎食过

rows.en: Bread and salad, then the steak, two glasses of red wine; nothing since the steak
rows.zh: 面包和沙拉，然后是牛排，两杯红酒；牛排之后没有再吃喝

rows.en: They were out for their anniversary dinner; he was talking and laughing, swallowed a large piece of steak without chewing; the server called
rows.zh: 两人在庆祝结婚纪念日晚餐；他边说边笑，没嚼就吞下一大块牛排；服务员报了警

history.noteEn: The wife answers (the patient is confused after ROSC and repeats 'what happened?'; use the wife as the main source). The patient gives a few words when asked about pain.
history.noteZh: 由妻子回答（患者在 ROSC 后意识错乱，反复问「发生什么了？」；以妻子为主要信息来源）。询问疼痛时患者用几个词回答。

sets.rxZh: ROSC 后的基线，3 分钟内

sets.rxEn: En route, about 6 minutes after set 1
sets.rxZh: 途中，第 1 组后约 6 分钟

vitals.noteEn: Set 1 is the baseline within 3 minutes of ROSC (no protocol drug is given on this call). GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6, confused, repeats the same question). SpO2 92% on 15 L NRB, rising. BGL indicated (altered LOC after the arrest); temperature not indicated. Priority patient: the second set is due within 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs, the pulse and all interventions after every move (floor to cot, cot to ambulance) and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, about 6 minutes after set 1): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6, still confused about the last few minutes but orienting better). BGL not repeated. Improving - document the trend; if the signs of life are lost at any reassessment, compressions restart at once and the AED analyzes.
vitals.noteZh: 第 1 组为 ROSC 后 3 分钟内的基线（本次呼救不给任何协议药物）。GCS 13（E3 V4 M6，意识错乱，反复问同一个问题）。SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 92%，正在上升。血糖有指征（骤停后意识改变）；体温无指征。优先患者：第 2 组应在 5-6 分钟内完成。每次移动（地面到担架床、担架床到救护车）后以及至少每 5 分钟复评 ABC、脉搏和全部处置。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组后约 6 分钟）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6，对最近几分钟仍模糊但定向力在好转）。血糖不需复测。病情好转——记录趋势；若任何一次复评发现生命征象消失，立即重新按压并让 AED 分析。

rows.en: Well all day, tired now
rows.zh: 一整天都很好，现在疲倦

rows.en: Confused about the last few minutes, no headache, no weakness
rows.zh: 对最近几分钟的事情模糊，无头痛，无无力

rows.en: Sore throat, hoarse voice, cough, no wheeze
rows.zh: 咽痛、声音嘶哑、咳嗽，无喘鸣

rows.en: Heart racing now, no chest pain before the choking, no palpitations before dinner
rows.zh: 现在心跳快，噎住之前没有胸痛，晚餐前没有心悸

rows.en: Nausea, sore upper abdomen, no vomiting
rows.zh: 恶心、上腹疼痛，无呕吐

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

rows.en: Chest wall sore over the sternum, no other pain
rows.zh: 胸骨处胸壁酸痛，无其他疼痛

rows.en: No diabetes
rows.zh: 无糖尿病

rows.en: Scratchy swollen-feeling throat, no mouth bleeding, no loose teeth
rows.zh: 喉咙发痒且有肿胀感，口腔无出血，牙齿无松动

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route, brief. From the patient (now answering in short sentences) with the wife helping.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，途中从简。由患者（现在能用短句回答）回答、妻子协助。

rows.en: Hoarse voice, mild redness at the back of the throat, no swelling, no stridor, trachea midline, no JVD, no scalp injury
rows.zh: 声音嘶哑，咽后壁轻度发红，无肿胀，无喉鸣，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张，头皮无损伤

rows.en: Tender over the sternum, no crepitus or deformity, equal air entry on 6-site auscultation, no wheeze
rows.zh: 胸骨处压痛，无捻发感或畸形，6 点听诊双侧进气对称，无喘鸣

rows.en: Soft, not distended, mild upper tenderness from the thrusts, no guarding
rows.zh: 软，不胀，冲击所致上腹轻度压痛，无肌紧张

rows.en: Nil, no injury from the lowering
rows.zh: 无，放倒时无损伤

rows.en: Nil, radial pulses present, CSM intact
rows.zh: 无，桡动脉搏动存在，远端 CSM 完好

rows.en: Nil, pedal pulses present, CSM intact
rows.zh: 无，足背动脉搏动存在，远端 CSM 完好

scenarios.titleEn: Acute Pulmonary Edema at 0300 - Sitting Upright, CPAP
scenarios.titleZh: 凌晨 03:00 急性肺水肿——端坐位与 CPAP
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0300 hrs. Code 3 to a townhouse in Coquitlam. 74-year-old male with severe shortness of breath; his wife says he woke up unable to breathe. Fire is not attending. Hospital is 12 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 03:00，Code 3 前往高贵林一处联排住宅。74 岁男性严重气促；其妻称他醒来后喘不上气。消防不出动。医院车程 12 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: his wife says he is sitting on the edge of the bed leaning forward and cannot lie down. The bedroom is on the second floor, up a narrow staircase. She will leave the front door unlocked and wait for you at the top of the stairs.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：其妻称他坐在床沿、身体前倾，无法平躺。卧室在二楼，要上一段狭窄的楼梯。她会把前门留着不锁，在楼梯口等你们。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan oxygen, upright positioning, CPAP (PCP) or BVM, a stair chair / carry device and early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备氧气、直立体位、CPAP（PCP）或球囊面罩、爬楼椅/搬运设备，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch a likely unstable respiratory-distress call: severe shortness of breath, unable to lie down
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即预判这很可能是不稳定的呼吸窘迫：严重气促、无法平躺

expected.actionEn: Fire is not attending: consider additional resources (e.g. First Responders) to help carry him down the stairs (p.10)
expected.actionZh: 消防不出动：考虑增派资源（如 First Responders）协助把他抬下楼（p.10）

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a coughing patient: PPE incl eye protection
expected.actionZh: 预判患者咳嗽：个人防护含护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The second-floor bedroom is reached by a narrow staircase; the lights are on and the room is at normal temperature. The patient sits on the edge of the bed, leaning forward with his hands on his knees and his feet on the floor, using his shoulders and neck to breathe, speaking only a few words at a time. His skin is pale and glistening with sweat. His wife stands in the doorway holding a bag of his medications. No hazards. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：二楼卧室，要经过狭窄的楼梯上去；灯亮着，室温正常。患者坐在床沿，身体前倾、双手撑膝、双脚着地，靠肩颈肌肉辅助呼吸，每次只能说几个词。皮肤苍白、满是汗珠。妻子站在门口，手里拿着他的药袋。无危险源。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none; narrow stairs), environment, nature of illness (severe shortness of breath, possible cardiac cause), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无；楼梯狭窄）、环境、发病性质（严重气促，可能为心源性）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection (coughing patient)
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜（患者咳嗽）

expected.actionEn: First look: sitting forward in a tripod position, shoulder and neck muscles working, a few words at a time, pale and sweaty
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：前倾三脚架坐姿、肩颈肌肉在用力、每次只能说几个词、苍白出汗

expected.actionEn: Plan egress: narrow staircase means a seated carry (stair chair / carry device); bring the equipment to the patient and keep his exertion to a minimum (p.33)
expected.actionZh: 规划撤离：楼梯狭窄，须坐姿搬运（爬楼椅/搬运设备）；把设备带到患者身边，尽量减少他的体力消耗（p.33）

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake and alert, anxious, sitting bolt upright, answers in 3-4 word phrases ('can't... catch... my breath'), says it feels like he is drowning, and follows simple commands. If the candidate lays him back or flat he panics, his SpO2 falls and he sits bolt upright again. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - patent, wet gurgly voice, a little pink-tinged frothy sputum when he coughs, no stridor; respirations 32, laboured with accessory muscle use, bilateral crackles to the mid-fields with a few expiratory wheezes, air entry equal, chest rise symmetrical; radial pulse 112 strong and regular. Skin: pale, cool, sweaty. RBS: no trauma; both ankles swollen with pitting edema. SpO2 84% RA. C-spine NOT indicated. UNSTABLE: respiratory distress with accessory muscle use.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒警觉、焦虑，笔直端坐，每次只能说 3-4 个词（「喘…不上…气」），说感觉像在溺水，能执行简单指令。若考生让他向后躺或平躺，他会惊恐、SpO2 下降并立刻重新坐直。考官（评估时给出）：气道——通畅，声音湿润带痰鸣，咳嗽时有少量粉红色泡沫痰，无喉鸣；呼吸 32 次/分、费力、动用辅助呼吸肌，双肺自肺底至中野可闻湿啰音并有少量呼气相喘鸣，进气对称、胸廓起伏对称；桡动脉 112 次/分、有力、规则。皮肤：苍白、发凉、出汗。RBS：无外伤；双踝肿胀，呈凹陷性水肿。SpO2 室内空气 84%。无颈椎固定指征。不稳定：呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌使用。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert; check that he follows commands (needed for the CPAP decision)
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert；确认他能执行指令（CPAP 决策所需）

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (medical, no trauma)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（内科、无外伤）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway: patent but wet voice and frothy sputum, no stridor; have suction ready
expected.actionZh: 评估气道：通畅但声音湿润、有泡沫痰，无喉鸣；备好吸引器

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: rate, effort, accessory muscle use, speech; auscultate both sides (crackles, wheezes, equal air entry)
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：频率、做功、辅助呼吸肌使用、说话；双侧听诊（湿啰音、喘鸣、进气是否对称）

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse rate, strength and regularity
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Perform the rapid body survey: no trauma; find the swollen ankles (pitting edema)
expected.actionZh: 做快速查体：无外伤；发现双踝肿胀（凹陷性水肿）

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale, cool, sweaty
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、发凉、出汗

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L NRB now, titrate to SpO2 94% or higher; if still below 94% add a nasal cannula under the mask at 15 L/min (p.33, p.50)
expected.actionZh: 立即高流量吸氧 15 L 非再吸入面罩，目标 SpO2 ≥ 94%；仍低于 94% 时在面罩下加鼻导管 15 L/min（p.33、p.50）

expected.actionEn: Keep him sitting upright with his legs hung down - do not lay him back; keep him at rest and warm, e.g. a blanket over the shoulders (p.33)
expected.actionZh: 让他保持端坐、双腿下垂——不要让他向后躺；保持安静休息并保暖，如肩部披毯（p.33）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Respiratory distress with accessory muscle use is on the unstable list = UNSTABLE, RTC. Do not delay for a full secondary survey - it is done en route. Ready to load within 15 minutes. The staircase is narrow: carry him seated (stair chair or carry device); he must not walk or exert himself. Delegate the crew and his wife (doors, equipment, medication bag).
phases.infoZh: 决策点。呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌使用属于不稳定标准=不稳定，RTC。不要为完成完整二次评估而拖延——二次评估途中完成。15 分钟内可装载。楼梯狭窄：用爬楼椅或搬运设备让他坐着抬下去；他不得自己行走或用力。指派搭档和他的妻子帮忙（开门、搬设备、带药袋）。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC (respiratory distress with accessory muscle use, p.7) and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC（呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌使用，p.7）并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Packaged seated with oxygen / CPAP running and ready to load within 15 minutes; secondary survey en route
expected.actionZh: 坐姿打包、氧气/CPAP 持续运行，15 分钟内可装载；二次评估途中完成

expected.actionEn: Delegate crew and wife effectively (doors, equipment, medication bag, stair chair)
expected.actionZh: 有效指挥搭档和患者妻子（开门、设备、药袋、爬楼椅）

expected.actionEn: Move him seated by stair chair / carry device - he does not walk or exert himself (avoid exertion during transfers, p.33)
expected.actionZh: 用爬楼椅/搬运设备让他坐着转运——不让他行走或用力（转运中避免体力消耗，p.33）

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (short phrases; the wife fills in): chief complaint 'I can't catch my breath'. He woke at about 0245, about 25 minutes before your arrival, gasping and feeling like he was drowning; he had to sit up and still could not get his breath. Sudden onset. Worse lying flat and with any movement; only a little better sitting up. Cough with a little pink-tinged frothy sputum. No chest pain or chest pressure, no pain anywhere. Breathlessness is the worst he has ever had. Heart racing and sweating; more breathless on stairs for two weeks, three pillows for the last week, ankles swollen for several days. No fever, no nausea or vomiting, no fall or injury. PMHx: congestive heart failure, heart attack with a stent 6 years ago, high blood pressure, high cholesterol. Meds: furosemide 40 mg daily (ran out 3 days ago), ramipril 5 mg daily, metoprolol 50 mg twice daily, atorvastatin 20 mg daily, nitroglycerin spray prn (not used tonight). Allergies: penicillin (rash). LOI: dinner at 1800, water at the bedside since.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员（短句作答；由妻子补充）：主诉「我喘不上气」。约 02:45（到场前约 25 分钟）醒来，大口喘气，感觉像在溺水；坐起来后仍喘不上气。起病突然。平躺和任何活动都加重；坐起来只稍好一点。咳嗽，有少量粉红色泡沫痰。无胸痛、无胸闷压迫感，全身无疼痛。气促是他历来最重的一次。心跳快、出汗；两周来上楼就更喘，近一周要垫三个枕头睡，脚踝肿了好几天。无发热、无恶心呕吐、无跌倒或外伤。既往史：充血性心力衰竭、6 年前心肌梗死并放置支架、高血压、高血脂。用药：呋塞米 40 mg 每日（3 天前用完）、雷米普利 5 mg 每日、美托洛尔 50 mg 每日两次、阿托伐他汀 20 mg 每日、硝酸甘油喷雾按需（今晚未用）。过敏：青霉素（皮疹）。最后进食：18:00 晚餐，之后床边喝水。

BGL not indicated (alert, not diabetic, cause evident). Temp not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS (CHF / Pulmonary Edema protocol, p.33): baseline vitals done first; keep him at rest and avoid exertion (bring the equipment to him, carry him seated down the stairs); position sitting upright with the legs hung down; keep him warm and protect him from heat loss; oxygen to keep SpO2 94% or higher (15 L NRB, then a nasal cannula added under the mask at 15 L/min if still below 94%, p.50); assist ventilations by BVM if SpO2 stays below 94%; transport. NOT indicated here: nitroglycerin (the monograph indication is chest discomfort that appears cardiac in nature, p.73 - he has none, and it is not among the p.33 interventions), ASA (chest pain or atypical symptoms of ischemia, p.60 - none), ipratropium (severe bronchospasm in asthma or COPD, p.70 - none), a fluid bolus (the Hypovolemia protocol needs SBP below 90, p.54 - his is 172) and a bronchodilator such as salbutamol (p.33 lists none for CHF / pulmonary edema, and he has no asthma/COPD history; textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: wheeze among bilateral crackles from pulmonary edema is not bronchospasm, so p.77 does not apply). PCP ON SCENE: CPAP (p.33, p.51-53). INDICATIONS, all met: age 13 or over, significant respiratory distress, awake and following commands, patent airway, respirations 32 (above 24), SpO2 89% on oxygen (below 94%), accessory muscle use. CONTRAINDICATIONS the candidate must verbalize as absent: age 12 or under; decreased LOC or unable to follow commands; respiratory arrest or hypoventilation; imminent or actual respiratory failure (slow, shallow respirations, falling LOC); unable to fit a mask to the face; vomiting or other aspiration risk; traumatic cause; tracheostomy; suspected or known pneumothorax (equal air entry, no trauma); SBP below 90 (his is 172). TECHNIQUE: start at 5 L/min with the valve at 5 cmH2O, obtain a facial seal, reassess patient and vitals, then repeat in 2.5 cmH2O increments (7.5 cmH2O = 7 L/min, 10 cmH2O = 8 L/min) to a maximum of 10 cmH2O. IF HE DETERIORATES: remove CPAP and ventilate with the BVM (PEEP valve 5 cmH2O to start, up in 2.5 cmH2O steps to a maximum of 10; remove the PEEP valve if SBP falls below 90).
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用（CHF / 肺水肿协议，p.33）：先完成基线生命体征；让他保持安静、避免用力（把设备带到他身边，坐姿抬下楼）；端坐位、双腿下垂；保暖并防止热量散失；吸氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%（15 L 非再吸入面罩，仍低于 94% 时在面罩下加鼻导管 15 L/min，p.50）；SpO2 持续低于 94% 时用球囊面罩辅助通气；转运。此例不适用：硝酸甘油（药物专论的指征是看似心源性的胸部不适，p.73——他没有，且它不在 p.33 的处置项内）、ASA（胸痛或缺血的非典型症状，p.60——没有）、异丙托溴铵（用于哮喘或 COPD 的严重支气管痉挛，p.70——没有）、补液（低血容量协议要求收缩压低于 90，p.54——他是 172）以及沙丁胺醇等支气管扩张剂（p.33 对 CHF / 肺水肿未列此类药，且他无哮喘/COPD 病史；教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：肺水肿时夹杂在双肺湿啰音中的喘鸣不是支气管痉挛，因此 p.77 不适用）。PCP 现场：CPAP（p.33、p.51-53）。指征，全部满足：年龄 ≥ 13 岁、明显呼吸窘迫、清醒且能执行指令、气道通畅、呼吸 32 次/分（> 24）、吸氧下 SpO2 89%（< 94%）、动用辅助呼吸肌。考生须口述以下禁忌均不存在：年龄 ≤ 12 岁；意识下降或不能执行指令；呼吸停止或通气不足；即将或已发生呼吸衰竭（呼吸慢而浅、意识下降）；面罩无法贴合面部；呕吐或其他误吸风险；创伤性病因；气管造口；疑似或已知气胸（进气对称、无外伤）；收缩压 < 90（他是 172）。操作：起始 5 L/min、阀门 5 cmH2O，取得面部密封，复评患者和生命体征，然后每次增加 2.5 cmH2O（7.5 cmH2O = 7 L/min，10 cmH2O = 8 L/min），最高 10 cmH2O。若病情恶化：撤下 CPAP，改用球囊面罩通气（PEEP 阀从 5 cmH2O 开始，每次增加 2.5 cmH2O，最高 10；收缩压降到 90 以下时取下 PEEP 阀）。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the CHF / Pulmonary Edema protocol with correct indications (CHF history + signs of pulmonary edema) and the baseline vitals already done: at rest, sitting upright with legs down, kept warm, oxygen to SpO2 94% or higher

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that no bronchodilator is among the p.33 interventions (no asthma/COPD history, so the p.49 protocol and ipratropium p.70 do not apply either) and that no fluid bolus is given: SBP 172 is far above the 90 the Hypovolemia protocol needs (p.54)

expected.actionZh: EMR：高流量吸氧后 SpO2 仍低于 94%——用球囊面罩和氧气辅助通气（p.33、p.11）

expected.actionEn: PCP: state that every CPAP indication is met (age 13 or over, significant respiratory distress, awake and following commands, patent airway, RR 32 above 24, SpO2 89% below 94% on O2, accessory muscle use)

expected.actionEn: PCP: verbalize each CPAP contraindication as absent (age 12 or under; decreased LOC / cannot follow commands; respiratory arrest or hypoventilation; imminent respiratory failure; mask will not fit; vomiting or aspiration risk; traumatic cause; tracheostomy; pneumothorax; SBP below 90)
expected.actionZh: PCP：逐条口述 CPAP 禁忌均不存在（年龄 ≤ 12 岁；意识下降/不能执行指令；呼吸停止或通气不足；即将呼吸衰竭；面罩无法贴合；呕吐或误吸风险；创伤性病因；气管造口；气胸；收缩压 < 90）

expected.actionEn: PCP: apply CPAP correctly - explain the mask, start at 5 L/min with the valve at 5 cmH2O, obtain a facial seal, reassess patient and vitals, then 2.5 cmH2O steps (7.5 cmH2O = 7 L/min) to a maximum of 10 cmH2O (8 L/min) (p.52-53)
expected.actionZh: PCP：正确应用 CPAP——向患者说明面罩，起始 5 L/min、阀门 5 cmH2O，取得面部密封，复评患者和生命体征，再每次增加 2.5 cmH2O（7.5 cmH2O = 7 L/min），最高 10 cmH2O（8 L/min）（p.52-53）

expected.actionZh: 指导并安抚患者：说明每一步的目的，让他保持镇定与安静

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and the effect of oxygen and CPAP after every CPAP adjustment and after each move (seated carry down the stairs, loading). Set 2 (6 minutes after set 1, PCP on CPAP at 7.5 cmH2O): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 164/92; pulse 104 regular; respirations 26, less laboured, speaks 4-5 words at a time; skin pale, cool, less sweaty; pupils equal; SpO2 94% on CPAP. EMR (no CPAP), after assisted ventilations by BVM: respirations 28, SpO2 92%, still laboured - keep assisting and transport. BGL and temperature not repeated. Improving - document the response. DETERIORATION BRANCH: if the candidate does not reassess within 6 minutes, or the patient becomes drowsy and breathes slowly and shallowly (respirations 10), CPAP must come off and he must be ventilated with a BVM (PEEP valve 5 cmH2O to start).
phases.infoZh: 每次调整 CPAP 后及每次移动后（坐姿抬下楼、装车）复评 ABC 以及氧疗和 CPAP 的效果。第 2 组（第 1 组后 6 分钟，PCP 在 CPAP 7.5 cmH2O 下）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 164/92；脉搏 104 规则；呼吸 26、费力减轻、每次说 4-5 个词；皮肤苍白、发凉、出汗减少；瞳孔等大；CPAP 下 SpO2 94%。EMR（无 CPAP），球囊面罩辅助通气后：呼吸 28、SpO2 92%、仍费力——继续辅助并转运。血糖和体温不需复测。病情好转——记录治疗反应。恶化分支：若考生 6 分钟内未复评，或患者变得嗜睡、呼吸又慢又浅（呼吸 10 次/分），必须撤下 CPAP，改用球囊面罩通气（PEEP 阀从 5 cmH2O 开始）。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and the effect of oxygen / CPAP after each CPAP adjustment
expected.actionZh: 每次调整 CPAP 后复评 ABC 及氧疗/CPAP 的效果

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and mask seal / SpO2 after each major move (seated carry down the stairs, loading) (p.10)
expected.actionZh: 每次重大移动（坐姿抬下楼、装车）后复评 ABC、面罩密封与 SpO2（p.10）

expected.actionEn: Second full vitals within 5-6 minutes; interpret the improving trend
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征；解读好转趋势

expected.actionEn: PCP: if he becomes drowsy, breathes slowly and shallowly, or SBP falls below 90, remove CPAP and ventilate with the BVM (PEEP valve 5 cmH2O to start) (p.52)
expected.actionZh: PCP：若他变得嗜睡、呼吸又慢又浅或收缩压降到 90 以下，撤下 CPAP 并用球囊面罩通气（PEEP 阀从 5 cmH2O 开始）（p.52）

expected.actionEn: EMR: keep assisting ventilations while SpO2 is below 94%, stay upright and keep moving to hospital
expected.actionZh: EMR：SpO2 低于 94% 期间持续辅助通气，保持端坐位并继续送医

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off: CHF history, ran out of furosemide, no chest pain, presentation, baseline versus repeat vitals

expected.actionEn: Treatments with times and response: oxygen, CPAP start time and settings (PCP) or assisted ventilations (EMR); no nitroglycerin, salbutamol or fluids given
