criticalPitfallsEn: Laying the patient back or flat, or reclining the stretcher fully - the protocol requires sitting upright with the legs hung down (p.33): position error, and a protocol error up to 100%

Starting CPAP (or any protocol) without a baseline set of vital signs, or without stating the CPAP indications and ruling out every contraindication aloud (decreased LOC / cannot follow commands, SBP below 90, pneumothorax, vomiting or aspiration risk, mask will not fit) - 100%
Leaving a deteriorating patient (drowsy, slow shallow breathing, SBP below 90) on CPAP instead of removing it and ventilating with the BVM and a PEEP valve (p.52) - 100%

Giving nitroglycerin or ASA without chest pain (p.73, p.60), ipratropium without asthma/COPD (p.70), or a fluid bolus with an SBP of 172 (p.54) - non-indicated treatments, protocol errors up to 25%; the same holds for salbutamol for the wheeze, which p.33 does not list (textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: wheeze among bilateral crackles from pulmonary edema is not bronchospasm)
Making him walk or exert himself (stairs) instead of a seated carry with the equipment brought to him (p.33) - 25%

EMR: not assisting ventilations when SpO2 stays below 94% on high-flow oxygen (p.33), or not escalating oxygen from the NRB to NRB plus nasal cannula (p.50) - breathing management / oxygen deductions up to 15%
Treating as non-RTC and completing a full on-scene secondary survey - transport category error, 25%
criticalPitfallsZh: 让患者向后躺或平躺，或把担架床完全放平——协议要求端坐位、双腿下垂（p.33）：体位错误，协议错误最高扣 100%
未做基线生命体征就启动 CPAP（或任何协议），或未口述 CPAP 指征、未逐条口述排除禁忌（意识下降/不能执行指令、收缩压 < 90、气胸、呕吐或误吸风险、面罩无法贴合）——扣 100%
对病情恶化（嗜睡、呼吸又慢又浅、收缩压 < 90）的患者不撤 CPAP，也不改用球囊面罩加 PEEP 阀通气（p.52）——扣 100%
无胸痛却给硝酸甘油或 ASA（p.73、p.60）、无哮喘/COPD 却给异丙托溴铵（p.70），或在收缩压 172 时补液（p.54）——给予无指征的治疗，协议错误最高扣 25%；因喘鸣而给沙丁胺醇同理，p.33 未列此药（教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：肺水肿时夹杂在双肺湿啰音中的喘鸣不是支气管痉挛）
让他自己走路或用力（上下楼梯），而不是把设备带到他身边、坐姿抬运（p.33）——扣 25%
EMR：高流量吸氧下 SpO2 仍低于 94% 却不辅助通气（p.33），或氧疗未从非再吸入面罩升级为面罩加鼻导管（p.50）——呼吸处理/氧疗最高扣 15%
当作非 RTC、在现场做完整二次评估——转运分类错误，扣 25%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: sit him upright with the legs hung down, keep him at rest and warm, high-flow oxygen by NRB (add a nasal cannula under the mask if SpO2 stays below 94%), assist ventilations with a BVM if SpO2 is still below 94% (p.33), and RTC with a seated carry. No CPAP or PEEP valve (PCP only). The patient's own nitroglycerin spray is not given: the CHF protocol (p.33) does not list it and the p.73 indication (chest discomfort that appears cardiac) is absent. (Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: some systems use nitroglycerin for hypertensive pulmonary edema; the BC guideline does not.) Salbutamol is not given for the wheeze (p.33 lists no bronchodilator; textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: wheeze among bilateral crackles from pulmonary edema is not bronchospasm). No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：让他端坐、双腿下垂，保持安静并保暖，用非再吸入面罩高流量吸氧（SpO2 仍低于 94% 时在面罩下加鼻导管），SpO2 仍低于 94% 时用球囊面罩辅助通气（p.33），坐姿抬运并按 RTC 转运。无 CPAP 或 PEEP 阀（仅 PCP）。不给患者自备的硝酸甘油喷雾：CHF 协议（p.33）未列此药，且 p.73 的指征（看似心源性的胸部不适）不存在。（教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：有些体系对高血压性肺水肿使用硝酸甘油，BC 指南未列。）不因喘鸣给沙丁胺醇（p.33 未列支气管扩张剂；教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：肺水肿时夹杂在双肺湿啰音中的喘鸣不是支气管痉挛）。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds, on scene, CPAP (state every indication, rule out every contraindication aloud; start 5 cmH2O at 5 L/min, facial seal, reassess, 2.5 cmH2O steps to a maximum of 10 cmH2O at 8 L/min), the BVM with a PEEP valve (5 cmH2O to start) if he deteriorates, and the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route. The CHF protocol does not call for vascular access, and a fluid bolus is NOT indicated (SBP 172, not below 90).
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加：现场 CPAP（口述全部指征、逐条口述排除禁忌；起始 5 L/min、5 cmH2O，取得面部密封，复评，每次增加 2.5 cmH2O，最高 10 cmH2O、8 L/min）、病情恶化时用球囊面罩加 PEEP 阀（从 5 cmH2O 开始），以及途中 9 系统功能问诊。CHF 协议并未要求建立静脉通路，且不应补液（收缩压 172，不低于 90）。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 74-year-old male with congestive heart failure, a previous heart attack with a stent, high blood pressure and high cholesterol, with sudden severe shortness of breath that woke him at about 0245 - worse lying flat, a little better sitting up, with a cough producing pink-tinged frothy sputum and no chest pain. He ran out of his furosemide 3 days ago; he also takes ramipril, metoprolol and atorvastatin, has a nitroglycerin spray that he did not use, and is allergic to penicillin (rash). On our arrival at 0310 he was sitting bolt upright in a tripod position, speaking 3-4 words at a time, respirations 32 with accessory muscle use, crackles to the mid-fields with a few expiratory wheezes, SpO2 84% on room air and 89% on 15 litres, BP 172/98, pulse 112, skin pale, cool and sweaty, GCS 15. Treatments: kept upright with his legs down, at rest and warm, high-flow oxygen, baseline vitals, then CPAP started at 0316 at 5 cmH2O and increased to 7.5 cmH2O at 0318, and a seated carry down the stairs. Six minutes after the baseline set, at 0320: SpO2 94% on CPAP, respirations 26, BP 164/92, pulse 104, speaking 4-5 words at a time. No nitroglycerin, salbutamol or fluids given.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 74 岁男性，有充血性心力衰竭、既往心肌梗死并放置支架、高血压和高血脂，02:45 左右突发严重气促将他憋醒——平躺加重、坐起稍好，咳粉红色泡沫痰，无胸痛。呋塞米 3 天前已用完；另服雷米普利、美托洛尔和阿托伐他汀，备有硝酸甘油喷雾但未使用，青霉素过敏（皮疹）。03:10 我们到场时他笔直端坐呈三脚架姿势，每次说 3-4 个词，呼吸 32 次/分并动用辅助呼吸肌，双肺自肺底至中野有湿啰音并有少量呼气相喘鸣，SpO2 室内空气 84%、15 升氧下 89%，血压 172/98，脉搏 112，皮肤苍白、发凉、出汗，GCS 15。处置：保持端坐、双腿下垂、安静保暖，高流量吸氧，完成基线生命体征，随后 03:16 开始 CPAP（5 cmH2O），03:18 增至 7.5 cmH2O，并坐姿抬下楼。基线后 6 分钟，即 03:20：CPAP 下 SpO2 94%，呼吸 26，血压 164/92，脉搏 104，每次说 4-5 个词。未给硝酸甘油、沙丁胺醇或补液。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Acute severe shortness of breath at night (acute pulmonary edema / CHF)
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Woke about 0245 gasping and 'drowning'; worse lying flat, three pillows for a week, pink-tinged frothy sputum, no chest pain; ran out of furosemide 3 days ago
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Congestive heart failure, previous MI with stent 6 years ago, hypertension, high cholesterol
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Furosemide 40 mg daily (ran out), ramipril 5 mg daily, metoprolol 50 mg twice daily, atorvastatin 20 mg daily, nitroglycerin spray prn (not used)
treatments: Kept at rest, sitting upright with legs down, kept warm
High-flow O2 15 L NRB (nasal cannula added if SpO2 stays below 94%)
PCP: CPAP started 0316 at 5 cmH2O, 7.5 cmH2O at 0318; EMR: BVM-assisted ventilations if SpO2 stays below 94%
Seated carry down the stairs, RTC transport with en-route notification
No nitroglycerin, ASA, salbutamol or fluids (indications absent)
findings: RR 32 with accessory muscle use, crackles to mid-fields with a few expiratory wheezes, JVD, bilateral ankle pitting edema
Baseline GCS 15, BP 172/98, pulse 112, SpO2 84% RA / 89% on 15 L NRB
On CPAP 7.5 cmH2O at 0320: SpO2 94%, RR 26, BP 164/92, pulse 104
BGL and temperature not indicated

dispatch.narrativeEn: His wife says he is sitting on the edge of the bed leaning forward and cannot lie down. The bedroom is on the second floor, up a narrow staircase. She will leave the front door unlocked and wait for you at the top of the stairs.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 其妻称他坐在床沿、身体前倾，无法平躺。卧室在二楼，要上一段狭窄的楼梯。她会把前门留着不锁，在楼梯口等你们。

scene.narrativeEn: The second-floor bedroom is reached by a narrow staircase; the lights are on and the room is at normal temperature. The patient sits on the edge of the bed, leaning forward with his hands on his knees and his feet on the floor, using his shoulders and neck to breathe, speaking only a few words at a time. His skin is pale and glistening with sweat.
scene.narrativeZh: 二楼卧室，要经过狭窄的楼梯上去；灯亮着，室温正常。患者坐在床沿，身体前倾、双手撑膝、双脚着地，靠肩颈肌肉辅助呼吸，每次只能说几个词。皮肤苍白、满是汗珠。

rows.en: No hazards. Lights on, normal room temperature; narrow staircase to the second-floor bedroom
rows.zh: 无危险源。灯亮着，室温正常；通往二楼卧室的楼梯狭窄

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: His wife stands in the doorway holding a bag of his medications
rows.zh: 妻子站在门口，手里拿着他的药袋

rows.en: Sitting bolt upright, anxious
rows.zh: 笔直端坐、焦虑

rows.en: Awake and alert; answers in 3-4 word phrases ('can't... catch... my breath'); says it feels like he is drowning; follows simple commands
rows.zh: 清醒警觉；每次只能说 3-4 个词（「喘…不上…气」）；说感觉像在溺水；能执行简单指令

rows.en: Patent; wet gurgly voice; a little pink-tinged frothy sputum when he coughs; no stridor
rows.zh: 通畅；声音湿润带痰鸣；咳嗽时有少量粉红色泡沫痰；无喉鸣

rows.en: 32, laboured with accessory muscle use; bilateral crackles to the mid-fields with a few expiratory wheezes; air entry equal, chest rise symmetrical
rows.zh: 32 次/分、费力、动用辅助呼吸肌；双肺自肺底至中野可闻湿啰音并有少量呼气相喘鸣；进气对称、胸廓起伏对称

rows.en: Radial pulse 112, strong and regular
rows.zh: 桡动脉 112 次/分、有力、规则

rows.en: Pale, cool, sweaty
rows.zh: 苍白、发凉、出汗

rows.en: 84% RA
rows.zh: 室内空气 84%

rows.en: No trauma; both ankles swollen with pitting edema
rows.zh: 无外伤；双踝肿胀，呈凹陷性水肿

rows.en: NOT indicated
rows.zh: 无颈椎固定指征

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed. If the candidate lays him back or flat he panics, his SpO2 falls and he sits bolt upright again. Stability: UNSTABLE - respiratory distress with accessory muscle use.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。若考生让他向后躺或平躺，他会惊恐、SpO2 下降并立刻重新坐直。判定：不稳定——呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌使用。

rows.en: 'I can't catch my breath'
rows.zh: 「我喘不上气」

rows.en: Woke gasping and feeling like he was drowning; had to sit up and still could not get his breath. Cough with a little pink-tinged frothy sputum
rows.zh: 醒来时大口喘气，感觉像在溺水；坐起来后仍喘不上气。咳嗽，有少量粉红色泡沫痰

rows.en: Sudden; woke at about 0245
rows.zh: 起病突然；约 02:45 醒来

rows.en: Worse lying flat and with any movement
rows.zh: 平躺和任何活动都加重

rows.en: No chest pain or chest pressure, no pain anywhere
rows.zh: 无胸痛、无胸闷压迫感，全身无疼痛

rows.en: Only a little better sitting up
rows.zh: 坐起来只稍好一点

rows.en: The worst breathlessness he has ever had
rows.zh: 气促是他历来最重的一次

rows.en: About 25 minutes before arrival
rows.zh: 到场前约 25 分钟

rows.en: Heart racing and sweating; more breathless on stairs for two weeks, three pillows for the last week, ankles swollen for several days. No fever, no nausea or vomiting, no fall or injury
rows.zh: 心跳快、出汗；两周来上楼就更喘，近一周要垫三个枕头睡，脚踝肿了好几天。无发热、无恶心呕吐、无跌倒或外伤

rows.en: Penicillin (rash)
rows.zh: 青霉素（皮疹）

rows.en: Furosemide 40 mg daily (ran out 3 days ago), ramipril 5 mg daily, metoprolol 50 mg twice daily, atorvastatin 20 mg daily, nitroglycerin spray prn (not used tonight)
rows.zh: 呋塞米 40 mg 每日（3 天前用完）、雷米普利 5 mg 每日、美托洛尔 50 mg 每日两次、阿托伐他汀 20 mg 每日、硝酸甘油喷雾按需（今晚未用）

rows.en: Congestive heart failure, heart attack with a stent 6 years ago, high blood pressure, high cholesterol
rows.zh: 充血性心力衰竭、6 年前心肌梗死并放置支架、高血压、高血脂

rows.en: Dinner at 1800, water at the bedside since
rows.zh: 18:00 晚餐，之后床边喝水

history.noteEn: Actor answers in short phrases; the wife fills in.
history.noteZh: 患者演员短句作答；由妻子补充。

sets.rxEn: On CPAP at 7.5 cmH2O (PCP); EMR after assisted ventilations by BVM
sets.rxZh: CPAP 7.5 cmH2O 下（PCP）；EMR 为球囊面罩辅助通气后

vitals.noteEn: Give each vital as it is properly assessed. Set 1 is the baseline BEFORE CPAP (required before initiating a protocol). SpO2 84% RA; 89% on 15 L NRB (still 89% with a nasal cannula added at 15 L). Speaks 3-4 words at a time, crackles to the mid-fields with a few expiratory wheezes. BGL not indicated (alert, not diabetic, cause evident); temperature not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs and the effect of oxygen and CPAP after every CPAP adjustment and after each move (seated carry down the stairs, loading). Set 2 (6 minutes after set 1, PCP on CPAP at 7.5 cmH2O): speaks 4-5 words at a time. EMR (no CPAP), after assisted ventilations by BVM: respirations 28, SpO2 92%, still laboured - keep assisting and transport. BGL and temperature not repeated. Improving - document the response. DETERIORATION BRANCH: if the candidate does not reassess within 6 minutes, or the patient becomes drowsy and breathes slowly and shallowly (respirations 10), CPAP must come off and he must be ventilated with a BVM (PEEP valve 5 cmH2O to start).
vitals.noteZh: 每项在考生规范评估时才给出。第 1 组为 CPAP 之前的基线（启动协议前必须完成）。SpO2 室内空气 84%；15 L 非再吸入面罩下 89%（再加鼻导管 15 L 仍为 89%）。每次说 3-4 个词，双肺自肺底至中野湿啰音伴少量呼气相喘鸣。血糖无指征（清醒、非糖尿病、病因明确）；体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。每次调整 CPAP 后及每次移动后（坐姿抬下楼、装车）复评 ABC 以及氧疗和 CPAP 的效果。第 2 组（第 1 组后 6 分钟，PCP 在 CPAP 7.5 cmH2O 下）：每次说 4-5 个词。EMR（无 CPAP），球囊面罩辅助通气后：呼吸 28、SpO2 92%、仍费力——继续辅助并转运。血糖和体温不需复测。病情好转——记录治疗反应。恶化分支：若考生 6 分钟内未复评，或患者变得嗜睡、呼吸又慢又浅（呼吸 10 次/分），必须撤下 CPAP，改用球囊面罩通气（PEEP 阀从 5 cmH2O 开始）。

rows.en: Tired and weak for a week
rows.zh: 乏力虚弱一周

rows.en: Anxious, no headache, no dizziness
rows.zh: 焦虑、无头痛、无头晕

rows.en: Breathless on stairs for two weeks, three pillows for the last week, cough with frothy sputum, breathing easier on CPAP
rows.zh: 两周来上楼就喘、近一周垫三个枕头、咳泡沫痰、戴 CPAP 后呼吸轻松些

rows.en: Heart racing, ankles swollen for several days, no chest pain
rows.zh: 心跳快、脚踝肿了好几天、无胸痛

rows.en: Bloated with a poor appetite, passing less urine since the furosemide ran out, no nausea or vomiting
rows.zh: 腹胀、食欲差、呋塞米用完后尿量减少、无恶心呕吐

rows.en: Sweaty, skin cool, ankles tight and swollen
rows.zh: 出汗、皮肤发凉、脚踝紧绷肿胀

rows.en: Legs heavy, no pain
rows.zh: 双腿沉重、无疼痛

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route AFTER CPAP is running, brief. Actor answers in short phrases.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，CPAP 已在运行后途中简要完成。患者演员短句作答。

rows.en: Jugular veins distended while sitting upright, trachea midline, no trauma
rows.zh: 坐位时颈静脉怒张、气管居中、无外伤

rows.en: Fine crackles from the bases to the mid-fields on 6-site auscultation, a few expiratory wheezes, air entry equal, chest rise symmetrical, no tenderness
rows.zh: 6 点听诊自肺底至中野可闻细湿啰音，少量呼气相喘鸣，进气对称、胸廓起伏对称，无压痛

rows.en: Soft, non-tender, mildly distended
rows.zh: 软、无压痛、轻度膨隆

rows.en: Fine crackles posteriorly, no trauma or tenderness
rows.zh: 背侧可闻细湿啰音，无外伤及压痛

rows.en: No edema, radial pulses strong, CSM intact
rows.zh: 无水肿，桡动脉脉搏有力，远端 CSM 完好

rows.en: Pitting edema to mid-shin on both sides, pulses present, CSM intact
rows.zh: 双侧凹陷性水肿至小腿中段，脉搏可触及，远端 CSM 完好

scenarios.titleEn: Two Days of Vomiting - Dehydration, Antiemetics and a Fluid Bolus
scenarios.titleZh: 呕吐两天——脱水、止吐药与补液
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0840 hrs. Code 3 to a ground-floor townhouse in Chilliwack. 71-year-old female with vomiting and diarrhea for two days, now too dizzy to stand. Her daughter called. Chilliwack General Hospital is 11 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 08:40，Code 3 前往奇利瓦克一处一楼联排住宅。71 岁女性，呕吐腹泻已两天，现在头晕得站不起来。女儿报警。奇利瓦克综合医院车程 11 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: the daughter says her mother has not kept any fluid down since last night and nearly fainted on the way to the bathroom this morning.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：女儿说母亲从昨晚起一点水也喝不进去，今早去卫生间的路上差点晕倒。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan oxygen, suction, a basin, blankets and (PCP) the IV and fluid set-up; anticipate dehydration or shock in an older patient
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备氧气、吸引器、呕吐盆、毛毯，（PCP）准备静脉和补液用物；预判老年患者的脱水或休克

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch that near-fainting after two days of vomiting may be an unstable hypovolemia call, not 'just the flu'
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即意识到呕吐两天后几乎晕厥可能是不稳定的低血容量，而不只是「肠胃炎」

expected.actionEn: Anticipate vomit and stool exposure: gloves and eye protection ready
expected.actionZh: 预判呕吐物与粪便暴露：备好手套和护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The patient's daughter meets you at the door of a ground-floor townhouse and leads you to the living room. The patient is semi-reclined on the sofa under a blanket, pale and sweaty, a plastic basin in her lap and vomit-stained towels on the floor. The room is warm, there are no hazards, and the ambulance can park at the door. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：患者女儿在一楼联排住宅门口迎接，并带你进客厅。患者半躺在沙发上盖着毯子，面色苍白、出冷汗，腿上放着塑料盆，地上有沾了呕吐物的毛巾。室内温暖，无危险源，救护车可停在门口。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment, nature of illness (vomiting and diarrhea, possible infectious gastroenteritis), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无）、环境、发病性质（呕吐和腹泻，可能为感染性胃肠炎）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection (vomit splash risk)
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜（呕吐物喷溅风险）

expected.actionEn: First look: pale, sweaty, weak, semi-reclined with a basin and soiled towels - looks dehydrated and unwell
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：苍白、出汗、虚弱，半躺着、旁边有盆和脏毛巾——看起来脱水且病得不轻

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake, pale and weak, speaking in short sentences: 'I'm so dizzy... I can't stop being sick.' EXAMINER (give when assessed): AVPU Alert, GCS 15. Airway patent, she is speaking and retching into the basin; the vomit is watery yellow-green with no blood or coffee-ground material - keep suction beside her. Respirations 24, shallow and regular, clear air entry both sides, no accessory muscle use. Radial pulse 118, weak and regular; capillary refill delayed at 4 seconds. Skin cool, pale and clammy, with dry mucous membranes and poor turgor. RBS (modified, medical): abdomen soft with mild diffuse tenderness around the umbilicus, no guarding or rigidity, not distended, no pulsatile mass; no signs of bleeding, no rash, no leg swelling. SpO2 95% on room air. C-spine NOT indicated (medical, no trauma). UNSTABLE: cool, pale, clammy skin secondary to suspected shock from fluid loss.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、苍白虚弱，用短句说：「好晕……吐个不停。」考官（评估时给出）：AVPU 为 Alert，GCS 15。气道通畅，能说话，正对着盆干呕；呕吐物为黄绿色水样，无血、无咖啡渣样物——吸引器放在身旁。呼吸 24 次/分，浅而规则，双侧进气清晰，无辅助呼吸肌动用。桡动脉 118 次/分，细弱规则；毛细血管再充盈延迟，4 秒。皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷，黏膜干燥，皮肤弹性差。快速查体（改良，内科）：腹软，脐周轻度弥漫压痛，无肌紧张或腹肌强直，不胀，无搏动性包块；无出血征象，无皮疹，双腿无水肿。SpO2 室内空气 95%。无颈椎固定指征（内科、无外伤）。不稳定：疑似失液性休克所致的皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert, GCS 15 - and state that any drift toward drowsiness would be a worsening sign
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert，GCS 15——并说明一旦出现嗜睡倾向即提示病情恶化

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (medical, no trauma)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（内科、无外伤）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway; she is retching, so keep suction and the basin within reach and check the vomit for blood
expected.actionZh: 评估气道；她在干呕，吸引器和呕吐盆放在手边，并查看呕吐物有无血迹

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing - rate, depth, air entry both sides, accessory muscle use; no respiratory distress
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸——频率、深度、双侧进气、辅助呼吸肌使用；无呼吸窘迫

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation - weak rapid radial pulse (118) and delayed capillary refill (4 seconds) mean poor perfusion; no external bleeding
expected.actionZh: 评估循环——桡动脉细弱而快（118）、毛细血管再充盈延迟（4 秒）提示灌注不良；无外出血

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey with a gentle abdominal exam - look for a pulsatile mass, guarding, bleeding and other causes of shock
expected.actionZh: 做改良快速查体并轻柔检查腹部——寻找搏动性包块、肌紧张、出血及其他休克原因

expected.actionEn: Note skin: cool, pale, clammy, dry mucous membranes, poor turgor
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：发凉、苍白、湿冷，黏膜干燥，皮肤弹性差

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L by non-rebreather - high flow is required in shock - and keep SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 非再吸入面罩 15 L 高流量吸氧——休克需要高流量——并维持 SpO2≥94%

expected.actionEn: Position supine to support blood pressure and keep her warm, with suction and the basin at hand and a plan to turn her onto her side if she vomits
expected.actionZh: 置仰卧位以支持血压并保暖，吸引器和呕吐盆放在手边，并有呕吐时将她翻向一侧的预案

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Cool, pale, clammy skin secondary to suspected shock, with a weak rapid radial pulse, is on the BC unstable-patient list: RTC, however harmless 'a stomach bug' sounds. Ready to load within 15 minutes; history, vitals, head-to-toe and the PCP treatments are done en route. The partner brings the stretcher to the sofa and the daughter collects the medications; the patient does not stand or walk.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷、疑似休克，伴桡动脉细弱而快，属于 BC 不稳定患者标准：无论「肠胃炎」听起来多轻，都是 RTC。15 分钟内可装载；病史、生命体征、从头到脚检查和 PCP 处置都在途中完成。搭档把担架床推到沙发旁，女儿收齐药物；患者不得自行站立或行走。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and name the criterion: cool, pale, clammy skin secondary to suspected shock (p.7), not 'just the flu'
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并说出依据：疑似休克所致的皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷（第 7 页），而不是「只是肠胃炎」

expected.actionEn: Packaged supine, warm and ready to load within 15 minutes, with the secondary survey done en route
expected.actionZh: 仰卧、保暖打包完毕，15 分钟内可装载，二次评估在途中完成

expected.actionEn: Delegate: the partner brings the stretcher, the daughter collects the medications; the patient is moved on the stretcher and never walked
expected.actionZh: 分派任务：搭档推来担架床，女儿收齐药物；患者用担架床转运，绝不让她步行

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (weak, short sentences; the daughter helps): chief complaint 'I can't stop being sick and I'm so dizzy.' Vomiting began 2 days ago, about 12 times in the last 24 hours, now only watery fluid, never blood. About 6 loose watery stools since yesterday, no blood or black stool. Crampy pain around the umbilicus in waves, no radiation, 4/10, worse with any attempt to drink and easing briefly after she vomits. Dizzy on standing and nearly fainted this morning on the way to the bathroom, no head strike. Feels hot and cold but no fever measured; no chest pain. Only a small amount of dark urine since yesterday. Her grandson had a stomach bug last week. Weight about 62 kg (the daughter confirms). PMHx: hypertension and type 2 diabetes; no heart failure, kidney or liver disease, no ulcers, no glaucoma, no asthma or COPD, no heart rhythm problem and no family history of long QT. Meds: ramipril 5 mg daily, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg daily, metformin 500 mg twice daily - none taken since yesterday morning because she vomited them; no blood thinners. Allergies: penicillin (rash); has taken Gravol (dimenhydrinate) before with no reaction. LOI: sips of water at 0600 this morning, vomited within minutes; last solid food was toast yesterday morning.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员（虚弱，只说短句，女儿协助）：主诉「吐个不停，而且好晕。」呕吐从 2 天前开始，过去 24 小时约吐 12 次，现在只吐水样液体，从未带血。从昨天起约 6 次稀水样便，无血便或黑便。脐周绞痛，阵发性，无放射，4/10，一喝水就加重，呕吐后短暂缓解。站起来就晕，今早去卫生间的路上差点晕倒，无头部撞击。忽冷忽热但没测过体温；无胸痛。从昨天起只排了少量深色尿。孙子上周得过肠胃炎。体重约 62 kg（女儿确认）。既往史：高血压和 2 型糖尿病；无心衰、肾病或肝病，无溃疡，无青光眼，无哮喘或 COPD，无心律问题，家族无长 QT 综合征史。用药：雷米普利 5 mg 每日一次、氢氯噻嗪 12.5 mg 每日一次、二甲双胍 500 mg 每日两次——从昨天早上起因呕吐都没吃进去；不服抗凝药。过敏：青霉素（皮疹）；以前用过 Gravol（茶苯海明）无反应。最后进食：今早 06:00 喝了几口水，几分钟内吐出；最后一次固体食物是昨天早上的吐司。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: two days of vomiting with dizziness and weakness
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：呕吐两天伴头晕乏力

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRST and quantify the fluid loss: about 12 vomits in 24 hours, about 6 watery stools, scant dark urine, no intake, near-fainting, sick contact, no blood in vomit or stool
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRST 采集现病史并量化液体丢失：24 小时约 12 次呕吐、约 6 次水样便、尿少色深、几乎无摄入、几乎晕厥、有病人接触史、呕吐物和大便无血

expected.actionEn: Pain scale: crampy periumbilical pain 4/10
expected.actionZh: 疼痛评分：脐周绞痛 4/10

expected.actionEn: PMHx, asking the pertinent negatives for the drugs she may need: hypertension and diabetes; no heart rhythm problem or family long QT, no glaucoma, no asthma/COPD, no ulcer or liver disease
expected.actionZh: 既往史，并追问可能要用药物的相关阴性项：高血压和糖尿病；无心律问题或家族长 QT、无青光眼、无哮喘/COPD、无溃疡或肝病

expected.actionEn: Medications: ramipril, hydrochlorothiazide, metformin, none kept down since yesterday morning, no blood thinners
expected.actionZh: 用药史：雷米普利、氢氯噻嗪、二甲双胍，从昨天早上起都没吃进去，不服抗凝药

expected.actionEn: Allergies: penicillin (rash); no prior reaction to dimenhydrinate (Gravol)
expected.actionZh: 过敏史：青霉素（皮疹）；以前用茶苯海明（Gravol）无反应

expected.actionEn: LOI: sips of water at 0600 and vomited; no solid food since yesterday morning
expected.actionZh: 最后进食：06:00 喝了几口水并吐出；自昨天早上起无固体食物

expected.actionEn: Ask her weight (about 62 kg) from the daughter - needed for the 20 mL/kg bolus and any weight-based antiemetic dose (PCP)
expected.actionZh: 向女儿询问体重（约 62 kg）——20 mL/kg 补液和按体重计算的止吐药剂量需要它（PCP）

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (en route, the baseline BEFORE any fluid or antiemetic; completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 86/54, taken supine - do not sit or stand her for an orthostatic check; pulse 118 weak regular; respirations 24 shallow and regular; skin cool, pale and clammy with dry mucous membranes, poor turgor and capillary refill 4 seconds; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on 15 L NRB; BGL 5.2 mmol/L - indicated (older diabetic on metformin, almost nothing eaten for two days, weak and dizzy); temperature 37.8 C - indicated (gastroenteritis, possible infection). Pain 4/10. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（途中，给任何补液或止吐药之前的基线；3 分钟内完成）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 86/54，仰卧位测量——不要为查体位性血压让她坐起或站起；脉搏 118 细弱规则；呼吸 24 浅而规则；皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷，黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 98%；血糖 5.2 mmol/L——有指征（老年糖尿病患者服二甲双胍、两天几乎没进食、虚弱头晕）；体温 37.8 C——有指征（肠胃炎，可能有感染）。疼痛 4/10。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (15: E4 V5 M6)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（15：E4 V5 M6）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation, supine - recognize a systolic under 90 as the Hypovolemia protocol criterion and do not stand her for orthostatics
expected.actionZh: 仰卧位听诊测血压——识别收缩压低于 90 为低血容量协议的标准，不要让她站起查体位性血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate/strength/rhythm - rapid and weak
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律——快而弱

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on: temperature, colour, moisture, turgor, mucous membranes, capillary refill
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：温度、颜色、湿度、弹性、黏膜、毛细血管再充盈

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration, noting the reading before and after oxygen
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准，记录吸氧前后读数

expected.actionEn: BGL - indicated: older diabetic on metformin who has barely eaten for two days
expected.actionZh: 血糖——有指征：服二甲双胍的老年糖尿病患者，两天几乎没进食

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated: gastroenteritis with possible infection
expected.actionZh: 体温——有指征：胃肠炎，可能有感染

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, brief for the unstable patient. ACTOR (weak, still nauseated): general - tired and weak for 2 days, felt hot and cold; CNS - dizzy on standing, no headache, no confusion; respiratory - no cough or shortness of breath; cardiovascular - heart racing when she sits up, no chest pain, no ankle swelling; GI/GU - crampy central abdominal pain, nausea, about 12 vomits and 6 watery stools, small amounts of dark urine, no blood in the vomit or stool; integumentary - skin feels dry, no rash; musculoskeletal - calf cramps, no joint pain; endocrine - type 2 diabetes, very thirsty, no sugar readings at home for 2 days; EENT - dry mouth and cracked lips, no vision change, no ear pain.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简。患者演员（虚弱，仍恶心）：整体——乏力虚弱 2 天，忽冷忽热；中枢神经——站起来头晕，无头痛，无意识模糊；呼吸——无咳嗽或气短；心血管——坐起来心跳快，无胸痛，脚踝不肿；消化/泌尿——脐周绞痛、恶心，约 12 次呕吐和 6 次水样便，尿量少色深，呕吐物和大便无血；皮肤——皮肤发干，无皮疹；肌肉骨骼——小腿抽筋，无关节痛；内分泌——2 型糖尿病，非常口渴，2 天没测过血糖；眼耳鼻喉——口干唇裂，视力无变化，无耳痛。

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe (before fluid): head/neck - dry mucous membranes and tongue, sunken eyes, neck veins flat, trachea midline, no neck stiffness; chest - clear, equal air entry 6 sites; abdomen - soft, mild diffuse tenderness around the umbilicus, no guarding or rebound, not distended, active bowel sounds, no pulsatile mass; back - nil; lower extremities - pedal pulses weak but present, feet cool, no swelling, calves soft and non-tender, CSM intact; upper extremities - radial pulses weak, skin tents slowly on the forearm, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚（补液前）：头颈——黏膜和舌干燥、眼窝凹陷、颈静脉塌陷、气管居中、颈部无强直；胸部——清晰、6 点进气对称；腹部——软，脐周轻度弥漫压痛，无肌紧张或反跳痛，不胀，肠鸣音活跃，无搏动性包块；背部——无；下肢——足背动脉搏动弱但可触及，足发凉，无水肿，小腿软、无压痛，远端 CSM 完好；上肢——桡动脉搏动弱，前臂皮肤捏起后回缩缓慢，远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam: mucous membranes, eyes, neck veins, trachea
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体：黏膜、眼窝、颈静脉、气管

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation, recorded as the baseline before fluid
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊，作为补液前的基线记录

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam: tenderness, guarding, distension, pulsatile mass
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体：压痛、肌紧张、腹胀、搏动性包块

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities: pulses, temperature, swelling, calves, CSM
expected.actionZh: 下肢：脉搏、温度、水肿、小腿、CSM

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities: radial pulses, skin turgor, CSM, and choose the IV site
expected.actionZh: 上肢：桡动脉搏动、皮肤弹性、CSM，并选择静脉穿刺部位

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS (Nausea - Vomiting and Hypovolemia protocols): high-flow oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, supine to support blood pressure, warmth, suction and a basin within reach with a plan to turn her onto her side if she vomits, rest, nothing by mouth, and rapid transport. THE ANALGESIA TRAP: she has crampy abdominal pain, so each analgesic must be ruled out against its monograph before anything is given. Entonox: shock is a listed caution and nausea and vomiting are listed adverse effects - withhold. Acetaminophen: the monograph bars it when an overdose is suspected and lists vomiting among the symptoms that indicate one; her vomiting has a clear gastroenteritis cause and no overdose is suspected, so that line alone is not a hard stop, but hypovolemia is a listed caution and she cannot keep tablets down - withhold. Ibuprofen: an oral tablet cannot be retained while she vomits every few minutes - withhold. Methoxyflurane (PCP): the monograph limits it to conscious, hemodynamically stable patients and lists cardiac instability among its cautions, and she is hypotensive - withhold. Say each reason aloud and document it. PCP ADDITIONS, EN ROUTE (unstable patients are treated en route, not on scene): vascular access with aseptic technique; fluid bolus 20 mL/kg - 62 kg gives 1,240 mL, never more than 2 L - given in 500 mL steps, reassessing after each and aiming for a systolic of 90; then an antiemetic once the IV is running and its contraindications are ruled out. Ondansetron 4 mg PO: ask about allergy, congenital long QT in her and her family, and phenylketonuria (first-trimester pregnancy does not apply). Dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg, so 50 mg here: ask about hypersensitivity and weigh the listed cautions for the elderly and for hypertension; dilute with NS and give IV over about 2 minutes. The guideline lists dimenhydrinate first but states no preference, and names dimenhydrinate as the recommended antiemetic only when long QT is a concern. The examiner's preferred choice is ondansetron because dimenhydrinate adds drowsiness and tachycardia to a patient who is already dizzy and tachycardic; either is accepted if its contraindications are ruled out aloud. TXA is not indicated - this is fluid loss, not blood loss.
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用（恶心呕吐与低血容量协议）：高流量吸氧维持 SpO2≥94%、仰卧以支持血压、保暖、吸引器和呕吐盆放在手边并有呕吐时翻向一侧的预案、卧床休息、禁食禁水、快速转运。镇痛陷阱：她有绞痛样腹痛，用任何镇痛药前都必须对照药物专论逐项排除。Entonox：休克属于列明的慎用情形，恶心呕吐属于列明的不良反应——不给。对乙酰氨基酚：药物专论规定怀疑过量时禁用，并把呕吐列为提示过量的症状之一；她的呕吐病因明确是胃肠炎、并不怀疑过量，所以仅凭这一条不构成硬性禁忌，但低血容量属于列明的慎用情形，而且她咽不下药片——不给。布洛芬：她每隔几分钟就吐一次，口服药片留不住——不给。甲氧氟烷（PCP）：药物专论把它限定于清醒、血流动力学稳定的患者，并把心血管不稳定列为慎用项，而她正处于低血压——不给。每条理由都要大声说出并记录。PCP 追加，途中进行（不稳定患者在途中而不是现场处理）：无菌技术建立静脉通路；补液 20 mL/kg——62 kg 为 1,240 mL，上限 2 升——分 500 mL 一步，每步后复评，目标收缩压 90；静脉通路通畅且禁忌证排除后再给止吐药。昂丹司琼 4 mg 口服：询问过敏、本人及家族先天性长 QT 综合征、苯丙酮尿症（早孕不适用）。茶苯海明 1 mg/kg、上限 50 mg，本例即 50 mg：询问过敏，并权衡老年和高血压这两项列明的慎用情形；用 NS 稀释，约 2 分钟静脉推注。指南先列茶苯海明但未表明偏好，仅在存在长 QT 顾虑时指明茶苯海明为推荐的止吐药。考官倾向的选择是昂丹司琼，因为茶苯海明会给本已头晕、心率快的患者增加嗜睡和心动过速；只要大声排除了禁忌证，两者都接受。TXA 无指征——这是失液而不是失血。

expected.actionEn: Start the Hypovolemia protocol only with the indications confirmed and baseline vitals complete: fluid loss (about 12 vomits, 6 watery stools, no intake), systolic 86 (under 90) and other signs of shock (cool clammy skin, pulse 118, capillary refill 4 seconds)
expected.actionZh: 只有在指征确认且基线生命体征完成后才启动低血容量协议：液体丢失（约 12 次呕吐、6 次水样便、无摄入）、收缩压 86（低于 90）及其他休克征象（皮肤湿冷、脉搏 118、毛细血管再充盈 4 秒）

expected.actionEn: Airway management for a vomiting patient: suction and basin within reach, supine for blood pressure but ready to turn her onto her side, suction any vomit at once
expected.actionZh: 呕吐患者的气道管理：吸引器和呕吐盆放在手边，为维持血压取仰卧但随时准备翻向一侧，一旦呕吐立即吸引

expected.actionEn: Rule out each analgesic aloud and withhold them all (at PCP level including methoxyflurane, which is limited to hemodynamically stable patients): Entonox (shock caution, causes nausea and vomiting), acetaminophen (hypovolemia caution, vomiting is a listed overdose symptom so the cause must be clear, no tablet will stay down), ibuprofen (cannot keep an oral tablet down); document the reasons
expected.actionZh: 逐一大声排除各镇痛药并全部不给（PCP 级别还包括甲氧氟烷，它仅限血流动力学稳定的患者）：Entonox（休克慎用，且会引起恶心呕吐）、对乙酰氨基酚（低血容量慎用，呕吐是列明的过量症状故须先明确病因，药片也留不住）、布洛芬（留不住口服药片）；记录理由

expected.actionEn: Nothing by mouth; say that the IV, the fluid bolus and the antiemetic are PCP additions and that at EMR level the care is oxygen, position, warmth and rapid transport
expected.actionZh: 禁食禁水；说明静脉、补液和止吐药是 PCP 追加的内容，EMR 级别的处置是吸氧、体位、保暖和快速转运

expected.actionEn: PCP: IV with aseptic technique, then the NS bolus calculated from the weight - 62 kg x 20 mL/kg = 1,240 mL, never above 2 L - given in 500 mL steps
expected.actionZh: PCP：无菌技术建立静脉通路，再按体重计算 NS 补液——62 kg x 20 mL/kg = 1,240 mL，上限 2 升——分 500 mL 一步给予

expected.actionEn: PCP: give the antiemetic en route only after ruling out its contraindications aloud - ondansetron 4 mg PO (allergy, congenital long QT in her and her family, phenylketonuria) or dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg (hypersensitivity; elderly and hypertension cautions)
expected.actionZh: PCP：在途中、并先大声排除禁忌证后才给止吐药——昂丹司琼 4 mg 口服（过敏、本人及家族先天性长 QT、苯丙酮尿症）或茶苯海明 1 mg/kg、上限 50 mg（过敏；老年和高血压慎用）

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs (including breath sounds), the IV site and the bolus after every move and after each 500 mL. Set 2 (en route, about 6 minutes after set 1, with the first 500 mL of the bolus running and roughly 250 mL in; ondansetron has been given but its onset is 15-30 minutes, so the nausea is unchanged): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 94/58; pulse 110 stronger regular; respirations 22; skin cool, less clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 99% on 15 L NRB; pain 4/10; BGL and temperature not repeated. During the set she vomits a small amount of watery fluid - the candidate must suction or turn her without losing the vitals. Improving but not corrected: reassess at 500 mL against the SBP target of 90, then continue the 20 mL/kg (1,240 mL) in 500 mL steps. EMR PATH (no IV, no fluid): set 2 stays near baseline - BP 88/54, pulse 116, respirations 24.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC（含呼吸音）、静脉穿刺部位和补液。第 2 组（途中，距第 1 组约 6 分钟，补液第一个 500 mL 正在输入、已进约 250 mL；已给昂丹司琼但起效需 15-30 分钟，所以恶心未变）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 94/58；脉搏 110 较前有力规则；呼吸 22；皮肤发凉、湿冷减轻；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 99%；疼痛 4/10；血糖和体温不需复测。测量期间她吐出少量水样液体——考生须在不丢失生命体征的前提下吸引或将她翻向一侧。好转但尚未纠正：到 500 mL 时对照收缩压目标 90 复评，然后按 500 mL 一步继续完成 20 mL/kg（1,240 mL）。EMR 路径（无静脉、无补液）：第 2 组接近基线——血压 88/54，脉搏 116，呼吸 24。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs (including breath sounds), the IV site and the bolus after every move and after each 500 mL
expected.actionZh: 每次移动及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC（含呼吸音）、静脉穿刺部位和补液

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes; interpret the trend out loud as improving but not yet corrected
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征；大声解读趋势为好转但尚未纠正

expected.actionEn: Reassess after every 500 mL against the systolic target of 90 and complete the 20 mL/kg (1,240 mL) in 500 mL steps - not an open-ended or fixed volume
expected.actionZh: 每 500 mL 后对照收缩压目标 90 复评，并按 500 mL 一步完成 20 mL/kg（1,240 mL）——不是无限制或固定容量

expected.actionEn: Manage the vomit that happens during the set: suction and turn her onto her side, then resume the vitals
expected.actionZh: 处理测量期间出现的呕吐：吸引并将她翻向一侧，然后继续测量生命体征

expected.actionEn: Reassess the pain (4/10) and the nausea, and document that Entonox and oral analgesics stay withheld and why
expected.actionZh: 复评疼痛（4/10）和恶心，并记录 Entonox 和口服镇痛药继续不给及其理由

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (older woman in shock from fluid loss). Structured hand-off with the weight, the fluid volume and times, the antiemetic, and why the analgesics were withheld; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（失液性休克的老年女性）。结构化交接，含体重、补液量与时间、止吐药，以及为何不给镇痛药；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical patient: age, shock from fluid loss, blood pressure, treatment started
expected.actionZh: 危重患者途中预报：年龄、失液性休克、血压、已开始的处置

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with weight, fluid loss, vitals trend, fluid volume and time, antiemetic and time, and the analgesics withheld with reasons
expected.actionZh: 完整交接（体重、液体丢失、生命体征趋势、补液量与时间、止吐药与时间，以及不给镇痛药的理由）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes with drug and fluid times and the reasons Entonox and oral analgesics were withheld
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，含用药和补液时间，以及不给 Entonox 和口服镇痛药的理由

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, baseline before any fluid or antiemetic
vitalsSets.skin: cool, pale, clammy, dry mucous membranes, poor turgor, capillary refill 4 seconds

vitalsSets.timeHint: about 6 minutes later, en route, first 500 mL of the bolus running

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving Entonox, acetaminophen, ibuprofen or (PCP) methoxyflurane for the cramping without ruling out each contraindication - shock caution and nausea/vomiting as an adverse effect (Entonox, p.65), hypovolemia caution and vomiting as an overdose symptom (acetaminophen, p.58-59), an oral tablet that cannot be kept down, methoxyflurane limited to hemodynamically stable patients (p.71) - protocol error up to 100%
Starting the Hypovolemia protocol or the fluid bolus without a baseline set of vital signs or without confirming the indications (hypovolemia, systolic under 90, other signs of shock) - 100%

Giving ondansetron or dimenhydrinate without ruling out its contraindications aloud (congenital long QT in the patient or family for ondansetron, p.75; hypersensitivity and the elderly/hypertension cautions for dimenhydrinate, p.63) - protocol error up to 100%

Never positioning the hypotensive patient supine (p.54) - the circulation auto-fail example 'does not position for hypotension at any time', 100%. Sitting or standing her for an orthostatic check, or walking her to the stretcher, is also unsafe (textbook practice - not a BC rubric item)
Treating the call as non-RTC because 'it is just the flu' and finishing a full secondary survey or the IV on scene instead of loading within 15 minutes - transport category error, 25%
Running the bolus without reassessing after every 500 mL, or giving a fixed volume instead of 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L (p.48, p.54) - protocol error up to 100%
criticalPitfallsZh: 在没有逐项排除禁忌证的情况下，为腹部绞痛给 Entonox、对乙酰氨基酚、布洛芬或（PCP）甲氧氟烷——Entonox 有休克慎用且恶心呕吐为其不良反应（第 65 页），对乙酰氨基酚有低血容量慎用且呕吐为过量症状（第 58-59 页），口服药片留不住，甲氧氟烷（第 71 页）仅限血流动力学稳定者——协议类错误最高扣 100%
没有基线生命体征、或没有确认指征（低血容量、收缩压低于 90、其他休克征象）就启动低血容量协议或补液——扣 100%
没有大声排除禁忌证就给昂丹司琼或茶苯海明（昂丹司琼要排除患者或家族先天性长 QT，第 75 页；茶苯海明要排除过敏并注意老年和高血压慎用，第 63 页）——协议类错误最高扣 100%
自始至终没有为低血压患者摆仰卧位（第 54 页）——属循环项自动失败示例「自始至终未对低血压患者摆位」，扣 100%。让她坐起或站起查体位性血压、或走着去担架同样不安全（教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项）
因为「只是肠胃炎」就当作非 RTC，在现场做完整二次评估或建立静脉通路而不在 15 分钟内装载——转运分类错误，扣 25%
补液时不做每 500 mL 复评，或给固定容量而不是 20 mL/kg 且上限 2 升（第 48、54 页）——协议类错误最高扣 100%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives high-flow oxygen (required in shock), supine positioning with suction and a basin ready, warmth, nothing by mouth, a full baseline set including BGL and temperature, a clear RTC decision with the criterion named, and rapid transport. EMR does NOT start an IV, give a fluid bolus, or give ondansetron or dimenhydrinate - those are PCP additions - so without fluid set 2 stays near baseline. Entonox and all oral analgesics are withheld at both levels, with the reasons said aloud. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 给高流量吸氧（休克时必须）、仰卧位并备好吸引器和呕吐盆、保暖、禁食禁水、含血糖和体温的完整基线生命体征、说出依据的明确 RTC 判断，并快速转运。EMR 不建立静脉、不补液、不给昂丹司琼或茶苯海明——这些是 PCP 追加的内容——所以没有补液时第 2 组接近基线。两个级别都不给 Entonox 和任何口服镇痛药，并大声说出理由。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds, en route, vascular access with aseptic technique, a 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus (62 kg = 1,240 mL, maximum 2 L, reassess after every 500 mL, target systolic 90), an antiemetic once its contraindications are ruled out (ondansetron 4 mg PO, or dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg) and the 9-system Functional Enquiry. TXA is not indicated: this is fluid loss, not blood loss. Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: ibuprofen is also unwise here because dehydration with an ACE inhibitor and a diuretic stresses the kidneys, and an ODT tablet dissolves on the tongue, which is why an oral antiemetic is still reasonable in a patient who is vomiting.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在途中追加：无菌技术建立静脉通路、20 mL/kg 生理盐水补液（62 kg = 1,240 mL，上限 2 升，每 500 mL 复评，目标收缩压 90）、排除禁忌证后给止吐药（昂丹司琼 4 mg 口服，或茶苯海明 1 mg/kg、上限 50 mg），以及 9 系统功能问诊。TXA 无指征：这是失液而不是失血。教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项：布洛芬在此也不明智，因为脱水合并 ACE 抑制剂和利尿剂会加重肾脏负担；口崩片在舌上溶解，所以呕吐患者仍可合理使用口服止吐药。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 71-year-old female, about 62 kilograms, with two days of vomiting and diarrhea - about 12 vomits in the last 24 hours and 6 watery stools - and almost no oral intake, who nearly fainted at home this morning. On our arrival she was alert, GCS 15, with cool pale clammy skin, dry mucous membranes, capillary refill 4 seconds, BP 86/54, pulse 118 and weak, resps 24, SpO2 95% on room air, BGL 5.2 and temperature 37.8. She has crampy periumbilical pain 4/10 with a soft abdomen and no pulsatile mass. History of hypertension and type 2 diabetes on ramipril, hydrochlorothiazide and metformin, allergic to penicillin. She received high-flow oxygen, supine positioning and warmth; Entonox and oral analgesics were withheld because of shock and vomiting. A PCP started an IV in the right forearm and the 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus, 1,240 mL ordered, at 0903, and ondansetron 4 milligrams by mouth at 0905 after long QT was ruled out. At 0907, with about 250 mL in, she is GCS 15, BP 94/58, pulse 110, resps 22, SpO2 99% on 15 litres, and the bolus is continuing with reassessment every 500 mL.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 71 岁女性，约 62 公斤，呕吐腹泻两天——过去 24 小时约吐 12 次、6 次水样便——几乎没有经口摄入，今早在家差点晕倒。我们到场时她清醒，GCS 15，皮肤发凉苍白湿冷，黏膜干燥，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒，血压 86/54，脉搏 118 细弱，呼吸 24，SpO2 室内空气 95%，血糖 5.2，体温 37.8。脐周绞痛 4/10，腹软，无搏动性包块。既往高血压和 2 型糖尿病，服雷米普利、氢氯噻嗪和二甲双胍，青霉素过敏。已给高流量吸氧、仰卧位和保暖；因休克和呕吐，Entonox 和口服镇痛药均未给。PCP 于右前臂建立静脉通路，09:03 开始 20 mL/kg 生理盐水补液（医嘱 1,240 mL），排除长 QT 后 09:05 口服昂丹司琼 4 毫克。09:07 已输入约 250 mL，她 GCS 15，血压 94/58，脉搏 110，呼吸 22，SpO2 15 升下 99%，补液继续，每 500 mL 复评。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Two days of vomiting and diarrhea with dizziness and near-fainting (dehydration with signs of shock)
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Vomiting began 2 days ago, about 12 vomits in 24 hours, about 6 watery stools, scant dark urine, no intake; nearly fainted this morning; crampy periumbilical pain 4/10; sick grandson last week; no blood in vomit or stool
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Hypertension, type 2 diabetes; no heart failure, kidney or liver disease, no glaucoma, no asthma/COPD, no long QT
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Ramipril 5 mg daily, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg daily, metformin 500 mg twice daily - none kept down since yesterday morning; no blood thinners
pcrKeyPoints.allergies: Penicillin (rash); no prior reaction to dimenhydrinate
treatments: High-flow O2 15 L NRB
Supine, warm, suction and basin ready, RTC transport with secondary survey en route
PCP: IV right forearm and NS bolus 20 mL/kg (1,240 mL ordered) at 0903, reassess every 500 mL
PCP: ondansetron 4 mg PO at 0905 after long QT, allergy and PKU ruled out
Entonox and oral analgesics withheld - shock caution, vomiting, hypovolemia (reasons documented)
findings: Baseline GCS 15, BP 86/54, pulse 118 weak, resps 24, SpO2 95% RA (98% on 15 L), skin cool pale clammy, capillary refill 4 s
BGL 5.2 mmol/L, temperature 37.8 C
Abdomen soft, mild diffuse periumbilical tenderness, no guarding, no pulsatile mass
Set 2 at about 250 mL in: BP 94/58, pulse 110, resps 22, SpO2 99%; one small watery vomit suctioned

dispatch.narrativeEn: The daughter says her mother has not kept any fluid down since last night and nearly fainted on the way to the bathroom this morning.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 女儿说母亲从昨晚起一点水也喝不进去，今早去卫生间的路上差点晕倒。

scene.narrativeEn: The patient's daughter meets you at the door of a ground-floor townhouse and leads you to the living room. The patient is semi-reclined on the sofa under a blanket, pale and sweaty, a plastic basin in her lap and vomit-stained towels on the floor.
scene.narrativeZh: 患者女儿在一楼联排住宅门口迎接，并带你进客厅。患者半躺在沙发上盖着毯子，面色苍白、出冷汗，腿上放着塑料盆，地上有沾了呕吐物的毛巾。

rows.en: The room is warm, there are no hazards, and the ambulance can park at the door
rows.zh: 室内温暖，无危险源，救护车可停在门口

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: The patient's daughter
rows.zh: 患者女儿

rows.en: Awake, pale and weak, retching into the basin
rows.zh: 清醒、苍白虚弱，正对着盆干呕

rows.en: Alert (AVPU), GCS 15; speaks in short sentences: 'I'm so dizzy... I can't stop being sick'
rows.zh: Alert（AVPU），GCS 15；用短句说：「好晕……吐个不停」

rows.en: Patent, she is speaking; vomit watery yellow-green with no blood or coffee-ground material - keep suction beside her
rows.zh: 通畅，能说话；呕吐物为黄绿色水样，无血、无咖啡渣样物——吸引器放在身旁

rows.en: 24, shallow and regular, clear air entry both sides, no accessory muscle use
rows.zh: 24 次/分，浅而规则，双侧进气清晰，无辅助呼吸肌动用

rows.en: Radial pulse 118, weak and regular; capillary refill delayed at 4 seconds
rows.zh: 桡动脉 118 次/分，细弱规则；毛细血管再充盈延迟，4 秒

rows.en: Cool, pale and clammy, with dry mucous membranes and poor turgor
rows.zh: 发凉、苍白、湿冷，黏膜干燥，皮肤弹性差

rows.en: 95% on room air
rows.zh: 室内空气 95%

rows.en: Abdomen soft with mild diffuse tenderness around the umbilicus, no guarding or rigidity, not distended, no pulsatile mass; no signs of bleeding, no rash, no leg swelling
rows.zh: 腹软，脐周轻度弥漫压痛，无肌紧张或腹肌强直，不胀，无搏动性包块；无出血征象，无皮疹，双腿无水肿

rows.en: NOT indicated (medical, no trauma)
rows.zh: 无颈椎固定指征（内科、无外伤）

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed. Modified rapid body survey (medical). Stability: UNSTABLE - cool, pale, clammy skin secondary to suspected shock from fluid loss.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。改良快速查体（内科）。判定：不稳定——疑似失液性休克所致的皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷。

rows.en: 'I can't stop being sick and I'm so dizzy'
rows.zh: 「吐个不停，而且好晕」

rows.en: Vomited about 12 times in the last 24 hours, now only watery fluid, never blood; about 6 loose watery stools since yesterday, no blood or black stool; dizzy on standing and nearly fainted this morning on the way to the bathroom, no head strike; only a small amount of dark urine since yesterday
rows.zh: 过去 24 小时约吐 12 次，现在只吐水样液体，从未带血；从昨天起约 6 次稀水样便，无血便或黑便；站起来就晕，今早去卫生间的路上差点晕倒，无头部撞击；从昨天起只排了少量深色尿

rows.en: Vomiting began 2 days ago
rows.zh: 呕吐从 2 天前开始

rows.en: Worse with any attempt to drink; eases briefly after she vomits
rows.zh: 一喝水就加重；呕吐后短暂缓解

rows.en: Crampy, in waves
rows.zh: 绞痛，阵发性

rows.en: Around the umbilicus, no radiation
rows.zh: 脐周，无放射

rows.en: Feels hot and cold but no fever measured; no chest pain
rows.zh: 忽冷忽热但没测过体温；无胸痛

rows.en: Penicillin (rash); has taken Gravol (dimenhydrinate) before with no reaction
rows.zh: 青霉素（皮疹）；以前用过 Gravol（茶苯海明）无反应

rows.en: Ramipril 5 mg daily, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg daily, metformin 500 mg twice daily - none taken since yesterday morning because she vomited them; no blood thinners
rows.zh: 雷米普利 5 mg 每日一次、氢氯噻嗪 12.5 mg 每日一次、二甲双胍 500 mg 每日两次——从昨天早上起因呕吐都没吃进去；不服抗凝药

rows.en: Hypertension and type 2 diabetes; no heart failure, kidney or liver disease, no ulcers, no glaucoma, no asthma or COPD, no heart rhythm problem and no family history of long QT
rows.zh: 高血压和 2 型糖尿病；无心衰、肾病或肝病，无溃疡，无青光眼，无哮喘或 COPD，无心律问题，家族无长 QT 综合征史

rows.en: Sips of water at 0600 this morning, vomited within minutes; last solid food was toast yesterday morning
rows.zh: 今早 06:00 喝了几口水，几分钟内吐出；最后一次固体食物是昨天早上的吐司

rows.en: Her grandson had a stomach bug last week
rows.zh: 孙子上周得过肠胃炎

rows.en: About 62 kg (the daughter confirms)
rows.zh: 约 62 kg（女儿确认）

history.noteEn: Actor is weak and answers in short sentences; the daughter helps.
history.noteZh: 患者演员虚弱，只说短句，由女儿协助。

sets.rxEn: First 500 mL of the bolus running, ondansetron given
sets.rxZh: 补液第一个 500 mL 正在输入，已给昂丹司琼

vitals.noteEn: Set 1 is the baseline taken en route BEFORE any fluid or antiemetic, completed in under 3 minutes. BP is taken supine - do not sit or stand her for an orthostatic check. BGL is indicated (older diabetic on metformin, almost nothing eaten for two days, weak and dizzy); temperature is indicated (gastroenteritis, possible infection). Pain 4/10 at both sets, with no analgesia given. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs (including breath sounds), the IV site and the bolus after every move and after each 500 mL. Set 2 is about 6 minutes after set 1, with roughly 250 mL in; ondansetron has been given but its onset is 15-30 minutes, so the nausea is unchanged. BGL and temperature are not repeated. During the set she vomits a small amount of watery fluid - the candidate must suction or turn her without losing the vitals. Improving but not corrected: reassess at 500 mL against the SBP target of 90, then continue the 20 mL/kg (1,240 mL) in 500 mL steps. EMR path (no IV, no fluid): set 2 stays near baseline - BP 88/54, pulse 116, respirations 24.
vitals.noteZh: 第 1 组为途中、给任何补液或止吐药之前的基线，3 分钟内完成。血压仰卧位测量——不要为查体位性血压让她坐起或站起。血糖有指征（老年糖尿病患者服二甲双胍、两天几乎没进食、虚弱头晕）；体温有指征（肠胃炎，可能有感染）。两组疼痛均为 4/10，未给任何镇痛药。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。每次移动后及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC（含呼吸音）、静脉穿刺部位和补液。第 2 组距第 1 组约 6 分钟，已进约 250 mL；已给昂丹司琼但起效需 15-30 分钟，所以恶心未变。血糖和体温不需复测。测量期间她吐出少量水样液体——考生须在不丢失生命体征的前提下吸引或将她翻向一侧。好转但尚未纠正：到 500 mL 时对照收缩压目标 90 复评，然后按 500 mL 一步继续完成 20 mL/kg（1,240 mL）。EMR 路径（无静脉、无补液）：第 2 组接近基线——血压 88/54，脉搏 116，呼吸 24。

rows.en: Tired and weak for 2 days, felt hot and cold
rows.zh: 乏力虚弱 2 天，忽冷忽热

rows.en: Dizzy on standing, no headache, no confusion
rows.zh: 站起来头晕，无头痛，无意识模糊

rows.en: No cough or shortness of breath
rows.zh: 无咳嗽或气短

rows.en: Heart racing when she sits up, no chest pain, no ankle swelling
rows.zh: 坐起来心跳快，无胸痛，脚踝不肿

rows.en: Crampy central abdominal pain, nausea, about 12 vomits and 6 watery stools, small amounts of dark urine, no blood in the vomit or stool
rows.zh: 脐周绞痛、恶心，约 12 次呕吐和 6 次水样便，尿量少色深，呕吐物和大便无血

rows.en: Skin feels dry, no rash
rows.zh: 皮肤发干，无皮疹

rows.en: Calf cramps, no joint pain
rows.zh: 小腿抽筋，无关节痛

rows.en: Type 2 diabetes, very thirsty, no sugar readings at home for 2 days
rows.zh: 2 型糖尿病，非常口渴，2 天没测过血糖

rows.en: Dry mouth and cracked lips, no vision change, no ear pain
rows.zh: 口干唇裂，视力无变化，无耳痛

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route, brief for the unstable patient. Actor is weak and still nauseated.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简。患者演员虚弱，仍恶心。

rows.en: Dry mucous membranes and tongue, sunken eyes, neck veins flat, trachea midline, no neck stiffness
rows.zh: 黏膜和舌干燥、眼窝凹陷、颈静脉塌陷、气管居中、颈部无强直

rows.en: Clear, equal air entry 6 sites
rows.zh: 清晰、6 点进气对称

rows.en: Soft, mild diffuse tenderness around the umbilicus, no guarding or rebound, not distended, active bowel sounds, no pulsatile mass
rows.zh: 软，脐周轻度弥漫压痛，无肌紧张或反跳痛，不胀，肠鸣音活跃，无搏动性包块

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

rows.en: Radial pulses weak, skin tents slowly on the forearm, CSM intact
rows.zh: 桡动脉搏动弱，前臂皮肤捏起后回缩缓慢，远端 CSM 完好

rows.en: Pedal pulses weak but present, feet cool, no swelling, calves soft and non-tender, CSM intact
rows.zh: 足背动脉搏动弱但可触及，足发凉，无水肿，小腿软、无压痛，远端 CSM 完好

scenarios.titleEn: Eleven-Year-Old Struck in the Chest by a Baseball - Commotio Cordis
scenarios.titleZh: 11 岁男孩被棒球击中胸部——心脏震荡（commotio cordis）
protocols: Child (1 year to puberty) Sudden Cardiac Arrest
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1834 hrs. Code 3 to a community ballpark in Langley. 11-year-old male was struck in the chest by a baseball, collapsed and is not breathing. The coach is doing CPR. Hospital is 14 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 18:34，Code 3 前往兰里一处社区棒球场。11 岁男孩被棒球击中胸部后倒地，无呼吸。教练正在做 CPR。医院车程 14 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: the caller (a parent) says the boy was hit in the chest by a ground ball, dropped at once and has not moved or breathed normally since; the coach started compressions about a minute later. There is no AED at the park. Fire First Responders are not currently assigned.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：报警的家长称男孩被地滚球击中胸口，当即倒地，此后一直没有动，也没有正常呼吸；教练约一分钟后开始按压。球场没有 AED。消防 First Responders 目前未派出。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan to bring the AED, BVM with oxygen and suction to the patient on the first trip, then the stretcher after ROSC
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；计划第一趟就把 AED、带氧气的球囊面罩和吸引器带到患者身边，ROSC 后再取担架床

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch that a witnessed collapse after a blow to the chest is a sudden rhythm arrest (commotio cordis, likely shockable) - AED first, not an asphyxial arrest
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即判断：胸部受击后被目击的倒地属突发心律性停搏（commotio cordis，很可能为可电击心律）——先上 AED，而非窒息性停搏

expected.actionEn: Consider additional resources (First Responders) to relieve the compressors and support the family
expected.actionZh: 考虑增派资源（First Responders）轮换按压并安抚家属

expected.actionEn: Anticipate an outdoor field with an upset crowd; PPE incl gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 预判户外球场与情绪激动的人群；个人防护含手套和护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Dry, sunny evening at the ballpark; the infield is firm packed dirt and the teammates have been moved to the dugout. A boy lies on his back near third base with his jersey pulled open; his coach kneels beside him giving chest compressions and a parent is on the phone with the dispatcher. Bystanders say a ground ball hit him in the chest. The baseball lies nearby. There is no AED at the park. One patient, no hazards. If the candidate asks, dispatch will send First Responders.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：傍晚干燥晴朗，内野是坚实的夯土地面，队友已被带到球员席。男孩仰卧在三垒附近，球衣被拉开；教练跪在他旁边做胸外按压，一位家长正在与调度员通话。旁观者说是一个地滚球砸中了他的胸口。棒球落在旁边。球场没有 AED。单一患者，无危险源。如考生询问，调度会派出 First Responders。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment (outdoor field, firm ground), mechanism (baseball to the chest) and number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无）、环境（户外球场、地面坚实）、受伤机制（棒球击中胸部）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: boy supine and motionless, coach doing compressions, parent on the phone - treat as cardiac arrest until proven otherwise
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：男孩仰卧不动、教练在做按压、家长在打电话——在排除前一律按心脏骤停处理

expected.actionEn: Keep the coach compressing without a pause (interruptions under 5 seconds) while the AED, BVM and oxygen are brought in; request First Responders
expected.actionZh: 让教练不间断地继续按压（中断不超过 5 秒），同时把 AED、球囊面罩和氧气拿到身边；申请 First Responders

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (the boy): unresponsive - no response to voice or pain (U). EXAMINER (give when assessed; the coach stops compressions only when the candidate tells him to): airway - closed by the tongue, opens with a manual maneuver; no vomit, fluid or foreign object. Breathing - none, only an occasional slow gasp. Pulse - no brachial or carotid pulse within 10 seconds of checking together with breathing. Skin (give during RBS): pale grey, cool and dry, lips blue. SpO2: cannot be read (no pulse). RBS (chest exposed): round red bruise over the left lower chest where the ball hit, no open wound, no deformity, the chest rises equally with ventilation; no head injury, no bleeding, no other injuries. C-spine NOT indicated (witnessed chest blow, no head or neck impact, no fall from a height). UNSTABLE: cardiac arrest. Chronology: CPR continues and the AED goes on as soon as arrest is recognized - the AED and shock sequence is graded under interventions.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员（男孩）：无反应——对呼唤和疼痛均无反应（U）。考官（评估时给出；只有考生下令教练才停止按压）：气道——被舌后坠堵住，手法开放后通畅；无呕吐物、液体或异物。呼吸——无，仅偶有缓慢的喘息样呼吸。脉搏——与呼吸同时检查，10 秒内摸不到肱动脉或颈动脉搏动。皮肤（RBS 时给出）：苍白发灰、发凉、干燥，口唇发绀。SpO2：无法读数（无脉搏）。RBS（暴露胸部）：左下胸部有圆形红色瘀斑（球击处），无开放伤口、无畸形，通气时胸廓起伏对称；无头部损伤、无出血、无其他损伤。无颈椎固定指征（目击胸部受击、无头颈部撞击、无高处坠落）。不稳定：心脏骤停。时序：CPR 持续进行，一旦识别骤停立即上 AED——AED 与电击流程在「处置」阶段评分。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Unresponsive (U) - no response to voice or pain
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：无反应（U）——对呼唤和疼痛均无反应

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated: witnessed collapse after a chest blow, no head or neck impact, no fall - spinal trauma can be reasonably ruled out, so CPR and the AED are not delayed
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征：目击的胸部受击后倒地，无头颈部撞击、无坠落——可合理排除脊柱外伤，因此不得为此推迟 CPR 和 AED

expected.actionEn: Assess airway: open it with a manual maneuver and look for vomit, fluid or a foreign object - clear
expected.actionZh: 评估气道：手法开放气道并查看有无呕吐物、液体或异物——通畅

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: none; an occasional gasp is not breathing - start ventilations
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：无；偶发喘息样呼吸不算有效呼吸——开始通气

expected.actionEn: Check breathing and pulse together for no more than 10 seconds (brachial, or carotid); no pulse = cardiac arrest, so CPR continues
expected.actionZh: 同时检查呼吸和脉搏不超过 10 秒（肱动脉或颈动脉）；无脉搏=心脏骤停，CPR 继续

expected.actionEn: Expose the chest and do the rapid body survey during CPR without stopping compressions: find the ball-impact bruise, no open chest wound or other injury
expected.actionZh: 在不停止按压的情况下暴露胸部并做快速查体：发现球击瘀斑，无开放性胸部伤口及其他损伤

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale grey, cool, dry, cyanotic lips
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白发灰、发凉、干燥、口唇发绀

expected.actionEn: Oxygen: connect the BVM to high-flow oxygen (15 L/min); SpO2 cannot be read in arrest
expected.actionZh: 氧气：球囊面罩接高流量氧气（15 L/min）；骤停时无法测 SpO2

expected.actionEn: Position: keep him supine on the firm ground for compressions; do not move him (move only for a dangerous scene or if CPR cannot be done effectively)
expected.actionZh: 体位：保持仰卧于坚实地面做按压，不要移动（仅在环境危险或无法有效做 CPR 时才移动）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Cardiac arrest (unconscious, no pulse) = UNSTABLE, RTC. Resuscitate where he lies - CPR is more effective while stationary - and load as soon as he has ROSC; do not delay loading for an on-scene secondary survey. Ready to load within 15 minutes of arrival. Direct your partner (and a bystander under direction) to prepare the stretcher and the ambulance while you run the AED sequence.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。心脏骤停（昏迷、无脉搏）=不稳定，RTC。就地复苏——CPR 在患者静止时效果更好——一旦 ROSC 立即装载；不要为在现场做二次评估而拖延装载。到场后 15 分钟内可装载。指挥搭档（及在指导下的旁观者）准备担架床和救护车，同时自己执行 AED 流程。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC (cardiac arrest, unconscious with no pulse) and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC（心脏骤停，昏迷无脉搏）并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Resuscitate where he lies and do not package or move him mid-cycle; load as soon as ROSC is confirmed
expected.actionZh: 就地复苏，不在按压周期中途打包或移动；确认 ROSC 后立即装载

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes of arrival, with the secondary survey left for en route
expected.actionZh: 到场后 15 分钟内可装载，二次评估留到途中

expected.actionEn: Delegate effectively: partner takes over compressions, then brings the stretcher; a bystander opens the gate and guides the crew; a parent stays ready to give history and ride along
expected.actionZh: 有效指挥：搭档接手按压，之后取担架床；旁观者开门并引路；家长随时准备提供病史并陪同上车

phases.infoEn: COACH (witness) and MOTHER (arrives during care) answer; the boy cannot. Coach: a ground ball took a bad hop and hit him squarely in the left chest during infield practice at about 1833, about 8 minutes before your arrival; he put a hand to his chest, took a step and dropped; he never spoke again; no head strike, no fall from a height; compressions started within about a minute, the emergency call was made at once, no AED was available and no shock has been given. Mother: weight about 32 kg; healthy boy, no heart condition, no fainting or chest pain with exercise, no family history of sudden death; no prescription medications; allergies - none known; LOI sandwich about 1700 and a sports drink at practice. Pain cannot be assessed.
phases.infoZh: 教练（目击者）和母亲（救治中赶到）回答，男孩本人无法回答。教练：内野练习时约 18:33（到场前约 8 分钟），一个地滚球弹起不规则，正正砸在他左胸；他用手捂住胸口，走了一步便倒下；之后再没说过话；头部没有撞击，没有高处坠落；约一分钟内开始按压，当即拨打了急救电话，球场没有 AED，也未曾电击。母亲：体重约 32 kg；平素健康，无心脏病，运动时无晕厥或胸痛，无猝死家族史；无处方药；过敏——无已知过敏；最后进食——约 17:00 吃了三明治，练习时喝了运动饮料。疼痛无法评估。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: collapsed and stopped breathing after being hit in the chest by a baseball (cardiac arrest)
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：被棒球击中胸部后倒地、呼吸停止（心脏骤停）

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from the coach: mechanism and point of impact, time of collapse, immediate collapse without warning, no head strike, when CPR started, no AED or shock before arrival
expected.actionZh: 向教练采集现病史：受伤机制与撞击部位、倒地时间、无预兆即刻倒地、无头部撞击、CPR 开始时间、到场前无 AED 无电击

expected.actionEn: PMHx with pertinent negatives: heart condition, fainting or chest pain with exercise, family history of sudden death
expected.actionZh: 既往史及相关阴性：心脏病、运动时晕厥或胸痛、猝死家族史

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI
expected.actionZh: 最后进食

expected.actionEn: Use the coach and the mother as history sources without stopping CPR or the AED sequence; ask the mother for his weight
expected.actionZh: 以教练和母亲作为病史来源，且不中断 CPR 和 AED 流程；向母亲询问体重

phases.infoEn: No vital signs can be taken during the arrest (CPR and the AED are never delayed for them), so the post-ROSC set is the baseline. Set 1 - about 1850, after ROSC: GCS 8 (E2 V2 M4); BP 100/62; pulse 126 regular, radial weak; respirations 10 shallow and irregular, assisted with the BVM; skin pale grey, cool, dry; pupils equal and sluggish; SpO2 92% on the BVM with 15 L oxygen; BGL 6.4 mmol/L (indicated - altered LOC after ROSC). Temp not indicated. Pain scale cannot be obtained (GCS 8). RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 心脏骤停期间无法测量生命体征（不得为此推迟 CPR 和 AED），因此 ROSC 后这一组即为基线。第 1 组——约 18:50，ROSC 后：GCS 8（E2 V2 M4）；血压 100/62；脉搏 126 规则，桡动脉搏动偏弱；呼吸 10 次/分、浅而不规则，球囊面罩辅助；皮肤苍白发灰、发凉、干燥；瞳孔等大、反应迟钝；SpO2 球囊面罩 15 L 氧气下 92%；血糖 6.4 mmol/L（有指征——ROSC 后意识改变）。体温无指征。疼痛评分无法获得（GCS 8）。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (8: E2 V2 M4)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（8：E2 V2 M4）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation with a correctly sized cuff for a child's arm
expected.actionZh: 用与儿童上臂相配的袖带听诊测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm - compare with the pulseless findings before ROSC
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度、节律——与 ROSC 前无脉搏的发现对比

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate, depth and character - recognize slow, shallow, irregular breathing as inadequate and keep assisting
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率、深度、性质——识别缓慢、浅、不规则的呼吸为通气不足并继续辅助

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on: temperature, colour, condition
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：温度、颜色、状态

expected.actionEn: Pupils: size, equality, reactivity
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔：大小、是否等大、反应

expected.actionEn: SpO2 - confirm the probe reading matches the palpated pulse; titrate oxygen to 94% or more

phases.infoEn: CHRONOLOGY: this sequence starts the moment arrest is recognized, right after the primary survey; the history, vital signs, Functional Enquiry and head-to-toe follow after ROSC. ALL LEVELS: a witnessed sudden collapse after a blow to the chest (commotio cordis, p.44) is a sudden rhythm arrest, NOT an asphyxial arrest - apply the AED and analyse as soon as possible (p.41, p.43) and do not give 5 cycles of CPR first (that rule is for asphyxial arrest, p.44). The coach's compressions continue until the crew takes over; keep interruptions under 5 seconds and change the compressor every 2 minutes (p.42). With two rescuers the child ratio is 15:2 (30:2 for one rescuer), rate 100-120 per minute, depth one third to one half of the chest diameter, full recoil, no hyperventilation (p.42-43). Pads: child pads are for ages 0-8 years (p.43); he is 11, so use the standard adult pads; on his small chest the pads sit about 2 cm apart in the normal anterior/lateral position, which is within 2.5 cm of each other - shift to anterior/posterior (p.44). EXAMINER: first analysis (about 1843) - SHOCK ADVISED: shock, resume CPR at once (also during charging), 2 minutes of CPR; second analysis (about 1845) - SHOCK ADVISED: shock, resume CPR at once. About a minute later the boy coughs, takes a spontaneous breath and his eyelids flutter: stop compressions and check the pulse - it is present (ROSC about 1846, p.42). Never compress a patient who has a pulse. After ROSC: clear fluid pools in his mouth - suction for no more than 10 seconds, the paediatric limit (p.45); his breathing is slow and shallow, so assist with the BVM and oxygen at a controlled rate without hyperventilating, aiming for SpO2 of 94% or more (p.11, p.42, p.50); reassess the ABCs before and after the move. ANALGESIA: pain cannot be assessed and altered LOC contraindicates Entonox (p.65) - say so and give nothing (acetaminophen and ibuprofen are oral drugs, p.58 and p.68, and he cannot swallow safely - textbook reasoning, not a monograph line). PCP: the guideline gives no IV, fluid or drug for this post-ROSC child (BP is not below 90, no hypovolemia) - do not delay loading; the Functional Enquiry is done en route.
phases.infoZh: 时序：本流程从识别骤停的那一刻开始，紧接初级评估；病史、生命体征、功能问诊和从头到脚检查在 ROSC 之后进行。各级别通用：目击的胸部受击后突然倒地（commotio cordis，第 44 页）属突发心律性停搏，不是窒息性停搏——应尽早上 AED 并分析（第 41、43 页），不要先做 5 个循环 CPR（那是窒息性停搏的规则，第 44 页）。教练的按压持续到急救人员接手；中断不超过 5 秒，每 2 分钟更换按压者（第 42 页）。两名施救者时儿童比例为 15:2（单人 30:2），频率每分钟 100-120 次，深度为胸廓前后径的 1/3 至 1/2，完全回弹，不过度通气（第 42-43 页）。电极片：儿童电极片适用于 0-8 岁（第 43 页）；他 11 岁，故使用标准成人电极片；他胸廓小，常规前侧/外侧位时电极片相距约 2 cm，处于 2.5 cm 以内——改为前后位（第 44 页）。考官：首次分析（约 18:43）——建议电击：电击，立即恢复 CPR（充电期间也继续），做 2 分钟 CPR；第二次分析（约 18:45）——建议电击：电击，立即恢复 CPR。约一分钟后男孩咳嗽、自主吸气、眼睑颤动：停止按压并检查脉搏——有脉搏（ROSC 约 18:46，第 42 页）。有脉搏的患者绝不能再按压。ROSC 后：口腔内有清亮液体积聚——吸引不超过 10 秒（儿童上限，第 45 页）；呼吸缓慢而浅，需用球囊面罩加氧气以受控频率辅助通气、不过度通气，目标 SpO2 94% 以上（第 11、42、50 页）；移动前后复评 ABC。镇痛：无法评估疼痛，意识改变是 Entonox 的禁忌（第 65 页）——口述并不给药（对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬均为口服药，第 58、68 页，而他无法安全吞咽——属教科书式推理，并非药物专论条文）。PCP：指南对这名 ROSC 后儿童没有静脉、补液或用药的规定（血压不低于 90，无低血容量）——不要为此推迟装载；功能问诊在途中完成。

expected.actionEn: Apply the AED and analyse as soon as possible: a witnessed sudden collapse after a chest blow is a rhythm arrest, not an asphyxial arrest, so NO 5 cycles of CPR first (compressions continue while the pads go on)
expected.actionZh: 尽早上 AED 并分析：目击的胸部受击后猝然倒地是心律性停搏而非窒息性停搏，因此不先做 5 个循环 CPR（贴电极片时按压继续）

expected.actionEn: CPR quality: interruptions under 5 seconds, rate 100-120 per minute, depth one third to one half of the chest diameter, full recoil, change the compressor every 2 minutes
expected.actionZh: CPR 质量：中断不超过 5 秒、频率每分钟 100-120 次、深度为胸廓前后径的 1/3 至 1/2、完全回弹、每 2 分钟换人

expected.actionEn: Two rescuers: ratio 15:2 with the BVM and oxygen, ventilating without hyperventilation
expected.actionZh: 两名施救者：15:2 比例，球囊面罩接氧气通气，不过度通气

expected.actionEn: Pads: state the age rule (child pads are for 0-8 years, he is 11, so adult pads) and, with the pads within 2.5 cm of each other on his small chest, shift to anterior/posterior
expected.actionZh: 电极片：口述年龄规则（儿童电极片适用于 0-8 岁，他 11 岁，用成人电极片），并因他胸廓小、电极片相距在 2.5 cm 以内而改为前后位

expected.actionEn: Shock advised: deliver the shock, resume CPR at once, 2 minutes of CPR, analyse and repeat - second shock at the second analysis

expected.actionEn: Stop compressions at signs of ROSC (spontaneous breath, cough, eyelid movement), confirm the pulse, and never compress a patient who has a pulse
expected.actionZh: 出现 ROSC 征象（自主呼吸、咳嗽、眼睑活动）时停止按压并确认脉搏，绝不对有脉搏的患者按压

expected.actionEn: After ROSC suction the mouth for no more than 10 seconds (paediatric limit) and maintain the airway
expected.actionZh: ROSC 后吸引口腔不超过 10 秒（儿童上限）并维持气道

expected.actionEn: Assist his slow, shallow breathing with the BVM and oxygen at a controlled rate, avoid hyperventilation, titrate to SpO2 of 94% or more

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and every intervention after ROSC, after loading and after each move; re-check the airway for secretions and keep SpO2 at 94% or more. Set 2 (6 minutes after set 1, en route, about 1856): GCS 9 (E3 V2 M4); BP 106/66; pulse 118 regular; respirations 16 regular and adequate, he is now breathing on his own; skin pale, cool, dry; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on 15 L NRB; BGL not repeated. Slowly improving - document the trend; if the pulse is lost again, resume CPR and re-analyse with the AED. If the candidate does not reassess after the move, tell him that the breathing is becoming slower and shallower.
phases.infoZh: ROSC 后、装载后及每次移动后复评 ABC 和各项处置；复查气道有无分泌物，保持 SpO2 在 94% 以上。第 2 组（距第 1 组 6 分钟，途中，约 18:56）：GCS 9（E3 V2 M4）；血压 106/66；脉搏 118 规则；呼吸 16 次/分、规则且充分，已能自主呼吸；皮肤苍白、发凉、干燥；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 98%；血糖不需复测。缓慢好转——记录趋势；若脉搏再次消失，恢复 CPR 并用 AED 再分析。如果考生移动后不复评，告诉他呼吸正变得更慢更浅。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after ROSC, after loading and after each move
expected.actionZh: ROSC 后、装载后及每次移动后复评 ABC 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes of the first and interpret the improving trend
expected.actionZh: 距第一组 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并解读好转趋势

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the re-arrest plan: if the pulse is lost, resume CPR at once and re-analyse with the AED
expected.actionZh: 口述再次骤停的预案：脉搏一旦消失，立即恢复 CPR 并用 AED 再分析

expected.actionEn: Re-check the airway for secretions and keep SpO2 at 94% or more at every reassessment
expected.actionZh: 每次复评都复查气道有无分泌物，并保持 SpO2 在 94% 以上

criticalPitfallsEn: Treating this as an asphyxial arrest - giving 5 cycles of CPR before the AED goes on, or waiting for the AED - in a witnessed sudden collapse after a chest blow (commotio cordis) the AED is applied as soon as possible; major delay in treatment, up to 100% (Protocols)
Interrupting compressions for more than 5 seconds (long pulse checks, vital signs, the head-to-toe, moving him mid-cycle), or never changing the compressor every 2 minutes - CPR/AED skill, 25%

Pads: leaving adult pads touching or within 2.5 cm of each other on his small chest instead of shifting to anterior/posterior, or choosing the pad size by guesswork instead of the age rule (child pads are for 0-8 years) - CPR/AED skill, 25%
Continuing chest compressions after ROSC, on a patient who has a pulse - 100% (Overall Patient Care: an act that may jeopardize life)
Not assisting his slow, shallow, irregular breathing after ROSC, or hyperventilating him - up to 100% (Breathing: irregular respirations without immediate intervention)
Giving Entonox, or any oral analgesic, to the unresponsive post-ROSC boy - altered LOC contraindicates Entonox; contraindications not ruled out, up to 100% (Protocols)
Stopping CPR to apply a collar or backboard - spinal trauma is not the mechanism and c-spine is not indicated; delaying the AED or CPR for it is a care-priority error (Overall Patient Care, 25%)
criticalPitfallsZh: 按窒息性停搏处理——先做 5 个循环 CPR 再上 AED，或等待 AED——目击的胸部受击后猝然倒地（commotio cordis）应尽早上 AED；治疗重大延误，最高扣 100%（协议类）
按压中断超过 5 秒（长时间摸脉、测生命体征、从头到脚检查、按压周期中途搬动），或始终不每 2 分钟换人——CPR/AED 技能类，扣 25%
电极片：成人电极片贴在他的小胸廓上互相接触或相距在 2.5 cm 以内而不改为前后位，或凭猜测选电极片而不按年龄规则（儿童电极片适用于 0-8 岁）——CPR/AED 技能类，扣 25%
ROSC 后对有脉搏的患者继续胸外按压——扣 100%（整体患者照护：可能危及生命的行为）
ROSC 后对其缓慢、浅表、不规则的呼吸不予辅助，或对其过度通气——最高扣 100%（呼吸：发现不规则呼吸而未立即干预）
给无反应的 ROSC 后男孩使用 Entonox 或任何口服镇痛药——意识改变是 Entonox 禁忌；未排除禁忌证，最高扣 100%（协议类）
为上颈托或脊柱板而停止 CPR——脊柱外伤不是该机制，无颈椎固定指征；为此推迟 AED 或 CPR 属照护优先级错误（整体患者照护，扣 25%）
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: CPR, AED, BVM with oxygen, suction, the pad and ratio rules and the 15-minute RTC clock are all EMR-level skills - this call is the same at EMR level. No Functional Enquiry (PCP only). No analgesia (altered LOC contraindicates Entonox; the oral analgesics are within EMR scope but he cannot swallow safely - textbook reasoning, not a monograph line). (Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: leave the AED pads on after ROSC in case the rhythm refibrillates.)
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：CPR、AED、球囊面罩加氧、吸引、电极片和比例规则以及 15 分钟 RTC 时限均属 EMR 级技能——本例 EMR 与 PCP 做法相同。无功能问诊（仅 PCP）。不给镇痛（意识改变是 Entonox 禁忌；口服镇痛药在 EMR 范围内，但他无法安全吞咽——属教科书式推理，并非药物专论条文）。（教科书做法——并非 BC 评分项：ROSC 后保留 AED 电极片，以防再次出现室颤。）
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route (the mother answers). The guideline mentions supraglottic airway insertion for PCPs once high-quality arrest management is under way (p.42) - not needed here, because ROSC follows the second shock and BVM ventilation works. No protocol in the guideline calls for IV access, a fluid bolus or a drug in this post-ROSC child (BP is not below 90, no hypovolemia), so nothing else is added at PCP level - do not delay loading for vascular access.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中 9 系统功能问诊（由母亲回答）。指南提到 PCP 在高质量骤停处理展开后可置入声门上气道（第 42 页）——本例不需要，因为第二次电击后即 ROSC 且球囊面罩通气有效。指南中没有任何协议要求对这名 ROSC 后儿童建立静脉通路、补液或用药（血压不低于 90，无低血容量），因此 PCP 级别没有其他追加——不要为静脉通路而推迟装载。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is an 11-year-old boy, about 32 kilograms, struck in the left chest by a ground ball at approximately 1833 with an immediate witnessed collapse and no head strike. His coach started compressions within about a minute and there was no AED on site. On our arrival at 1841 he was unresponsive, not breathing apart from an occasional gasp, and pulseless. We continued CPR at 15 to 2 and applied the AED with adult pads in an anterior-posterior position because of his small chest. Shock advised and delivered at 1843, a second shock at 1845, and he regained a pulse at 1846. After ROSC: GCS 8, BP 100/62, pulse 126, respirations 10 shallow and assisted with the BVM and oxygen, SpO2 92%, BGL 6.4. Latest set at 1856: GCS 9, BP 106/66, pulse 118, respirations 16 on his own, SpO2 98% on 15 litres. He has a round bruise over the left lower chest and no other injuries. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies, last ate at about 1700. No analgesia given because of his altered level of consciousness. His mother is travelling with us.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 11 岁男孩，约 32 公斤，约 18:33 被地滚球击中左胸，当即被目击倒地，无头部撞击。教练约一分钟内开始按压，现场没有 AED。我们 18:41 到场时他无反应、除偶有喘息外无呼吸、无脉搏。我们以 15:2 继续 CPR，并因他胸廓小而用成人电极片以前后位上 AED。18:43 建议电击并已电击，18:45 第二次电击，18:46 恢复脉搏。ROSC 后：GCS 8、血压 100/62、脉搏 126、呼吸 10 次浅表，球囊面罩加氧气辅助，SpO2 92%，血糖 6.4。18:56 最新一组：GCS 9、血压 106/66、脉搏 118、呼吸 16 次自主，SpO2 15 升下 98%。左下胸部圆形瘀斑，无其他损伤。无既往病史，无用药，无已知过敏，约 17:00 最后进食。因意识水平改变未给任何镇痛。母亲随车同行。
