After ROSC: GCS 8, BP 100/62, pulse 126, respirations 10 shallow, SpO2 92%, BGL 6.4
Set 2 at 1856: GCS 9, BP 106/66, pulse 118, respirations 16, SpO2 98%

dispatch.narrativeEn: Dispatch update en route: the caller (a parent) says the boy was hit in the chest by a ground ball, dropped at once and has not moved or breathed normally since; the coach started compressions about a minute later. There is no AED at the park. Fire First Responders are not currently assigned.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 途中调度更新：报警的家长称男孩被地滚球击中胸口，当即倒地，此后一直没有动，也没有正常呼吸；教练约一分钟后开始按压。球场没有 AED。消防 First Responders 目前未派出。

scene.narrativeEn: A dry, sunny evening at the ballpark. A boy lies on his back near third base with his jersey pulled open. The baseball lies nearby.
scene.narrativeZh: 傍晚干燥晴朗的球场。男孩仰卧在三垒附近，球衣被拉开。棒球落在旁边。

rows.en: The infield is firm packed dirt; the teammates have been moved to the dugout. No hazards
rows.zh: 内野是坚实的夯土地面，队友已被带到球员席。无危险源

rows.en: Bystanders say a ground ball hit him in the chest
rows.zh: 旁观者说是一个地滚球砸中了他的胸口

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: There is no AED at the park. If the candidate asks, dispatch will send First Responders
rows.zh: 球场没有 AED。如考生询问，调度会派出 First Responders

rows.en: His coach kneels beside him giving chest compressions; a parent is on the phone with the dispatcher
rows.zh: 教练跪在他旁边做胸外按压，一位家长正在与调度员通话

rows.en: Unresponsive - no response to voice or pain (U)
rows.zh: 无反应——对呼唤和疼痛均无反应（U）

rows.en: Closed by the tongue, opens with a manual maneuver; no vomit, fluid or foreign object
rows.zh: 被舌后坠堵住，手法开放后通畅；无呕吐物、液体或异物

rows.en: None, only an occasional slow gasp
rows.zh: 无，仅偶有缓慢的喘息样呼吸

rows.en: No brachial or carotid pulse within 10 seconds of checking together with breathing
rows.zh: 与呼吸同时检查，10 秒内摸不到肱动脉或颈动脉搏动

rows.en: Pale grey, cool and dry, lips blue
rows.zh: 苍白发灰、发凉、干燥，口唇发绀

rows.en: Cannot be read (no pulse)
rows.zh: 无法读数（无脉搏）

rows.en: Chest exposed: round red bruise over the left lower chest where the ball hit, no open wound, no deformity, the chest rises equally with ventilation. No head injury, no bleeding, no other injuries
rows.zh: 暴露胸部：左下胸部有圆形红色瘀斑（球击处），无开放伤口、无畸形，通气时胸廓起伏对称。无头部损伤、无出血、无其他损伤

rows.en: NOT indicated (witnessed chest blow, no head or neck impact, no fall from a height)
rows.zh: 无固定指征（目击胸部受击、无头颈部撞击、无高处坠落）

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed; the coach stops compressions only when the candidate tells him to. Skin is given during the RBS. UNSTABLE: cardiac arrest. Chronology: CPR continues and the AED goes on as soon as arrest is recognized - the AED and shock sequence is graded under interventions.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现；只有考生下令教练才停止按压。皮肤在 RBS 时给出。不稳定：心脏骤停。时序：CPR 持续进行，一旦识别骤停立即上 AED——AED 与电击流程在「处置」阶段评分。

rows.en: A ground ball took a bad hop and hit him squarely in the left chest during infield practice; he put a hand to his chest, took a step and dropped; he never spoke again. No head strike, no fall from a height
rows.zh: 内野练习时，一个地滚球弹起不规则，正正砸在他左胸；他用手捂住胸口，走了一步便倒下；之后再没说过话。头部没有撞击，没有高处坠落

rows.en: At about 1833, about 8 minutes before your arrival
rows.zh: 约 18:33，到场前约 8 分钟

rows.en: None known
rows.zh: 无已知过敏

rows.en: No prescription medications
rows.zh: 无处方药

rows.en: Healthy boy; no heart condition, no fainting or chest pain with exercise, no family history of sudden death
rows.zh: 平素健康；无心脏病，运动时无晕厥或胸痛，无猝死家族史

rows.en: Sandwich about 1700 and a sports drink at practice
rows.zh: 约 17:00 吃了三明治，练习时喝了运动饮料

rows.en: Compressions started within about a minute, the emergency call was made at once; no AED was available and no shock has been given
rows.zh: 约一分钟内开始按压，当即拨打了急救电话；球场没有 AED，也未曾电击

rows.en: About 32 kg
rows.zh: 约 32 kg

history.noteEn: Coach (witness) and mother (arrives during care) answer; the boy cannot. Pain cannot be assessed.
history.noteZh: 教练（目击者）和母亲（救治中赶到）回答，男孩本人无法回答。疼痛无法评估。

sets.rxZh: ROSC 后，球囊面罩辅助通气

vitals.noteEn: No vital signs can be taken during the arrest (CPR and the AED are never delayed for them), so the post-ROSC set is the baseline. BGL is indicated (altered LOC after ROSC); temperature is not indicated. Pain scale cannot be obtained (GCS 8). RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs and every intervention after ROSC, after loading and after each move; re-check the airway for secretions and keep SpO2 at 94% or more. Set 2: BGL not repeated. Slowly improving - document the trend; if the pulse is lost again, resume CPR and re-analyse with the AED. If the candidate does not reassess after the move, tell him that the breathing is becoming slower and shallower.
vitals.noteZh: 心脏骤停期间无法测量生命体征（不得为此推迟 CPR 和 AED），因此 ROSC 后这一组即为基线。血糖有指征（ROSC 后意识改变）；体温无指征。疼痛评分无法获得（GCS 8）。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。ROSC 后、装载后及每次移动后复评 ABC 和各项处置；复查气道有无分泌物，保持 SpO2 在 94% 以上。第 2 组：血糖不需复测。缓慢好转——记录趋势；若脉搏再次消失，恢复 CPR 并用 AED 再分析。如果考生移动后不复评，告诉他呼吸正变得更慢更浅。

rows.en: Healthy boy, no recent illness or fever
rows.zh: 平素健康，近期无疾病或发热

rows.en: Never had seizures or fainting spells
rows.zh: 从无抽搐或晕厥

rows.en: No asthma, no cough
rows.zh: 无哮喘、无咳嗽

rows.en: No known heart problems, no palpitations or chest pain with exercise, no family history of sudden death
rows.zh: 无已知心脏问题，运动时无心悸或胸痛，无猝死家族史

rows.en: No vomiting, no bowel or bladder problems
rows.zh: 无呕吐，无排便或排尿问题

rows.en: No rashes
rows.zh: 无皮疹

rows.en: No earlier fractures or injuries
rows.zh: 既往无骨折或外伤

rows.en: No diabetes
rows.zh: 无糖尿病

rows.en: No vision, hearing or ear problems
rows.zh: 无视力、听力或耳部问题

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route after ROSC, brief. The boy cannot answer, so his mother answers.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，ROSC 后在途中简要完成。男孩本人无法回答，由母亲回答。

rows.en: No injury, trachea midline, no JVD
rows.zh: 无损伤，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张

rows.en: Round bruise over the left lower chest, no open wound or crepitus, equal rise with the BVM, equal air entry on 6-site auscultation
rows.zh: 左下胸部圆形瘀斑，无开放伤口、无骨擦音，球囊面罩通气时胸廓起伏对称，6 点听诊进气对称

rows.en: Soft, not distended
rows.zh: 软，无膨隆

rows.en: No injury
rows.zh: 无损伤

rows.en: No injury, moves to pain, pulses present
rows.zh: 无损伤，对疼痛有活动，脉搏可触及

rows.en: No injury, moves to pain, pulses present
rows.zh: 无损伤，对疼痛有活动，脉搏可触及

exam.noteEn: En route head-to-toe (brief, after the move).
exam.noteZh: 途中从头到脚检查（移动后，简要）。

scenarios.titleEn: Five-Year-Old With a Bee Sting at the Park - Paediatric Anaphylaxis
scenarios.titleZh: 公园里被蜜蜂蜇伤的 5 岁儿童——儿童过敏性休克
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1432 hrs. Code 3 to a playground at Confederation Park in Burnaby. 5-year-old female stung by a bee. Her mother reports the child's lips are swelling and she is struggling to breathe. Hospital is 8 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 14:32，Code 3 前往本拿比 Confederation Park 的儿童游乐场。5 岁女童被蜜蜂蜇伤。母亲报告孩子嘴唇肿胀、呼吸费力。医院车程 8 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the mother says her daughter was stung once on the arm near a garbage bin, has no known bee allergy and no EpiPen, and is now very sleepy; a few bees are still around the bin.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：母亲称女儿在垃圾桶旁手臂被蜇了一下，没有已知的蜜蜂过敏史、也没有 EpiPen，现在非常嗜睡；垃圾桶周围仍有几只蜜蜂。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan epinephrine (weight-based paediatric dose), child-sized oxygen mask, suction, BVM, salbutamol, early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备肾上腺素（按体重计算的儿童剂量）、儿童尺寸吸氧面罩、吸引器、球囊面罩、沙丁胺醇，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch a likely unstable paediatric anaphylaxis (lip swelling, breathing difficulty, sleepy child) and plan to obtain the child's weight on arrival
expected.actionZh: 从调度信息即预判这很可能是不稳定的儿童过敏性休克（嘴唇肿胀、呼吸困难、孩子嗜睡），并计划到场后询问孩子体重

expected.actionEn: Anticipate bees still present at the scene; plan PPE and a safe approach
expected.actionZh: 预判现场可能仍有蜜蜂；规划个人防护与安全的接近路线

expected.actionEn: Assign crew roles before arrival: one member on the patient and the protocol, one on the stretcher and egress (p.55)
expected.actionZh: 到场前先分好搭档分工：一人负责患者与协议，一人负责担架床和撤离路线（p.55）

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Sunny afternoon, 24 °C, dry. A parks worker flags you to a grassy area beside the playground; the paved path lets the stretcher come to within 15 m. The father has carried the child about 10 m away from the garbage bin, where a few bees are still buzzing. The child is on her mother's lap, limp and drowsy, lips visibly swollen, face flushed, with a wet cough and wheeze, and a small amount of vomit on the grass beside them. Other children and parents stand back. The mother says no one else was stung. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：晴朗的下午，24 °C，干燥。公园管理员把你引到游乐场旁的草地；担架车可沿铺装小路推到距现场 15 m 处。父亲已把孩子抱离垃圾桶约 10 m，桶边仍有几只蜜蜂在飞。孩子坐在母亲腿上，瘫软嗜睡，嘴唇明显肿胀、面部潮红，湿性咳嗽伴喘鸣，旁边草地上有少量呕吐物。其他孩子和家长站在远处。母亲说没有其他人被蜇。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (bees still near the garbage bin - keep crew and patient clear), environment, nature of illness (allergic reaction to a bee sting), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（垃圾桶附近仍有蜜蜂——让队员和患者远离）、环境、发病性质（蜜蜂蜇伤后的过敏反应）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: limp, drowsy child on her mother's lap, swollen lips, flushed face, wet cough and audible wheeze, vomit on the grass
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：孩子瘫软嗜睡地坐在母亲腿上，嘴唇肿胀、面部潮红、湿性咳嗽并可闻及喘鸣，草地上有呕吐物

expected.actionEn: Confirm with the mother that no one else was stung
expected.actionZh: 向母亲确认没有其他人被蜇

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (child): drowsy, whimpering, answers her mother's voice with a word or two ('can't... breathe', 'tummy hurts'); the mother is holding her upright and the child slumps against her. EXAMINER (give when assessed): AVPU V. Airway - lips and eyelids swollen, hoarse cry, no stridor, vomited once with a little vomit still in the mouth; airway patent but at risk. Respirations 36, laboured with retractions and audible wheeze. Radial pulse 146 weak. Skin: face flushed, widespread urticaria (hives) over chest, back and limbs, hands cool. RBS: one sting site on the left forearm with the stinger and venom sac still embedded, local swelling; no other stings, no trauma. SpO2 89% RA. C-spine NOT indicated (medical; she sat down on the grass - no fall, no head strike). UNSTABLE: anaphylaxis with respiratory distress and decreased LOC.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员（孩子）：嗜睡、哼哼唧唧，对母亲的声音能回应一两个词（「喘…不上气」「肚子疼」）；母亲抱着她保持直立，孩子软软地靠在母亲身上。考官（评估时给出）：AVPU 为 V。气道——嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、哭声嘶哑、无喉鸣，呕吐过一次，口中仍有少量呕吐物；气道通畅但有危险。呼吸 36 次/分，费力，有凹陷，可闻及喘鸣。桡动脉 146 次/分、细弱。皮肤：面部潮红，胸、背和四肢广泛荨麻疹（风团），双手发凉。RBS：左前臂一处蜇伤点，蜂刺和毒囊仍留在皮肤内，局部肿胀；无其他蜇伤、无外伤。SpO2 室内空气 89%。无颈椎固定指征（内科问题；她是坐到草地上的——无跌倒、无头部撞击）。不稳定：过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫和意识下降。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to Verbal, drowsy - a decreased LOC finding
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：对言语有反应、嗜睡——属意识下降

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (medical, no fall, no head strike)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（内科问题、无跌倒、无头部撞击）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway - swollen lips and eyelids, hoarse cry, vomit in the mouth; clear it and keep suction ready (paediatric suction 10 seconds at most, p.45)
expected.actionZh: 评估气道——嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、哭声嘶哑、口中有呕吐物；清理并备好吸引器（儿童吸引每次不超过 10 秒，p.45）

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing - rate, effort, retractions, wheeze
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸——频率、做功、凹陷、喘鸣

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation - fast, weak radial pulse; cool hands
expected.actionZh: 评估循环——桡动脉细速；双手发凉

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey: find the sting site and the embedded stinger, look for hives and other stings, rule out trauma
expected.actionZh: 做改良快速查体：找到蜇伤点和残留蜂刺，查看荨麻疹和其他蜇伤，排除外伤

expected.actionEn: Note skin: flushed, urticaria, cool hands
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：潮红、荨麻疹、双手发凉

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L/min by child-sized non-rebreather mask to keep SpO2 at or above 94% (shortness of breath and shock need high flow, p.50)
expected.actionZh: 高流量吸氧 15 L/min，儿童尺寸非再吸入面罩，维持 SpO2≥94%（呼吸困难和休克需要高流量，p.50）

expected.actionEn: Lay the child SUPINE (not held upright on her mother's lap) and do NOT walk her (per the Anaphylaxis protocol, p.55)
expected.actionZh: 让孩子仰卧（不要继续让她直立靠在母亲腿上），且绝不让她行走（按过敏性休克协议，p.55）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Anaphylaxis with respiratory distress (accessory muscle use) and decreased LOC = UNSTABLE, RTC (p.7 primary-survey findings: Anaphylaxis; Respiratory distress / accessory muscle use; Altered LOC - and the p.55 instability criteria). The p.7 list is headed 'Adult' but the guideline has no separate paediatric list, and the p.55 criteria are met. Give epinephrine on scene, then transport - do not delay for a full secondary survey. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Delegate the partner to prepare the stretcher and egress while you run the protocol. The mother rides along.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫（辅助呼吸肌参与）和意识下降=不稳定，RTC（p.7 原始评估所见：过敏性休克；呼吸窘迫/辅助呼吸肌参与；意识改变——以及 p.55 的不稳定标准）。p.7 的清单标题虽为「成人」，但指南没有单独的儿童清单，且 p.55 的标准已满足。现场先给肾上腺素再转运——不要为做完整二次评估而拖延。15 分钟内可装载。执行协议的同时，指派搭档准备担架床和撤离路线。母亲随车同行。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Epinephrine given on scene, then ready to load within 15 minutes - no full secondary survey on scene
expected.actionZh: 现场给予肾上腺素后 15 分钟内可装载——不在现场做完整二次评估

expected.actionEn: Delegate the partner to prepare the stretcher and egress (explicitly required by the Anaphylaxis protocol, p.55)
expected.actionZh: 指派搭档准备担架床和撤离通道（过敏性休克协议明确要求，p.55）

expected.actionEn: Manage the parent: explain what is happening, keep the mother with the child, arrange for her to ride along, and keep the child supine for the carry to the stretcher
expected.actionZh: 安抚家长：说明正在做什么，让母亲陪在孩子身边并安排她随车同行，搬运上担架床时保持孩子仰卧

phases.infoEn: MOTHER ANSWERS (the child is drowsy and gives only a word or two; use the mother): her daughter is 5 years old and weighed 20 kg at her check-up last month. She was playing near the garbage bin and was stung once on the left forearm about 15 minutes before your arrival; within minutes the lips swelled and she broke out in hives; she vomited once about 5 minutes before you arrived, then went floppy and sleepy. Onset sudden, the worst reaction she has ever had, nothing has helped (the mother gave nothing). Sting-site pain: shown the faces scale, she points to 2/10. Last summer a sting caused a large local swelling only, with no breathing trouble. PMHx: mild eczema, no asthma. Meds: none. Allergies: no known drug or food allergies; no EpiPen. LOI: lunch at 1230, popsicle about 1415.
phases.infoZh: 母亲回答（孩子嗜睡，只能说一两个词，主要问母亲）：女儿 5 岁，上个月体检时体重 20 kg。她在垃圾桶附近玩耍，左前臂被蜇了一下，约在到场前 15 分钟；几分钟内嘴唇肿起、全身起风团；到场前约 5 分钟呕吐一次，随后变得软绵绵、嗜睡。起病突然，是她历来最严重的一次反应，什么都没起效（母亲什么药也没给）。蜇伤处疼痛：给她看表情量表，她指向 2/10。去年夏天被蜇过一次，只有局部大片肿胀，没有呼吸困难。既往史：轻度湿疹，无哮喘。用药：无。过敏：无已知药物或食物过敏；没有 EpiPen。最后进食：12:30 午饭，约 14:15 吃了冰棍。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: swollen lips and difficulty breathing after a bee sting
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：被蜜蜂蜇伤后嘴唇肿胀、呼吸困难

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST/LOTARP: time of the sting, number of stings, time to the first signs, progression (lips, hives, vomiting, drowsiness), reaction to previous stings
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST/LOTARP 采集现病史：蜇伤时间、蜇伤次数、出现首批症状的时间、进展（嘴唇、荨麻疹、呕吐、嗜睡）、既往蜇伤反应

expected.actionEn: Pain score at the sting site using a faces scale
expected.actionZh: 用表情量表评估蜇伤处疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx (mild eczema, no asthma)
expected.actionZh: 既往史（轻度湿疹，无哮喘）

expected.actionEn: Medications, and whether anything was given for this reaction
expected.actionZh: 用药史，以及这次反应是否已给过任何药

expected.actionEn: Allergies (none known; previous large local reaction to a sting; no EpiPen)
expected.actionZh: 过敏史（无已知过敏；曾有蜇伤后局部大片肿胀；没有 EpiPen）

expected.actionEn: LOI (lunch and a popsicle)
expected.actionZh: 最后进食（午饭和一根冰棍）

expected.actionEn: Use the mother as the history source and get the child's weight (20 kg) before any drug dose is calculated
expected.actionZh: 以母亲为病史来源，并在计算任何药量之前问清孩子体重（20 kg）

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE epinephrine (required before initiating a protocol): GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6, drowsy, whimpering); BP 72/40 by auscultation with a child-sized cuff (systolic below 90 is the p.55 hypotension criterion; the guideline gives no separate paediatric cut-off); pulse 146 weak regular; respirations 36 laboured with wheeze and retractions; skin flushed, urticarial, hands cool; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 89% RA. BGL 5.6 if checked (decreased LOC in a child - reasonable). Temp not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——给肾上腺素前的基线（启动协议前必须完成）：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6，嗜睡、哼哼唧唧）；儿童袖带听诊血压 72/40（收缩压低于 90 即 p.55 的低血压标准；指南没有单独的儿童界值）；脉搏 146 细弱规则；呼吸 36 费力伴喘鸣和凹陷；皮肤潮红、有荨麻疹、双手发凉；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 89%。若测血糖为 5.6（儿童意识下降，测血糖合理）。体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项，按儿童调整（13：E3 V4 M6）

expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/work of breathing incl wheeze and retractions

expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：温度、颜色、状态、荨麻疹范围

expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准

expected.actionZh: 血糖——儿童意识下降时合理（体温无指征）

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route AFTER epinephrine, brief. MOTHER and child answer (the child gives a few words, the mother adds details): general - healthy and playing normally until the sting; CNS - dizzy and sleepy, no headache, no seizure; respiratory - wheezy cough, hoarse voice, says her chest feels tight; cardiovascular - says her heart is going fast, no heart problems; GI/GU - tummy ache, vomited once, no diarrhea; integumentary - itchy all over with hives, mild eczema on her elbows; musculoskeletal - sore left forearm at the sting, otherwise nil; endocrine nil (no diabetes); EENT - lips and eyelids swollen, eyes itchy, says her throat feels funny.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，给肾上腺素后在途中简要完成。母亲和孩子回答（孩子只能说几个词，母亲补充细节）：整体——蜇伤前健康、玩耍如常；中枢神经——头晕嗜睡、无头痛、无抽搐；呼吸——咳嗽伴喘鸣、声音嘶哑、说胸口发紧；心血管——说心跳得很快、无心脏病史；消化/泌尿——肚子疼、呕吐过一次、无腹泻；皮肤——全身瘙痒、有风团，肘部有轻度湿疹；肌肉骨骼——左前臂蜇伤处疼痛，余处无；内分泌无（无糖尿病）；眼耳鼻喉——嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、眼痒、说喉咙「怪怪的」。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - lip and eyelid swelling, hoarse voice, no stridor; chest - expiratory wheeze in all fields on 6-site auscultation, equal air entry; abdomen - soft, mild generalized tenderness; back - urticaria across the back; lower extremities - urticaria, CSM intact; upper extremities - left forearm sting site red and swollen, about 4 cm across, stinger already scraped off (if the candidate has not removed it, it is still embedded), urticaria, CSM intact; right arm urticaria, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、声音嘶哑、无喉鸣；胸部——6 点听诊各野呼气相喘鸣、进气对称；腹部——软，轻度弥漫压痛；背部——背部可见荨麻疹；下肢——荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好；上肢——左前臂蜇伤处红肿、直径约 4 cm，蜂刺已被刮除（若考生尚未处理，蜂刺仍留在皮肤内），荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好；右臂荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含气道肿胀复评）

expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊、双侧对比

expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionZh: 下肢

expected.actionZh: 上肢：蜇伤处、确认蜂刺已清除、CSM

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS (p.55): remove the allergen - scrape off the embedded stinger; position supine and do not walk the child; primary survey with airway management and high-flow O2 to SpO2 at or above 94%; delegate egress; history and baseline vitals; then EPINEPHRINE. The child weighs 20 kg: 0.01 mg/kg IM x 20 kg = 0.2 mg (maximum 0.5 mg - NEVER the 0.5 mg adult dose; p.66). There is no absolute contraindication in life-threatening anaphylaxis. It goes into the anterolateral thigh with an IM needle. It may be repeated up to 3 times (the paediatric line states no interval; the adult line is every 5 minutes, so the 5-6 minute reassessment is the repeat decision point). Then transport and continue treatment en route. PCP ADDITIONS (p.55): vascular access and fluid if still hypotensive or hypoperfused (20 mL/kg = 400 mL, maximum 2 L, reassess every 500 mL - a 400 mL bolus is reassessed when it is in); bronchospasm is treated with salbutamol AFTER epinephrine (p.77: nebulized 5 mg for age over 1 year, or MDI 5 x 100 mcg for 10-20 kg - she weighs exactly 20 kg, so she is in the 10-20 kg band, not the over 20 kg band); diphenhydramine after epinephrine (p.64 lists 25-50 mg IV or PO and no paediatric weight-based dose: give the lowest listed dose, 25 mg, IV because she is vomiting; hypotension is a listed adverse effect, so give it with the bolus running). Note: epinephrine first - salbutamol or an antihistamine INSTEAD of epinephrine is a major protocol error. ANALGESIA: the sting-site pain is mild (2/10) and never delays epinephrine; Entonox is withheld - altered LOC and inability to comply are listed contraindications and shock is a listed caution (p.65); oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen are withheld - she is vomiting and drowsy with a threatened airway (p.58 lists vomiting among the symptoms that argue against acetaminophen; ibuprofen has no listed contraindication here, so nothing by mouth for a drowsy, vomiting child is textbook practice — not a BC rubric item).
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用（p.55）：移除过敏原——刮除残留蜂刺；仰卧，不让孩子行走；做原始评估，处理气道并高流量吸氧使 SpO2 不低于 94%；指派搭档准备撤离路线；问病史并完成基线生命体征；然后肌注肾上腺素。孩子体重 20 kg：0.01 mg/kg IM × 20 kg = 0.2 mg（上限 0.5 mg——绝不能给 0.5 mg 的成人剂量；p.66）。危及生命的过敏性休克无绝对禁忌。注射于大腿前外侧，使用肌注针。可重复，最多 3 次（儿童剂量一行没有写间隔；成人为每 5 分钟，故以 5-6 分钟的复评作为是否重复的决策点）。随后转运并在途中继续治疗。PCP 追加（p.55）：仍低血压或灌注不足时建立静脉通路并补液（20 mL/kg = 400 mL，上限 2 升，每 500 mL 复评——400 mL 的补液在输完时复评）；支气管痉挛在肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇处理（p.77：年龄大于 1 岁雾化 5 mg，或 10-20 kg 用 MDI 5 × 100 mcg——她刚好 20 kg，属于 10-20 kg 档，而不是大于 20 kg 档）；肾上腺素之后给苯海拉明（p.64 只写了 25-50 mg 静脉或口服，没有按体重的儿童剂量：给所列最低量 25 mg，因为她在呕吐所以走静脉；低血压是所列不良反应，所以在补液进行中给）。注意：必须先给肾上腺素——用沙丁胺醇或抗组胺药替代肾上腺素属重大协议错误。镇痛：蜇伤处疼痛轻微（2/10），绝不能因此延误肾上腺素；Entonox 不给——意识改变和无法配合是所列禁忌，休克是所列慎用情形（p.65）；口服对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬不给——她在呕吐、嗜睡且气道受威胁（p.58 把呕吐列为不宜给对乙酰氨基酚的症状之一；布洛芬在此没有所列禁忌，对嗜睡、呕吐的孩子不经口给药属教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项）。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Anaphylaxis protocol with the correct indications (signs + bee-sting exposure + instability: systolic under 90, respiratory distress, decreased LOC) and with the baseline vitals done first (p.55)
expected.actionZh: 在指征正确（症状+蜇伤暴露+不稳定：收缩压低于 90、呼吸窘迫、意识下降）且基线生命体征已先完成的前提下启动过敏性休克协议（p.55）

expected.actionEn: Remove the allergen: scrape off the embedded stinger (p.55)
expected.actionZh: 移除过敏原：刮除残留蜂刺（p.55）

expected.actionEn: State the weight (20 kg) and calculate the epinephrine dose: 0.01 mg/kg x 20 kg = 0.2 mg IM, maximum 0.5 mg - never the 0.5 mg adult dose (p.66)
expected.actionZh: 说出体重（20 kg）并计算肾上腺素剂量：0.01 mg/kg × 20 kg = 0.2 mg 肌注，上限 0.5 mg——绝不能给 0.5 mg 的成人剂量（p.66）

expected.actionEn: Administer epinephrine 0.2 mg IM with the 6 rights, correct site (anterolateral thigh) and IM needle; note the time
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对肌注肾上腺素 0.2 mg，部位正确（大腿前外侧）并使用肌注针；记录给药时间

expected.actionEn: Keep the child supine and do not walk her or carry her upright to the stretcher (p.55)
expected.actionZh: 保持孩子仰卧，不让她行走，也不以直立姿势抱到担架床（p.55）

expected.actionEn: Give epinephrine first: treat bronchospasm with salbutamol only AFTER epinephrine, and never use salbutamol or an antihistamine instead of it (p.55)
expected.actionZh: 先给肾上腺素：支气管痉挛只在肾上腺素之后才用沙丁胺醇，绝不以沙丁胺醇或抗组胺药替代肾上腺素（p.55）

expected.actionEn: PCP: after epinephrine give salbutamol at the weight-based dose (nebulized 5 mg, or MDI 5 x 100 mcg for the 10-20 kg band - 20 kg is not over 20 kg) and diphenhydramine (p.64: 25-50 mg, no paediatric dose printed - the lowest listed dose, 25 mg IV)
expected.actionZh: PCP：肾上腺素之后按体重给沙丁胺醇（雾化 5 mg，或 10-20 kg 档用 MDI 5 × 100 mcg——20 kg 不属于大于 20 kg 档）和苯海拉明（p.64：25-50 mg，没有印出儿童剂量——取所列最低量 25 mg 静脉）

expected.actionEn: Verbalize repeat dosing: epinephrine 0.2 mg IM may be repeated up to 3 times if she is still unstable at the 5-6 minute reassessment
expected.actionZh: 口述重复给药：若 5-6 分钟复评时仍不稳定，可重复肌注肾上腺素 0.2 mg，最多 3 次

expected.actionEn: Verbalize withholding Entonox (altered LOC, inability to comply, shock caution - p.65) and oral acetaminophen/ibuprofen (vomiting, drowsy); the mild sting-site pain does not delay epinephrine
expected.actionZh: 口述不给 Entonox（意识改变、无法配合、休克慎用——p.65）以及口服对乙酰氨基酚/布洛芬（呕吐、嗜睡）；蜇伤处轻微疼痛不得延误肾上腺素

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions 5 minutes after epinephrine and after each move. Set 2 (5 minutes after the first epinephrine dose, en route): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6); BP 82/50; pulse 138 regular; respirations 30, wheeze reduced but still present, no stridor; skin still flushed with hives, hands cool; pupils equal; SpO2 94% on 15 L NRB. PARTIAL response - BP is still under 90 and she is still wheezing, so the second epinephrine dose (0.2 mg IM; p.66: may repeat up to 3 times) is required now. PCP: because she remains hypotensive (p.55), IV and a 20 mL/kg bolus = 400 mL, reassessed when the 400 mL is in (the 500 mL checkpoint is not reached). Examiner: if the candidate repeats epinephrine and runs the bolus, the next check about 5 minutes later is BP 94/58, pulse 126, SpO2 97% on 15 L, wheeze mild.
phases.infoZh: 肾上腺素后 5 分钟及每次移动后复评 ABC 与各项处置。第 2 组（首剂肾上腺素后 5 分钟，途中）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6）；血压 82/50；脉搏 138 规则；呼吸 30，喘鸣减轻但仍有、无喉鸣；皮肤仍潮红、有风团、双手发凉；瞳孔等大；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 94%。部分好转——血压仍低于 90、仍有喘鸣，所以现在必须追加第二剂肾上腺素（0.2 mg 肌注；p.66：最多可重复 3 次）。PCP：因仍低血压（p.55），建立静脉通路并按 20 mL/kg = 400 mL 补液，输完 400 mL 时复评（未到 500 mL 的复评点）。考官：若考生已重复肾上腺素并在补液，约 5 分钟后的下一次检查为血压 94/58、脉搏 126、SpO2 15 L 下 97%、喘鸣轻微。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, the airway swelling and all interventions 5 minutes after epinephrine and after each move (including loading the stretcher)
expected.actionZh: 肾上腺素后 5 分钟及每次移动（含装载担架床）后复评 ABC、气道肿胀与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes and interpret it as a partial response (BP still under 90, wheeze persists)
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并解读为部分好转（血压仍低于 90、喘鸣仍在）

expected.actionEn: Repeat epinephrine 0.2 mg IM (same weight-based dose) when the second set shows she is still hypotensive and wheezing; up to 3 repeats are allowed (p.66)
expected.actionZh: 第二组显示仍低血压、仍有喘鸣时，按同样的体重剂量再肌注肾上腺素 0.2 mg；最多可重复 3 次（p.66）

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access and a 20 mL/kg (400 mL) fluid bolus because she remains hypotensive, reassessed when the bolus is in (p.55)
expected.actionZh: PCP：因仍低血压，建立静脉通路并 20 mL/kg（400 mL）补液，输完后复评（p.55）

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (paediatric allergic airway, 20 kg). Structured hand-off with the weight, each epinephrine dose with its time, and the response; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（儿童过敏性气道问题，20 kg）。结构化交接，含体重、每一剂肾上腺素及其时间和反应；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical paediatric patient (airway swelling, hypotension, 20 kg)
expected.actionZh: 危重儿童患者途中预报（气道肿胀、低血压、20 kg）

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off: age, weight, allergen exposure and timeline, baseline and repeat vitals, response to treatment
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：年龄、体重、过敏原暴露及时间线、基线与复测生命体征、治疗反应

expected.actionEn: State each epinephrine dose with its weight-based calculation, time, route and response (0.2 mg IM, twice)
expected.actionZh: 说明每一剂肾上腺素的按体重计算、时间、途径与反应（0.2 mg 肌注，共两剂）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes (weight and its source, dose calculation, time of each dose and of the fluid bolus)
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR（体重及其来源、剂量计算、每剂药和补液的时间）

vitalsSets.timeHint: baseline, before epinephrine
5 min after epinephrine, en route
vitalsSets.resp: 30, wheeze reduced but present, no stridor

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving the adult 0.5 mg epinephrine dose, or not calculating the dose from the weight, to a 20 kg child - 0.025 mg/kg is 2.5 times the 0.01 mg/kg paediatric dose (p.66), up to 100%
Giving salbutamol or diphenhydramine before / instead of epinephrine - major protocol error up to 100% (p.55)
Leaving the hypotensive child upright on her mother's lap, sitting her up or walking her to the stretcher - 100% (p.55: supine, do not walk)
Initiating the protocol without a baseline set of vital signs - 100%
Not reassessing at 5-6 minutes, or not repeating epinephrine 0.2 mg when BP is still under 90 and she is still wheezing - major delay in subsequent doses, up to 100% (p.66)
Giving Entonox to a drowsy, hypotensive child who cannot self-administer it - contraindicated (p.65), up to 100%

Dosing salbutamol from the wrong weight band (20 kg is the 10-20 kg MDI band, 5 x 100 mcg; 10 puffs is the over 20 kg dose, p.77) or giving diphenhydramine at the full 50 mg - drug-administration deductions (textbook practice — not a BC rubric item: a weight-based 1 mg/kg, about 20 mg)
Treating as non-RTC and completing a full on-scene secondary survey - transport category error, 25%
criticalPitfallsZh: 给 20 kg 的孩子打成人的 0.5 mg 肾上腺素，或不按体重计算剂量——0.025 mg/kg 是儿童剂量 0.01 mg/kg 的 2.5 倍（p.66），最高扣 100%
抢在肾上腺素之前、或用沙丁胺醇/苯海拉明替代肾上腺素——重大协议错误，最高扣 100%（p.55）
让低血压的孩子继续直立坐在母亲腿上、把她扶坐起来或让她走向担架——扣 100%（p.55：仰卧、禁止行走）
未做基线生命体征就启动协议——扣 100%
5-6 分钟不复评，或血压仍低于 90、仍有喘鸣时不追加肾上腺素 0.2 mg——后续剂量重大延误，最高扣 100%（p.66）
给嗜睡、低血压、无法自行吸入的孩子用 Entonox——属禁忌（p.65），最高扣 100%
沙丁胺醇按错体重档（20 kg 属 10-20 kg 的 MDI 档，5 × 100 mcg；10 喷是大于 20 kg 的剂量，p.77），或苯海拉明给足 50 mg——给药类扣分（教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项：按体重 1 mg/kg，约 20 mg）
当作非 RTC、在现场做完整二次评估——转运分类错误，扣 25%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives epinephrine 0.2 mg IM (0.01 mg/kg x 20 kg; repeat up to 3 times), scrapes off the stinger, gives high-flow oxygen, keeps the child supine and transports rapidly. Salbutamol is within EMR scope (p.49, p.77) and may follow epinephrine for bronchospasm, although p.55 lists it among the PCP additions; EMR does NOT give diphenhydramine or IV fluids. No Functional Enquiry. Entonox and oral analgesics are withheld (altered LOC, vomiting). Textbook practice (not a BC rubric item): do not squeeze the venom sac when removing the stinger.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 肌注肾上腺素 0.2 mg（0.01 mg/kg × 20 kg；最多可重复 3 次）、刮除蜂刺、高流量吸氧、保持仰卧并快速转运。沙丁胺醇在 EMR 范围内（p.49、p.77），可在肾上腺素之后用于支气管痉挛，但 p.55 把它列在 PCP 追加项中；EMR 不给苯海拉明和静脉补液。无功能问诊。Entonox 和口服镇痛药不给（意识改变、呕吐）。教科书做法（不属 BC 评分项）：刮除蜂刺时不要挤压毒囊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access with a 20 mL/kg (400 mL) fluid bolus for persistent hypotension (reassessed when the bolus is in; the 500 mL checkpoint is not reached), salbutamol after epinephrine (nebulized 5 mg, or MDI 5 x 100 mcg for the 10-20 kg band), diphenhydramine (p.64: 25-50 mg and no paediatric dose printed, so the lowest listed dose, 25 mg IV; textbook practice — not a BC rubric item — is a weight-based 1 mg/kg, about 20 mg), and the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加静脉通路与 20 mL/kg（400 mL）补液处理持续低血压（输完时复评，未到 500 mL 的复评点）、肾上腺素后用沙丁胺醇（雾化 5 mg，或 10-20 kg 档用 MDI 5 × 100 mcg）、苯海拉明（p.64：25-50 mg，没有印出儿童剂量，故取所列最低量 25 mg 静脉；教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项——为按体重 1 mg/kg，约 20 mg），以及途中 9 系统功能问诊。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 5-year-old female, 20 kilograms, stung once on the left forearm by a bee at a park about 15 minutes before our arrival, with lip and eyelid swelling, hives, one episode of vomiting, wheeze and drowsiness: anaphylaxis. On our arrival she had GCS 13, BP 72/40, pulse 146 weak, resps 36 laboured with wheeze, SpO2 89% on room air, BGL 5.6. We scraped off the stinger, kept her supine and gave high-flow oxygen. She received epinephrine 0.2 milligrams IM into the anterolateral thigh at 1448, which is 0.01 milligrams per kilogram. Five minutes later she was GCS 14, BP 82/50, pulse 138, resps 30, SpO2 94% on 15 litres, a partial response, so a second 0.2 milligram IM dose was given at 1454. PCP: IV with a 400 mL fluid bolus, salbutamol 5 milligrams nebulized after the first epinephrine, and diphenhydramine 25 milligrams IV. Past history of mild eczema, no asthma, no medications, no known drug or food allergies; a large local reaction to a sting last summer. Last ate at 1415.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 5 岁女童，体重 20 kg，在公园被蜜蜂蜇伤左前臂一处，约在我们到场前 15 分钟，出现嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、荨麻疹、呕吐一次、喘鸣和嗜睡：过敏性休克。我们到场时 GCS 13、血压 72/40、脉搏 146 细弱、呼吸 36 费力伴喘鸣、SpO2 室内空气 89%、血糖 5.6。我们刮除了蜂刺、保持仰卧并高流量吸氧。14:48 于大腿前外侧肌注肾上腺素 0.2 mg，即 0.01 mg/kg。5 分钟后 GCS 14、血压 82/50、脉搏 138、呼吸 30、SpO2 15 L 下 94%，为部分好转，因此 14:54 追加第二剂 0.2 mg 肌注。PCP：已建立静脉通路并补液 400 mL，首剂肾上腺素后雾化沙丁胺醇 5 mg，苯海拉明 25 mg 静脉。既往轻度湿疹、无哮喘，无常规用药，无已知药物或食物过敏；去年夏天被蜇后有局部大片肿胀。最后进食 14:15。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Swollen lips and difficulty breathing after a bee sting (paediatric anaphylaxis)
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Stung once on the left forearm about 15 min before arrival; lip/eyelid swelling and hives within minutes, vomited once, then drowsy; worst reaction ever; weight 20 kg per mother; large local reaction to a sting last summer; sting-site pain 2/10
pcrKeyPoints.meds: None; nothing given for this reaction
pcrKeyPoints.allergies: No known drug or food allergies; no EpiPen; large local reaction to a bee sting last summer
treatments: Stinger scraped off
Supine, not walked
High-flow O2 15 L child-sized NRB
Epinephrine 0.2 mg IM (0.01 mg/kg x 20 kg) anterolateral thigh at 1448; second 0.2 mg IM at 1454
PCP: IV, 400 mL fluid bolus, salbutamol after epinephrine, diphenhydramine 25 mg IV
Entonox and oral analgesics withheld (altered LOC, vomiting)
RTC transport with en-route notification
findings: Lip/eyelid angioedema, hoarse voice, wheeze, urticaria, vomiting
Baseline GCS 13, BP 72/40, pulse 146, SpO2 89% RA, BGL 5.6
5 min post-epinephrine: GCS 14, BP 82/50, pulse 138, SpO2 94% on 15 L - partial response
Sting site: left forearm, local swelling, stinger embedded until scraped off

dispatch.narrativeEn: The mother says her daughter was stung once on the arm near a garbage bin, has no known bee allergy and no EpiPen, and is now very sleepy; a few bees are still around the bin.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 母亲称女儿在垃圾桶旁手臂被蜇了一下，没有已知的蜜蜂过敏史、也没有 EpiPen，现在非常嗜睡；垃圾桶周围仍有几只蜜蜂。

scene.narrativeEn: A parks worker flags you to a grassy area beside the playground. The child is on her mother's lap, limp and drowsy, lips visibly swollen, face flushed, with a wet cough and wheeze, and a small amount of vomit on the grass beside them.
scene.narrativeZh: 公园管理员把你引到游乐场旁的草地。孩子坐在母亲腿上，瘫软嗜睡，嘴唇明显肿胀、面部潮红，湿性咳嗽伴喘鸣，旁边草地上有少量呕吐物。

rows.en: Sunny afternoon, 24 °C, dry. The paved path lets the stretcher come to within 15 m. The father has carried the child about 10 m away from the garbage bin, where a few bees are still buzzing
rows.zh: 晴朗的下午，24 °C，干燥。担架车可沿铺装小路推到距现场 15 m 处。父亲已把孩子抱离垃圾桶约 10 m，桶边仍有几只蜜蜂在飞

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: Other children and parents stand back. The mother says no one else was stung
rows.zh: 其他孩子和家长站在远处。母亲说没有其他人被蜇

rows.en: Drowsy, whimpering; the mother is holding her upright and the child slumps against her
rows.zh: 嗜睡、哼哼唧唧；母亲抱着她保持直立，孩子软软地靠在母亲身上

rows.en: Drowsy, answers her mother's voice with a word or two ('can't... breathe', 'tummy hurts'). AVPU V
rows.zh: 嗜睡，对母亲的声音能回应一两个词（「喘…不上气」「肚子疼」）。AVPU 为 V

rows.en: Lips and eyelids swollen, hoarse cry, no stridor, vomited once with a little vomit still in the mouth; airway patent but at risk
rows.zh: 嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、哭声嘶哑、无喉鸣，呕吐过一次，口中仍有少量呕吐物；气道通畅但有危险

rows.en: 36, laboured with retractions and audible wheeze
rows.zh: 36 次/分，费力，有凹陷，可闻及喘鸣

rows.en: Radial pulse 146, weak
rows.zh: 桡动脉 146 次/分、细弱

rows.en: Face flushed, widespread urticaria (hives) over chest, back and limbs, hands cool
rows.zh: 面部潮红，胸、背和四肢广泛荨麻疹（风团），双手发凉

rows.en: 89% RA
rows.zh: 室内空气 89%

rows.en: One sting site on the left forearm with the stinger and venom sac still embedded, local swelling; no other stings, no trauma
rows.zh: 左前臂一处蜇伤点，蜂刺和毒囊仍留在皮肤内，局部肿胀；无其他蜇伤、无外伤

rows.en: NOT indicated (medical; she sat down on the grass - no fall, no head strike)
rows.zh: 无颈椎固定指征（内科问题；她是坐到草地上的——无跌倒、无头部撞击）

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed. Stability: UNSTABLE - anaphylaxis with respiratory distress and decreased LOC.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。判定：不稳定——过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫和意识下降。

rows.en: Within minutes the lips swelled and she broke out in hives; she vomited once about 5 minutes before you arrived, then went floppy and sleepy
rows.zh: 几分钟内嘴唇肿起、全身起风团；到场前约 5 分钟呕吐一次，随后变得软绵绵、嗜睡

rows.en: Sudden
rows.zh: 起病突然

rows.en: Nothing has helped (the mother gave nothing)
rows.zh: 什么都没起效（母亲什么药也没给）

rows.en: Worst reaction she has ever had. Sting-site pain: shown the faces scale, she points to 2/10
rows.zh: 是她历来最严重的一次反应。蜇伤处疼痛：给她看表情量表，她指向 2/10

rows.en: Stung about 15 minutes before your arrival
rows.zh: 约在到场前 15 分钟被蜇

rows.en: No known drug or food allergies; no EpiPen
rows.zh: 无已知药物或食物过敏；没有 EpiPen

rows.en: None
rows.zh: 无

rows.en: Mild eczema, no asthma. Last summer a sting caused a large local swelling only, with no breathing trouble
rows.zh: 轻度湿疹，无哮喘。去年夏天被蜇过一次，只有局部大片肿胀，没有呼吸困难

rows.en: Lunch at 1230, popsicle about 1415
Playing near the garbage bin, stung once on the left forearm
rows.zh: 在垃圾桶附近玩耍，左前臂被蜇了一下

rows.en: 5 years old; weighed 20 kg at her check-up last month
rows.zh: 5 岁；上个月体检时体重 20 kg

history.noteEn: The mother answers: the child is drowsy and gives only a word or two; use the mother.
history.noteZh: 由母亲回答：孩子嗜睡，只能说一两个词，主要问母亲。

sets.rxEn: 5 minutes after the first epinephrine dose
sets.rxZh: 首剂肾上腺素后 5 分钟

vitals.noteEn: Set 1 is the baseline BEFORE epinephrine (required before initiating a protocol). GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6, drowsy, whimpering). BP by auscultation with a child-sized cuff - systolic below 90 is the p.55 hypotension criterion; the guideline gives no separate paediatric cut-off. BGL 5.6 if checked (decreased LOC in a child - reasonable). Temp not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs and interventions 5 minutes after epinephrine and after each move. Set 2 (5 minutes after the first epinephrine dose, en route): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6), SpO2 94% on 15 L NRB, wheeze reduced but still present, no stridor, hands cool. PARTIAL response - BP is still under 90 and she is still wheezing, so the second epinephrine dose (0.2 mg IM; p.66: may repeat up to 3 times) is required now. PCP: because she remains hypotensive (p.55), IV and a 20 mL/kg bolus = 400 mL, reassessed when the 400 mL is in (the 500 mL checkpoint is not reached). If the candidate repeats epinephrine and runs the bolus, the next check about 5 minutes later is BP 94/58, pulse 126, SpO2 97% on 15 L, wheeze mild.
vitals.noteZh: 第 1 组为给肾上腺素前的基线（启动协议前必须完成）。GCS 13（E3 V4 M6，嗜睡、哼哼唧唧）。儿童袖带听诊血压——收缩压低于 90 即 p.55 的低血压标准；指南没有单独的儿童界值。若测血糖为 5.6（儿童意识下降，测血糖合理）。体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。肾上腺素后 5 分钟及每次移动后复评 ABC 与各项处置。第 2 组（首剂肾上腺素后 5 分钟，途中）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6），SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 94%，喘鸣减轻但仍有、无喉鸣，双手发凉。部分好转——血压仍低于 90、仍有喘鸣，所以现在必须追加第二剂肾上腺素（0.2 mg 肌注；p.66：最多可重复 3 次）。PCP：因仍低血压（p.55），建立静脉通路并按 20 mL/kg = 400 mL 补液，输完 400 mL 时复评（未到 500 mL 的复评点）。若考生已重复肾上腺素并在补液，约 5 分钟后的下一次检查为血压 94/58、脉搏 126、SpO2 15 L 下 97%、喘鸣轻微。

rows.en: Healthy and playing normally until the sting
rows.zh: 蜇伤前健康、玩耍如常

rows.en: Dizzy and sleepy, no headache, no seizure
rows.zh: 头晕嗜睡、无头痛、无抽搐

rows.en: Wheezy cough, hoarse voice, says her chest feels tight
rows.zh: 咳嗽伴喘鸣、声音嘶哑、说胸口发紧

rows.en: Says her heart is going fast, no heart problems
rows.zh: 说心跳得很快、无心脏病史

rows.en: Tummy ache, vomited once, no diarrhea
rows.zh: 肚子疼、呕吐过一次、无腹泻

rows.en: Itchy all over with hives, mild eczema on her elbows
rows.zh: 全身瘙痒、有风团，肘部有轻度湿疹

rows.en: Sore left forearm at the sting, otherwise nil
rows.zh: 左前臂蜇伤处疼痛，余处无

rows.en: Nil (no diabetes)
rows.zh: 无（无糖尿病）

rows.en: Lips and eyelids swollen, eyes itchy, says her throat feels funny
rows.zh: 嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、眼痒、说喉咙「怪怪的」

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route AFTER epinephrine, brief. The mother and child answer: the child gives a few words, the mother adds details.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，给肾上腺素后在途中简要完成。母亲和孩子回答：孩子只能说几个词，母亲补充细节。

rows.en: Lip and eyelid swelling, hoarse voice, no stridor
rows.zh: 嘴唇和眼睑肿胀、声音嘶哑、无喉鸣

rows.en: Expiratory wheeze in all fields on 6-site auscultation, equal air entry
rows.zh: 6 点听诊各野呼气相喘鸣、进气对称

rows.en: Soft, mild generalized tenderness
rows.zh: 软，轻度弥漫压痛

rows.en: Urticaria across the back
rows.zh: 背部可见荨麻疹

rows.en: Left forearm sting site red and swollen, about 4 cm across, stinger already scraped off (if the candidate has not removed it, it is still embedded), urticaria, CSM intact; right arm urticaria, CSM intact
rows.zh: 左前臂蜇伤处红肿、直径约 4 cm，蜂刺已被刮除（若考生尚未处理，蜂刺仍留在皮肤内），荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好；右臂荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好

rows.en: Urticaria, CSM intact
rows.zh: 荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好

scenarios.titleZh: 仪表台撞膝——髋关节后脱位
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1648 hrs. Code 3 to King George Boulevard at 72 Avenue in Surrey. Two-vehicle collision, a front passenger is complaining of right hip pain, the driver is walking. Hospital is 14 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 16:48，Code 3 前往素里 King George Boulevard 与 72 Avenue 交叉口。两车相撞，前排乘客诉右髋疼痛，司机能行走。医院车程 14 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: fire first responders are already on scene and report the front passenger is conscious and complaining of right hip and knee pain, and the driver is walking.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：消防第一响应者已在现场，报告前排乘客清醒、诉右髋和右膝疼痛，司机能行走。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan the stretcher, a sized hard collar, blankets, ties and rolled blankets, Entonox and the oral analgesics, and high-visibility gear
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备担架床、合适尺寸的硬颈托、毯子、绑带和卷毯、Entonox 及口服镇痛药，以及高可视度反光装备

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a frontal-impact patient who needs spinal motion restriction and a limb injury that needs careful movement; ask dispatch for a second crew so the driver does not distract you
expected.actionZh: 预判正面撞击的患者需要脊柱活动限制，且肢体损伤需要谨慎搬动；请调度加派第二组人员，使司机不分散你的注意力

expected.actionEn: Brief the partner before arrival: one takes the head and the c-spine, the other the assessment and the drugs
expected.actionZh: 到场前先与搭档分工：一人负责头部和颈椎，另一人负责评估和用药

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a roadway scene in the rain: high-visibility vest, gloves and eye protection before leaving the unit
expected.actionZh: 预判雨中的路面现场：下车前穿好反光背心，戴手套和护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Cold steady rain, 6 degrees C, dusk with streetlights on, wet roadway at an intersection. Police have stopped traffic and the fire first responders are with you. Two vehicles: a pickup that ran the red light struck a grey SUV head-on at the front, estimated 50 km/h, airbags deployed, the dash panel is cracked at knee level, no significant intrusion into the passenger compartment, no fluid leak, both vehicles stable. The patient, a 36-year-old man, is the belted front passenger, still sitting in the seat with the door open and the seat slid fully back by the fire crew; he is alert, grimacing, holding his right thigh, and wants to stay still. The driver, a coworker, is walking and is being assessed by fire first responders - he is not your patient. One patient for you.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：冷雨持续，6 摄氏度，黄昏、路灯已亮，路口路面湿滑。警察已封路，消防第一响应者与你在一起。两辆车：一辆闯红灯的皮卡正面撞上一辆灰色 SUV 的前部，估计时速 50 km/h，安全气囊已弹出，仪表台在膝部高度处有裂痕，乘客舱无明显侵入，无漏液，两车均稳固。患者是一名 36 岁男性，系着安全带的前排乘客，仍坐在座位上，车门已打开，座椅已被消防人员完全向后滑动；他清醒、面带痛苦，手按着右大腿，不想动。司机是他的同事，能行走，正由消防第一响应者评估——不是你的患者。你负责一名患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (road traffic held by police, wet roadway, vehicles stable, no fluid leak), environment (cold rain, dusk), MOI (head-on frontal impact at about 50 km/h, belted, airbags deployed, no intrusion), number of patients (1 yours, the driver is with fire) and resources (fire first responders)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（警察已拦停车流、路面湿滑、车辆稳固、无漏液）、环境（冷雨、黄昏）、受伤机制（正面撞击约 50 km/h、系安全带、安全气囊弹出、无侵入）、患者数量（你负责 1 名，司机由消防照看）和资源（消防第一响应者）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves, eye protection and a high-visibility vest
expected.actionZh: 戴手套、护目镜，穿反光背心

expected.actionEn: First look: alert man belted in the front passenger seat, grimacing, holding his right thigh, the right leg held flexed against the dash, wants to stay still
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：清醒男性系着安全带坐在前排乘客座，面带痛苦、手按右大腿，右腿屈曲抵着仪表台，想保持不动

expected.actionEn: Ask the fire first responders to keep the vehicle stable and to bring the stretcher, blankets and a weather cover to the door
expected.actionZh: 请消防第一响应者稳住车辆，并把担架床、毯子和防雨罩带到车门旁

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert, oriented, in severe pain: 'my knee hit the dash and my hip is on fire'; his right foot feels 'asleep and numb'; he wants to stay still and does not want anyone to touch the leg. EXAMINER (give each finding only when assessed): airway clear, speaks full sentences; respirations 20, regular; radial pulse 96, strong and regular. Skin: pink, warm, dry (no shock). RBS (the candidate must expose the right hip and leg): the right leg is SHORTENED, flexed at the hip and knee, ADDUCTED and INTERNALLY ROTATED, resting against the dash - a posterior hip dislocation; abrasion, swelling and bruising over the front of the right knee; no open wound and no external bleeding; pelvis stable and not tender on one gentle compression; abdomen soft, no seat-belt mark; no other injuries. Right foot CSM: dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses PRESENT, foot warm and pink, capillary refill under 2 seconds; sensation DECREASED - numb over the outer foot and sole; toes move only weakly and he cannot lift the foot. Left leg normal. SpO2 98% RA. C-SPINE (NEXUS): no midline neck tenderness, alert and oriented, not intoxicated, but a NEW focal neurological deficit (right foot numbness) and a major DISTRACTING injury (the hip dislocation) = NEXUS positive, spinal motion restriction indicated; the Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor 'paresthesias in extremities' is also present. If the candidate lifts, rotates, straightens or pulls on the right leg the patient screams (pain 10/10) and the hip does not move. RTC: all hip dislocations are RAPID TRANSPORT; vital signs are stable but the neurological impairment makes this a limb-threatening injury.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、定向力正常，剧烈疼痛：「我的膝盖撞到了仪表台，髋部像着了火」；右脚感觉「发麻、没知觉」；他想保持不动，不让任何人碰那条腿。考官（评估时才给出相应发现）：气道通畅，能说完整句子；呼吸 20 次/分、规则；桡动脉 96 次/分、有力规则。皮肤：红润、温暖、干燥（无休克）。RBS（考生必须暴露右髋和右腿）：右腿缩短，髋、膝屈曲，内收并内旋，靠在仪表台上——髋关节后脱位；右膝前方擦伤、肿胀、淤青；无开放伤口、无外出血；骨盆稳定，轻柔按压一次无压痛；腹软，无安全带痕；无其他损伤。右足 CSM：足背动脉和胫后动脉搏动存在，足暖而红润，毛细血管再充盈小于 2 秒；感觉减退——足外侧和足底麻木；脚趾只能微弱活动，无法抬起足部。左腿正常。SpO2 室内空气 98%。颈椎（NEXUS）：颈部无中线压痛、清醒且定向力正常、未醉酒，但有新的局灶性神经功能缺损（右足麻木）和重大分散注意力的损伤（髋关节脱位）=NEXUS 阳性，有脊柱活动限制指征；加拿大颈椎规则的高危因素「肢体感觉异常」同样存在。若考生抬起、旋转、拉直或牵拉右腿，患者尖叫（疼痛 10/10），髋关节纹丝不动。RTC：所有髋关节脱位都属快速转运类别；生命体征平稳，但神经功能受损使其成为威胁肢体的损伤。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert and oriented
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：清醒、定向力正常

expected.actionEn: Take manual c-spine stabilization at first contact (frontal MVC with a significant injury) before any movement or pain stimulus, apply the modified NEXUS out loud - new focal neurological deficit and a major distracting injury are positive - and justify spinal motion restriction (Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor: paresthesias in extremities); not multi-trauma, so simple SMR
expected.actionZh: 首次接触即徒手稳定颈椎（正面 MVC 伴重大损伤），先于任何移动或疼痛刺激；大声应用改良 NEXUS——新的局灶性神经功能缺损和重大分散注意力的损伤均为阳性——并说明脊柱活动限制的理由（加拿大颈椎规则高危因素：肢体感觉异常）；非多发伤，故为简易 SMR

expected.actionEn: Assess airway: clear, speaking full sentences
expected.actionZh: 评估气道：通畅，能说完整句子

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing rate, depth and effort
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸频率、深度与做功

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse strong and regular, skin pink warm dry - no shock; the pulse is not the tachycardia of blood loss
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉有力规则，皮肤红润温暖干燥——无休克；脉搏不是失血性心动过速

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey: expose the right hip and leg, recognize the posterior hip dislocation (shortened, flexed, adducted, internally rotated), check the pelvis with ONE gentle compression, find the knee injury, and check right-foot pulses, sensation and movement BEFORE anything is moved
expected.actionZh: 快速查体：暴露右髋和右腿，识别髋关节后脱位（缩短、屈曲、内收、内旋），轻柔按压骨盆一次，发现膝部损伤，并在任何搬动之前检查右足脉搏、感觉和活动

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pink, warm, dry - evidence against shock
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：红润、温暖、干燥——提示无休克

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the oxygen decision: trauma is an indication (p.11) but oxygen is titrated to SpO2 94% (p.50) and he is at 98% on room air with no distress or shock, so none is required now; apply if it falls
expected.actionZh: 口述氧疗决定：创伤是吸氧指征（第 11 页），但氧气按 SpO2 94% 滴定（第 50 页），他室内空气下 98%、无窘迫或休克，故目前不需要；若下降则给予

expected.actionEn: Leave him in the position of comfort found with the right leg supported where it lies; blankets over him against the cold and rain
expected.actionZh: 保持发现时的舒适体位，右腿就地支托；盖毯保暖防寒防雨

phases.infoEn: Decision point. 'All hip dislocations are in the Rapid Transport Category' (p.22); the new neurological deficit in the right foot makes this a limb-threatening injury and 'new onset neurological deficits' is also on the unstable-findings list (p.7). Vital signs are stable, so there is no shock protocol, but the priority is early medical reduction: do not stay on scene. Analgesia first (a helper may steady the limb where it lies meanwhile), then limb support with blankets and ties and SMR, then the move; packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes, with the secondary survey en route. Delegate fire first responders under direction (stretcher, blankets, limb support, head); the second crew looks after the driver.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。「所有髋关节脱位都属快速转运类别」（第 22 页）；右足新出现的神经功能缺损使其成为威胁肢体的损伤，「新发神经功能缺损」也在不稳定表现清单上（第 7 页）。生命体征平稳，所以没有休克协议，但首要任务是尽早医疗复位：不要滞留现场。先镇痛（其间帮手可就地稳住肢体），再用毯子和绑带支托肢体并做 SMR，然后搬动；15 分钟内打包完毕可装载，二次评估在途中完成。指导消防第一响应者（担架床、毯子、支托肢体、扶头）；第二组人员照看司机。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and name the criterion: all hip dislocations are RTC (p.22), the neurological impairment makes it limb-threatening, and a new neurological deficit is also on the p.7 list
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并说出依据：所有髋关节脱位都属 RTC（第 22 页），神经功能受损使其威胁肢体，新发神经功能缺损也在第 7 页清单上

expected.actionEn: Packaged (analgesia given, limb supported, SMR on, on the stretcher with straps secured) and ready to load within 15 minutes of arrival, with the secondary survey done en route
expected.actionZh: 到场后 15 分钟内打包完毕可装载（已镇痛、肢体已支托、已做 SMR、躺在担架床上束带扣好），二次评估在途中完成

expected.actionEn: Delegate fire first responders and the partner effectively: stretcher and blankets, helpers to support the limb, someone holding the head, a slide device; nobody pulls on the leg
expected.actionZh: 有效指挥消防第一响应者和搭档：担架床和毯子、支托肢体的帮手、扶头的人、滑动转运器具；任何人都不得牵拉腿部

expected.actionEn: Brief every helper before each move - who holds the head, who supports the limb, a clear 'ready, lift' count - and move as one unit
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动前向所有帮手交代清楚——谁扶头、谁托肢体、明确的「准备、起」口令——并作为一个整体一起移动

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: a pickup ran the red light and hit them head-on at about 1640; he was the belted front passenger, the airbag went off, his right knee slammed into the dash and he felt the hip 'pop'; no head strike, no loss of consciousness, no neck or back pain; he has not moved since. Right hip, thigh and knee pain 8/10, sharp and throbbing, constant, worse with any movement, nothing makes it better; the right foot has been numb and tingling since the impact. PMHx: seasonal allergies; no previous hip, knee or back problems, no surgery, no diabetes, no heart or lung disease, no ulcers or stomach bleeding, no liver disease. Meds: cetirizine as needed, no blood thinners; he took acetaminophen 1000 mg at 0900 for a headache and nothing since, no ibuprofen today. Allergies: none known (no NSAID allergy). LOI: lunch (sandwich and coffee) at 1230.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：一辆皮卡闯红灯，约 16:40 与他们迎面相撞；他是系着安全带的前排乘客，安全气囊弹出，右膝重重撞在仪表台上，感觉髋部「啪」地一响；头部没撞到，无意识丧失，无颈部或背部疼痛；此后一直没动过。右髋、大腿和膝部疼痛 8/10，锐痛并搏动样，持续存在，任何活动都加重，没有缓解的办法；撞击以来右脚一直发麻、刺痛。既往史：季节性过敏；既往没有髋、膝或背部问题，无手术史，无糖尿病，无心脏或肺部疾病，无溃疡或胃出血，无肝病。用药：西替利嗪按需，无抗凝药；上午 09:00 因头痛服过 1000 mg 对乙酰氨基酚，之后没再服，今天没服布洛芬。过敏：无已知过敏（无 NSAID 过敏）。最后进食：12:30 午餐（三明治和咖啡）。

expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：碰撞后右髋、大腿和膝部疼痛，右脚麻木

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with the MVC critical questions and OPQRRRST: position in the vehicle, vehicles and impact speed, damage, restraints, airbags, head strike, loss of consciousness, what the knee hit, whether he has moved, onset and character of the pain
expected.actionZh: 用 MVC 关键问题和 OPQRRRST 采集现病史：车内位置、车辆和撞击速度、损坏情况、约束装置、气囊、有无头部撞击、有无意识丧失、膝部撞到什么、有没有移动过、疼痛起病和性质

expected.actionZh: 疼痛评分（8/10），以及加重和缓解因素

expected.actionEn: PMHx, asking directly about previous hip and back problems and the items that bear on the drug contraindications (ulcers or stomach bleeding, liver disease)
expected.actionZh: 既往史，并直接询问既往髋部和背部问题，以及与药物禁忌相关的项目（溃疡或胃出血、肝病）

expected.actionEn: Medications - cetirizine, no anticoagulants, and the time of the last acetaminophen (0900) against the 4-hour rule and the 24-hour maximum

BGL not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no altered LOC); temperature not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - collar on, no scalp or facial injury, no midline neck tenderness, trachea midline, no JVD; chest - no seat-belt mark, non-tender, equal air entry on 6-site auscultation; abdomen - soft and non-tender, no seat-belt mark; back - no midline tenderness felt during the transfer; lower extremities - RIGHT: shortened, flexed, adducted and internally rotated, supported in that position by blankets and ties, abrasion and swelling over the front of the knee, tender over the patella, no knee deformity, pedal pulses present, foot warm, sensation still decreased over the outer foot and sole, toes move weakly; LEFT: normal, pulses, sensation and movement intact; upper extremities - nil, radial pulses present, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——颈托在位，头皮和面部无损伤，颈部无中线压痛，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张；胸部——无安全带痕，无压痛，6 点听诊双侧进气对称；腹部——软、无压痛，无安全带痕；背部——转运时触及无中线压痛；下肢——右侧：缩短、屈曲、内收并内旋，由毯子和绑带支托在该位置，膝前方擦伤肿胀，髌骨压痛，膝关节无畸形，足背动脉搏动存在，足暖，足外侧和足底感觉仍减退，脚趾活动微弱；左侧：正常，脉搏、感觉和活动完好；上肢——无，桡动脉搏动存在，远端 CSM 完好。
