phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS, in this order. 1) Spinal motion restriction (NEXUS positive): manual stabilization of the head and neck, a properly sized hard collar, head NOT taped; simple SMR means collar on and the patient on a mattress or firm stretcher, not a clamshell (p.25-26). 2) Pain Management BEFORE the limb is supported with blankets and ties or he is moved - a helper may steady the limb where it lies meanwhile (p.21: analgesia prior to movement in stable, appropriate patients; Appendix A rule 6), with baseline vitals including SpO2 complete and every contraindication ruled out aloud. Acetaminophen 500-1000 mg PO (contraindications: hypersensitivity, severe liver disease, a dose within the last 4 hours or the 24-hour maximum of 4000 mg exceeded, suspected overdose - he took 1000 mg at 0900, so a further dose is acceptable; p.58). Ibuprofen 300-400 mg PO (contraindications: NSAID hypersensitivity, active GI hemorrhage or ulcers, pregnancy, anticoagulants - none; may be given with acetaminophen; p.68). Entonox, self-administered (invert the cylinder 3 times; contraindications: inability to comply, inability to ventilate an enclosed treatment area, decompression sickness, altered LOC, pneumothorax, air embolism, inhalation injury, nitroglycerin in the last 5 minutes - none; cautions: shock, abdominal distention, depressant drugs, COPD, facial injuries - none; in the ambulance turn on the ventilation system; p.65). Oral drugs take 30-60 minutes, so they go in early and Entonox covers the move. 3) Quickly support the injured limb IN THE POSITION FOUND with helpers, rolled blankets and ties - NO traction, NO traction splint, NO attempt to straighten, rotate or reduce the hip; the general p.21 line 'realign grossly deformed limbs' does not apply because pulses are present and p.22 governs hip dislocations (p.22-23). 4) Check pulse, sensation and movement of the right foot before and after every move. 5) Move him onto a firm, blanketed stretcher (or spinal device) and secure him so there is no motion in the affected hip; keep him warm; finish the secondary survey en route (p.22). 6) Pelvic binder NOT indicated: the pelvis is stable and non-tender and this is not a major pelvic mechanism (p.24-25). 7) Oxygen: titrate to SpO2 94% - none needed at 98% on room air (p.50). 8) If the hip spontaneously reduces during treatment or transport, update the receiving hospital. PCP ADDITIONS: the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route; no IV or fluid bolus (no shock, the p.54 criteria are not met).
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用，按此顺序：1) 脊柱活动限制（NEXUS 阳性）：徒手稳定头颈，用尺寸合适的硬颈托，头部不贴胶带；简易 SMR 即戴颈托、患者躺在床垫或坚硬担架床上，不用铲式担架（第 25-26 页）。2) 在用毯子和绑带支托肢体或搬动他之前先镇痛，其间帮手可就地稳住肢体（第 21 页：对稳定、合适的患者在搬动前给予镇痛；附录 A 第 6 条），基线生命体征（含 SpO2）已完成，并逐条大声排除各药禁忌。对乙酰氨基酚 500-1000 mg 口服（禁忌：过敏、严重肝病、4 小时内已服过或超过 24 小时上限 4000 mg、疑似过量——他 09:00 服过 1000 mg，所以可再给；第 58 页）。布洛芬 300-400 mg 口服（禁忌：NSAID 过敏、活动性消化道出血或溃疡、妊娠、抗凝药——均无；可与对乙酰氨基酚合用；第 68 页）。Entonox 自行吸入（钢瓶倒置 3 次；禁忌：无法配合、无法给治疗区通风、减压病、意识改变、气胸、空气栓塞、吸入性损伤、5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油——均无；慎用：休克、腹胀、抑制类药物、COPD、面部损伤——均无；在救护车内要开启通风系统；第 65 页）。口服药起效需 30-60 分钟，所以尽早给，由 Entonox 覆盖搬动过程。3) 用帮手、卷毯和绑带，迅速把伤肢就地按发现时的位置支托——不牵引、不用牵引夹板、不要试图拉直、旋转或复位髋关节；第 21 页「复位严重畸形的肢体」的一般规则在此不适用，因为脉搏存在且髋关节脱位以第 22 页为准（第 22-23 页）。4) 每次搬动前后都检查右足脉搏、感觉和活动。5) 把他移到坚硬、铺有毯子的担架床（或脊柱固定装置）上并固定好，使受累髋关节不再活动；保暖；二次评估在途中完成（第 22 页）。6) 不需要骨盆带：骨盆稳定、无压痛，也不是重大骨盆损伤机制（第 24-25 页）。7) 氧气：按 SpO2 94% 滴定——室内空气 98% 时不需要（第 50 页）。8) 若髋关节在治疗或转运中自行复位，通知接收医院。PCP 追加：途中做 9 系统功能问诊；无需静脉通路或补液（无休克，不符合第 54 页标准）。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Pain Management protocol only with baseline vitals (including SpO2) complete and every contraindication ruled out aloud: acetaminophen (hypersensitivity, liver disease, dose within 4 hours or the 24-hour maximum, overdose), ibuprofen (NSAID hypersensitivity, GI hemorrhage or ulcers, pregnancy, anticoagulants) and Entonox (inability to comply, altered LOC, pneumothorax, inhalation injury, decompression sickness, air embolism, nitroglycerin in the last 5 minutes)
expected.actionZh: 仅在基线生命体征（含 SpO2）完成、并逐条大声排除各药禁忌后才启动疼痛管理协议：对乙酰氨基酚（过敏、肝病、4 小时内已服或超 24 小时上限、过量）、布洛芬（NSAID 过敏、消化道出血或溃疡、妊娠、抗凝药）和 Entonox（无法配合、意识改变、气胸、吸入性损伤、减压病、空气栓塞、5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油）

expected.actionEn: Give the analgesia BEFORE the limb is supported with blankets and ties or he is moved (a helper may steady the limb where it lies meanwhile) - Entonox must not wait until after the limb support and the transfer (Appendix A rule 6; p.21 'analgesia prior to movement')
expected.actionZh: 在用毯子和绑带支托肢体或搬动他之前就给镇痛（其间帮手可就地稳住肢体）——Entonox 不得拖到肢体支托和转运之后（附录 A 第 6 条；第 21 页「搬动前镇痛」）

expected.actionEn: Administer acetaminophen 1000 mg PO, ibuprofen 400 mg PO and self-administered Entonox (cylinder inverted 3 times, area ventilated) with the 6 rights; identical at EMR and PCP
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对给予对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服、布洛芬 400 mg 口服及自行吸入 Entonox（钢瓶倒置 3 次、治疗区通风）；EMR 与 PCP 相同

expected.actionEn: Support the limb in the position found with helpers, rolled blankets and ties, and do NOT attempt traction, a traction splint, straightening or reduction of the hip (p.22-23)
expected.actionZh: 用帮手、卷毯和绑带把伤肢就地按发现时的位置支托，并且绝不尝试牵引、牵引夹板、拉直或复位髋关节（第 22-23 页）

expected.actionEn: Fracture-management skill: manual support of the limb throughout, right-foot pulses, sensation and movement checked before and after every move, secured to the stretcher so there is no motion in the affected hip, kept warm
expected.actionZh: 骨折处理技能：全程徒手支托肢体，每次搬动前后检查右足脉搏、感觉和活动，固定在担架床上使受累髋关节不再活动，并保暖

expected.actionEn: Spinal-management skill: manual stabilization maintained, hard collar sized correctly, head NOT taped, neutral alignment, firm blanketed stretcher or spinal device (a mattress, not a clamshell, for simple SMR), minimal movement in the transfer
expected.actionZh: 脊柱处理技能：全程保持徒手稳定，硬颈托尺寸正确，头部不贴胶带，保持中立对线，用坚硬铺毯的担架床或脊柱固定装置（简易 SMR 用床垫而非铲式担架），转运时尽量少动

expected.actionEn: Verbalize why no pelvic binder: the pelvis is stable and non-tender, this is not a major pelvic mechanism, and the dislocated hip is managed by support in the position found (p.22, p.24)
expected.actionZh: 口述为何不上骨盆带：骨盆稳定、无压痛，并非重大骨盆损伤机制，脱位的髋关节靠按发现时位置支托来处理（第 22、24 页）

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the limb support, the collar and the right-foot CSM after every move and with every set. Set 2 (about 6 minutes after set 1, on the stretcher after analgesia with the hip secured): GCS 15; BP 130/80; pulse 84 strong regular; respirations 18 regular; skin pink, warm, dry; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on room air; pain 3/10. Right foot: pulses still present, numbness unchanged (no better, no worse); the hip is unchanged in the position found. BGL not repeated. If at any reassessment the hip has spontaneously reduced (leg longer and straighter, pain suddenly easier), recheck the CSM and update the receiving hospital.
phases.infoZh: 每次搬动后以及每一组生命体征时，复评 ABC、肢体支托、颈托和右足 CSM。第 2 组（第 1 组后约 6 分钟，镇痛后躺在担架床上、髋部已固定）：GCS 15；血压 130/80；脉搏 84 有力规则；呼吸 18 规则；皮肤红润、温暖、干燥；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 98%；疼痛 3/10。右足：脉搏仍存在，麻木无变化（没好转也没加重）；髋部仍保持发现时的位置。血糖不需复测。若任何一次复评发现髋关节已自行复位（腿变长变直、疼痛突然减轻），复查 CSM 并通知接收医院。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, the collar, the limb support and the straps after each move and with each set of vitals
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后及每组生命体征时复评 ABC、颈托、肢体支托和束带

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes and interpret the response to the analgesia
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并解读对镇痛的反应

expected.actionEn: Re-check right-foot pulses, sensation and movement after every move and with every set, compare with the baseline and report any change
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后及每组生命体征时复查右足脉搏、感觉和活动，与基线对比并报告任何变化

expected.actionEn: Reassess the pain score (3/10) and let him continue Entonox to effect
expected.actionZh: 复评疼痛评分（3/10），让他继续吸入 Entonox 至起效

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that if the hip spontaneously reduces during treatment or transport, the receiving hospital is updated (p.22)
expected.actionZh: 口述：若髋关节在治疗或转运中自行复位，须通知接收医院（第 22 页）

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - notify the receiving hospital en route: posterior hip dislocation with neurological impairment, early reduction needed. The hand-off states the position the limb is supported in, the right-foot CSM before and after each move, the analgesia given with times, the SMR decision, and that no traction or reduction was attempted. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中通知接收医院：髋关节后脱位伴神经功能受损，需尽早复位。交接须说明肢体支托的位置、每次搬动前后的右足 CSM、给予的镇痛药及时间、SMR 的决定，以及未尝试牵引或复位。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification: posterior hip dislocation with neurological impairment, RTC, early reduction needed
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：髋关节后脱位伴神经功能受损，RTC，需尽早复位

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with the mechanism, the limb position, the analgesia given with times and doses, and both sets of vitals
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：受伤机制、肢体位置、给予的镇痛药及时间和剂量、两组生命体征

expected.actionEn: State the right-foot CSM before and after each move, the NEXUS-based SMR, that no traction or reduction was attempted, and the plan to update the hospital if the hip reduces
expected.actionZh: 说明每次搬动前后的右足 CSM、基于 NEXUS 的 SMR、未尝试牵引或复位，以及若髋关节复位将通知医院的安排

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes with the NEXUS reasoning, drug times and the neurovascular checks
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，含 NEXUS 推理、给药时间和神经血管检查

vitalsSets.timeHint: baseline, before analgesia
on the stretcher after analgesia, about 6 minutes after set 1

criticalPitfallsEn: Trying to straighten, rotate or 'pop back' the leg, or letting a helper pull on it - p.22 says support the limb in the position found and leave reduction to the hospital; the p.21 line 'realign grossly deformed limbs' does not apply to a hip dislocation with pulses present - up to 100% (overall patient care, limb-threatening act)
Applying a traction splint - it is indicated only for suspected mid-shaft femur fractures in stable patients (p.23) and on a dislocated hip it is a limb-threatening act - up to 100%
Categorizing as non-RTC because the vital signs are normal and he is talking - p.22: ALL hip dislocations are RTC, and the foot numbness makes it limb-threatening; transport-category error, 25%
Delaying Entonox until after the limb is supported or he is moved (Appendix A rule 6) - 100%; giving Entonox without both oral drugs - 10%; giving the oral drugs without Entonox - 25%

Skipping spinal motion restriction because he has no neck pain - the modified NEXUS is positive here (new focal neurological deficit plus a major distracting injury); failing to take c-spine control when indicated - 100%

Not checking and recording right-foot pulses, sensation and movement before and after each move (fracture management, 15-25%), or forgetting to update the hospital if the hip spontaneously reduces (p.22)
Applying a pelvic binder by reflex - the pelvis is stable and non-tender and this is not a major pelvic mechanism (p.24); an unnecessary intervention, up to 25%
criticalPitfallsZh: 试图拉直、旋转或「推回」那条腿，或让帮手牵拉——第 22 页要求按发现时的位置支托肢体、把复位留给医院；第 21 页「复位严重畸形的肢体」不适用于脉搏存在的髋关节脱位——最高扣 100%（overall patient care，威胁肢体的行为）
使用牵引夹板——它只适用于稳定患者疑似股骨干中段骨折（第 23 页），用在脱位的髋关节上属于威胁肢体的行为——最高扣 100%
因生命体征正常、能说话就判为非 RTC——第 22 页：所有髋关节脱位都是 RTC，足部麻木更使其威胁肢体；转运分类错误，扣 25%
把 Entonox 拖到支托肢体或搬动之后才给（附录 A 第 6 条）——扣 100%；只给 Entonox 而不给两种口服药——扣 10%；只给口服药不给 Entonox——扣 25%
因无颈痛而省略脊柱活动限制——此处改良 NEXUS 为阳性（新的局灶性神经功能缺损加重大分散注意力的损伤）；有指征却未做颈椎控制——扣 100%
搬动前后不检查并记录右足脉搏、感觉和活动（骨折处理，扣 15-25%），或髋关节自行复位后忘记通知医院（第 22 页）
反射性地上骨盆带——骨盆稳定、无压痛，也不是重大骨盆损伤机制（第 24 页）；不必要的干预，最高扣 25%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR performs the whole call: manual c-spine stabilization and the NEXUS decision, simple SMR with a collar, the rapid body survey with right-foot CSM, the full Appendix A pain rule (oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen for pain are within the EMR licence - only pyrexia dosing is PCP-only, p.58/68 - plus Entonox, all before the limb is supported or moved), limb support with blankets and ties in the position found, the move to a firm blanketed stretcher, and RTC transport. No traction splint, no reduction attempt. No IV, no Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 完成整个呼救：徒手稳定颈椎并做 NEXUS 判断、戴颈托的简易 SMR、含右足 CSM 的快速查体、完整的附录 A 疼痛规则（对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬用于镇痛属 EMR 执照范围——只有退热剂量是 PCP 专属，第 58/68 页——加 Entonox，全部在支托或搬动肢体之前给）、用毯子和绑带按发现时位置支托肢体、转移到坚硬铺毯的担架床，以及 RTC 转运。不用牵引夹板，不尝试复位。无静脉通路，无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP does everything the EMR does and adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route. IV access and a fluid bolus are not indicated (no shock; the p.54 criteria are not met). (textbook practice - not a BC rubric item) A binder is not a treatment for a dislocated hip, and a seated patient is usually slid out with the hip kept flexed rather than extended.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 完成 EMR 的全部内容，并增加途中的 9 系统功能问诊。无需静脉通路和补液（无休克，不符合第 54 页标准）。（教科书做法——非 BC 评分项）骨盆带不能治疗脱位的髋关节；坐位患者通常保持髋关节屈曲平移出来，而不是把髋拉直。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 36-year-old male, belted front passenger in a head-on collision at about 50 km/h at 1640, airbags deployed, no intrusion, no head strike or loss of consciousness. He has a posterior right hip dislocation - the leg shortened, flexed, adducted and internally rotated - with a numb right foot, weak toe movement but present pedal pulses, and a bruised, swollen right knee from the dash. Spinal motion restriction was applied for a positive NEXUS: a new focal neurological deficit and a major distracting injury. Baseline at 1700: GCS 15, BP 138/84, pulse 96, resps 20, SpO2 98% on room air, pain 8/10. Acetaminophen 1000 mg and ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth at 1701 and Entonox from 1702, then the limb was supported in the position found with blankets and ties and he was secured to a firm stretcher; ready to load at 1708. At 1706: BP 130/80, pulse 84, resps 18, SpO2 98%, pain 3/10, right-foot pulses present and numbness unchanged. No traction and no reduction attempt. History: seasonal allergies, cetirizine, no blood thinners, acetaminophen 1000 mg at 0900, no known drug allergies, last ate at 1230. RTC for early reduction; we will update you if the hip reduces on its own.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 36 岁男性，是 16:40 一起约 50 km/h 正面碰撞中系着安全带的前排乘客，安全气囊弹出，无侵入，无头部撞击或意识丧失。他有右髋关节后脱位——腿缩短、屈曲、内收并内旋——右脚麻木、脚趾活动微弱但足背动脉搏动存在，右膝被仪表台撞得淤青肿胀。因 NEXUS 阳性（新的局灶性神经功能缺损和重大分散注意力的损伤）做了脊柱活动限制。17:00 基线：GCS 15，血压 138/84，脉搏 96，呼吸 20，SpO2 室内空气 98%，疼痛 8/10。17:01 口服对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 和布洛芬 400 mg，17:02 起吸入 Entonox，然后用毯子和绑带按发现时位置支托肢体，并固定在坚硬的担架床上；17:08 可装载。17:06：血压 130/80，脉搏 84，呼吸 18，SpO2 98%，疼痛 3/10，右足脉搏存在、麻木无变化。未牵引、未尝试复位。病史：季节性过敏，服西替利嗪，无抗凝药，09:00 服过对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg，无已知药物过敏，12:30 进食。RTC，以便尽早复位；若髋关节自行复位，我们会再通知你们。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Right hip, thigh and knee pain after a head-on collision; posterior right hip dislocation with a numb right foot
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Belted front passenger, head-on collision at about 50 km/h at about 1640, airbags deployed, right knee struck the dash, felt the hip 'pop'; no head strike or LOC; pain 8/10; right foot numb and tingling since impact
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Seasonal allergies; no hip, knee or back problems, no surgery, no diabetes, no ulcers or GI bleeding, no liver disease
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Cetirizine as needed; no blood thinners; acetaminophen 1000 mg at 0900 for a headache
treatments: Manual c-spine stabilization at first contact; NEXUS positive (new focal neurological deficit, major distracting injury); simple SMR with a hard collar, head not taped
Acetaminophen 1000 mg PO at 1701, ibuprofen 400 mg PO at 1701, Entonox from 1702 - all before the limb was supported or moved, contraindications ruled out for each
Limb supported in the position found with helpers, rolled blankets and ties; no traction, no traction splint, no reduction attempt
Moved to a firm blanketed stretcher and secured to eliminate motion in the affected hip; kept warm; ready to load at 1708
Right-foot pulses, sensation and movement checked before and after each move
No pelvic binder (pelvis stable and non-tender); oxygen not required at SpO2 98% on room air
RTC transport with en-route notification; hospital to be updated if the hip spontaneously reduces
findings: Right leg shortened, flexed, adducted and internally rotated - posterior hip dislocation; right knee abrasion, swelling and bruising
Right foot: pulses present, warm, pink, sensation decreased over the outer foot and sole, toes move weakly
Pelvis stable and non-tender; no other injuries; no seat-belt mark
Baseline GCS 15, BP 138/84, pulse 96, resps 20, SpO2 98% on room air, pain 8/10
Set 2: BP 130/80, pulse 84, resps 18, SpO2 98%, pain 3/10, neurovascular status unchanged

dispatch.narrativeEn: Dispatch update en route: fire first responders are already on scene and report the front passenger is conscious and complaining of right hip and knee pain, and the driver is walking.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 途中调度更新：消防第一响应者已在现场，报告前排乘客清醒、诉右髋和右膝疼痛，司机能行走。

scene.narrativeEn: Cold steady rain, 6 degrees C, dusk with streetlights on, wet roadway at an intersection. The patient, a 36-year-old man, is the belted front passenger, still sitting in the seat with the door open and the seat slid fully back by the fire crew; he is alert, grimacing, holding his right thigh, and wants to stay still.
scene.narrativeZh: 冷雨持续，6 摄氏度，黄昏、路灯已亮，路口路面湿滑。患者是一名 36 岁男性，系着安全带的前排乘客，仍坐在座位上，车门已打开，座椅已被消防人员完全向后滑动；他清醒、面带痛苦，手按着右大腿，不想动。

rows.en: Police have stopped traffic; both vehicles stable, no fluid leak
rows.zh: 警察已封路；两车均稳固，无漏液

rows.en: Two vehicles: a pickup that ran the red light struck a grey SUV head-on at the front, estimated 50 km/h, airbags deployed, the dash panel is cracked at knee level, no significant intrusion into the passenger compartment
rows.zh: 两辆车：一辆闯红灯的皮卡正面撞上一辆灰色 SUV 的前部，估计时速 50 km/h，安全气囊已弹出，仪表台在膝部高度处有裂痕，乘客舱无明显侵入

rows.en: One for you; the driver, a coworker, is walking and is being assessed by fire first responders - not your patient
rows.zh: 你负责一名；司机是他的同事，能行走，正由消防第一响应者评估——不是你的患者

rows.en: Fire first responders are with you
rows.zh: 消防第一响应者与你在一起

rows.en: Wants to stay still and does not want anyone to touch the leg
rows.zh: 想保持不动，不让任何人碰那条腿

rows.en: Alert, oriented, in severe pain: 'my knee hit the dash and my hip is on fire'; his right foot feels 'asleep and numb'
rows.zh: 清醒、定向力正常，剧烈疼痛：「我的膝盖撞到了仪表台，髋部像着了火」；右脚感觉「发麻、没知觉」

rows.en: Clear, speaks full sentences
rows.zh: 通畅，能说完整句子

rows.en: 20, regular
rows.zh: 20 次/分、规则

rows.en: Radial pulse 96, strong and regular
rows.zh: 桡动脉 96 次/分、有力规则

rows.en: Pink, warm, dry (no shock)
rows.zh: 红润、温暖、干燥（无休克）

rows.en: 98% RA
rows.zh: 室内空气 98%

rows.en: The right leg is SHORTENED, flexed at the hip and knee, ADDUCTED and INTERNALLY ROTATED, resting against the dash - a posterior hip dislocation; abrasion, swelling and bruising over the front of the right knee; no open wound and no external bleeding; pelvis stable and not tender on one gentle compression; abdomen soft, no seat-belt mark; no other injuries. Left leg normal
rows.zh: 右腿缩短，髋、膝屈曲，内收并内旋，靠在仪表台上——髋关节后脱位；右膝前方擦伤、肿胀、淤青；无开放伤口、无外出血；骨盆稳定，轻柔按压一次无压痛；腹软，无安全带痕；无其他损伤。左腿正常

rows.en: NEXUS: no midline neck tenderness, alert and oriented, not intoxicated, but a NEW focal neurological deficit (right foot numbness) and a major DISTRACTING injury (the hip dislocation) = NEXUS positive, spinal motion restriction indicated; the Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor 'paresthesias in extremities' is also present
rows.zh: NEXUS：颈部无中线压痛、清醒且定向力正常、未醉酒，但有新的局灶性神经功能缺损（右足麻木）和重大分散注意力的损伤（髋关节脱位）=NEXUS 阳性，有脊柱活动限制指征；加拿大颈椎规则的高危因素「肢体感觉异常」同样存在

rows.en: Dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses PRESENT, foot warm and pink, capillary refill under 2 seconds; sensation DECREASED - numb over the outer foot and sole; toes move only weakly and he cannot lift the foot
rows.zh: 足背动脉和胫后动脉搏动存在，足暖而红润，毛细血管再充盈小于 2 秒；感觉减退——足外侧和足底麻木；脚趾只能微弱活动，无法抬起足部

initial.noteEn: Give each finding only when assessed. The candidate must expose the right hip and leg. If the candidate lifts, rotates, straightens or pulls on the right leg the patient screams (pain 10/10) and the hip does not move. RTC: all hip dislocations are RAPID TRANSPORT; vital signs are stable but the neurological impairment makes this a limb-threatening injury.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。考生必须暴露右髋和右腿。若考生抬起、旋转、拉直或牵拉右腿，患者尖叫（疼痛 10/10），髋关节纹丝不动。RTC：所有髋关节脱位都属快速转运类别；生命体征平稳，但神经功能受损使其成为威胁肢体的损伤。

rows.en: Right hip, thigh and knee pain after a head-on collision
rows.zh: 迎面碰撞后右髋、大腿和膝部疼痛

rows.en: Right knee slammed into the dash and he felt the hip 'pop'; no head strike, no loss of consciousness, no neck or back pain; he has not moved since
rows.zh: 右膝重重撞在仪表台上，感觉髋部「啪」地一响；头部没撞到，无意识丧失，无颈部或背部疼痛；此后一直没动过

rows.en: Worse with any movement
rows.zh: 任何活动都加重

rows.en: Sharp and throbbing, constant
rows.zh: 锐痛并搏动样，持续存在

rows.en: Right hip, thigh and knee
rows.zh: 右髋、大腿和膝部

rows.en: Nothing makes it better
rows.zh: 没有缓解的办法

rows.en: Since the collision at about 1640
rows.zh: 自约 16:40 的碰撞起

rows.en: Right foot numb and tingling since the impact
rows.zh: 撞击以来右脚一直发麻、刺痛

rows.en: None known (no NSAID allergy)
rows.zh: 无已知过敏（无 NSAID 过敏）

rows.en: Cetirizine as needed, no blood thinners; took acetaminophen 1000 mg at 0900 for a headache and nothing since, no ibuprofen today
rows.zh: 西替利嗪按需，无抗凝药；上午 09:00 因头痛服过 1000 mg 对乙酰氨基酚，之后没再服，今天没服布洛芬

rows.en: Seasonal allergies; no previous hip, knee or back problems, no surgery, no diabetes, no heart or lung disease, no ulcers or stomach bleeding, no liver disease
rows.zh: 季节性过敏；既往没有髋、膝或背部问题，无手术史，无糖尿病，无心脏或肺部疾病，无溃疡或胃出血，无肝病

rows.en: Lunch (sandwich and coffee) at 1230
rows.zh: 12:30 午餐（三明治和咖啡）

rows.en: A pickup ran the red light and hit them head-on; he was the belted front passenger and the airbag went off
rows.zh: 一辆皮卡闯红灯与他们迎面相撞；他是系着安全带的前排乘客，安全气囊弹出

sets.rxEn: On the stretcher after analgesia with the hip secured; about 6 minutes after set 1
sets.rxZh: 镇痛后躺在担架床上、髋部已固定；第 1 组后约 6 分钟

vitals.noteEn: Set 1 is the baseline BEFORE any analgesia (required before the pain protocol; SpO2 is needed before Entonox). Pain 8/10 at set 1 and 3/10 at set 2. BGL not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no altered LOC); temperature not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs, the limb support, the collar and the right-foot CSM after every move and with every set. Set 2: right foot pulses still present, numbness unchanged (no better, no worse); the hip is unchanged in the position found. BGL not repeated. If at any reassessment the hip has spontaneously reduced (leg longer and straighter, pain suddenly easier), recheck the CSM and update the receiving hospital.
vitals.noteZh: 第 1 组是任何镇痛之前的基线（疼痛协议前必须完成；使用 Entonox 前必须有 SpO2）。第 1 组疼痛 8/10，第 2 组 3/10。血糖无指征（清醒、无糖尿病、无意识改变）；体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。每次搬动后以及每一组生命体征时，复评 ABC、肢体支托、颈托和右足 CSM。第 2 组：右足脉搏仍存在，麻木无变化（没好转也没加重）；髋部仍保持发现时的位置。血糖不需复测。若任何一次复评发现髋关节已自行复位（腿变长变直、疼痛突然减轻），复查 CSM 并通知接收医院。

rows.en: Healthy and active, no recent illness
rows.zh: 健康活跃，近期无病

rows.en: No headache, no neck pain, right foot numb and tingling, no loss of consciousness
rows.zh: 无头痛、无颈痛，右脚发麻刺痛，无意识丧失

rows.en: No shortness of breath
rows.zh: 无气短

rows.en: No chest pain, no palpitations
rows.zh: 无胸痛、无心悸

rows.en: No abdominal pain, no nausea, no blood in the urine
rows.zh: 无腹痛、无恶心、尿中无血

rows.en: Scraped knee
rows.zh: 膝部擦伤

rows.en: Right hip, thigh and knee pain, no other joint pain, no previous hip problems
rows.zh: 右髋、大腿和膝部疼痛，无其他关节疼痛，既往无髋部问题

rows.en: No diabetes
rows.zh: 无糖尿病

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route. From the patient.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，途中。由患者回答。

rows.en: Collar on, no scalp or facial injury, no midline neck tenderness, trachea midline, no JVD
rows.zh: 颈托在位，头皮和面部无损伤，颈部无中线压痛，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张

rows.en: No seat-belt mark, non-tender, equal air entry on 6-site auscultation
rows.zh: 无安全带痕，无压痛，6 点听诊双侧进气对称

rows.en: Soft and non-tender, no seat-belt mark
rows.zh: 软、无压痛，无安全带痕

rows.en: No midline tenderness felt during the transfer
rows.zh: 转运时触及无中线压痛

rows.en: Nil, radial pulses present, CSM intact
rows.zh: 无，桡动脉搏动存在，远端 CSM 完好

rows.en: RIGHT: shortened, flexed, adducted and internally rotated, supported in that position by blankets and ties, abrasion and swelling over the front of the knee, tender over the patella, no knee deformity, pedal pulses present, foot warm, sensation still decreased over the outer foot and sole, toes move weakly. LEFT: normal, pulses, sensation and movement intact
rows.zh: 右侧：缩短、屈曲、内收并内旋，由毯子和绑带支托在该位置，膝前方擦伤肿胀，髌骨压痛，膝关节无畸形，足背动脉搏动存在，足暖，足外侧和足底感觉仍减退，脚趾活动微弱。左侧：正常，脉搏、感觉和活动完好

scenarios.titleEn: Stab Wound to the Abdomen With Evisceration
scenarios.dispatchEn: 2355 hrs. Code 3 to a pub in Langley. A fight has left a 28-year-old male stabbed in the abdomen; a second patient has minor injuries. RCMP are on scene. Hospital is 10 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 23:55，Code 3 前往兰里一家酒吧。斗殴致一名 28 岁男性腹部被刺伤；另一名患者伤势轻微。RCMP 已在现场。医院车程 10 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: RCMP report the scene is secure. The second patient has left with the officers and the weapon has been seized. Bar staff are holding a towel on the wound.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：RCMP 报告现场已控制。另一名患者已随警员离开，凶器已被扣押。酒吧员工正用毛巾按压伤口。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan oxygen, moist sterile dressings with an occlusive layer, warmth, IV equipment (PCP), minimal-movement lift and early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备氧气、湿润无菌敷料加密闭层、保暖用品、静脉用物（PCP）、尽量少动的搬运方式，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch a likely unstable penetrating torso injury (a stabbing to the abdomen); note that a second patient has already left with police
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即预判这很可能是不稳定的躯干穿透伤（腹部刺伤）；注意另一名患者已随警员离开

expected.actionEn: Confirm with dispatch that police have secured the scene and the weapon before approaching
expected.actionZh: 接近前向调度确认警方已控制现场并扣押凶器

expected.actionEn: Anticipate blood exposure: PPE incl eye protection
expected.actionZh: 预判血液暴露：个人防护含护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Bar staff lead you down the back hallway of the pub. The lighting is good; the floor is wet with spilled drink and some broken glass has been swept against the wall. The patient lies on his back on the floor with his knees drawn up, both hands pressing a blood-soaked bar towel to his left lower abdomen; about 500 mL of blood is on the floor. Two RCMP officers stand at the end of the hallway; the knife is in an evidence bag, its blade about 10 cm long. He was stabbed once during a fight. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：酒吧员工领你们穿过酒吧后走廊。照明良好；地面被洒出的饮料弄湿，一些碎玻璃已被扫到墙边。患者仰卧在地上、双膝屈起，双手把一条浸透血的吧台毛巾按在左下腹；地面约有 500 mL 血。两名 RCMP 警员站在走廊尽头；刀已装入证物袋，刀刃约 10 cm 长。他在斗殴中被刺了一刀。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (broken glass, wet floor, blood; police have the scene and the weapon), environment, MOI (stabbed once in a fight), one patient; estimate blood loss
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（碎玻璃、湿滑地面、血液；警方已控制现场并扣押凶器）、环境、受伤机制（斗殴中被刺一刀）、单一患者；估计失血量

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection (blood splash risk)
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜（血液喷溅风险）

expected.actionEn: First look: pale male lying on his back with knees drawn up, awake, blood-soaked towel on the left lower abdomen, blood on the floor
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：苍白男性仰卧、双膝屈起、清醒、左下腹浸血毛巾、地面有血

expected.actionEn: Ask police one question about what they know (weapon, number of wounds), then go straight to the patient - no time spent on a scene debrief
expected.actionZh: 只向警方问一个问题（凶器、伤口数量），随后直接处理患者——不在现场情况汇报上耗时

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake and alert, pale, frightened, groaning, speaks in full sentences ('he stabbed me... I can see my guts'), shivering; smells of alcohol but is clear-headed and oriented. He keeps his knees drawn up and tries to hold the towel on. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear; respirations 24 shallow, no chest wounds, air entry equal; right radial pulse 124 weak. Skin: pale, cool, clammy. RBS (expose the abdomen): ONE 4 cm horizontal wound left of the umbilicus with a loop of small bowel about 10 cm long protruding, pink and glistening, dark blood oozing from the wound edge; abdomen guarded; no other wounds on chest, flanks, groin, arms or legs; the back is seen only if he is moved. If the candidate applies a dry dressing, tell them it sticks to the bowel; if the candidate pushes the bowel back in, he screams and the bleeding restarts. SpO2 96% RA. C-spine NOT indicated (single penetrating wound to the abdomen, not struck on the head or neck, no neck pain). UNSTABLE: major penetrating torso trauma with shock signs.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒警觉、苍白、恐惧、呻吟，能说完整句子（「他捅了我…我看到肠子了」），发抖；身上有酒味但头脑清楚、定向力正常。他一直屈着双膝，想把毛巾按住。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅；呼吸 24 次/分、浅，无胸部伤口，进气对称；右桡动脉 124 次/分、细弱。皮肤：苍白、发凉、湿冷。RBS（暴露腹部）：脐左侧一处 4 cm 横向伤口，一段约 10 cm 长的小肠脱出，呈粉红色、湿亮，伤口边缘有暗红色血液渗出；腹部保护性紧张；胸部、两侧腰部、腹股沟、上肢和下肢无其他伤口；只有搬动他时才能看到背部。若考生用干敷料，告知敷料粘在肠管上；若考生把肠管推回去，他会尖叫、出血重新开始。SpO2 室内空气 96%。无颈椎固定指征（腹部单发穿透伤，头颈未受击打，无颈痛）。不稳定：躯干重大穿透伤伴休克征象。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated: single penetrating wound to the abdomen, not struck on the head or neck, no neck pain (p.25)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征：腹部单发穿透伤，头颈未受击打，无颈痛（p.25）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: rate, depth, chest for wounds, air entry both sides
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：频率、深度、胸部有无伤口、双侧进气

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse rate and strength; recognize shock; control any external hemorrhage
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉频率与强度；识别休克；控制外出血

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey: expose and find the single 4 cm wound and the protruding bowel, check chest, flanks, groin and limbs for other wounds, then cover the bowel with a moist sterile dressing followed by an occlusive layer - do not push it back or pack the wound (p.32, p.19)
expected.actionZh: 快速查体：暴露并发现单发 4 cm 伤口及脱出的肠管，检查胸部、两侧腰部、腹股沟和四肢有无其他伤口，然后用湿润无菌敷料覆盖肠管再加一层密闭敷料——不要把肠管推回去，也不要填塞伤口（p.32、p.19）

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale, cool, clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、发凉、湿冷

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L NRB (trauma and shock) to keep SpO2 94% or higher (p.11, p.54)
expected.actionZh: 高流量吸氧 15 L 非再吸入面罩（创伤、休克），维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%（p.11、p.54）

expected.actionEn: Leave him supine in his position of comfort with the knees drawn up; limit movement; keep him warm with blankets (p.32, p.54)
expected.actionZh: 保持仰卧并维持其舒适体位（双膝屈起）；限制活动；盖毯保暖（p.32、p.54）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Major penetrating trauma to the torso is on the unstable list, and he has cool pale clammy skin from shock = UNSTABLE, RTC. Do not delay for the secondary survey - history, vitals and head-to-toe are done en route. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Limit his movement to protect the clot: lift him onto the stretcher with a scoop or slide sheet and keep his knees up. Delegate the bar staff and the RCMP officers (hallway, doors, stretcher).
phases.infoZh: 决策点。躯干重大穿透伤属于不稳定标准，加之休克所致皮肤湿冷苍白=不稳定，RTC。不要为二次评估而拖延——病史、生命体征和头到脚检查途中完成。15 分钟内可装载。限制他的活动以保护血凝块：用铲式担架或滑板把他抬上担架床，保持膝部屈起。指派酒吧员工和 RCMP 警员帮忙（走廊、开门、担架床）。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC (major penetrating torso trauma, p.7; pale cool clammy skin from shock) and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC（躯干重大穿透伤，p.7；休克所致苍白湿冷）并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes; secondary survey (history, vitals, head-to-toe) en route, not on scene
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内打包完毕可装载；二次评估（病史、生命体征、头到脚）途中完成，不在现场做

expected.actionEn: Delegate bar staff and police effectively (hallway, doors, stretcher, lift)
expected.actionZh: 有效指挥酒吧员工和警员（走廊、开门、担架床、抬运）

expected.actionEn: Move him with the least movement possible - one coordinated lift with a scoop or slide sheet, knees kept up, dressing undisturbed (limit patient movement, p.32)
expected.actionZh: 以最小的活动量移动他——一次协调的铲式担架或滑板抬运、膝部保持屈起、敷料不受扰动（限制患者活动，p.32）

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE. ACTOR (alert, answers in full sentences, wincing, answers only if asked): chief complaint 'I got stabbed in the stomach.' He was standing at the bar when a man he did not know pulled a folding knife and stabbed him once, at about 2348, about 16 minutes before your arrival; the blade was about 10 cm long and 2 cm wide, a stab and not a slash; one wound, no other injuries, he was not hit on the head or neck; he slid down the wall, never lost consciousness, and staff laid him on the floor. Pain is sharp and burning, constant, worse with movement and coughing, no radiation, 8/10. Lightheaded, cold and thirsty; no vomiting, no chest pain, no trouble breathing. PMHx: stomach ulcer last year. Meds: pantoprazole 40 mg daily; he took two acetaminophen 500 mg tablets at 2100 for a headache. Allergies: none known. LOI: burger and fries at 1900, two beers, the last at about 2230. Weight about 80 kg.
phases.infoZh: 途中。患者演员（清醒，能说完整句子，面露痛苦，问到才答）：主诉「我被捅了肚子」。他站在吧台边，一个不认识的男人拔出折叠刀捅了他一刀，时间约 23:48，即到场前约 16 分钟；刀刃约 10 cm 长、2 cm 宽，是刺伤而非划伤；仅一处伤口，无其他损伤，头颈未受击打；他顺着墙滑坐下来，始终没有昏迷，员工把他放平在地上。疼痛为尖锐灼烧样、持续性，活动和咳嗽时加重，无放射，8/10。头晕、发冷、口渴；无呕吐、无胸痛、无呼吸困难。既往史：去年有胃溃疡。用药：泮托拉唑 40 mg 每日；21:00 因头痛服了两片对乙酰氨基酚 500 mg。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：19:00 汉堡和薯条，喝了两杯啤酒，最后一杯约 22:30。体重约 80 kg。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: stabbed in the abdomen
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：腹部被刺伤

expected.actionEn: HxC/C using the stabbing questions (p.13): weapon and blade size, stab or slash, number of wounds, other injuries, initial position and condition, LOC, plus pain features
expected.actionZh: 按刺伤问诊要点（p.13）采集现病史：凶器及刃长、刺伤还是划伤、伤口数量、其他损伤、初始体位与状态、有无昏迷，以及疼痛特点

expected.actionEn: Time of injury (2348) and weight (about 80 kg) - needed for the TXA window and the bolus calculation
expected.actionZh: 受伤时间（23:48）和体重（约 80 kg）——TXA 时间窗和补液量计算所需

expected.actionEn: Pain score (8/10)
expected.actionZh: 疼痛评分（8/10）

expected.actionEn: PMHx (stomach ulcer) - a contraindication check for ibuprofen
expected.actionZh: 既往史（胃溃疡）——布洛芬禁忌核查所需

expected.actionEn: Medications incl pantoprazole and the acetaminophen taken at 2100 (within 4 hours) - contraindication checks for the oral analgesics
expected.actionZh: 用药史（含泮托拉唑，以及 21:00 服用的对乙酰氨基酚——4 小时内）——口服镇痛药禁忌核查所需

expected.actionEn: Allergies (none known) - also relevant to TXA
expected.actionZh: 过敏史（无已知过敏）——也与 TXA 相关

expected.actionEn: LOI (burger and fries, two beers)

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (en route, baseline BEFORE fluids, TXA or any drug; give each vital as it is properly assessed): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 88/54; pulse 124 weak regular; respirations 24 shallow; skin pale, cool, clammy; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 96% RA, 99% on 15 L NRB. BGL not indicated (alert, not diabetic, cause evident). Temp not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（途中，补液、TXA 或任何药物之前的基线；每项在考生规范评估时才给出）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 88/54；脉搏 124 细弱规则；呼吸 24 浅；皮肤苍白、发凉、湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 96%，15 L 非再吸入面罩下 99%。血糖无指征（清醒、非糖尿病、病因明确）。体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, brief for the unstable patient. ACTOR: general - cold, shivering and thirsty; CNS - lightheaded when he lifts his head, no headache; respiratory - no shortness of breath, the wound hurts on a deep breath; cardiovascular - heart pounding, no chest pain; GI/GU - wound pain, no vomiting, no blood in stool or urine; integumentary - the wound, no rash; musculoskeletal - no back or limb pain; endocrine nil; EENT nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简。患者演员：整体——发冷、发抖、口渴；中枢神经——抬头时头晕、无头痛；呼吸——无气促、深呼吸时伤口疼；心血管——心跳剧烈、无胸痛；消化/泌尿——伤口疼痛、无呕吐、大便和尿中无血；皮肤——伤口、无皮疹；肌肉骨骼——背部和四肢不痛；内分泌无；眼耳鼻喉无。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - no trauma, trachea midline, neck veins flat; chest - clear, equal air entry 6 sites, no wounds or tenderness; abdomen - dressing intact over the single 4 cm wound left of the umbilicus with the bowel covered, no new bleeding through, abdomen guarded and tender in all quadrants, not distended; pelvis - stable; back - no wounds or tenderness (seen only if he is moved); lower extremities - CSM intact, pulses weak but present; upper extremities - radial pulses weak, CSM intact, IV site clean and flushing freely (PCP).
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——无外伤、气管居中、颈静脉塌陷；胸部——清晰、6 点进气对称、无伤口及压痛；腹部——脐左侧单发 4 cm 伤口上的敷料完好、肠管已覆盖、无新的渗血，腹部保护性紧张、四个象限均有压痛、无膨隆；骨盆——稳定；背部——无伤口及压痛（只有搬动他时才能看到）；下肢——远端 CSM 完好、脉搏弱但可触及；上肢——桡动脉脉搏弱、远端 CSM 完好、静脉穿刺部位清洁且冲洗通畅（PCP）。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl neck veins and trachea
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含颈静脉与气管）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation, bilateral comparison
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊、双侧对比

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam without disturbing the dressing: inspect, check the dressing is intact and not bleeding through, gentle palpation away from the wound; check the pelvis is stable
expected.actionZh: 不扰动敷料的腹部查体：视诊，检查敷料完好且无渗血，在远离伤口处轻柔触诊；检查骨盆是否稳定

expected.actionEn: Back exam as far as the single controlled movement allowed
expected.actionZh: 背部查体（在仅有的一次受控搬动所允许的范围内）

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities: CSM, pulses
expected.actionZh: 下肢：CSM、脉搏

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities: radial pulses, CSM, IV site (PCP)
expected.actionZh: 上肢：桡动脉脉搏、CSM、静脉穿刺部位（PCP）

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS (Abdominal Injuries, p.32; Wound Care, p.19; Hypovolemia, p.54): control external hemorrhage; limit patient movement to reduce clot disruption; protect against heat loss; COVER the protruding bowel with a MOIST sterile dressing (sterile saline) followed by an OCCLUSIVE layer, and do NOT place it back in the abdominal cavity; do not pack the wound (no packing of abdominal wounds, p.19); position of comfort - leave him supine with his knees drawn up (supine also supports blood pressure, p.54); high-flow oxygen to keep SpO2 94% or higher; transport. HYPOVOLEMIA PROTOCOL (p.54), indications all present: blood loss (about 500 mL on the floor, penetrating abdominal wound), SBP 88 (below 90), signs of shock (pale cool clammy skin, pulse 124); baseline vitals done first. PAIN (Appendix A, 8/10): rule out each drug's contraindications aloud - Entonox is withheld because he is in shock (p.65 caution); ibuprofen is withheld (stomach ulcer history and possible bleeding from the injured bowel, p.68); acetaminophen is withheld (two 500 mg tablets taken at 2100, within the past 4 hours, p.58). (Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: nothing by mouth with an open abdomen heading for surgery; nitrous oxide expands gas-filled bowel.) PCP EN ROUTE: vascular access (p.32, p.54) and fluid bolus 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L (80 kg = 1,600 mL), reassessing every 500 mL (SBP target 90, p.48); TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute (p.78) is indicated (major trauma after the Hypovolemia protocol has started, shock with a penetrating abdominal injury and ongoing bleeding): the injury was at 2348 so he is well inside the 3 hours, no known allergy, age over 12, no isolated TBI. Push it over the full minute because a rapid push can drop the pressure further, and record the time.
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用（腹部损伤，p.32；伤口处理，p.19；低血容量，p.54）：控制外出血；限制患者活动以减少血凝块破坏；防止热量散失；用湿润无菌敷料（无菌生理盐水）覆盖脱出的肠管，再覆盖一层密闭敷料，且不得把肠管放回腹腔；不要填塞伤口（腹部伤口不填塞，p.19）；舒适体位——保持仰卧、双膝屈起（仰卧也有助于维持血压，p.54）；高流量吸氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%；转运。低血容量协议（p.54）指征全部具备：失血（地面约 500 mL，腹部穿透伤）、收缩压 88（< 90）、休克征象（皮肤苍白湿冷、脉搏 124）；先完成基线生命体征。疼痛（附录 A，8/10）：逐一口述排除各药物禁忌——Entonox 因休克不给（p.65 慎用）；布洛芬不给（胃溃疡病史且受损肠管可能出血，p.68）；对乙酰氨基酚不给（21:00 服了两片 500 mg，在 4 小时内，p.58）。（教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：腹腔开放、即将手术的患者禁饮食；氧化亚氮会使含气肠管膨胀。）PCP 途中：建立静脉通路（p.32、p.54）并补液 20 mL/kg、上限 2 L（80 kg = 1,600 mL），每 500 mL 复评（目标收缩压 90，p.48）；TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟（p.78）有指征（重大创伤且已启动低血容量协议，腹部穿透伤伴休克及持续出血）：受伤时间 23:48，远在 3 小时内，无已知过敏，年龄大于 12 岁，非孤立性颅脑损伤。须用满 1 分钟推注，因为推得太快会使血压进一步下降，并记录时间。

expected.actionEn: Wound management skill: moist sterile (saline) dressing over the bowel, an occlusive layer over it, secured without pressure, bowel not pushed back, wound not packed, dressing left undisturbed
expected.actionZh: 伤口处理技能：肠管上覆盖湿润无菌（生理盐水）敷料、其上加密闭层、固定但不加压，不把肠管推回、不填塞伤口、敷料保持不被扰动

expected.actionEn: Execute the Abdominal Injuries protocol: control external hemorrhage, limit movement, protect against heat loss, moist dressing plus occlusive layer, NEVER place the bowel back, position of comfort, transport (p.32)
expected.actionZh: 执行腹部损伤协议：控制外出血、限制活动、防止热量散失、湿润敷料加密闭层、绝不把肠管放回腹腔、舒适体位、转运（p.32）

expected.actionEn: Hypovolemia protocol with the indications stated (blood loss, SBP 88 below 90, signs of shock) and baseline vitals done: supine, warm, oxygen to SpO2 94% or higher, rapid transport (p.54)
expected.actionZh: 在口述指征（失血、收缩压 88 < 90、休克征象）且基线生命体征已完成的前提下执行低血容量协议：仰卧、保暖、吸氧至 SpO2 ≥ 94%、快速转运（p.54）

expected.actionEn: Pain management (Appendix A): rule out each drug's contraindications aloud and name the reasons - Entonox withheld (shock, p.65), ibuprofen withheld (ulcer history / possible bowel bleeding, p.68), acetaminophen withheld (taken within the past 4 hours, p.58)
expected.actionZh: 疼痛处理（附录 A）：逐一口述排除各药物禁忌并说出理由——Entonox 不给（休克，p.65）、布洛芬不给（溃疡病史/肠管可能出血，p.68）、对乙酰氨基酚不给（4 小时内已服，p.58）

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access en route with aseptic technique and a 20 mL/kg bolus (80 kg = 1,600 mL, max 2 L) reassessed every 500 mL (p.54, p.32, p.38)
expected.actionZh: PCP：途中以无菌技术建立静脉通路并补液 20 mL/kg（80 kg = 1,600 mL，上限 2 L），每 500 mL 复评（p.54、p.32、p.38）

expected.actionEn: PCP: TXA 2 g IV push over the full minute with the 6 rights, after stating the indication and checking the contraindications (injury 2348 - within 3 hours; no hypersensitivity; adult; no isolated TBI); record the time (p.78)
expected.actionZh: PCP：口述指征并核对禁忌后（受伤 23:48——3 小时内；无过敏；成人；非孤立性颅脑损伤），按六项核对静推 TXA 2 g 用满 1 分钟，并记录时间（p.78）

expected.actionEn: Reassure him and ask him to stay still and not touch the dressing; keep him warm
expected.actionZh: 安抚患者，请他保持不动、不要碰敷料；保暖

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the dressing (moist, in place, no new bleeding through), the IV site (PCP) and warmth after each move and after every 500 mL. Set 2 (6 minutes after set 1, en route; PCP after the first 500 mL of the bolus): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 96/60; pulse 116; respirations 22; skin pale, cool, less clammy; pupils equal; SpO2 99% on 15 L. EMR (no fluids): BP 90/56, pulse 120, respirations 24. Pain 7/10 (8/10 at first). BGL and temperature not repeated. PCP improving with fluid, EMR holding steady - either way the bleeding is still internal and transport continues. If the candidate lifts the dressing to look or pushes the bowel back, he screams and the bleeding restarts.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC、敷料（湿润、在位、无新渗血）、静脉穿刺部位（PCP）与保暖。第 2 组（第 1 组后 6 分钟，途中；PCP 为补液第一个 500 mL 之后）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 96/60；脉搏 116；呼吸 22；皮肤苍白、发凉、湿冷减轻；瞳孔等大；SpO2 15 L 下 99%。EMR（无补液）：血压 90/56、脉搏 120、呼吸 24。疼痛 7/10（起初 8/10）。血糖和体温不需复测。PCP 补液后好转，EMR 维持稳定——无论哪种，出血仍在体内，转运继续。若考生掀开敷料查看或把肠管推回，他会尖叫、出血重新开始。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, IV site (PCP) and warmth after each major move and after every 500 mL (p.10)
expected.actionZh: 每次重大移动及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC、静脉穿刺部位（PCP）与保暖（p.10）

expected.actionEn: Recheck the dressing is moist, in place and not bleeding through - without lifting it to look
expected.actionZh: 复查敷料湿润、在位、无渗血——不掀开敷料查看

expected.actionEn: Second full vitals within 5-6 minutes; interpret the trend and the pain score (7/10)
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内第二组完整生命体征；解读趋势与疼痛评分（7/10）

expected.actionEn: PCP: reassess BP after each 500 mL of the bolus and continue per the reassessment while transport carries on (p.54)
expected.actionZh: PCP：补液每 500 mL 后复评血压并据此继续，转运不中断（p.54）

expected.actionEn: If the dressing slips or dries, re-cover with a fresh moist sterile dressing and occlusive layer - never push the bowel back (p.32)
expected.actionZh: 敷料移位或变干时，用新的湿润无菌敷料和密闭层重新覆盖——绝不把肠管推回（p.32）

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (penetrating abdominal trauma with evisceration, in shock). The hand-off must state the time of injury, the dressing, fluids, the TXA time and why the analgesics were withheld. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（腹部穿透伤伴肠管脱出，休克）。交接须说明受伤时间、敷料、补液、TXA 时间以及未给镇痛药的理由。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical patient: stabbing, evisceration, shock, ETA
expected.actionZh: 危重患者途中预报：刺伤、肠管脱出、休克、预计到达时间

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off: mechanism and weapon, time of injury, findings, baseline versus repeat vitals
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：受伤机制与凶器、受伤时间、发现、基线与复测生命体征对比

expected.actionEn: Treatments and times: dressing, fluids, TXA time; analgesics withheld and why; PMHx, medications incl the 2100 acetaminophen, allergies, LOI
expected.actionZh: 处置与时间：敷料、补液、TXA 时间；未给的镇痛药及理由；既往史、用药（含 21:00 的对乙酰氨基酚）、过敏、最后进食

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes (time of injury, TXA time, bolus volume, pain scores)
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR（受伤时间、TXA 时间、补液量、疼痛评分）

vitalsSets.timeHint: baseline, before fluids or TXA
6 min after set 1, en route (PCP: after first 500 mL)

criticalPitfallsEn: Dry dressing on the eviscerated bowel, or a moist dressing with no occlusive layer over it (p.32) - wound-management skill deductions (up to 25%) and an Abdominal Injuries protocol error (up to 100%)
Pushing the bowel back into the abdomen, packing the wound, or lifting and replacing the dressing (p.32, p.19) - 100%
Not completing the rapid body survey (missing the wound, the bowel, or other wounds) - 100%
Delaying loading to do the secondary survey on scene, or treating as non-RTC (p.7: major penetrating torso trauma plus shock) - transport category error, 25%
Moving him more than necessary - sitting him up, repeated rolls, a rough lift - instead of one coordinated lift with the knees kept up (limit patient movement, p.32) - up to 25%

PCP: starting fluids or TXA without baseline vitals, skipping the reassessment every 500 mL, or giving TXA outside its indications (more than 3 hours after injury, hypersensitivity, isolated TBI; p.78) - protocol errors up to 100%

Giving Entonox in shock (p.65 caution), ibuprofen with an ulcer history and a possibly bleeding bowel (p.68), or acetaminophen within 4 hours of the 2100 dose (p.58) - pain-management / drug errors up to 25%; offering food or drink is also wrong (textbook practice: nothing by mouth with an open abdomen - not a BC rubric item)
criticalPitfallsZh: 对脱出的肠管使用干敷料，或湿润敷料外未加密闭层（p.32）——伤口处理技能扣分（最高 25%）及腹部损伤协议错误（最高 100%）
把肠管推回腹腔、填塞伤口，或掀开又重新放置敷料（p.32、p.19）——扣 100%
未完成快速查体（漏掉伤口、肠管或其他伤口）——扣 100%
为在现场做二次评估而推迟装车，或判为非 RTC（p.7：躯干重大穿透伤加休克）——转运分类错误，扣 25%
不必要地多次搬动他——让他坐起、反复翻身、粗暴抬运——而不是一次协调抬运并保持膝部屈起（限制患者活动，p.32）——最高扣 25%
PCP：没有基线生命体征就补液或给 TXA、补液时不做每 500 mL 复评，或在指征之外给 TXA（受伤超过 3 小时、过敏、孤立性颅脑损伤；p.78）——协议错误最高扣 100%
休克时给 Entonox（p.65 慎用）、有溃疡病史且肠管可能出血时给布洛芬（p.68），或在 21:00 那次服药后 4 小时内给对乙酰氨基酚（p.58）——疼痛处理/给药错误最高扣 25%；给吃喝同样不对（教科书做法：腹腔开放者禁饮食——不属于 BC 评分项）
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: control external bleeding, cover the bowel with a moist sterile dressing and an occlusive layer (never replace it), leave him supine in his position of comfort with the knees up, keep him warm, high-flow oxygen, limit movement, and RTC with the secondary survey en route. No IV, no fluid bolus, no TXA. Pain: Entonox, ibuprofen and acetaminophen are all withheld with the reasons stated (shock, p.65; ulcer history and possible bowel bleeding, p.68; acetaminophen within 4 hours, p.58). (Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: nothing by mouth with an open abdomen; nitrous oxide expands gas-filled bowel.)
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：控制外出血，用湿润无菌敷料加密闭层覆盖肠管（绝不放回），保持仰卧于舒适体位、膝部屈起，保暖，高流量吸氧，限制活动，按 RTC 转运、二次评估途中完成。无静脉、无补液、无 TXA。疼痛：Entonox、布洛芬、对乙酰氨基酚全部不给并说明理由（休克，p.65；溃疡病史及肠管可能出血，p.68；对乙酰氨基酚 4 小时内已服，p.58）。（教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：腹腔开放者禁饮食；氧化亚氮会使含气肠管膨胀。）
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds, en route, vascular access, a 20 mL/kg bolus (80 kg = 1,600 mL, max 2 L) reassessed every 500 mL with the SBP target of 90 from p.48, and TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute once the Hypovolemia protocol has started (injury 2348, inside the 3-hour limit), plus the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route. (Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: many systems accept a lower pressure target in penetrating torso trauma; the BC guideline gives the 20 mL/kg bolus and q500 mL reassessment.)
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加：途中静脉通路、20 mL/kg 补液（80 kg = 1,600 mL，上限 2 L）每 500 mL 复评并采用 p.48 的收缩压目标 90，以及低血容量协议启动后 TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟（受伤 23:48，在 3 小时限制内），另有途中 9 系统功能问诊。（教科书做法——不属于 BC 评分项：不少体系对躯干穿透伤接受较低的血压目标；BC 指南给出的是 20 mL/kg 补液与每 500 mL 复评。）
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 28-year-old male, about 80 kg, with a single 4 cm stab wound left of the umbilicus and a loop of small bowel eviscerated, from a folding knife with a 10 cm blade at about 2348 in a bar fight. About 500 mL of blood was lost externally. On our arrival at 0004 he was alert, GCS 15, BP 88/54, pulse 124 weak, respirations 24 shallow, skin pale, cool and clammy, SpO2 96% on room air, pain 8/10. Treatments: the bowel covered with a moist sterile dressing and an occlusive layer and not replaced, supine with his knees up, kept warm, minimal movement, high-flow oxygen at 15 litres, an IV with a 1,600 mL saline bolus running; after the first 500 mL his BP was 96/60, pulse 116, SpO2 99% and pain 7/10; TXA 2 grams IV push at 0021. History of a stomach ulcer on pantoprazole, no known allergies, 1,000 mg of acetaminophen taken at 2100, last ate at 1900 and had two beers, the last at about 2230. No Entonox because of shock, no ibuprofen because of the ulcer history and possible bowel bleeding, no acetaminophen because of the recent dose.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 28 岁男性，约 80 kg，在酒吧斗殴中约 23:48 被折叠刀（刀刃 10 cm）刺伤，脐左侧单发 4 cm 伤口，一段小肠脱出。外出血约 500 mL。00:04 我们到场时他清醒，GCS 15，血压 88/54，脉搏 124 细弱，呼吸 24 浅，皮肤苍白、发凉、湿冷，SpO2 室内空气 96%，疼痛 8/10。处置：肠管以湿润无菌敷料加密闭层覆盖、未放回，仰卧屈膝、保暖、尽量少动，15 升高流量吸氧，静脉通路下 1,600 mL 生理盐水补液进行中；第一个 500 mL 后血压 96/60、脉搏 116、SpO2 99%、疼痛 7/10；00:21 静推 TXA 2 g。既往胃溃疡、服泮托拉唑，无已知过敏，21:00 服过对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg，19:00 最后进食并喝了两杯啤酒，最后一杯约 22:30。因休克未给 Entonox，因溃疡病史及肠管可能出血未给布洛芬，因刚服过药未给对乙酰氨基酚。

dispatch.narrativeEn: RCMP report the scene is secure. The second patient has left with the officers and the weapon has been seized. Bar staff are holding a towel on the wound.
dispatch.narrativeZh: RCMP 报告现场已控制。另一名患者已随警员离开，凶器已被扣押。酒吧员工正用毛巾按压伤口。

scene.narrativeEn: Bar staff lead you down the back hallway of the pub. The patient lies on his back on the floor with his knees drawn up, both hands pressing a blood-soaked bar towel to his left lower abdomen; about 500 mL of blood is on the floor.
scene.narrativeZh: 酒吧员工领你们穿过酒吧后走廊。患者仰卧在地上、双膝屈起，双手把一条浸透血的吧台毛巾按在左下腹；地面约有 500 mL 血。

rows.en: Good lighting; the floor is wet with spilled drink and some broken glass has been swept against the wall

rows.en: Clear

rows.en: 24, shallow; no chest wounds, air entry equal

rows.en: Right radial pulse 124, weak
rows.zh: 右桡动脉 124 次/分、细弱

rows.en: Pale, cool, clammy
rows.zh: 苍白、发凉、湿冷

rows.en: 96% RA
rows.zh: 室内空气 96%

rows.en: ONE 4 cm horizontal wound left of the umbilicus with a loop of small bowel about 10 cm long protruding, pink and glistening, dark blood oozing from the wound edge; abdomen guarded. No other wounds on chest, flanks, groin, arms or legs; the back is seen only if he is moved
rows.zh: 脐左侧一处 4 cm 横向伤口，一段约 10 cm 长的小肠脱出，呈粉红色、湿亮，伤口边缘有暗红色血液渗出；腹部保护性紧张。胸部、两侧腰部、腹股沟、上肢和下肢无其他伤口；只有搬动他时才能看到背部

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed (the abdomen is seen when exposed). If the candidate applies a dry dressing, tell them it sticks to the bowel; if the candidate pushes the bowel back in, he screams and the bleeding restarts. Stability: UNSTABLE - major penetrating torso trauma with shock signs.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现（暴露后才能看到腹部）。若考生用干敷料，告知敷料粘在肠管上；若考生把肠管推回去，他会尖叫、出血重新开始。判定：不稳定——躯干重大穿透伤伴休克征象。

rows.en: 'I got stabbed in the stomach'
rows.zh: 「我被捅了肚子」

rows.en: Stabbed once; slid down the wall, never lost consciousness, and staff laid him on the floor
rows.zh: 被刺一刀；顺着墙滑坐下来，始终没有昏迷，员工把他放平在地上

rows.en: Worse with movement and coughing
rows.zh: 活动和咳嗽时加重

rows.en: Sharp and burning, constant
rows.zh: 尖锐灼烧样、持续性

rows.en: No radiation
rows.zh: 无放射

rows.en: Stabbed at about 2348, about 16 minutes before arrival
rows.zh: 约 23:48 被刺，即到场前约 16 分钟

rows.en: Lightheaded, cold and thirsty; no vomiting, no chest pain, no trouble breathing
rows.zh: 头晕、发冷、口渴；无呕吐、无胸痛、无呼吸困难

rows.en: None known
rows.zh: 无已知过敏

rows.en: Pantoprazole 40 mg daily; took two acetaminophen 500 mg tablets at 2100 for a headache
rows.zh: 泮托拉唑 40 mg 每日；21:00 因头痛服了两片对乙酰氨基酚 500 mg

rows.en: Stomach ulcer last year
rows.zh: 去年有胃溃疡

rows.en: Burger and fries at 1900, two beers, the last at about 2230
rows.zh: 19:00 汉堡和薯条，喝了两杯啤酒，最后一杯约 22:30

rows.en: Standing at the bar when a man he did not know pulled a folding knife and stabbed him once; the blade was about 10 cm long and 2 cm wide, a stab and not a slash; one wound, no other injuries, he was not hit on the head or neck
rows.zh: 他站在吧台边，一个不认识的男人拔出折叠刀捅了他一刀；刀刃约 10 cm 长、2 cm 宽，是刺伤而非划伤；仅一处伤口，无其他损伤，头颈未受击打

rows.en: About 80 kg
rows.zh: 约 80 kg

history.noteEn: En route. Alert, answers in full sentences, wincing; the actor answers only if asked.
history.noteZh: 途中。患者清醒，能说完整句子，面露痛苦；演员问到才答。

sets.rxZh: 基线，补液或 TXA 之前

sets.rxEn: En route; PCP after the first 500 mL of the bolus
sets.rxZh: 途中；PCP 为补液第一个 500 mL 之后

vitals.noteEn: Give each vital as it is properly assessed. Set 1 is the baseline BEFORE fluids, TXA or any drug (en route). SpO2 96% RA, 99% on 15 L NRB. BGL not indicated (alert, not diabetic, cause evident); temperature not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs, the dressing (moist, in place, no new bleeding through), the IV site (PCP) and warmth after each move and after every 500 mL. Set 2 (6 minutes after set 1, en route; PCP after the first 500 mL of the bolus). EMR (no fluids): BP 90/56, pulse 120, respirations 24. Pain 7/10 (8/10 at first). BGL and temperature not repeated. PCP improving with fluid, EMR holding steady - either way the bleeding is still internal and transport continues. If the candidate lifts the dressing to look or pushes the bowel back, he screams and the bleeding restarts.
vitals.noteZh: 每项在考生规范评估时才给出。第 1 组为补液、TXA 或任何药物之前的基线（途中）。SpO2 室内空气 96%，15 L 非再吸入面罩下 99%。血糖无指征（清醒、非糖尿病、病因明确）；体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。每次移动后及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC、敷料（湿润、在位、无新渗血）、静脉穿刺部位（PCP）与保暖。第 2 组（第 1 组后 6 分钟，途中；PCP 为补液第一个 500 mL 之后）。EMR（无补液）：血压 90/56、脉搏 120、呼吸 24。疼痛 7/10（起初 8/10）。血糖和体温不需复测。PCP 补液后好转，EMR 维持稳定——无论哪种，出血仍在体内，转运继续。若考生掀开敷料查看或把肠管推回，他会尖叫、出血重新开始。

rows.en: Cold, shivering and thirsty
rows.zh: 发冷、发抖、口渴

rows.en: Lightheaded when he lifts his head, no headache
rows.zh: 抬头时头晕、无头痛

rows.en: No shortness of breath, the wound hurts on a deep breath
rows.zh: 无气促、深呼吸时伤口疼

rows.en: Heart pounding, no chest pain
rows.zh: 心跳剧烈、无胸痛

rows.en: Wound pain, no vomiting, no blood in stool or urine
rows.zh: 伤口疼痛、无呕吐、大便和尿中无血

rows.en: The wound, no rash
rows.zh: 伤口、无皮疹

rows.en: No back or limb pain
rows.zh: 背部和四肢不痛

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

rows.en: Nil
rows.zh: 无

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route, brief for the unstable patient.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简。

rows.en: No trauma, trachea midline, neck veins flat
rows.zh: 无外伤、气管居中、颈静脉塌陷

rows.en: Clear, equal air entry 6 sites, no wounds or tenderness
rows.zh: 清晰、6 点进气对称、无伤口及压痛

rows.en: Dressing intact over the single 4 cm wound left of the umbilicus with the bowel covered, no new bleeding through; abdomen guarded and tender in all quadrants, not distended
rows.zh: 脐左侧单发 4 cm 伤口上的敷料完好、肠管已覆盖、无新的渗血；腹部保护性紧张、四个象限均有压痛、无膨隆

rows.en: Stable
rows.zh: 稳定

rows.en: No wounds or tenderness (seen only if he is moved)
rows.zh: 无伤口及压痛（只有搬动他时才能看到）

rows.en: Radial pulses weak, CSM intact, IV site clean and flushing freely (PCP)
rows.zh: 桡动脉脉搏弱、远端 CSM 完好、静脉穿刺部位清洁且冲洗通畅（PCP）

rows.en: CSM intact, pulses weak but present
rows.zh: 远端 CSM 完好、脉搏弱但可触及

scenarios.titleEn: Horse Kick to the Chest - Flail Segment
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1620 hrs. Code 3 to a horse boarding stable in Aldergrove. 44-year-old male kicked in the chest by a horse, having trouble breathing. The barn owner is with him. Langley Memorial Hospital is 14 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 16:20，Code 3 前往奥尔德格罗夫一处马匹寄养马厩。44 岁男性被马踢中胸部，呼吸困难。马厩主人陪在他身边。兰里纪念医院车程 14 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: the barn owner says the horse has been put back in its stall and the man is sitting on the aisle floor holding his right side; he is talking but keeps stopping to catch his breath.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：马厩主人说马已被牵回马厩，男子坐在过道地上捂着右侧；他能说话，但总要停下来喘气。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan oxygen, BVM and suction, a collar and spinal device, and an early transport decision; anticipate a significant chest injury
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备氧气、球囊面罩和吸引器、颈托和脊柱固定装置，并尽早做出转运决定；预判严重胸部损伤

expected.actionEn: Anticipate an animal hazard (a loose or kicking horse) in a barn aisle; gloves and eye protection ready; ask that the horse stays secured
expected.actionZh: 预判动物危险（脱缰或踢人的马）和马厩过道的环境；备好手套和护目镜；要求把马始终拴好

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The barn owner meets you at the aisle entrance. The horse is back in its stall behind a closed, latched door and is quiet; a second horse is tied at the far end of the aisle. The aisle is concrete with shavings, well lit and wide enough for the stretcher. The patient is sitting on the floor against a steel stall gate, his left hand pressed to his right chest, breathing fast and shallow, pale and sweaty. The owner saw it: the gelding struck out with a hind hoof while he was brushing its flank, and he was knocked backward about 3 m into the gate. He did not hit his head or lose consciousness. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：马厩主人在过道入口迎接你。那匹马已被牵回马厩，门关好并上了闩，很安静；过道远端还拴着另一匹马。过道为水泥地铺着木屑，光线好，宽度足够推担架床。患者坐在地上靠着钢制马厩栏门，左手按着右胸，呼吸又快又浅，面色苍白、出冷汗。主人亲眼所见：这匹去势公马在他刷其侧腹时用后蹄踢出，他被向后撞飞约 3 米撞在栏门上。他没有撞到头，也没有失去意识。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (horse secured in its stall, a second horse tied at the far end, concrete floor), environment, mechanism (kicked in the chest and thrown about 3 m into a steel gate), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（马已关入马厩、远端另拴一匹马、水泥地面）、环境、受伤机制（胸部被踢并被撞飞约 3 米撞上钢栏门）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection; ask the owner to keep both horses and any onlookers away from the patient
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜；请主人让两匹马和围观者远离患者

expected.actionEn: First look: sitting against the gate, hand pressed to the right chest, fast shallow breathing, pale and sweaty
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：靠着栏门坐着、手按右胸、呼吸又快又浅、面色苍白出冷汗

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert, anxious, grimacing, speaking in short phrases: 'Can't... take a deep breath... it hurts.' EXAMINER (give when assessed): AVPU Alert, GCS 15, oriented to person, place, time and event. Airway clear and he is speaking, no blood or vomit. Respirations 32, shallow, with accessory muscle use and guarding of the right chest. When the chest is exposed: a horseshoe-shaped bruise over the right lateral ribs and a segment of the right lateral chest wall that moves INWARD on inspiration and OUTWARD on expiration (paradoxical movement); crepitus on palpation over the right lateral chest; air entry decreased on the right; trachea midline, no JVD, no open wound. SpO2 89% on room air. Radial pulse 112, strong and regular; skin pale and sweaty; capillary refill 2 seconds. RBS otherwise: head and neck no deformity; abdomen soft and non-tender; pelvis stable; limbs no deformity; back no deformity or tenderness when he is log-rolled. SPINE (BC SMR matrix and Modified NEXUS): no midline tenderness, alert and oriented, no new neurological deficit, not intoxicated - but the flail chest with 9/10 pain is a major distracting injury, and multiple rib fractures with probable lung injury count as multi-trauma, so SMR IS warranted. UNSTABLE: flail chest with respiratory distress.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、焦虑、面部痛苦，用短句说：「喘……不上气……好痛。」考官（评估时给出）：AVPU 为 Alert，GCS 15，对人物、地点、时间和事件定向正常。气道通畅，能说话，无血、无呕吐物。呼吸 32 次/分，浅，动用辅助呼吸肌，右胸保护性僵硬。暴露胸部后：右侧胸壁外侧有马蹄形瘀斑，右侧胸壁外侧有一段在吸气时向内凹陷、呼气时向外鼓出（反常呼吸运动）；右侧胸壁外侧触诊有捻发感；右侧进气减弱；气管居中，无颈静脉怒张，无开放性伤口。SpO2 室内空气 89%。桡动脉 112 次/分，有力规则；皮肤苍白、出冷汗；毛细血管再充盈 2 秒。快速查体其余：头颈无畸形；腹软无压痛；骨盆稳定；四肢无畸形；翻身时背部无畸形和压痛。脊柱（BC 的 SMR 决策矩阵和改良 NEXUS）：无中线压痛，清醒且定向正常，无新发局灶性神经功能缺损，无醉酒——但伴 9/10 疼痛的连枷胸属于重大分散注意力的损伤，而且多处肋骨骨折伴可能的肺损伤属于多发伤，所以需要脊柱活动限制（SMR）。不稳定：连枷胸伴呼吸窘迫。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert, GCS 15, fully oriented
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert，GCS 15，定向完全正常

expected.actionEn: Decide the spine out loud with the BC SMR matrix and Modified NEXUS (p.26): no midline tenderness, alert and oriented, no deficit, not intoxicated - but the flail chest is a major distracting injury (and multiple rib fractures with lung injury are multi-trauma), so SMR is warranted; manually stabilize the head and neck, apply a hard collar, never tape the head (p.25-26)
expected.actionZh: 用 BC 的 SMR 决策矩阵和改良 NEXUS 大声做出脊柱决定（第 26 页）：无中线压痛、清醒定向、无神经功能缺损、无醉酒——但连枷胸属于重大分散注意力的损伤（多处肋骨骨折伴肺损伤也属多发伤），所以需要 SMR；手法固定头颈、上硬颈托、绝不用胶带固定头部（第 25-26 页）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway: clear and he is speaking; keep it protected while the head and chest are stabilized
expected.actionZh: 评估气道：通畅且能说话；在固定头部和胸部的过程中保持气道

expected.actionEn: Expose and assess the chest: rate 32 and shallow with accessory muscle use, paradoxical segment, crepitus, decreased air entry on the right, SpO2 89% - recognize respiratory distress
expected.actionZh: 暴露并评估胸部：呼吸 32 次/分且浅、动用辅助呼吸肌、反常呼吸段、捻发感、右侧进气减弱、SpO2 89%——识别呼吸窘迫

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse 112, skin pale and sweaty, capillary refill 2 seconds, no external bleeding
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉 112 次/分、皮肤苍白出冷汗、毛细血管再充盈 2 秒、无外出血

expected.actionEn: Complete the rapid body survey and MANUALLY stabilize the flail segment at once (p.34) - hand pressure over the segment by the partner or the patient's own hand; there is no open wound, so no chest seal; nothing taped or strapped across it
expected.actionZh: 完成快速查体并立即用手法稳定连枷段（第 34 页）——由搭档或患者自己的手压住该段；没有开放性伤口，所以不用胸部封闭敷料；不要用胶带或绑带环绕固定

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale and sweaty
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、出冷汗

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L by non-rebreather (trauma, respiratory distress, SpO2 89%) to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, with the BVM ready to assist ventilations
expected.actionZh: 非再吸入面罩 15 L 高流量吸氧（创伤、呼吸窘迫、SpO2 89%），维持 SpO2≥94%，球囊面罩备好随时辅助通气

expected.actionEn: Position the patient ASAP (p.34) within SMR: supine on the spinal device or stretcher with the injured side supported by hand; the head of the stretcher is not raised because he has no head injury (p.26)
expected.actionZh: 尽快摆位（第 34 页），并在 SMR 范围内：仰卧于脊柱固定装置或担架上，用手托住受伤一侧；因无头部损伤，不抬高担架头端（第 26 页）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Chest wall instability (flail chest) is on the BC unstable-patient list as an anatomical finding, and respiratory distress with accessory muscle use is a primary-survey finding on the same list: RTC. The kick and the throw are not on the mechanism list - the call is RTC because of the injury, not the mechanism. Ready to load within 15 minutes; history, vitals, head-to-toe and the PCP treatments are done en route. Delegate the barn owner (keep the horses away, open the gate and the doors) while you package, and keep the manual flail stabilization going through every move.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。胸壁不稳定（连枷胸）作为解剖学发现列在 BC 不稳定患者标准中，伴辅助呼吸肌动用的呼吸窘迫是同一清单中的初步评估发现：RTC。被踢和被撞飞不在受伤机制清单上——判定为 RTC 是因为损伤本身，而不是受伤机制。15 分钟内可装载；病史、生命体征、从头到脚检查和 PCP 处置都在途中完成。打包时指派马厩主人（把马拉开、打开栏门和大门），并在每次移动中持续用手法稳定连枷段。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and name the criteria: chest wall instability (flail chest) and respiratory distress with accessory muscle use (p.7)
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并说出依据：胸壁不稳定（连枷胸）和伴辅助呼吸肌动用的呼吸窘迫（第 7 页）

expected.actionEn: Collared, packaged on the spinal device with the flail side supported, and ready to load within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 已戴颈托、打包于脊柱固定装置上并托住连枷侧，15 分钟内可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate effectively: the barn owner keeps the horses clear and opens the gate and doors, the partner prepares the device and cot, and a helper holds the flail and head steady during the roll

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (short phrases, grimacing): was brushing the gelding's flank in the aisle when the horse struck out and kicked him with a hind hoof in the right side of the chest; knocked backward about 3 m into the steel gate and slid to the floor; no head strike, no loss of consciousness; it happened about 15 minutes before arrival. Chief complaint: 'my right side... I can't breathe in.' Sharp pain in the right lower chest, 9/10, worse with every breath and any movement, no radiation; no cough, no coughing blood; no neck pain, no back pain, no numbness or tingling, no abdominal pain. PMHx: high cholesterol; no lung or heart disease, no bleeding problems, does not smoke. Meds: atorvastatin 20 mg daily; no blood thinners; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen taken today. Allergies: none known. LOI: sandwich at 1230, coffee at 1500. Two beers a week, no liver disease, no stomach ulcers.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员（短句，面部痛苦）：他在过道里刷这匹去势公马的侧腹时，马突然踢出，用后蹄踢中他右侧胸部；他被向后撞飞约 3 米撞在钢栏门上，滑坐到地上；无头部撞击，无意识丧失；发生在到场前约 15 分钟。主诉：「右边……吸不进气。」右下胸尖锐样疼痛，9/10，每次呼吸和任何活动都加重，无放射；无咳嗽、无咯血；无颈痛、无背痛，无麻木或刺痛，无腹痛。既往史：高胆固醇；无肺病或心脏病，无出血问题，不吸烟。用药：阿托伐他汀 20 mg 每日一次；不服抗凝药；今天没吃过对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：12:30 吃了三明治，15:00 喝了咖啡。每周喝两瓶啤酒，无肝病，无胃溃疡。

Pain 9/10. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（途中，给任何镇痛药之前的基线；3 分钟内完成）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 138/86；脉搏 112 有力规则；呼吸 32 浅，动用辅助呼吸肌，右侧保护性僵硬；皮肤苍白、发凉、出冷汗；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 93%（吸氧前室内空气 89%）；血糖无指征（清醒、无糖尿病、无意识改变）；体温无指征（室内温和、无暴露）。疼痛 9/10。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, brief for the unstable patient; stop the Functional Enquiry the moment ventilations are assisted. ACTOR (breathless, tiring): general - fit and healthy, no recent illness; CNS - no headache or dizziness, no numbness or tingling in the arms or legs; respiratory - right chest pain and shortness of breath, no cough, no coughing blood; cardiovascular - heart racing, no chest pressure, no palpitations before the injury; GI/GU - no nausea, no abdominal pain, urine normal; integumentary - bruise on the right chest and a scrape on the right forearm; musculoskeletal - right chest wall pain only, no neck, back or limb pain; endocrine - no diabetes or thyroid problems; EENT - no vision change, no ear or nose bleeding, no facial pain.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简；一旦开始辅助通气就停止功能问诊。患者演员（气促、渐显疲惫）：整体——体健，近期无病；中枢神经——无头痛或头晕，双臂双腿无麻木刺痛；呼吸——右胸痛和气短，无咳嗽、无咯血；心血管——心跳快，无胸闷，受伤前无心悸；消化/泌尿——无恶心、无腹痛，尿正常；皮肤——右胸瘀斑和右前臂擦伤；肌肉骨骼——仅右侧胸壁痛，无颈、背或肢体痛；内分泌——无糖尿病或甲状腺问题；眼耳鼻喉——视力无变化，耳鼻无出血，面部无痛。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - hard collar in place, no wounds, no midline tenderness, trachea midline, neck veins flat, no crepitus in the neck; chest - horseshoe-shaped bruise over the right lateral ribs, paradoxical segment, crepitus, air entry decreased on the right and clear on the left, no wound; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - no deformity or tenderness at the log roll; lower extremities - nil, CSM intact; upper extremities - scrape on the right forearm, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——硬颈托在位，无伤口，无中线压痛，气管居中，颈静脉塌陷，颈部无捻发感；胸部——右侧胸壁外侧马蹄形瘀斑、反常呼吸段、捻发感，右侧进气减弱、左侧清晰，无伤口；腹部——软，无压痛；背部——翻身时无畸形和压痛；下肢——无异常，远端 CSM 完好；上肢——右前臂擦伤，远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionZh: 头颈查体：颈托是否合适、中线压痛、气管、颈静脉

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS (Chest Trauma and Spinal Management): MANUALLY stabilize the flail segment at once and keep it stabilized through every move - hand pressure by the partner or the patient's own hand; nothing is taped or strapped across it. There is no open wound, so no chest seal, and no bleeding to control. Assist oxygenation and ventilation if necessary, and position the patient as soon as possible. SMR (p.25-26): manual head stabilization and a hard collar, never tape the head; the examiner's key is the Full SMR of multi-trauma - spinal device with foam blocks, body secured only where appropriate - and the Simple SMR of a positive Modified NEXUS (collar on, patient on the stretcher mattress and not a clamshell) is also accepted when the candidate states the branch. THE ANALGESIA CALL (Appendix A): Entonox is withheld - crepitus and decreased air entry on the right mean a pneumothorax cannot be ruled out, nitrous oxide expands a closed air space and pneumothorax is a listed contraindication; by set 2 an altered LOC is a second contraindication. Say it aloud and document it. Both oral drugs are indicated and permitted after the checks - acetaminophen 1000 mg PO (no dose in the last 4 hours, no liver disease, no overdose concern) and ibuprofen 400 mg PO (no NSAID allergy, no ulcer or GI bleeding, no anticoagulants) - and are given while he is alert, before he deteriorates; giving only one of the two costs marks. Methoxyflurane is outside Appendix A and its CHECK caution for respiratory depression argues against it here. PCP EN ROUTE: vascular access (Chest Trauma, if required); the Hypovolemia fluid bolus and TXA are NOT indicated - systolic 138 and no signs of shock. Do NOT apply CPAP: a traumatic cause of respiratory distress and a possible pneumothorax are both listed contraindications, and a patient whose breathing is failing needs a BVM instead.
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用（胸部创伤与脊柱管理）：立即用手法稳定连枷段，并在每次移动中持续稳定——由搭档或患者自己的手压住；不要用胶带或绑带环绕固定。没有开放性伤口，所以不用胸部封闭敷料，也无出血需要控制。必要时辅助氧合和通气，并尽快摆位。SMR（第 25-26 页）：手法固定头颈和硬颈托，绝不用胶带固定头部；考官的标准答案是多发伤的完整 SMR——带泡沫垫块的脊柱固定装置、仅在合适时固定身体——如果考生说明了所走的分支，改良 NEXUS 阳性对应的简易 SMR（戴颈托、躺在担架床垫上而不是铲式担架）也接受。镇痛决策（附录 A）：不给 Entonox——胸壁捻发感和右侧进气减弱意味着不能排除气胸，笑气会使封闭的气腔膨胀，而气胸是列明的禁忌证；到第 2 组时意识改变是第二项禁忌证。大声说出并记录。两种口服药在核查后都有指征且允许使用——对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服（过去 4 小时内未服、无肝病、无过量顾虑）和布洛芬 400 mg 口服（无非甾体抗炎药过敏、无溃疡或消化道出血、不服抗凝药）——并趁他清醒、在恶化之前给；只给其中一种会扣分。甲氧氟烷不在附录 A 之内，其 CHECK 慎用项中的呼吸抑制使它在此不宜使用。PCP 途中：建立静脉通路（胸部创伤协议，如有需要）；低血容量的补液和 TXA 均无指征——收缩压 138、无休克征象。不要使用 CPAP：创伤性呼吸窘迫和可能存在的气胸都是列明的禁忌证，呼吸衰竭的患者需要改用球囊面罩。

expected.actionEn: Keep the flail segment manually stabilized through the log roll, the move to the cot and loading - nothing taped or strapped across it (p.34 'MANUALLY')
expected.actionZh: 在翻身、转移到担架床和装车的全过程中持续用手法稳定连枷段——不要用胶带或绑带环绕固定（第 34 页「MANUALLY」）

expected.actionEn: Spinal management skill: manual head stabilization, correctly sized hard collar, head never taped, coordinated log roll with the flail side supported, then the spinal device with foam blocks and the body secured only where appropriate (Full SMR) or the stretcher mattress rather than a clamshell (Simple SMR) (p.25-26)
expected.actionZh: 脊柱管理技能：手法固定头部、尺寸合适的硬颈托、头部绝不用胶带、托住连枷侧的协调翻身，然后用带泡沫垫块的脊柱固定装置并仅在合适时固定身体（完整 SMR），或躺在担架床垫上而不是铲式担架（简易 SMR）（第 25-26 页）

expected.actionEn: Withhold Entonox and say why: a pneumothorax cannot be ruled out (crepitus, decreased right air entry) and is a listed contraindication - nitrous oxide expands a closed air space; the altered LOC at set 2 is a second reason (p.65)
expected.actionZh: 不给 Entonox 并说明理由：不能排除气胸（捻发感、右侧进气减弱），而气胸是列明的禁忌证——笑气会使封闭气腔膨胀；第 2 组的意识改变是第二个理由（第 65 页）

expected.actionEn: Give BOTH acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO, after ruling out each contraindication aloud (p.58, p.68), while he is still alert, with the six rights
expected.actionZh: 趁他仍清醒时，在大声排除各自禁忌证后（第 58、68 页），按六项核对给予对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 和布洛芬 400 mg，两种都要给

expected.actionEn: PCP: do NOT apply CPAP - a traumatic cause of respiratory distress and a possible pneumothorax are listed contraindications (p.52); use the BVM when breathing is inadequate
expected.actionZh: PCP：不要使用 CPAP——创伤性呼吸窘迫和可能存在的气胸是列明的禁忌证（第 52 页）；呼吸不足时改用球囊面罩

expected.actionEn: PCP: obtain vascular access en route (p.34, p.38); say that the fluid bolus (needs systolic under 90, p.54) and TXA (needs signs of shock, p.78) are not indicated
expected.actionZh: PCP：途中建立静脉通路（第 34、38 页）；说明补液（需收缩压低于 90，第 54 页）和 TXA（需有休克征象，第 78 页）均无指征

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the manual flail stabilization and SpO2 after every move and every 5 minutes; watch for tension pneumothorax (tracheal shift, JVD, absent air entry on the right, falling BP). Set 2 (en route, about 6 minutes after set 1 - he is tiring and the oral analgesics given 4 minutes ago have not yet taken effect): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6), drowsy and confused; BP 132/80; pulse 124 regular; respirations 38, very shallow; skin pale, cool and clammy with dusky lips; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 86% on 15 L NRB; pain 9/10; trachea midline, no JVD. BREATHING IS NOW INADEQUATE: fast, very shallow, SpO2 falling despite oxygen and a falling LOC - the candidate must begin assisted ventilations with a BVM and 15 L oxygen at once. Once he is assisted in time with his own breaths, SpO2 climbs to 95%. If he is not assisted, the next check shows SpO2 82%.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后及每 5 分钟复评 ABC、手法稳定连枷段的情况和 SpO2；留意张力性气胸（气管移位、颈静脉怒张、右侧进气消失、血压下降）。第 2 组（途中，距第 1 组约 6 分钟——他在衰竭，4 分钟前给的口服镇痛药尚未起效）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6），嗜睡、言语错乱；血压 132/80；脉搏 124 规则；呼吸 38，极浅；皮肤苍白、发凉、湿冷，口唇发暗；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 86%；疼痛 9/10；气管居中，无颈静脉怒张。呼吸现已不足：快而极浅，吸氧下 SpO2 仍下降，意识水平下降——考生必须立即用球囊面罩和 15 L 氧气开始辅助通气。顺着他自己的呼吸节奏辅助后，SpO2 升至 95%。若不辅助，下次检查 SpO2 为 82%。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, the flail stabilization and SpO2 after every move and every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次移动后及每 5 分钟复评 ABC、连枷段稳定情况和 SpO2

expected.actionEn: Recognize that breathing is now inadequate (38, very shallow, SpO2 86% on 15 L, falling LOC) and begin assisted ventilations with a BVM and 15 L oxygen at once, timed with his own breaths (p.11, p.34)
expected.actionZh: 识别呼吸现已不足（38 次/分、极浅、15 L 下 SpO2 86%、意识下降），并立即用球囊面罩和 15 L 氧气开始辅助通气，配合他自己的呼吸节奏（第 11、34 页）

expected.actionEn: Assist ventilations with the BVM connected to oxygen: good mask seal, visible chest rise, flail segment kept stabilized
expected.actionZh: 用连接氧气的球囊面罩辅助通气：面罩密合良好、胸廓有可见起伏、连枷段仍保持稳定

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes; interpret the trend out loud as a tiring patient with failing breathing, and upgrade the hospital notification
