expected.actionEn: Monitor for tension pneumothorax (p.34): tracheal shift, JVD, absent right air entry, falling BP - none yet - and say what you would report
expected.actionZh: 监测张力性气胸（第 34 页）：气管移位、颈静脉怒张、右侧进气消失、血压下降——目前均无——并说明会汇报什么

expected.actionEn: Reassess the pain (9/10), note that the oral analgesics have not yet taken effect, and document that Entonox stays withheld and why
expected.actionZh: 复评疼痛（9/10），说明口服镇痛药尚未起效，并记录 Entonox 继续不给及其理由

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (flail chest with failing breathing). Structured hand-off with the mechanism, the flail finding, the SMR decision, the analgesics given and withheld, and the assisted ventilations with times; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（连枷胸伴呼吸衰竭）。结构化交接，含受伤机制、连枷胸发现、SMR 决定、已给和未给的镇痛药，以及辅助通气及其时间；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical patient: flail chest, failing breathing needing assisted ventilations, SMR in place
expected.actionZh: 危重患者途中预报：连枷胸、呼吸衰竭需辅助通气、已做 SMR

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with mechanism, flail segment findings, vitals trend, SMR reason, oral analgesics with times, Entonox withheld and why, and when assisted ventilations began
expected.actionZh: 完整交接（受伤机制、连枷段发现、生命体征趋势、SMR 的理由、口服镇痛药及时间、不给 Entonox 的理由，以及开始辅助通气的时间）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes with drug times, the Entonox contraindication and the change in breathing
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，含用药时间、Entonox 禁忌证和呼吸状态的变化

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, baseline before any analgesic
about 6 minutes later, en route, tiring

criticalPitfallsEn: Not applying spinal motion restriction (or releasing manual head control) when the Modified NEXUS is met by a major distracting injury and the injury is multi-trauma - delicate-spine auto-fail, 100% (p.26, p.25)

Not beginning assisted ventilations when breathing becomes inadequate (fast, very shallow, SpO2 falling on 15 L, falling LOC) - the breathing auto-fail 'determines inadequate breathing but does not intervene', 100% (p.11, p.34)
Never stabilizing the flail segment, or leaving it unsupported during the log roll and the move - finds a life-threatening injury and fails to intervene, 100% (rapid body survey, p.34)

Giving Entonox when a pneumothorax cannot be ruled out (crepitus, decreased air entry; altered LOC at set 2), or giving any analgesic before baseline vitals with SpO2 - protocol error up to 100% (p.65)

PCP: applying CPAP despite a traumatic cause of respiratory distress and a possible pneumothorax (p.52), or starting a fluid bolus or TXA without the indications (p.54, p.78) - protocol error up to 100%

Stabilizing the flail segment with circumferential tape or a tight strap instead of by hand - contrary to 'MANUALLY stabilize' (p.34) and, as textbook practice (not a BC rubric item), it restricts chest expansion in a patient already breathing shallowly - skill deduction
Treating the call as non-RTC or finishing the secondary survey on scene instead of loading within 15 minutes - transport category error, 25% (p.7: chest wall instability)
Giving only one of the two oral analgesics without a stated contraindication - pain-management deduction (Appendix A); with Entonox correctly withheld, both orals are still expected
criticalPitfallsZh: 改良 NEXUS 已因重大分散注意力的损伤而满足、且属多发伤时仍不做脊柱活动限制（或放开手法头部控制）——颈椎项自动失败，扣 100%（第 26、25 页）
呼吸变得不足（快而极浅、15 L 下 SpO2 下降、意识下降）时不开始辅助通气——属呼吸项自动失败「判断出呼吸不足却不干预」，扣 100%（第 11、34 页）
从不稳定连枷段，或在翻身和转移中不托住它——发现危及生命的损伤却不干预，扣 100%（快速查体，第 34 页）
在不能排除气胸（捻发感、进气减弱；第 2 组意识改变）时给 Entonox，或在没有含 SpO2 的基线生命体征前就给任何镇痛药——协议类错误最高扣 100%（第 65 页）
PCP：在创伤性呼吸窘迫且可能存在气胸时使用 CPAP（第 52 页），或在没有指征时补液或给 TXA（第 54、78 页）——协议类错误最高扣 100%
用环绕胶带或紧绷带而不是用手稳定连枷段——违背「MANUALLY stabilize」（第 34 页），且（教科书理由，不属 BC 评分项）会限制本已呼吸浅快患者的胸廓扩张——技能类扣分
当作非 RTC，或在现场做完二次评估而不在 15 分钟内装载——转运分类错误，扣 25%（第 7 页：胸壁不稳定）
两种口服镇痛药只给一种且没有说明禁忌证——疼痛处理类扣分（附录 A）；即使 Entonox 已正确不给，仍应两种口服药都给
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives manual flail stabilization, spinal motion restriction (hard collar, spinal device), high-flow oxygen, assisted ventilations with a BVM when breathing fails, oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen, and rapid transport within 15 minutes; Entonox is withheld with the reason said aloud. EMR does NOT start an IV or give a fluid bolus or TXA, and there is no Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 实施手法稳定连枷段、脊柱活动限制（硬颈托、脊柱固定装置）、高流量吸氧、呼吸衰竭时用球囊面罩辅助通气、口服对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬，并在 15 分钟内快速转运；不给 Entonox 并大声说出理由。EMR 不建立静脉、不补液、不给 TXA，也没有功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route (Chest Trauma, 'if required') and the 9-system Functional Enquiry, and must say what is NOT indicated: no CPAP (traumatic cause and possible pneumothorax, p.52), no fluid bolus (systolic 138; the Hypovolemia protocol needs under 90, p.54) and no TXA (no signs of shock, p.78). A PEEP valve on the BVM is a PCP option (p.50-52) but, with a possible pneumothorax, the candidate should name the risk aloud. Methoxyflurane is not part of Appendix A and carries a respiratory-depression caution (p.71). Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: a folded pad held by hand on the flail segment gives the same support as bare hands.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中建立静脉通路（胸部创伤协议，「如有需要」）和 9 系统功能问诊，并且必须说出哪些无指征：不用 CPAP（创伤性病因且可能存在气胸，第 52 页）、不补液（收缩压 138；低血容量协议要求低于 90，第 54 页）、不给 TXA（无休克征象，第 78 页）。球囊面罩加 PEEP 阀是 PCP 的选项（第 50-52 页），但存在可能的气胸时，考生应大声说出风险。甲氧氟烷不在附录 A 之内，且有呼吸抑制的慎用项（第 71 页）。教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项：用手按住折叠的垫子放在连枷段上，与徒手支撑效果相同。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 44-year-old male kicked in the right chest by a horse at about 1617 and knocked about 3 metres backward into a steel gate, with no head strike or loss of consciousness. On our arrival he was alert, GCS 15, with a flail segment of the right lateral chest moving paradoxically, crepitus and decreased air entry on the right, respirations 32 shallow with accessory muscle use, SpO2 89% on room air, BP 138/86, pulse 112, pain 9/10. We stabilized the segment by hand, gave high-flow oxygen, and applied spinal motion restriction with a collar and spinal device because the chest injury is a major distracting injury. Entonox was withheld because a pneumothorax cannot be ruled out; he took acetaminophen 1000 milligrams and ibuprofen 400 milligrams by mouth at 1652. A PCP started an IV at 1653; no fluid bolus or TXA was given. At 1656 he was tiring - GCS 14, BP 132/80, pulse 124, resps 38 very shallow, SpO2 86% on 15 litres - so we began assisted ventilations with the BVM at 1657 and his SpO2 rose to 95%. History of high cholesterol on atorvastatin, no known allergies, last ate at 1230.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 44 岁男性，约 16:17 被马踢中右胸，并向后撞飞约 3 米撞在钢栏门上，无头部撞击或意识丧失。我们到场时他清醒，GCS 15，右侧胸壁外侧有反常运动的连枷段，右侧有捻发感且进气减弱，呼吸 32 次/分浅，动用辅助呼吸肌，SpO2 室内空气 89%，血压 138/86，脉搏 112，疼痛 9/10。我们用手稳定了连枷段，给高流量吸氧，并因胸部损伤属于重大分散注意力的损伤而用颈托和脊柱固定装置做了脊柱活动限制。因不能排除气胸，未给 Entonox；16:52 口服对乙酰氨基酚 1000 毫克和布洛芬 400 毫克。PCP 16:53 建立静脉通路，未补液也未给 TXA。16:56 他渐衰竭——GCS 14，血压 132/80，脉搏 124，呼吸 38 极浅，15 升下 SpO2 86%——所以 16:57 开始用球囊面罩辅助通气，SpO2 升至 95%。既往高胆固醇，服阿托伐他汀，无已知过敏，最后进食 12:30。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Right chest pain and difficulty breathing after a horse kick; flail segment right lateral chest
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Kicked by a hind hoof in the right chest while brushing a gelding at about 1617, knocked about 3 m into a steel gate; no head strike or LOC; sharp right lower chest pain 9/10 worse with breathing; no neck or back pain, no neurological symptoms
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: High cholesterol; no lung or heart disease, no bleeding problems, no liver disease or ulcers
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Atorvastatin 20 mg daily; no blood thinners; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen taken today
treatments: Flail segment stabilized manually and kept so through every move
SMR: manual head stabilization, hard collar, spinal device (Modified NEXUS - major distracting injury)
High-flow O2 15 L NRB; BVM assisted ventilations from 1657 when breathing became inadequate (SpO2 rose to 95%)
Acetaminophen 1000 mg PO + ibuprofen 400 mg PO at 1652; Entonox withheld (pneumothorax not excluded, later altered LOC)
PCP: IV at 1653; no fluid bolus or TXA (not indicated); no CPAP (traumatic cause, possible pneumothorax)
RTC transport with en-route notification
findings: Paradoxical segment right lateral chest, horseshoe bruise, crepitus, decreased right air entry; trachea midline, no JVD
Baseline GCS 15, BP 138/86, pulse 112, resps 32 shallow, SpO2 89% RA (93% on 15 L), pain 9/10
Set 2: GCS 14, BP 132/80, pulse 124, resps 38 very shallow, SpO2 86% on 15 L - assisted ventilations started
Scrape right forearm; abdomen soft, pelvis stable, back non-tender at log roll

dispatch.narrativeEn: The barn owner says the horse has been put back in its stall and the man is sitting on the aisle floor holding his right side; he is talking but keeps stopping to catch his breath.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 马厩主人说马已被牵回马厩，男子坐在过道地上捂着右侧；他能说话，但总要停下来喘气。

scene.narrativeEn: The barn owner meets you at the aisle entrance. The patient is sitting on the floor against a steel stall gate, his left hand pressed to his right chest, breathing fast and shallow, pale and sweaty.
scene.narrativeZh: 马厩主人在过道入口迎接你。患者坐在地上靠着钢制马厩栏门，左手按着右胸，呼吸又快又浅，面色苍白、出冷汗。

rows.en: The horse is back in its stall behind a closed, latched door and is quiet; a second horse is tied at the far end of the aisle. The aisle is concrete with shavings, well lit and wide enough for the stretcher
rows.zh: 那匹马已被牵回马厩，门关好并上了闩，很安静；过道远端还拴着另一匹马。过道为水泥地铺着木屑，光线好，宽度足够推担架床

rows.en: The gelding struck out with a hind hoof while he was brushing its flank, and he was knocked backward about 3 m into the steel gate; he did not hit his head or lose consciousness
rows.zh: 这匹去势公马在他刷其侧腹时用后蹄踢出，他被向后撞飞约 3 米撞在钢栏门上；他没有撞到头，也没有失去意识

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: The barn owner, who saw it happen
rows.zh: 马厩主人，亲眼目睹了经过

rows.en: Anxious and grimacing
rows.zh: 焦虑、面部痛苦

rows.en: Alert (AVPU), GCS 15, oriented to person, place, time and event; speaks in short phrases: 'Can't... take a deep breath... it hurts'
rows.zh: Alert（AVPU），GCS 15，对人物、地点、时间和事件定向正常；用短句说：「喘……不上气……好痛」

rows.en: Clear and he is speaking, no blood or vomit
rows.zh: 通畅，能说话，无血、无呕吐物

rows.en: 32, shallow, with accessory muscle use and guarding of the right chest. When the chest is exposed: a horseshoe-shaped bruise over the right lateral ribs and a segment of the right lateral chest wall that moves INWARD on inspiration and OUTWARD on expiration (paradoxical movement); crepitus on palpation over the right lateral chest; air entry decreased on the right; trachea midline, no JVD, no open wound
rows.zh: 32 次/分，浅，动用辅助呼吸肌，右胸保护性僵硬。暴露胸部后：右侧胸壁外侧有马蹄形瘀斑，右侧胸壁外侧有一段在吸气时向内凹陷、呼气时向外鼓出（反常呼吸运动）；右侧胸壁外侧触诊有捻发感；右侧进气减弱；气管居中，无颈静脉怒张，无开放性伤口

rows.en: Radial pulse 112, strong and regular; capillary refill 2 seconds
rows.zh: 桡动脉 112 次/分，有力规则；毛细血管再充盈 2 秒

rows.en: Pale and sweaty
rows.zh: 苍白、出冷汗

rows.en: 89% on room air
rows.zh: 室内空气 89%

rows.en: Head and neck no deformity; abdomen soft and non-tender; pelvis stable; limbs no deformity; back no deformity or tenderness when he is log-rolled
rows.zh: 头颈无畸形；腹软无压痛；骨盆稳定；四肢无畸形；翻身时背部无畸形和压痛

rows.en: SMR IS warranted (BC SMR matrix and Modified NEXUS): no midline tenderness, alert and oriented, no new neurological deficit, not intoxicated - but the flail chest with 9/10 pain is a major distracting injury, and multiple rib fractures with probable lung injury count as multi-trauma
rows.zh: 需要 SMR（BC 的 SMR 决策矩阵和改良 NEXUS）：无中线压痛，清醒且定向正常，无新发局灶性神经功能缺损，无醉酒——但伴 9/10 疼痛的连枷胸属于重大分散注意力的损伤，而且多处肋骨骨折伴可能的肺损伤属于多发伤

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed; the chest findings only once the chest is exposed. Stability: UNSTABLE - flail chest with respiratory distress.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现；胸部发现须在暴露胸部后才给出。判定：不稳定——连枷胸伴呼吸窘迫。

rows.en: 'My right side... I can't breathe in'
rows.zh: 「右边……吸不进气」

rows.en: No cough, no coughing blood; no neck pain, no back pain, no numbness or tingling, no abdominal pain
rows.zh: 无咳嗽、无咯血；无颈痛、无背痛，无麻木或刺痛，无腹痛

rows.en: Worse with every breath and any movement
rows.zh: 每次呼吸和任何活动都加重

rows.en: Sharp
rows.zh: 尖锐样

rows.en: Right lower chest, no radiation
rows.zh: 右下胸，无放射

rows.en: About 15 minutes before arrival
rows.zh: 到场前约 15 分钟

rows.en: None known
rows.zh: 无已知过敏

rows.en: Atorvastatin 20 mg daily; no blood thinners; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen taken today
rows.zh: 阿托伐他汀 20 mg 每日一次；不服抗凝药；今天没吃过对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬

rows.en: High cholesterol; no lung or heart disease, no bleeding problems, does not smoke. Two beers a week, no liver disease, no stomach ulcers
rows.zh: 高胆固醇；无肺病或心脏病，无出血问题，不吸烟。每周喝两瓶啤酒，无肝病，无胃溃疡

rows.en: Sandwich at 1230, coffee at 1500
rows.zh: 12:30 吃了三明治，15:00 喝了咖啡

rows.en: Was brushing the gelding's flank in the aisle when the horse struck out and kicked him with a hind hoof in the right side of the chest; knocked backward about 3 m into the steel gate and slid to the floor; no head strike, no loss of consciousness
rows.zh: 他在过道里刷这匹去势公马的侧腹时，马突然踢出，用后蹄踢中他右侧胸部；他被向后撞飞约 3 米撞在钢栏门上，滑坐到地上；无头部撞击，无意识丧失

history.noteEn: Actor answers in short phrases, grimacing.
history.noteZh: 患者演员用短句回答，面部痛苦。

sets.rxEn: Oral analgesics given 4 minutes earlier, not yet effective
sets.rxZh: 4 分钟前已给口服镇痛药，尚未起效

vitals.noteEn: Set 1 is the baseline taken en route BEFORE any analgesic, completed in under 3 minutes; SpO2 is 93% on 15 L NRB (89% on room air before oxygen). BGL is not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no altered LOC); temperature is not indicated (mild indoor setting, no exposure). Pain 9/10 at both sets. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs, the manual flail stabilization and SpO2 after every move and every 5 minutes; watch for tension pneumothorax (tracheal shift, JVD, absent air entry on the right, falling BP). Set 2 is about 6 minutes after set 1: he is tiring and the oral analgesics given 4 minutes ago have not yet taken effect; GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6), drowsy and confused; trachea midline, no JVD. BREATHING IS NOW INADEQUATE: fast, very shallow, SpO2 falling despite oxygen and a falling LOC - the candidate must begin assisted ventilations with a BVM and 15 L oxygen at once. Once he is assisted in time with his own breaths, SpO2 climbs to 95%. If he is not assisted, the next check shows SpO2 82%.
vitals.noteZh: 第 1 组为途中、给任何镇痛药之前的基线，3 分钟内完成；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 93%（吸氧前室内空气 89%）。血糖无指征（清醒、无糖尿病、无意识改变）；体温无指征（室内温和、无暴露）。两组疼痛均为 9/10。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。每次移动后及每 5 分钟复评 ABC、手法稳定连枷段的情况和 SpO2；留意张力性气胸（气管移位、颈静脉怒张、右侧进气消失、血压下降）。第 2 组距第 1 组约 6 分钟：他在衰竭，4 分钟前给的口服镇痛药尚未起效；GCS 14（E4 V4 M6），嗜睡、言语错乱；气管居中，无颈静脉怒张。呼吸现已不足：快而极浅，吸氧下 SpO2 仍下降，意识水平下降——考生必须立即用球囊面罩和 15 L 氧气开始辅助通气。顺着他自己的呼吸节奏辅助后，SpO2 升至 95%。若不辅助，下次检查 SpO2 为 82%。

rows.en: Fit and healthy, no recent illness
rows.zh: 体健，近期无病

rows.en: No headache or dizziness, no numbness or tingling in the arms or legs
rows.zh: 无头痛或头晕，双臂双腿无麻木刺痛

rows.en: Right chest pain and shortness of breath, no cough, no coughing blood
rows.zh: 右胸痛和气短，无咳嗽、无咯血

rows.en: Heart racing, no chest pressure, no palpitations before the injury
rows.zh: 心跳快，无胸闷，受伤前无心悸

rows.en: No nausea, no abdominal pain, urine normal
rows.zh: 无恶心、无腹痛，尿正常

rows.en: Bruise on the right chest and a scrape on the right forearm
rows.zh: 右胸瘀斑和右前臂擦伤

rows.en: Right chest wall pain only, no neck, back or limb pain
rows.zh: 仅右侧胸壁痛，无颈、背或肢体痛

rows.en: No diabetes or thyroid problems
rows.zh: 无糖尿病或甲状腺问题

rows.en: No vision change, no ear or nose bleeding, no facial pain
rows.zh: 视力无变化，耳鼻无出血，面部无痛

systems.noteEn: PCP only, en route, brief for the unstable patient; stop the Functional Enquiry the moment ventilations are assisted. Actor is breathless and tiring.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简；一旦开始辅助通气就停止功能问诊。患者演员气促、渐显疲惫。

rows.en: Hard collar in place, no wounds, no midline tenderness, trachea midline, neck veins flat, no crepitus in the neck
rows.zh: 硬颈托在位，无伤口，无中线压痛，气管居中，颈静脉塌陷，颈部无捻发感

rows.en: Horseshoe-shaped bruise over the right lateral ribs, paradoxical segment, crepitus, air entry decreased on the right and clear on the left, no wound
rows.zh: 右侧胸壁外侧马蹄形瘀斑、反常呼吸段、捻发感，右侧进气减弱、左侧清晰，无伤口

rows.en: Soft, non-tender
rows.zh: 软，无压痛

rows.en: No deformity or tenderness at the log roll
rows.zh: 翻身时无畸形和压痛

rows.en: Scrape on the right forearm, CSM intact
rows.zh: 右前臂擦伤，远端 CSM 完好

rows.en: Nil, CSM intact
rows.zh: 无异常，远端 CSM 完好

scenarios.titleEn: Trampoline Fall - Spinal Cord Injury With Hypotension and Bradycardia
scenarios.titleZh: 蹦床坠落——脊髓损伤伴低血压与心动过缓
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1620 hrs. Code 3 to a house in Abbotsford. 19-year-old male fell from a backyard trampoline, landed on his head and cannot move his legs. The caller is his sister. Hospital is 20 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 16:20，Code 3 前往阿伯茨福德一处住宅。19 岁男性从后院蹦床上摔下，头部着地，双腿无法活动。报警人是他的妹妹。医院车程 20 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: the sister says a friend is holding his head as the call-taker instructed; he is awake, lying on the lawn and says he cannot feel his legs; there is no heavy bleeding. It is a cold, damp afternoon. Fire First Responders are not attending.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：妹妹说朋友按调度员的指示正扶住他的头；他清醒，躺在草坪上，说双腿没有知觉；没有大出血。下午又冷又潮。消防 First Responders 不会到场。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan the collar, spinal immobilization device with blocks and straps, oxygen, blankets and extra hands, with early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备颈托、带头部固定块和绑带的脊柱固定装置、氧气、毯子和额外人手，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch that a head-first landing with loss of leg movement and feeling is a spinal cord injury: nobody moves him until you take over the head
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即判断头先着地并出现腿部运动和感觉丧失属脊髓损伤：在你接手头部之前任何人都不得移动他

expected.actionEn: Consider additional resources (First Responders) for the coordinated roll and lift
expected.actionZh: 考虑增派资源（First Responders）协助协调翻身与抬运

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a cold, wet backyard; PPE incl gloves
expected.actionZh: 预判寒冷潮湿的后院；个人防护含手套

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: A cold, damp November afternoon, 6 °C. His sister meets you at the side gate and leads you to the backyard. A round trampoline with a net enclosure stands on the lawn. The patient lies on his back on the wet grass beside it, shivering a little. A friend kneels behind his head holding it between his hands as the call-taker instructed, and a neighbour has laid a jacket over his chest. Nobody has moved him. Bystanders say he was doing a front flip. The wet grass is slippery but there are no other hazards. One patient. If the candidate asks, dispatch will send First Responders.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：十一月一个又冷又潮的下午，6 °C。他妹妹在侧门接你，带你到后院。草坪上有一个带护网的圆形蹦床。患者仰卧在蹦床旁湿漉漉的草地上，微微发抖。一位朋友跪在他头后，按调度员的指示双手扶住他的头；一位邻居把一件夹克盖在他的胸口。没有人动过他。旁观者说他当时在翻前空翻。湿草地较滑，但没有其他危险。单一患者。如考生询问，调度会派出 First Responders。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (slippery wet grass only), environment (cold, damp, outdoors), mechanism (head-first landing from a front flip on a trampoline) and number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（仅湿滑草地）、环境（寒冷、潮湿、户外）、受伤机制（蹦床前空翻头先着地）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves
expected.actionZh: 戴手套

expected.actionEn: First look: young man supine and still on cold wet grass, shivering, friend holding his head, awake and anxious
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：年轻男子仰卧不动躺在冰冷湿草地上、发抖、朋友扶着头、清醒焦虑

expected.actionEn: Approach calmly, tell him not to move, ask the friend to keep holding his head until you take over, and request First Responders
expected.actionZh: 沉稳接近，告诉他不要动，让朋友继续扶住头直到你接手，并申请 First Responders

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake and anxious, lies still, says 'I can't feel my legs'. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): LOC - alert (A) and oriented. Airway - clear, speaks in full sentences. Breathing - 16, regular, adequate depth, chest rises symmetrically; SpO2 96% on room air. Circulation - radial pulse 52, regular and weak. Skin (give during RBS): warm, pink and dry below the nipple line; face and hands cool. RBS (hands-on, without moving him): chest symmetrical, no bruising; abdomen soft and non-tender; pelvis stable; no external bleeding anywhere; midline tenderness at the base of the neck and between the shoulder blades when palpated with his head held; if the groin is exposed, a persistent erection (priapism) is noted. Neuro (CSM): arms - moves both on command, strong equal grip, sensation intact; legs - no movement on command and no response to touch or pinch below the nipple line. C-spine INDICATED (NEXUS positive: midline tenderness and a focal neurological deficit). UNSTABLE: new-onset neurological deficit with a slow, weak pulse - hypotension is confirmed with the BP in the vitals.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、焦虑，躺着不动，说「我腿没感觉了」。考官（评估时才给出）：意识——清醒（A）、定向正常。气道——通畅，能说完整句子。呼吸——16 次/分、规则、深度足够、胸廓起伏对称；SpO2 室内空气 96%。循环——桡动脉 52 次/分、规则、细弱。皮肤（RBS 时给出）：乳头线以下温暖、红润、干燥；面部和双手发凉。RBS（动手检查，不移动患者）：胸部对称、无瘀斑；腹部软、无压痛；骨盆稳定；任何部位均无外出血；扶住他的头触诊时，颈根部和两肩胛之间正中线有压痛；如暴露腹股沟，可见持续性阴茎勃起（priapism）。神经（CSM）：双臂——按指令均可活动，握力强且对称，感觉正常；双腿——按指令无活动，乳头线以下对触摸和针刺无反应。有颈椎固定指征（NEXUS 阳性：中线压痛和局灶性神经功能缺损）。不稳定：新发神经功能缺损伴脉搏缓慢细弱——低血压以生命体征中的血压确认。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert

expected.actionEn: Take over manual in-line stabilization of the head and neck from the friend BEFORE any movement or pain stimulus (head-first landing, midline tenderness and a neurological deficit = NEXUS positive) and keep it until he is secured to the device
expected.actionZh: 在任何移动或疼痛刺激之前，从朋友手中接过头颈部手法中立固定（头先着地、中线压痛和神经功能缺损=NEXUS 阳性），并保持到他被固定在装置上

expected.actionEn: Assess airway while holding the head still - clear
expected.actionZh: 在保持头部不动的同时评估气道——通畅

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: rate, depth, chest rise and SpO2
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：频率、深度、胸廓起伏和 SpO2

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse is slow and weak - recognize it as abnormal, suspect hypotension and keep him flat
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动缓慢细弱——识别其异常，怀疑低血压并保持平卧

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey hands-on WITHOUT moving or rolling him: search chest, abdomen, pelvis and limbs for hidden bleeding and other injury, and check movement and feeling in all four limbs; the search never costs him his spinal precautions
expected.actionZh: 动手做快速查体但不移动、不翻动他：检查胸、腹、骨盆和四肢有无隐匿性出血及其他损伤，并检查四肢的运动与感觉；检查过程中不得放弃脊柱保护

expected.actionEn: Note skin: warm, pink and dry below the injury, face and hands cool
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：损伤平面以下温暖、红润、干燥，面部和双手发凉

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L NRB (trauma with suspected shock), titrated to keep SpO2 at 94% or more
expected.actionZh: 高流量吸氧 15 L 非再吸入面罩（创伤伴疑似休克），调整至 SpO2 保持在 94% 以上

expected.actionEn: Position supine and flat, no sitting up, no recovery position; cover him with a blanket against the cold wet ground
expected.actionZh: 保持仰卧平放，不得坐起，不得翻成复苏体位；盖毯保暖以隔绝冰冷湿地

phases.infoEn: Decision point. New-onset neurological deficit (no movement or feeling in both legs) = UNSTABLE, RTC; the slow weak pulse and the BP in the vitals add urgency. Ready to be lifted onto the cot within 15 minutes, with the secondary survey en route. Delegate your partner to bring the device, blanket and cot and direct two bystanders (friend and neighbour) as extra hands for a coordinated roll while the sister opens the gate. Baseline vitals and the oral analgesia are done before the roll, with urgency - a protocol is not a delay.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。新发神经功能缺损（双腿无运动和感觉）=不稳定，RTC；脉搏缓慢细弱及生命体征中的血压更增加紧迫性。15 分钟内达到可抬上担架床状态，二次评估在途中。指挥搭档取装置、毯子和担架床，并指导两名旁观者（朋友和邻居）作为协调翻身的额外人手，同时让妹妹开门。基线生命体征和口服镇痛在翻身前带着紧迫感完成——启动协议不算延误。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC (new-onset neurological deficit) and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC（新发神经功能缺损）并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Packaged on the device, warmed and ready to be lifted onto the cot within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内完成固定于装置、保暖，达到可抬上担架床状态

expected.actionEn: Complete baseline vitals and the oral analgesia before the roll without losing the sense of urgency
expected.actionZh: 在翻身前完成基线生命体征和口服镇痛，并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Delegate effectively: partner fetches device and cot, friend and neighbour act as extra hands in the roll under your head control, sister opens the gate
expected.actionZh: 有效指挥：搭档取装置和担架床，朋友和邻居在你控制头部下作为翻身人手，妹妹开门

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (alert, answers in full sentences): 'I can't feel or move my legs, and my neck and upper back hurt.' He was doing a front flip, did not get all the way round, landed on the top of his head and folded over; his legs went numb at once. The fall was at about 1616, about 14 minutes before your arrival. No loss of consciousness, no vomiting, no alcohol or drugs today. Pain 5/10: a constant dull ache at the base of the neck and between the shoulder blades, no radiation, worse with any head movement, nothing makes it better. Feels lightheaded and cold; no chest pain, no abdominal pain, no trouble breathing, no headache. PMHx: healthy. Meds: none; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen today, no blood thinners. Allergies: none known, no reaction to ibuprofen. Asked about the analgesics: no liver disease, no stomach ulcers or bleeding. LOI: lunch at 1230, water since. Weight 78 kg.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员（清醒，能说完整句子）：「我的腿没感觉也动不了，脖子和上背也疼。」他当时在翻前空翻，没转完一圈，头顶着地，身体折叠；双腿立刻就麻了。摔伤约在 16:16，到场前约 14 分钟。无意识丧失，无呕吐，今天未饮酒、未用药物。疼痛 5/10：颈根部和两肩胛之间持续钝痛，无放射，任何头部活动都加重，没有缓解因素。感觉头晕、发冷；无胸痛、无腹痛、无呼吸困难、无头痛。既往史：健康。用药：无；今天没吃过对乙酰氨基酚（acetaminophen）或布洛芬（ibuprofen），不服抗凝药。过敏：无已知过敏，对布洛芬无不良反应。针对镇痛药追问：无肝病，无胃溃疡或出血。最后进食：12:30 午餐，之后喝水。体重 78 kg。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: cannot feel or move his legs, with neck and upper-back pain
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：双腿无知觉且不能活动，伴颈部和上背部疼痛

expected.actionEn: HxC/C: how he landed, time of injury, immediate onset of numbness, no LOC or vomiting, no alcohol or drugs, whether anyone moved him since
expected.actionZh: 现病史：着地方式、受伤时间、麻木立即出现、无意识丧失与呕吐、无酒精或药物、此后是否被人移动过

expected.actionEn: Pain score and character (neck and upper back)
expected.actionZh: 疼痛评分及性质（颈部和上背部）

expected.actionEn: PMHx
expected.actionZh: 既往史

expected.actionEn: Medications incl acetaminophen or ibuprofen taken today and blood thinners
expected.actionZh: 用药史（含今天是否服过对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬，及抗凝药）

expected.actionEn: Allergies incl any reaction to ibuprofen
expected.actionZh: 过敏史（含对布洛芬的不良反应）

expected.actionEn: LOI
expected.actionZh: 最后进食

expected.actionEn: Ask the questions that rule out each analgesic's contraindications (liver disease, ulcers or bleeding) and get his weight for the fluid dose
expected.actionZh: 询问用以排除各镇痛药禁忌证的问题（肝病、溃疡或出血），并问清体重以便计算补液量

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - about 1636, supine on the lawn with manual stabilization held and oxygen on, before the oral analgesics: GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 78/44 by auscultation; pulse 52 regular, radial weak; respirations 16 regular; skin warm, pink and dry below the injury, face and hands cool; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on 15 L NRB; temp 35.6 °C (indicated - he lay on cold wet ground); BGL not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no altered LOC). Pain 5/10 at the neck and upper back. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——约 16:36，仰卧于草坪，手法固定保持、已吸氧，口服镇痛药之前：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；听诊血压 78/44；脉搏 52 规则，桡动脉搏动偏弱；呼吸 16 规则；皮肤损伤平面以下温暖、红润、干燥，面部和双手发凉；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 98%；体温 35.6 °C（有指征——他躺在冰冷湿地上）；血糖无指征（清醒、无糖尿病、无意识改变）。颈部和上背部疼痛 5/10。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (15: E4 V5 M6)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（15：E4 V5 M6）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - recognize a systolic pressure below 90 as hypotension and say what it triggers (keep flat, keep warm, oxygen, search for bleeding)
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——识别收缩压低于 90 为低血压，并说明由此要做什么（保持平卧、保暖、吸氧、搜寻出血）

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm - recognize a slow pulse with low BP, not the fast pulse expected with blood loss
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度、节律——识别低血压伴缓慢脉搏，而非失血时预期的快速脉搏

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate, depth and character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率、深度、性质

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on: temperature, colour, condition above and below the injury
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：损伤平面上下的温度、颜色、状态

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 and confirm it matches the palpated pulse
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并确认与触及的脉搏一致

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated after lying on cold wet ground
expected.actionZh: 体温——躺在冰冷湿地上后有指征

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that BGL is not indicated: alert, no diabetes, no altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 口述血糖无指征：清醒、无糖尿病、无意识改变

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, brief for the unstable patient. ACTOR: general - felt fine until the fall, now lightheaded and cold; CNS - no headache, no confusion, no loss of consciousness, numb and unable to move below the nipple line; respiratory - no cough, no trouble breathing; cardiovascular - no chest pain or palpitations, lightheaded; GI/GU - no abdominal pain or nausea, cannot tell whether he has passed urine; integumentary - no wounds or rashes, feels cold; musculoskeletal - neck and upper-back pain, no other pain; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - no vision, hearing or ear problems.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中，对不稳定患者从简。患者演员：整体——摔伤前一切正常，现在头晕发冷；中枢神经——无头痛、无意识混乱、无意识丧失，乳头线以下麻木且不能活动；呼吸——无咳嗽、无呼吸困难；心血管——无胸痛或心悸，头晕；消化/泌尿——无腹痛或恶心，说不清自己是否排过尿；皮肤——无伤口或皮疹，觉得冷；肌肉骨骼——颈部和上背部疼痛，无其他疼痛；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无视力、听力或耳部问题。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (headache, confusion, level of numbness)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（头痛、意识混乱、麻木平面）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (lightheadedness)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管（头晕）

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (abdominal pain, urine)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（腹痛、排尿）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe (brief, strict spinal precautions): head/neck - collar in place, no wounds, no deformity; chest - symmetrical rise, equal air entry, no bruising; abdomen - soft, non-tender, not distended; back (seen during the roll) - midline tenderness between the shoulder blades, no step deformity, bruising or wounds; lower extremities - no deformity, no movement and no sensation, pedal pulses present, skin warm and dry; upper extremities - no injury, full movement, sensation intact, radial pulses weak.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚（简要，严格脊柱保护）：头颈——颈托在位，无伤口，无畸形；胸部——起伏对称，进气对称，无瘀斑；腹部——软、无压痛、无膨隆；背部（翻身时查看）——两肩胛之间正中线压痛，无台阶样畸形、瘀斑或伤口；下肢——无畸形，无运动、无感觉，足背动脉可触及，皮肤温暖干燥；上肢——无损伤，活动完全，感觉正常，桡动脉搏动偏弱。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam with the collar and manual stabilization maintained
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体，颈托与手法固定保持不变

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with auscultation, bilateral comparison
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并听诊、双侧对比

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam for tenderness and distension (hidden bleeding)
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体，查压痛和膨隆（隐匿性出血）

expected.actionEn: Back exam during the roll: spine palpated for tenderness and step deformity, bruising, wounds
expected.actionZh: 翻身时查背：触诊脊柱有无压痛和台阶样畸形，查看瘀斑和伤口

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities: movement, sensation, pulses
expected.actionZh: 下肢：运动、感觉、脉搏

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities: movement, sensation, pulses
expected.actionZh: 上肢：运动、感觉、脉搏

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS - SPINAL MANAGEMENT (NEXUS positive, p.25): the candidate takes over manual in-line stabilization from the friend before any movement, measures and applies a hard collar without losing stabilization, and moves him off the cold wet lawn onto the spinal immobilization device with a coordinated roll (the candidate controls the head; partner and two bystanders under direction), examining the back during the roll, with a blanket under and over him; foam blocks, body secured to the device, head NOT taped; CSM checked before and after the move. HYPOTENSION (SBP 78): supine and flat, kept warm and protected from heat loss, oxygen to keep SpO2 at 94% or more (p.54). He is not bleeding externally, and a pulse of 52 with warm dry skin does not fit blood loss, so the candidate must say that the Hypovolemia indications (evidence of blood loss, SBP below 90, other signs of shock) are not all met, but that SBP 78 still needs treating and hidden bleeding is still being looked for. EXAMINER GUIDANCE: do not penalize a candidate who calls these measures the Hypovolemia protocol if SBP 78 is recognized and the search for bleeding goes on; penalize one who dismisses the low BP, or who gives TXA. PCP: IV en route and a fluid bolus because he is hypotensive and it is clinically indicated - 20 mL/kg (78 kg = 1,560 mL, maximum 2 L), reassessing every 500 mL, target SBP 90 (p.54, p.48); TXA is NOT indicated - no physical findings suggestive of occult or ongoing bleeding (p.78, p.54). PAIN (5/10, Appendix A): baseline vitals first, then rule out each drug's contraindications - acetaminophen 1000 mg PO (no hypersensitivity, no liver disease, none in the last 4 hours, p.58) and ibuprofen 400 mg PO (no NSAID hypersensitivity, no GI bleeding or ulcers, no anticoagulants, not pregnant, p.68); both are given before the roll. Entonox is withheld: shock is a caution on p.65 and his BP is 78/44 - the candidate must say so.
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用——脊柱处理（NEXUS 阳性，第 25 页）：考生在任何移动之前从朋友手中接过头颈部手法中立固定，量好尺寸并上硬质颈托且不丢失固定，然后用协调翻身把他从冰冷湿草坪移到脊柱固定装置上（考生控制头部；搭档和两名旁观者在指导下协助），翻身时检查背部，身下身上都垫盖毯子；放头部固定块，躯干固定于装置上，头部不贴胶带；移动前后检查 CSM。低血压（收缩压 78）：仰卧平放、保暖并防止热量散失，吸氧使 SpO2 保持 94% 以上（第 54 页）。他没有外出血，脉搏 52 加皮肤温暖干燥并不符合失血，因此考生必须说明：低血容量协议的指征（有失血证据、收缩压低于 90、其他休克征象）并未全部满足，但收缩压 78 仍需处理，且仍在寻找隐匿性出血。考官提示：若考生把这些措施称为低血容量协议，只要认识到收缩压 78 并继续搜寻出血，就不扣分；对无视低血压或给 TXA 者扣分。PCP：途中建立静脉通路并补液，因为他低血压且临床有指征——20 mL/kg（78 kg=1,560 mL，上限 2 升），每 500 mL 复评，目标收缩压 90（第 54、48 页）；TXA 无指征——没有提示隐匿性或持续性出血的体征（第 78、54 页）。镇痛（5/10，附录 A）：先完成基线生命体征，再逐药排除禁忌证——对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服（无过敏、无肝病、4 小时内未服用，第 58 页）和布洛芬 400 mg 口服（无 NSAID 过敏、无消化道出血或溃疡、不用抗凝药、非孕妇，第 68 页）；两者均在翻身前给予。不给 Entonox：休克是第 65 页上的慎用情形，且他血压 78/44——考生必须口述这一点。

expected.actionEn: Spinal management: sized hard collar applied without losing manual stabilization, foam blocks, body secured to the device and the head NOT taped (p.25)
expected.actionZh: 脊柱处理：量好尺寸的硬质颈托在不丢失手法固定的情况下上好，放头部固定块，躯干固定于装置而头部不贴胶带（第 25 页）

expected.actionEn: Move him off the cold ground onto the device with manual stabilization held throughout the roll, neutral alignment, the back examined, and a blanket under and over him
expected.actionZh: 把他从冰冷地面移到装置上：整个翻身过程手法固定不放松、保持中立位、检查背部，身下身上都垫盖毯子

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Pain Management protocol only after baseline vitals, ruling out the contraindications of acetaminophen (hypersensitivity, liver disease, recent doses) and ibuprofen (NSAID hypersensitivity, GI bleeding or ulcers, anticoagulants, pregnancy) BEFORE the roll (p.58, p.68)
expected.actionZh: 仅在基线生命体征完成后启动镇痛协议，翻身前排除对乙酰氨基酚（过敏、肝病、近期用药）和布洛芬（NSAID 过敏、消化道出血或溃疡、抗凝药、妊娠）的禁忌证（第 58、68 页）

expected.actionEn: Administer acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO with the 6 rights
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对口服对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 和布洛芬 400 mg

expected.actionEn: Verbalize withholding Entonox: shock is a caution on p.65 and his BP is 78/44
expected.actionZh: 口述不给 Entonox：休克是第 65 页的慎用情形，且他血压 78/44

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the hypotension plan: SBP below 90 is treated (supine and flat, warm, oxygen to 94% or more) although the Hypovolemia indications are not all met - no blood loss seen, pulse 52, warm dry skin - and the search for hidden bleeding continues
expected.actionZh: 口述低血压处理方案：虽然低血容量协议指征未全部满足——未见失血、脉搏 52、皮肤温暖干燥——收缩压低于 90 仍要处理（仰卧平放、保暖、吸氧至 94% 以上），并继续搜寻隐匿性出血

expected.actionEn: PCP: IV en route and a bolus of 20 mL/kg (78 kg = 1,560 mL, maximum 2 L) reassessed every 500 mL, target SBP 90
expected.actionZh: PCP：途中建立静脉通路，补液 20 mL/kg（78 kg=1,560 mL，上限 2 升），每 500 mL 复评，目标收缩压 90

expected.actionEn: PCP: verbalize why TXA is not given - no physical findings suggestive of occult or ongoing bleeding, shock not shown to be from blood loss (p.78, p.54)
expected.actionZh: PCP：口述不给 TXA 的理由——没有提示隐匿性或持续性出血的体征，休克未被证实源于失血（第 78、54 页）

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, CSM and every intervention after the roll onto the device and after each move; compare the neurological level with the earlier findings. Set 2 (6 minutes after set 1, packaged and warmed on the device, about 1642): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 84/50; pulse 54 regular, radial weak; respirations 16 regular; skin warm, pink and dry below the injury, face and hands warmer; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 99% on 15 L NRB; temp not repeated. Pain still 5/10 (oral analgesics take about 30 minutes to work). Neurological status unchanged: no movement or sensation below the nipple line, arms normal. PCP: after the first 500 mL en route (about 1655): BP 92/56, pulse 54, chest clear - the target SBP of 90 is reached, so stop the bolus and keep watching the BP.
phases.infoZh: 翻身上装置后及每次移动后复评 ABC、CSM 和各项处置；将神经平面与之前的发现对比。第 2 组（距第 1 组 6 分钟，已固定于装置并保暖，约 16:42）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 84/50；脉搏 54 规则，桡动脉搏动偏弱；呼吸 16 规则；皮肤损伤平面以下温暖、红润、干燥，面部和双手转暖；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 99%；体温不需复测。疼痛仍为 5/10（口服镇痛药约 30 分钟起效）。神经状态不变：乳头线以下无运动和感觉，双臂正常。PCP：途中输完第一个 500 mL 后（约 16:55）：血压 92/56，脉搏 54，胸部呼吸音清晰——已达目标收缩压 90，应停止补液并继续监测血压。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, CSM and all interventions after the roll and after each move
expected.actionZh: 翻身后及每次移动后复评 ABC、CSM 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes of the first and interpret the trend (BP still low, neurological level unchanged)
expected.actionZh: 距第一组 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并解读趋势（血压仍低，神经平面不变）

expected.actionEn: PCP: reassess BP and chest after each 500 mL, recognize the target SBP of 90 is reached and stop the bolus
expected.actionZh: PCP：每 500 mL 后复评血压和胸部，识别已达目标收缩压 90 并停止补液

expected.actionEn: Recheck movement and sensation after the move and tell the hospital at once if the level of numbness rises
expected.actionZh: 移动后复查运动与感觉，若麻木平面上升立即告知医院

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the receiving hospital en route (spinal cord injury with hypotension). Hand-off: mechanism and time of injury, neurological level and deficits, vitals trend, interventions with times (acetaminophen 1000 mg and ibuprofen 400 mg at about 1639), no Entonox and why, PCP fluid, TXA not given and why. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知接收医院（脊髓损伤伴低血压）。交接：受伤机制与时间、神经平面与缺损、生命体征趋势、带时间的处置（约 16:39 给对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 和布洛芬 400 mg）、不给 Entonox 及理由、PCP 补液、未给 TXA 及理由。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical patient (spinal cord injury with hypotension)
expected.actionZh: 危重患者途中预报（脊髓损伤伴低血压）

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off: mechanism, time of injury, neurological level and deficits, vitals trend and response to treatment
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：受伤机制、受伤时间、神经平面与缺损、生命体征趋势与治疗反应

expected.actionEn: State the drug times and what was withheld (Entonox, TXA) with the reasons
expected.actionZh: 报告给药时间及未给的药物（Entonox、TXA）和理由

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes with times, neurological findings and the reason Entonox was withheld
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，含时间、神经学发现及不给 Entonox 的理由

vitalsSets.timeHint: baseline, about 1636, supine on the lawn, oxygen on
vitalsSets.skin: warm, pink, dry below the injury; face and hands cool

vitalsSets.timeHint: 6 min after set 1, packaged and warmed on the device, about 1642
vitalsSets.skin: warm, pink, dry below the injury; face and hands warmer

criticalPitfallsEn: Not taking manual in-line c-spine control before any movement or pain stimulus, or letting go of it before he is secured to the device - 100% (Delicate Spine)
Putting the low BP down to hidden bleeding and then rolling, stripping or searching him without spinal precautions during the search - 100% (Delicate Spine, Rapid Body Survey)
Not treating the hypotension - leaving him sitting up or on his side, not keeping him flat and warm, or never responding to SBP 78 - 100% (Circulation: no positioning for hypotension)
Leaving him on the cold wet ground, or rolling him onto a bare device with no blanket under and over him while he is hypotensive - 15% (Patient Position) plus a protocol-measures deduction
PCP: giving TXA with no finding of occult or ongoing bleeding - outside its indications (p.78): up to 100% (Protocols)
PCP: starting the bolus without computing 20 mL/kg from his weight, skipping the reassessment every 500 mL, or running fluid on past the target SBP of 90 - up to 100% (Protocols)

Giving Entonox to a hypotensive patient (shock caution, p.65), or giving the oral analgesics without baseline vitals and a contraindication check - up to 100% (Protocols); giving neither oral agent with no reason - 25%
Moving him without a coordinated roll - head not controlled, no neutral alignment - or turning him into the recovery position - 25% (Spinal Management) plus a Delicate Spine deduction
(Textbook label - not a BC rubric item) naming this 'neurogenic shock' earns no marks: the BC guidelines do not use the term, and the marks are for the actions above
criticalPitfallsZh: 在任何移动或疼痛刺激之前未实施颈椎手法中立固定，或在他被固定于装置之前就放手——扣 100%（Delicate Spine）
把低血压归因于隐匿性出血，然后在搜寻过程中不做脊柱保护就翻动、脱衣或检查他——扣 100%（Delicate Spine、Rapid Body Survey）
不处理低血压——让他坐起或侧卧、不保持平卧保暖，或对收缩压 78 始终没有反应——扣 100%（循环：未为低血压摆位）
低血压时让他躺在冰冷湿地上，或把他翻到光秃秃的装置上、身下身上都没有毯子——扣 15%（Patient Position）并加协议措施类扣分
PCP：没有隐匿性或持续性出血的发现就给 TXA——超出指征（第 78 页）：最高扣 100%（协议类）
PCP：不按体重计算 20 mL/kg 就开始补液、跳过每 500 mL 复评、或在已达目标收缩压 90 后继续输液——最高扣 100%（协议类）
给低血压患者使用 Entonox（休克慎用，第 65 页），或未做基线生命体征与禁忌证核查就给口服镇痛药——最高扣 100%（协议类）；两种口服药都无理由不给——扣 25%
没有协调翻身就搬动他——头部未控制、未保持中立位——或把他翻成复苏体位——扣 25%（脊柱处理）并加 Delicate Spine 扣分
（教科书术语——并非 BC 评分项）把这种情况叫作「神经源性休克」得不到任何分数：BC 指南不使用该术语，得分来自上述各项行动
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: manual stabilization, hard collar, spinal device with blocks, blankets, high-flow oxygen and keeping him supine, flat and warm are all EMR skills, as are oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen for pain (only pyrexia dosing is PCP-only, p.58/68). Entonox is withheld (shock caution, p.65). No IV, no fluid bolus, no TXA, no Functional Enquiry - the hypotension is managed with positioning, warmth, oxygen and the 15-minute RTC clock. (Textbook label - not a BC rubric item: low BP with a slow pulse and warm dry skin below a spinal injury is usually called neurogenic shock; the BC guidelines do not use the term. Textbook caution - not a BC rubric item: some clinicians hold ibuprofen while occult bleeding is not excluded; neither monograph lists hypotension as a contraindication, so the rubric expectation is both oral agents.)
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：手法固定、硬质颈托、带固定块的脊柱装置、毯子、高流量吸氧以及保持仰卧平放保暖都是 EMR 级技能，口服对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬镇痛也在 EMR 范围内（仅退热剂量属 PCP，第 58、68 页）。不给 Entonox（休克慎用，第 65 页）。无静脉、无补液、无 TXA、无功能问诊——低血压靠体位、保暖、吸氧和 15 分钟 RTC 时限来处理。（教科书术语——并非 BC 评分项：脊柱损伤平面以下低血压伴脉搏缓慢、皮肤温暖干燥，通常称为神经源性休克；BC 指南不使用该术语。教科书式提醒——并非 BC 评分项：不少临床医师在尚未排除隐匿性出血时会暂缓使用布洛芬；两份药物专论均未把低血压列为禁忌，因此评分预期是两种口服药都给。）
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route, vascular access en route and a fluid bolus of 20 mL/kg (78 kg = 1,560 mL, maximum 2 L) reassessed every 500 mL and stopped when the target SBP of 90 is reached (p.54, p.48), because he is hypotensive and it is clinically indicated; the chest is rechecked at each step. TXA is not indicated without findings of occult or ongoing bleeding (p.78). (Textbook practice - not a BC rubric item: in this pattern of low BP with a slow pulse, more fluid does not fix the cause and risks overload, which is why the bolus is stopped as soon as the target is reached.)
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中 9 系统功能问诊、途中静脉通路，以及 20 mL/kg 补液（78 kg=1,560 mL，上限 2 升），每 500 mL 复评，达到目标收缩压 90 即停止（第 54、48 页），因为他低血压且临床有指征；每一步都复查胸部。没有隐匿性或持续性出血的发现，TXA 无指征（第 78 页）。（教科书做法——并非 BC 评分项：在这种低血压伴脉搏缓慢的情形中，多补液并不能解决病因且有过负荷风险，所以一达到目标就停止补液。）
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 19-year-old male, 78 kilograms, who landed on the top of his head from a front flip on a backyard trampoline at about 1616. He has been alert throughout with no loss of consciousness. On our arrival at 1630 he had no movement or sensation below the nipple line, normal arms, midline tenderness at the base of the neck and between the shoulder blades, priapism, and no external bleeding; chest, abdomen and pelvis were negative. Baseline at 1636: GCS 15, BP 78/44, pulse 52, resps 16, skin warm and dry below the injury, SpO2 98% on 15 litres, temp 35.6, pain 5 out of 10. We held manual stabilization from first contact, applied a hard collar and packaged him on the spinal device with blocks, high-flow oxygen, supine and warmed with a blanket under and over him; he had been lying on cold wet ground. Acetaminophen 1000 milligrams and ibuprofen 400 milligrams by mouth at 1639; no Entonox because of his hypotension. At 1642 BP 84/50, pulse 54, neurological findings unchanged. PCP: IV started en route with saline running at 1648, BP 92/56 after the first 500 millilitres so the bolus was stopped; TXA was not given because there is no sign of bleeding. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies, last ate lunch at 1230. His sister is following by car.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 19 岁男性，78 公斤，约 16:16 在后院蹦床上翻前空翻，头顶着地。全程清醒，无意识丧失。我们 16:30 到场时，乳头线以下无运动和感觉，双臂正常，颈根部和两肩胛之间正中线压痛，阴茎持续勃起，无外出血；胸、腹、骨盆检查阴性。16:36 基线：GCS 15、血压 78/44、脉搏 52、呼吸 16、损伤平面以下皮肤温暖干燥、SpO2 15 升下 98%、体温 35.6、疼痛 5/10。我们从接触起就保持手法固定，上硬质颈托并用带固定块的脊柱装置打包，高流量吸氧、仰卧保暖，身下身上垫盖毯子；他此前躺在冰冷湿地上。16:39 口服对乙酰氨基酚 1000 毫克和布洛芬 400 毫克；因低血压未给 Entonox。16:42 血压 84/50、脉搏 54，神经学发现不变。PCP：途中建立静脉通路，16:48 开始输生理盐水，输完第一个 500 毫升后血压 92/56，故停止补液；未见出血迹象，未给 TXA。无既往病史，无用药，无已知过敏，12:30 最后进食午餐。他妹妹开车跟随。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Cannot feel or move his legs after landing on his head from a trampoline; neck and upper-back pain 5/10
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Front flip on a backyard trampoline, landed on the top of his head at about 1616; immediate leg numbness; no LOC, no vomiting; no alcohol or drugs; lay on cold wet grass with his head held by a friend until crew arrival 1630
pcrKeyPoints.meds: None; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen today; no anticoagulants
pcrKeyPoints.allergies: No known allergies; no reaction to ibuprofen
treatments: Manual in-line stabilization from first contact, hard collar, coordinated roll onto the spinal device with blocks, head not taped
High-flow oxygen 15 L NRB, supine and flat, blanket under and over (cold wet ground)
Acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO at about 1639 after baseline vitals and contraindication check; Entonox withheld (hypotension)
PCP: IV and saline bolus started about 1648 (20 mL/kg = 1,560 mL), stopped after 500 mL at SBP 92; TXA not given (no sign of bleeding)
RTC transport with en-route notification
findings: No movement or sensation below the nipple line, arms normal, midline tenderness at the base of the neck and between the shoulder blades, priapism
No external bleeding; chest, abdomen and pelvis negative
Set 1 at 1636: GCS 15, BP 78/44, pulse 52, resps 16, SpO2 98% on 15 L, temp 35.6
Set 2 at 1642: BP 84/50, pulse 54, SpO2 99%; neurological status unchanged

dispatch.narrativeEn: Dispatch update en route: the sister says a friend is holding his head as the call-taker instructed; he is awake, lying on the lawn and says he cannot feel his legs; there is no heavy bleeding. It is a cold, damp afternoon. Fire First Responders are not attending.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 途中调度更新：妹妹说朋友按调度员的指示正扶住他的头；他清醒，躺在草坪上，说双腿没有知觉；没有大出血。下午又冷又潮。消防 First Responders 不会到场。

scene.narrativeEn: A round trampoline with a net enclosure stands on the lawn. The patient lies on his back on the wet grass beside it, shivering a little.
scene.narrativeZh: 草坪上有一个带护网的圆形蹦床。患者仰卧在蹦床旁湿漉漉的草地上，微微发抖。

rows.en: Cold, damp November afternoon, 6 °C. The wet grass is slippery but there are no other hazards
rows.zh: 十一月一个又冷又潮的下午，6 °C。湿草地较滑，但没有其他危险

rows.en: Bystanders say he was doing a front flip
rows.zh: 旁观者说他当时在翻前空翻

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: If the candidate asks, dispatch will send First Responders
rows.zh: 如考生询问，调度会派出 First Responders

rows.en: His sister meets you at the side gate and leads you to the backyard. A friend kneels behind his head holding it between his hands as the call-taker instructed; a neighbour has laid a jacket over his chest. Nobody has moved him
rows.zh: 他妹妹在侧门接你，带你到后院。一位朋友跪在他头后，按调度员的指示双手扶住他的头；一位邻居把一件夹克盖在他的胸口。没有人动过他

rows.en: Awake and anxious, lies still, says 'I can't feel my legs'
rows.zh: 清醒、焦虑，躺着不动，说「我腿没感觉了」

rows.en: Alert (A) and oriented
rows.zh: 清醒（A）、定向正常

rows.en: Clear, speaks in full sentences
rows.zh: 通畅，能说完整句子

rows.en: 16, regular, adequate depth, chest rises symmetrically
rows.zh: 16 次/分、规则、深度足够、胸廓起伏对称

rows.en: Radial pulse 52, regular and weak
rows.zh: 桡动脉 52 次/分、规则、细弱

rows.en: Warm, pink and dry below the nipple line; face and hands cool
rows.zh: 乳头线以下温暖、红润、干燥；面部和双手发凉

rows.en: 96% on room air
rows.zh: 室内空气 96%

rows.en: Hands-on, without moving him: chest symmetrical, no bruising; abdomen soft and non-tender; pelvis stable; no external bleeding anywhere. Midline tenderness at the base of the neck and between the shoulder blades when palpated with his head held. If the groin is exposed, a persistent erection (priapism) is noted
rows.zh: 动手检查，不移动患者：胸部对称、无瘀斑；腹部软、无压痛；骨盆稳定；任何部位均无外出血。扶住他的头触诊时，颈根部和两肩胛之间正中线有压痛。如暴露腹股沟，可见持续性阴茎勃起（priapism）

rows.en: INDICATED (NEXUS positive: midline tenderness and a focal neurological deficit)
rows.zh: 有固定指征（NEXUS 阳性：中线压痛和局灶性神经功能缺损）

rows.en: Arms: moves both on command, strong equal grip, sensation intact. Legs: no movement on command and no response to touch or pinch below the nipple line
rows.zh: 双臂：按指令均可活动，握力强且对称，感觉正常。双腿：按指令无活动，乳头线以下对触摸和针刺无反应

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed. Skin is given during the RBS. UNSTABLE: new-onset neurological deficit with a slow, weak pulse - hypotension is confirmed with the BP in the vitals.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。皮肤在 RBS 时给出。不稳定：新发神经功能缺损伴脉搏缓慢细弱——低血压以生命体征中的血压确认。

rows.en: 'I can't feel or move my legs, and my neck and upper back hurt'
rows.zh: 「我的腿没感觉也动不了，脖子和上背也疼」

rows.en: His legs went numb at once. No loss of consciousness, no vomiting, no alcohol or drugs today
rows.zh: 双腿立刻就麻了。无意识丧失，无呕吐，今天未饮酒、未用药物

rows.en: Worse with any head movement; nothing makes it better
rows.zh: 任何头部活动都加重，没有缓解因素

rows.en: Constant dull ache
rows.zh: 持续钝痛

rows.en: Base of the neck and between the shoulder blades, no radiation
rows.zh: 颈根部和两肩胛之间，无放射

rows.en: The fall was at about 1616, about 14 minutes before your arrival
rows.zh: 摔伤约在 16:16，到场前约 14 分钟

rows.en: Feels lightheaded and cold; no chest pain, no abdominal pain, no trouble breathing, no headache
rows.zh: 感觉头晕、发冷；无胸痛、无腹痛、无呼吸困难、无头痛

rows.en: None known, no reaction to ibuprofen
rows.zh: 无已知过敏，对布洛芬无不良反应

rows.en: None; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen today, no blood thinners
rows.zh: 无；今天没吃过对乙酰氨基酚（acetaminophen）或布洛芬（ibuprofen），不服抗凝药

rows.en: Healthy. Asked about the analgesics: no liver disease, no stomach ulcers or bleeding
rows.zh: 健康。针对镇痛药追问：无肝病，无胃溃疡或出血

rows.en: Lunch at 1230, water since
rows.zh: 12:30 午餐，之后喝水

rows.en: Was doing a front flip, did not get all the way round, landed on the top of his head and folded over
rows.zh: 当时在翻前空翻，没转完一圈，头顶着地，身体折叠

rows.en: 78 kg
rows.zh: 78 kg

history.noteEn: Actor is alert and answers in full sentences.
history.noteZh: 患者演员清醒，能说完整句子。

sets.rxEn: Baseline: supine on the lawn, oxygen on, manual stabilization held, before the oral analgesics
sets.rxZh: 基线：仰卧于草坪，已吸氧，手法固定保持，口服镇痛药之前

sets.rxEn: After the roll onto the device, packaged and warmed
sets.rxZh: 翻身上装置、固定并保暖后

vitals.noteEn: Give each vital only as it is properly assessed. Temperature is indicated (he lay on cold wet ground); BGL is not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no altered LOC). Pain 5/10 at the neck and upper back. RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs, CSM and every intervention after the roll onto the device and after each move; compare the neurological level with the earlier findings. Set 2: temp not repeated. Pain still 5/10 (oral analgesics take about 30 minutes to work). Neurological status unchanged: no movement or sensation below the nipple line, arms normal. PCP: after the first 500 mL en route (about 1655): BP 92/56, pulse 54, chest clear - the target SBP of 90 is reached, so stop the bolus and keep watching the BP.
vitals.noteZh: 按评估逐项给出。体温有指征（他躺在冰冷湿地上）；血糖无指征（清醒、无糖尿病、无意识改变）。颈部和上背部疼痛 5/10。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。翻身上装置后及每次移动后复评 ABC、CSM 和各项处置；将神经平面与之前的发现对比。第 2 组：体温不需复测。疼痛仍为 5/10（口服镇痛药约 30 分钟起效）。神经状态不变：乳头线以下无运动和感觉，双臂正常。PCP：途中输完第一个 500 mL 后（约 16:55）：血压 92/56，脉搏 54，胸部呼吸音清晰——已达目标收缩压 90，应停止补液并继续监测血压。

rows.en: Felt fine until the fall, now lightheaded and cold
rows.zh: 摔伤前一切正常，现在头晕发冷

rows.en: No headache, no confusion, no loss of consciousness; numb and unable to move below the nipple line
rows.zh: 无头痛、无意识混乱、无意识丧失；乳头线以下麻木且不能活动

rows.en: No cough, no trouble breathing
rows.zh: 无咳嗽、无呼吸困难

rows.en: No chest pain or palpitations, lightheaded
rows.zh: 无胸痛或心悸，头晕

rows.en: No abdominal pain or nausea, cannot tell whether he has passed urine
rows.zh: 无腹痛或恶心，说不清自己是否排过尿

rows.en: No wounds or rashes, feels cold
rows.zh: 无伤口或皮疹，觉得冷

rows.en: Neck and upper-back pain, no other pain
rows.zh: 颈部和上背部疼痛，无其他疼痛

rows.en: No diabetes
rows.zh: 无糖尿病

rows.en: No vision, hearing or ear problems
rows.zh: 无视力、听力或耳部问题

systems.noteEn: PCP only. En route, brief for the unstable patient.
systems.noteZh: 仅 PCP。途中，对不稳定患者从简。

rows.en: Collar in place, no wounds, no deformity
rows.zh: 颈托在位，无伤口，无畸形

rows.en: Symmetrical rise, equal air entry, no bruising
rows.zh: 起伏对称，进气对称，无瘀斑

rows.en: Soft, non-tender, not distended
rows.zh: 软、无压痛、无膨隆

rows.en: Seen during the roll: midline tenderness between the shoulder blades, no step deformity, bruising or wounds
rows.zh: 翻身时查看：两肩胛之间正中线压痛，无台阶样畸形、瘀斑或伤口

rows.en: No injury, full movement, sensation intact, radial pulses weak
rows.zh: 无损伤，活动完全，感觉正常，桡动脉搏动偏弱

rows.en: No deformity, no movement and no sensation, pedal pulses present, skin warm and dry
rows.zh: 无畸形，无运动、无感觉，足背动脉可触及，皮肤温暖干燥

exam.noteEn: En route head-to-toe (brief, strict spinal precautions).
exam.noteZh: 途中从头到脚检查（简要，严格脊柱保护）。

scenarios.titleEn: Rear-End Collision at 32 Weeks Pregnant - Abdominal Pain and Spinal Precautions
scenarios.titleZh: 怀孕 32 周被追尾——腹痛与脊柱固定
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0848 hrs. Code 3 to Granville Avenue at Garden City Road in Richmond. Two-vehicle collision: a woman who is 32 weeks pregnant was rear-ended while stopped at a red light and complains of abdominal pain. Fire rescue and police are on scene. Hospital is 9 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 08:48，Code 3 前往列治文 Granville Avenue 与 Garden City Road 路口。两车相撞：一名怀孕 32 周的女性在红灯前停车时被追尾，诉腹痛。消防救援和警察已在现场。医院车程 9 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch update en route: fire rescue reports both vehicles are stable and the driver has climbed out of her car and is sitting on the curb with a bystander; the other driver says he is uninjured.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：消防救援报告两辆车已稳定，女司机已自行爬出车外，与一名路人坐在路缘；另一名司机称自己没有受伤。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan collar and spinal device, oxygen, trauma pads, Entonox and oral acetaminophen, early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备颈托和脊柱固定装置、氧气、创伤护垫、Entonox 和口服对乙酰氨基酚，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize a pregnant trauma patient with abdominal pain after a rear-end crash as a likely RTC and plan to ask about gestation, bleeding, contractions and fetal movement
expected.actionZh: 把追尾后诉腹痛的孕妇创伤患者预判为很可能的 RTC，并计划询问孕周、出血、宫缩和胎动

expected.actionEn: Anticipate traffic and vehicle hazards; plan PPE incl eye protection
expected.actionZh: 预判交通和车辆危险；规划个人防护，含护目镜

expected.actionEn: Assign crew roles before arrival: one member takes manual head stabilization on first contact, one handles scene, equipment and fire rescue
expected.actionZh: 到场前先分好搭档分工：一人第一时间接手徒手固定头颈，一人负责现场、设备并与消防救援协调

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Dry morning, 12 °C, light traffic held back by police. The fire engine is parked beside the crash with its lights on and the vehicles are chocked and stable. The patient's sedan was hit from behind by a pickup truck at an estimated 60 km/h: the trunk is crushed and the rear seat area is pushed forward about 0.6 m into the passenger compartment; the driver's airbag did not deploy. The pickup driver stands with a police officer and says he is uninjured. The patient is sitting on the curb beside a bystander, one hand on her lower abdomen, turning her head to look at you. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：干燥的早晨，12 °C，警察把车流拦在后方。消防车停在事故旁亮着灯，两辆车已垫好并稳定。患者的轿车被一辆皮卡以估计 60 km/h 的速度追尾：后备箱被压扁，后排座位区域向前挤入乘客舱约 0.6 m；驾驶员气囊未弹出。皮卡司机和一名警察站在一起，说自己没有受伤。患者坐在路缘上，身旁有一名路人，一只手按着下腹部，不停转头看你。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (traffic held by police, vehicles stable per fire rescue), environment, MOI (rear-end collision at about 60 km/h with 0.6 m rear intrusion), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（警察管制的车流、消防确认车辆稳定）、环境、受伤机制（约 60 km/h 追尾、后排挤入 0.6 m）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: alert pregnant woman on the curb holding her lower abdomen and turning her head
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：清醒的孕妇坐在路缘，手按下腹部，不停转头

expected.actionEn: Size up the vehicle damage (crushed trunk, rear seat area pushed in, no airbag deployment) to judge the severity of the mechanism
expected.actionZh: 评估车辆损毁情况（后备箱压扁、后排座位区域挤入、气囊未弹出），判断受伤机制的严重程度

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert, anxious, speaks in full sentences ('My stomach hurts and my neck hurts, and the baby isn't moving as much'); keeps turning her head toward the traffic and toward you until told to stay still. EXAMINER (give when assessed): AVPU A. C-spine IS indicated: high-risk crash (p.7 intrusion) and, on palpation, midline tenderness over the lower cervical spine, plus a painful distracting injury (NEXUS) - she climbed out and sat down, which does not clear her spine; the actor keeps turning her head if the candidate has not stabilized it. Airway clear, speaks in full sentences. Respirations 22 regular, no distress; faint seat-belt redness running diagonally across the chest, non-tender, equal air entry. Radial pulse 110 strong and regular. Skin (during RBS): pale, warm, slightly moist. RBS: midline neck tenderness; bruise across the lower abdomen above the pubic bone; gravid abdomen tender over the uterus with contractions about every 6 minutes; pelvis stable; small amount of bright red blood on her underwear and pad, no clots; no limb injuries. SpO2 98% RA. RTC by mechanism - see the decision point.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、焦虑，能说完整句子（「我肚子疼、脖子疼，宝宝动得没有以前多了」）；在被告知保持不动之前，一直转头看车流和看你。考官（评估时给出）：AVPU 为 A。有颈椎固定指征：高风险碰撞（p.7 的车内挤入），触诊下颈段中线压痛，并有疼痛性分散注意力的损伤（NEXUS）——她自己爬出车外并坐下，并不能排除脊柱损伤；若考生没有立即固定，演员会继续转头。气道通畅，能说完整句子。呼吸 22 次/分、规则、无窘迫；胸部有一道斜行的安全带浅红印，无压痛，进气对称。桡动脉 110 次/分、有力规则。皮肤（RBS 时给出）：苍白、温暖、略潮。RBS：颈部中线压痛；耻骨联合上方下腹部有一道瘀青；妊娠子宫有压痛，宫缩约每 6 分钟一次；骨盆稳定；内裤和护垫上有少量鲜红色血迹、无血块；四肢无损伤。SpO2 室内空气 98%。按受伤机制判定 RTC——见决策点。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert

expected.actionEn: At first contact tell her to keep her head still and manually stabilize the head and neck; spinal motion restriction is indicated (high-risk crash with intrusion, midline neck tenderness, painful distracting injury) - walking out of the car does not clear the spine (p.25, p.11)
expected.actionZh: 第一时间要求她保持头部不动并徒手固定头颈；有脊柱活动限制指征（高风险碰撞伴车内挤入、颈部中线压痛、疼痛性分散注意力损伤）——自己走出车外并不能排除脊柱损伤（p.25、p.11）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway: clear, speaking in full sentences
expected.actionZh: 评估气道：通畅，能说完整句子

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing with the chest exposed: rate, effort, chest wall (seat-belt redness), air entry both sides
expected.actionZh: 暴露胸部评估呼吸：频率、费力程度、胸壁（安全带压痕）、两侧进气

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: fast, strong radial pulse; look for external bleeding
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉快而有力；寻找外出血

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey, exposing and examining with spinal precautions kept up: neck tenderness, chest, lower-abdominal seat-belt bruise, uterine tenderness and contractions, pelvis, vaginal bleeding, limbs
expected.actionZh: 快速全身检查，暴露并检查、全程保持脊柱保护：颈部压痛、胸部、下腹安全带瘀斑、子宫压痛与宫缩、骨盆、阴道出血、四肢

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale, warm, slightly moist
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、温暖、略潮

expected.actionEn: Oxygen (indicated for trauma, p.11), titrated to keep SpO2 at or above 94% (p.50)
expected.actionZh: 吸氧（创伤有指征，p.11），滴定使 SpO2 不低于 94%（p.50）

expected.actionEn: Position supine on the spinal device with one coordinated move (p.54 supine to support BP; p.32 limit movement), position of comfort as far as the device allows
expected.actionZh: 一次协调一致的搬运，使她仰卧于脊柱固定装置上（p.54 仰卧以维持血压；p.32 限制移动），在装置允许范围内尽量舒适

phases.infoEn: Decision point. RTC by mechanism: p.7 Mechanism of Injury - high risk automobile crash with 'significant intrusion into the passenger compartment (>0.3m on occupant side or >.5m any site including roof)'; here the rear seat area is pushed in about 0.6 m. Her SBP of 102 is above 90 and she is not in shock, so the p.54 Hypovolemia numbers are not met, and none of the p.7 primary-survey findings (altered LOC, absent radial pulses, cool pale clammy skin) is present - but the intrusion criterion alone makes her RTC; pregnancy is not itself listed on p.7. Ready to load within 15 minutes, secondary survey en route. Direct fire rescue and the partner for a single coordinated lift onto the spinal device (p.32: limit patient movement).
phases.infoZh: 决策点。按受伤机制判定 RTC：p.7「受伤机制」——高风险车祸，「车内显著挤入乘客舱（乘员侧大于 0.3 m，或任何部位大于 0.5 m，含车顶）」；本例后排座位区域被挤入约 0.6 m。她的收缩压 102 高于 90、也不在休克中，所以 p.54 低血容量协议的数值标准并未满足，p.7 的原始评估所见（意识改变、桡动脉消失、皮肤湿冷苍白）也都没有——但仅凭车内挤入这一条标准她就是 RTC；怀孕本身并不在 p.7 清单中。15 分钟内可装载，二次评估途中完成。指导消防救援队员和搭档，只做一次协调一致的搬运到脊柱固定装置上（p.32：限制患者移动）。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC citing the p.7 mechanism criterion (high-risk crash, intrusion more than 0.5 m at any site) - not SBP under 90
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC，并引用 p.7 的受伤机制标准（高风险车祸、任何部位车内挤入大于 0.5 m）——而不是收缩压低于 90

expected.actionEn: Packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes, secondary survey en route
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内打包完毕可装载，二次评估途中完成

expected.actionEn: Direct fire rescue and the partner (lift onto the spinal device, stretcher, egress) and keep to one coordinated move
expected.actionZh: 指导消防救援队员和搭档（抬运到脊柱固定装置、担架床、撤离），并控制为一次协调一致的搬运

expected.actionEn: Keep her calm and informed: explain why she must stay still, stay with her, tell her the baby will be checked at hospital
expected.actionZh: 安抚患者并保持沟通：解释为什么必须保持不动，陪伴她，告知宝宝会在医院得到检查

phases.infoEn: ACTOR answers: 29 years old, 32 weeks pregnant (second pregnancy, one earlier uncomplicated vaginal birth); this pregnancy has been uncomplicated, last prenatal visit two weeks ago, due in about 8 weeks. Stopped at the red light, saw the pickup in her mirror and was hit a second later; she wore a lap and shoulder belt, hands on the wheel, head snapped back and then forward; no LOC; no airbag deployment; two vehicles; the police estimate 60 km/h. Afterwards she climbed out and walked to the curb. Complaints: constant lower abdominal pain with cramping that comes and goes about every 6 minutes, neck pain at the back, low back ache; she noticed a small amount of bright red vaginal bleeding about 5 minutes ago; no fluid leaking; the baby has been moving less than usual since the crash. Pain: abdomen 7/10, neck 4/10. PMHx: healthy, no hypertension or diabetes. Meds: prenatal vitamins only; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen today. Allergies: none known. LOI: toast and tea at 0730.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员回答：29 岁，怀孕 32 周（第二胎，之前有一次顺产、无并发症）；本次孕期至今顺利，两周前最后一次产检，预产期约 8 周后。她在红灯前停车，从后视镜里看到皮卡，一秒后被撞；系着腰肩安全带，双手扶着方向盘，头先后仰再前冲；无昏迷；无气囊弹出；两辆车；警方估计时速 60 km/h。事后她自己爬出车外走到路边。主诉：持续性下腹疼痛，伴阵发绞痛、约每 6 分钟一次，颈后部疼痛，腰背酸痛；约 5 分钟前发现少量鲜红色阴道出血；没有液体流出；撞车后胎动比平时少。疼痛：腹部 7/10，颈部 4/10。既往史：健康，无高血压和糖尿病。用药：仅孕期维生素；今天没吃过对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：07:30 吐司和茶。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaints: lower abdominal pain and neck pain after a rear-end collision at 32 weeks pregnant
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：怀孕 32 周被追尾后的下腹痛和颈痛

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with the critical MVC questions (p.12: impact speed, restraint, intrusion, airbags, LOC, vehicles) and the pregnancy questions: contractions, vaginal bleeding, fluid leaking, fetal movement
expected.actionZh: 现病史：关键车祸问题（p.12：撞击速度、约束装置、车内挤入、气囊、昏迷、车辆数）及孕期相关问题：宫缩、阴道出血、羊水流出、胎动

expected.actionEn: Pain scores for the abdomen and the neck
expected.actionZh: 腹部和颈部的疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx incl obstetric history (second pregnancy, one earlier uncomplicated birth, no hypertension or diabetes)
expected.actionZh: 既往史含产科史（第二胎，之前一次顺产无并发症，无高血压和糖尿病）

expected.actionEn: Medications, and specifically whether acetaminophen or ibuprofen was already taken today (needed before analgesia)
expected.actionZh: 用药史，并明确今天是否已服用对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬（镇痛前必须问清）

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI
expected.actionZh: 最后进食

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE any protocol drug (required before analgesia): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 102/64 by auscultation; pulse 110 regular and strong; respirations 22 regular; skin pale, warm, slightly moist; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 98% RA. BGL and temperature are not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no fever). RTC interval 5-6 minutes.

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, brief. ACTOR: general - healthy, uncomplicated pregnancy; CNS - neck pain, no headache, no numbness or tingling; respiratory - no shortness of breath; cardiovascular - heart racing, no chest pain; GI/GU - lower abdominal cramping, no nausea or vomiting, small amount of vaginal bleeding, no fluid leaking, baby moving less than usual since the crash, no urinary symptoms; integumentary - seat-belt bruises; musculoskeletal - neck pain and low back ache, no limb pain; endocrine - nil, no diabetes; EENT - no visual changes, no ringing in the ears.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中，简要完成。患者演员：整体——健康，孕期一直顺利；中枢神经——颈痛，无头痛，无麻木或刺痛；呼吸——无气促；心血管——心跳快，无胸痛；消化/泌尿——下腹绞痛，无恶心呕吐，少量阴道出血，没有液体流出，撞车后胎动比平时少，无泌尿症状；皮肤——安全带瘀青；肌肉骨骼——颈痛和腰背酸痛，四肢不痛；内分泌——无，无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——视觉无变化、无耳鸣。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe (on the spinal device): head/neck - collar in place, midline tenderness over the lower cervical spine, no step-off, no head or face injury; chest - faint seat-belt redness running diagonally across the chest, non-tender, clear, equal air entry 6 sites; abdomen - gravid, fundus between the umbilicus and the xiphoid, bruise across the lower abdomen above the pubic bone, tender over the uterus, firm during a contraction and soft between, not distended by bowel gas, small amount of bright red blood on the pad, no fluid leaking; pelvis - stable, no tenderness; back - mild low back ache, no step or deformity felt at the lift; lower extremities - CSM intact, no injury; upper extremities - CSM intact, no injury.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚（在脊柱固定装置上）：头颈——颈托在位，下颈段中线压痛，无台阶感，头面部无损伤；胸部——一道斜行的安全带浅红印，无压痛，清晰，6 点进气对称；腹部——妊娠子宫，宫底在脐与剑突之间，耻骨联合上方下腹部有一道瘀青，子宫区压痛，宫缩时变硬、间歇时变软，没有肠胀气造成的膨隆，护垫上有少量鲜红色血迹，没有液体流出；骨盆——稳定，无压痛；背部——轻度腰背酸痛，搬动时未触及台阶或畸形；下肢——CSM 完好，无损伤；上肢——CSM 完好，无损伤。

expected.actionZh: 戴着颈托做头颈查体：中线压痛、台阶感、头面部损伤

phases.infoEn: SPINAL (p.25, all levels): manual stabilization of the head and neck, hard collar, spinal immobilization device, foam rollers/blocks, body secured to the device as appropriate, head not taped; one coordinated move onto the device (p.32: limit patient movement). ABDOMINAL INJURY (p.32): control external hemorrhage (a pad over the vaginal bleeding), protect against heat loss, position of comfort as far as the spinal device allows, transport. HYPOVOLEMIA (p.54): SBP is 102, above 90, so the protocol's numeric indication is not met, but note 2 allows the protocol when shock is anticipated from the mechanism, the nature and extent of the injuries or the patient's condition - third-trimester blunt abdominal trauma with vaginal bleeding and a pulse of 110 - so apply the all-level interventions: control external bleeding, supine to support blood pressure, keep warm, oxygen to keep SpO2 at 94% or above. PCP en route (p.32, p.54): vascular access; hold the fluid bolus while SBP stays at 90 or above and she is not hypoperfused - if SBP falls below 90, 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L, reassessing every 500 mL; TXA (p.78) is not indicated yet because there is no shock secondary to blood loss - reconsider if she deteriorates (2 g IV push over 1 minute, within 3 hours of injury). ANALGESIA (abdomen 7/10, neck 4/10; Appendix A): baseline vitals first, then rule out each drug's contraindications. IBUPROFEN: withheld - pregnancy (first, second or third trimester) is a listed contraindication (p.68). ACETAMINOPHEN: give 1,000 mg PO (p.58: 500-1,000 mg) - no hypersensitivity, no liver disease, none taken today, no nausea, vomiting or right upper quadrant pain; it may be used with Entonox. ENTONOX: give - p.65 lists no pregnancy contraindication or caution; she is alert and able to comply, there is no pneumothorax (chest clear, equal air entry), no inhalation injury, no nitroglycerin, no decompression sickness or air embolism, and she is not in shock (shock is a caution - recheck with each set); first complete the primary survey, pain assessment, vitals and the history and exam needed to rule out contraindications, invert the cylinder 3 times and make sure the ambulance ventilation is on; she holds the mask herself. Withholding Entonox only because she is pregnant is not supported by p.65.
phases.infoZh: 脊柱（p.25，各级别）：徒手固定头颈、硬质颈托、脊柱固定装置、泡沫垫/垫块、视情况将身体固定于装置上、不要用胶带固定头部；一次协调一致的搬运到装置上（p.32：限制患者移动）。腹部损伤（p.32）：控制外出血（阴道出血处垫护垫）、防止热量丢失、在脊柱装置允许范围内取舒适体位、转运。低血容量（p.54）：收缩压 102 高于 90，协议的数值指征并不满足，但注释 2 允许在根据受伤机制、损伤性质与范围或患者状况预期会发生休克时使用——本例为妊娠晚期钝性腹部创伤伴阴道出血、脉搏 110——所以执行各级别处置：控制外出血、仰卧以维持血压、保暖、吸氧使 SpO2 不低于 94%。PCP 途中（p.32、p.54）：建立静脉通路；收缩压维持在 90 或以上且无灌注不足时暂不补液——收缩压跌到 90 以下则 20 mL/kg 补液、上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评；TXA（p.78）目前无指征，因为没有失血性休克——若病情恶化再评估（2 g 静推 1 分钟，伤后 3 小时内）。镇痛（腹部 7/10，颈部 4/10；附录 A）：先完成基线生命体征，再逐药排除禁忌。布洛芬：不给——妊娠（早、中、晚期）为所列禁忌（p.68）。对乙酰氨基酚：给 1,000 mg 口服（p.58：500-1,000 mg）——无过敏、无肝病、今天未服过、无恶心呕吐或右上腹痛；可与 Entonox 合用。Entonox：给——p.65 没有列出妊娠禁忌或慎用；她清醒能配合，无气胸（胸部清晰、进气对称），无吸入性损伤，未用硝酸甘油，无减压病或空气栓塞，也不在休克中（休克为慎用情形——每组生命体征都要重新评估）；先完成原始评估、疼痛评估、生命体征及排除禁忌所需的病史和查体，将气瓶倒转 3 次并确认救护车通风已开，由她自己持面罩吸入。仅因为怀孕就不给 Entonox，p.65 并不支持。

expected.actionEn: Spinal management per p.25: manual stabilization, hard collar, spinal immobilization device, foam rollers/blocks, body secured as appropriate, head not taped, one coordinated move; recheck CSM afterwards
expected.actionZh: 按 p.25 做脊柱固定：徒手固定、硬质颈托、脊柱固定装置、泡沫垫/垫块、视情况固定身体、不用胶带固定头部、一次协调一致的搬运；之后复查 CSM

expected.actionEn: Control the external (vaginal) bleeding with a pad, protect against heat loss, and check the pad at every reassessment (p.32, p.54)
expected.actionZh: 用护垫控制外出血（阴道出血）、防止热量丢失，并在每次复评时检查护垫（p.32、p.54）

expected.actionEn: Apply the Hypovolemia interventions on the anticipated-shock basis (p.54 note 2) and say so: SBP 102 is above 90, but the mechanism, abdominal injury, bleeding and pulse 110 make shock likely
expected.actionZh: 按预期休克的依据（p.54 注释 2）执行低血容量处置并口述理由：收缩压 102 高于 90，但受伤机制、腹部损伤、出血和脉搏 110 使休克很可能发生

expected.actionEn: Before any analgesic: baseline vitals done and each drug's contraindications ruled out (p.58, p.65, p.68); withhold ibuprofen - pregnancy is a listed contraindication in every trimester (p.68)
expected.actionZh: 任何镇痛药之前：基线生命体征已完成，逐药排除禁忌（p.58、p.65、p.68）；不给布洛芬——妊娠在各孕期均为所列禁忌（p.68）

expected.actionEn: Acetaminophen 1,000 mg PO (p.58: 500-1,000 mg) after confirming no dose in the last 4 hours, no liver disease or hypersensitivity, and no overdose signs (nausea, vomiting, right upper quadrant pain)
expected.actionZh: 口服对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg（p.58：500-1,000 mg），前提是确认 4 小时内未服过、无肝病或过敏、无过量征象（恶心、呕吐、右上腹痛）

expected.actionEn: Entonox, self-administered, only after the primary survey, pain assessment, baseline vitals with SpO2 and the chest exam; ventilation on, cylinder inverted 3 times (p.65)
expected.actionZh: Entonox 由患者自己吸入，须在原始评估、疼痛评估、含 SpO2 的基线生命体征和胸部查体之后；通风已开，气瓶倒转 3 次（p.65）

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the Entonox decision: indicated for pain, no p.65 contraindication (pregnancy is not listed), shock is a caution to recheck with every set; omitting it only because she is pregnant is an error
expected.actionZh: 口述 Entonox 的决策：疼痛有指征，p.65 无禁忌（未列妊娠），休克为慎用情形、每组生命体征都要重新评估；仅因怀孕就不给属于错误

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the spinal restriction, the pad and all interventions after every move and each 5-6 minutes. Set 2 (en route, about 6 minutes after set 1, on the spinal device with oxygen, Entonox and acetaminophen given): GCS 15; BP 98/60; pulse 114 regular; respirations 22; skin pale, warm, slightly moist; pupils equal; SpO2 99% on O2. Pain after Entonox and acetaminophen: abdomen 4/10, neck 3/10. Contractions continue about every 6 minutes; one more small stain on the pad. Trend: SBP drifting down (102 to 98) and pulse up (110 to 114) - still above 90, so no bolus yet; keep the Hypovolemia interventions and recheck. If SBP falls below 90 the PCP bolus trigger applies.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后及约每 5-6 分钟复评 ABC、脊柱固定、护垫及各项处置。第 2 组（途中，约在第 1 组后 6 分钟，已在脊柱固定装置上并吸氧，已给 Entonox 和对乙酰氨基酚）：GCS 15；血压 98/60；脉搏 114 规则；呼吸 22；皮肤苍白、温暖、略潮；瞳孔等大；SpO2 吸氧下 99%。给 Entonox 和对乙酰氨基酚后疼痛：腹部 4/10，颈部 3/10。宫缩仍约每 6 分钟一次；护垫上又多了一小块血渍。趋势：收缩压缓慢下滑（102 到 98）、脉搏上升（110 到 114）——仍高于 90，所以暂不补液；保持低血容量处置并复评。若收缩压跌到 90 以下，则触发 PCP 补液。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, collar and straps, the pad and all interventions after every move and about every 5-6 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次移动后及约每 5-6 分钟复评 ABC、颈托与固定带、护垫及各项处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes; interpret the trend (SBP 102 to 98, pulse 110 to 114): still above 90 so no bolus, but keep the Hypovolemia interventions and recheck
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征；解读趋势（收缩压 102 到 98、脉搏 110 到 114）：仍高于 90 故暂不补液，但保持低血容量处置并复评

expected.actionEn: Reassess pain after the analgesics (abdomen and neck) and document the response
expected.actionZh: 镇痛后复评疼痛（腹部和颈部）并记录反应

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access en route; verbalize the bolus trigger (SBP under 90: 20 mL/kg, maximum 2 L, reassess every 500 mL) and that TXA is not indicated unless shock secondary to blood loss develops (p.54, p.78)
expected.actionZh: PCP：途中建立静脉通路；口述补液触发条件（收缩压低于 90：20 mL/kg、上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评），以及除非出现失血性休克否则 TXA 无指征（p.54、p.78）

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (pregnant trauma patient, 32 weeks, RTC). Structured hand-off with the mechanism, obstetric details, vitals trend, the analgesics given and the one withheld; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（孕妇创伤患者，32 周，RTC）。结构化交接，含受伤机制、产科情况、生命体征趋势、已给的镇痛药和未给的那一种；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification: pregnant trauma patient, 32 weeks, abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, contractions, spinal precautions, ETA
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：孕妇创伤患者，32 周，腹痛、阴道出血、宫缩、脊柱固定，预计到达时间

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off: mechanism incl intrusion and restraint, obstetric history, findings, vitals trend, spinal restriction, oxygen
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：受伤机制（含车内挤入和约束装置）、产科史、发现、生命体征趋势、脊柱固定、吸氧

expected.actionEn: State the analgesic decisions with reasons: acetaminophen and Entonox given with times, ibuprofen withheld (pregnancy, p.68)
expected.actionZh: 说明镇痛决策及理由：已给对乙酰氨基酚和 Entonox 并报告时间，未给布洛芬（妊娠，p.68）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes (mechanism, gestation, contraction interval, bleeding amount, vitals trend, analgesic times)
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR（受伤机制、孕周、宫缩间隔、出血量、生命体征趋势、镇痛药时间）
