about 6 min later, en route

criticalPitfallsEn: Not stabilizing the head and neck at first contact, letting her keep turning her head, or clearing her spine because she climbed out and walked to the curb - spinal failure, 100% (p.25, p.11)
Giving ibuprofen to a pregnant patient - pregnancy is a listed contraindication in every trimester (p.68), up to 100%

Giving any analgesic before the baseline vitals or without ruling out contraindications (no acetaminophen in the last 4 hours, no liver disease, no nausea, vomiting or right upper quadrant pain; chest checked before Entonox) - up to 100%
Treating as non-RTC because SBP is 102 and not under 90 - the p.7 mechanism criterion (intrusion more than 0.5 m at any site) makes her RTC; transport category error, 25%
Withholding Entonox only because she is pregnant - p.65 does not list pregnancy, so omitting an indicated, uncontraindicated Entonox costs 25% under Appendix A
PCP: starting a 20 mL/kg bolus while SBP is above 90 and she is not hypoperfused, or missing the trigger when SBP falls below 90 - protocol deviation, 25%
Several unnecessary moves, or a long on-scene secondary survey, instead of one coordinated lift and transport (p.32: limit patient movement) - 25%

Textbook practice — not a BC rubric item: in the third trimester, lying flat can compress the vena cava and textbooks tilt the whole spinal device to the left; the BC Hypovolemia line says supine, so lying flat on the device loses no marks and the tilt gains none
criticalPitfallsZh: 没有在第一时间固定头颈、任由她继续转头，或因她自己爬出车外、走到路边就认为脊柱没问题——脊柱处理失误，扣 100%（p.25、p.11）
给孕妇用布洛芬——妊娠在各孕期均为所列禁忌（p.68），最高扣 100%
在基线生命体征之前、或未排除禁忌（4 小时内未服对乙酰氨基酚、无肝病、无恶心呕吐或右上腹痛；用 Entonox 前查胸部）就给任何镇痛药——最高扣 100%
因收缩压 102、没有低于 90 就当作非 RTC——p.7 的受伤机制标准（任何部位车内挤入大于 0.5 m）已使她成为 RTC；转运分类错误，扣 25%
仅因怀孕就不给 Entonox——p.65 没有列出妊娠，对有指征、无禁忌的 Entonox 漏给，按附录 A 扣 25%
PCP：收缩压高于 90 且无灌注不足时就开始 20 mL/kg 补液，或收缩压跌到 90 以下时错过触发点——协议偏差，扣 25%
多次不必要的搬动，或在现场做冗长的二次评估，而不是一次协调一致的搬运后转运（p.32：限制患者移动）——扣 25%
教科书做法——不属 BC 评分项：妊娠晚期平躺可能压迫下腔静脉，教科书会把整个脊柱固定装置向左倾斜；BC 低血容量条目写的是仰卧，所以平躺在装置上不扣分，做了倾斜也不加分
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: manual stabilization, collar and spinal device, oxygen, a pad for the bleeding, supine and warm, one coordinated lift, oral acetaminophen 1,000 mg and Entonox (both within EMR scope); ibuprofen is withheld for pregnancy. No IV, no fluid, no TXA, no Functional Enquiry. Textbook practice (not a BC rubric item): tilting the whole spinal device to the left in the third trimester.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：徒手固定、颈托和脊柱固定装置、吸氧、出血处垫护垫、仰卧保暖、一次协调一致的搬运、口服对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg 和 Entonox（均在 EMR 范围内）；布洛芬因妊娠不给。无静脉、无补液、无 TXA、无功能问诊。教科书做法（不属 BC 评分项）：妊娠晚期把整个脊柱固定装置向左倾斜。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route, a 20 mL/kg bolus (maximum 2 L, reassess every 500 mL) only if SBP falls below 90 or she becomes hypoperfused, TXA (2 g IV push over 1 minute) only if shock secondary to blood loss develops within 3 hours of injury, and the 9-system Functional Enquiry. Analgesia is the same as for EMR: acetaminophen and Entonox, no ibuprofen.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中建立静脉通路、仅当收缩压跌到 90 以下或出现灌注不足时才 20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评）、仅当伤后 3 小时内出现失血性休克时才用 TXA（2 g 静推 1 分钟），以及 9 系统功能问诊。镇痛与 EMR 相同：对乙酰氨基酚和 Entonox，不用布洛芬。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 29-year-old female, 32 weeks pregnant with her second pregnancy, a restrained driver rear-ended at a red light by a pickup truck at about 60 km/h, with about 0.6 m of intrusion into the rear passenger compartment, no airbag deployment and no loss of consciousness. She climbed out of the car on her own. She has lower abdominal pain 7/10 with cramping about every 6 minutes, a seat-belt bruise across the lower abdomen, a small amount of bright red vaginal bleeding, decreased fetal movement, and midline neck tenderness with neck pain 4/10. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 102/64, pulse 110, resps 22, SpO2 98% on room air; repeat BP 98/60, pulse 114, SpO2 99% on oxygen. Treatment: manual stabilization, collar and spinal device at 0905, oxygen, supine and warm, a pad on the vaginal bleeding, acetaminophen 1,000 milligrams PO at 0912 and self-administered Entonox, with pain down to abdomen 4/10 and neck 3/10; ibuprofen withheld because of pregnancy. PCP: IV access, no bolus as SBP has stayed above 90. No past history apart from the pregnancy, prenatal vitamins only, no known allergies, last ate toast and tea at 0730.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 29 岁女性，怀孕 32 周（第二胎），系安全带的司机，在红灯前被皮卡以约 60 km/h 追尾，后排乘客舱挤入约 0.6 m，气囊未弹出，无昏迷。她自己爬出了车外。下腹痛 7/10，伴约每 6 分钟一次的绞痛，下腹有安全带瘀青，少量鲜红色阴道出血，胎动减少，颈部中线压痛、颈痛 4/10。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 102/64、脉搏 110、呼吸 22、SpO2 室内空气 98%；复测血压 98/60、脉搏 114、吸氧下 SpO2 99%。处置：徒手固定，09:05 上颈托和脊柱固定装置，吸氧，仰卧保暖，阴道出血处垫护垫，09:12 口服对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg 并自行吸入 Entonox，疼痛降至腹部 4/10、颈部 3/10；布洛芬因妊娠未给。PCP：已建立静脉通路，收缩压一直高于 90，未补液。除怀孕外无既往史，仅服孕期维生素，无已知过敏，最后进食 07:30 吐司和茶。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Lower abdominal pain and neck pain after a rear-end collision at 32 weeks pregnant
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Restrained driver rear-ended at a red light by a pickup at about 60 km/h; rear seat area pushed in about 0.6 m; no LOC, no airbag; climbed out and walked to the curb; abdominal pain 7/10 with cramping about every 6 min, small bright red vaginal bleeding about 5 min ago, no fluid leaking, decreased fetal movement; neck pain 4/10 with midline tenderness
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Healthy; second pregnancy, one earlier uncomplicated vaginal birth; no hypertension or diabetes
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Prenatal vitamins only; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen today
treatments: Manual head stabilization at first contact, hard collar and spinal device at 0905, one coordinated lift
Oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above
Supine, warm, pad over the vaginal bleeding (Hypovolemia interventions on anticipated shock, p.54 note 2)
Acetaminophen 1,000 mg PO at 0912
Entonox self-administered after baseline vitals and chest exam
Ibuprofen withheld - pregnancy (p.68)
PCP: IV access, no bolus while SBP stayed above 90
RTC transport (p.7 intrusion) with en-route notification
findings: Midline lower cervical tenderness; seat-belt redness across the chest, non-tender, equal air entry
Lower abdominal seat-belt bruise, uterine tenderness, contractions about every 6 min, small bright red vaginal bleeding, pelvis stable
Baseline GCS 15, BP 102/64, pulse 110, resps 22, SpO2 98% RA
Repeat BP 98/60, pulse 114, SpO2 99% on O2; pain abdomen 4/10, neck 3/10 after Entonox and acetaminophen

dispatch.narrativeEn: Fire rescue reports both vehicles are stable and the driver has climbed out of her car and is sitting on the curb with a bystander; the other driver says he is uninjured.
dispatch.narrativeZh: 消防救援报告两辆车已稳定，女司机已自行爬出车外，与一名路人坐在路缘；另一名司机称自己没有受伤。

scene.narrativeEn: The patient is sitting on the curb beside a bystander, one hand on her lower abdomen, turning her head to look at you.
scene.narrativeZh: 患者坐在路缘上，身旁有一名路人，一只手按着下腹部，不停转头看你。

rows.en: Dry morning, 12 °C, light traffic held back by police. The fire engine is parked beside the crash with its lights on and the vehicles are chocked and stable
rows.zh: 干燥的早晨，12 °C，警察把车流拦在后方。消防车停在事故旁亮着灯，两辆车已垫好并稳定

rows.en: Rear-end collision: the patient's sedan was hit from behind by a pickup truck at an estimated 60 km/h; the trunk is crushed and the rear seat area is pushed forward about 0.6 m into the passenger compartment; the driver's airbag did not deploy
rows.zh: 追尾：患者的轿车被一辆皮卡以估计 60 km/h 的速度追尾；后备箱被压扁，后排座位区域向前挤入乘客舱约 0.6 m；驾驶员气囊未弹出

rows.en: One
rows.zh: 单一患者

rows.en: The pickup driver stands with a police officer and says he is uninjured
rows.zh: 皮卡司机和一名警察站在一起，说自己没有受伤

rows.en: Anxious, keeps turning her head toward the traffic and toward you until told to stay still
rows.zh: 焦虑，在被告知保持不动之前，一直转头看车流和看你

rows.en: Alert, speaks in full sentences ('My stomach hurts and my neck hurts, and the baby isn't moving as much'). AVPU A
rows.zh: 清醒，能说完整句子（「我肚子疼、脖子疼，宝宝动得没有以前多了」）。AVPU 为 A

rows.en: Clear, speaks in full sentences
rows.zh: 通畅，能说完整句子

rows.en: 22 regular, no distress; faint seat-belt redness running diagonally across the chest, non-tender, equal air entry
rows.zh: 22 次/分、规则、无窘迫；胸部有一道斜行的安全带浅红印，无压痛，进气对称

rows.en: Radial pulse 110, strong and regular
rows.zh: 桡动脉 110 次/分、有力规则

rows.en: Pale, warm, slightly moist
rows.zh: 苍白、温暖、略潮

rows.en: 98% RA
rows.zh: 室内空气 98%

rows.en: Midline neck tenderness; bruise across the lower abdomen above the pubic bone; gravid abdomen tender over the uterus with contractions about every 6 minutes; pelvis stable; small amount of bright red blood on her underwear and pad, no clots; no limb injuries
rows.zh: 颈部中线压痛；耻骨联合上方下腹部有一道瘀青；妊娠子宫有压痛，宫缩约每 6 分钟一次；骨盆稳定；内裤和护垫上有少量鲜红色血迹、无血块；四肢无损伤

rows.en: IS indicated: high-risk crash (p.7 intrusion) and, on palpation, midline tenderness over the lower cervical spine, plus a painful distracting injury (NEXUS) - she climbed out and sat down, which does not clear her spine; the actor keeps turning her head if the candidate has not stabilized it
rows.zh: 有指征：高风险碰撞（p.7 的车内挤入），触诊下颈段中线压痛，并有疼痛性分散注意力的损伤（NEXUS）——她自己爬出车外并坐下，并不能排除脊柱损伤；若考生没有立即固定，演员会继续转头

initial.noteEn: Give findings only when assessed. Skin is given during the RBS. RTC by mechanism - see the decision point.
initial.noteZh: 评估时才给出相应发现。皮肤在 RBS 时给出。按受伤机制判定 RTC——见决策点。

rows.en: Constant lower abdominal pain with cramping that comes and goes about every 6 minutes, neck pain at the back, low back ache. She noticed a small amount of bright red vaginal bleeding about 5 minutes ago; no fluid leaking; the baby has been moving less than usual since the crash
rows.zh: 持续性下腹疼痛，伴阵发绞痛、约每 6 分钟一次，颈后部疼痛，腰背酸痛。约 5 分钟前发现少量鲜红色阴道出血；没有液体流出；撞车后胎动比平时少

rows.en: Abdomen 7/10, neck 4/10
None known
rows.zh: 无已知过敏

rows.en: Prenatal vitamins only; no acetaminophen or ibuprofen today
rows.zh: 仅孕期维生素；今天没吃过对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬

rows.en: Healthy, no hypertension or diabetes. 32 weeks pregnant: second pregnancy, one earlier uncomplicated vaginal birth; this pregnancy has been uncomplicated, last prenatal visit two weeks ago, due in about 8 weeks
rows.zh: 健康，无高血压和糖尿病。怀孕 32 周：第二胎，之前有一次顺产、无并发症；本次孕期至今顺利，两周前最后一次产检，预产期约 8 周后

rows.en: Toast and tea at 0730
rows.zh: 07:30 吐司和茶

rows.en: Stopped at the red light, saw the pickup in her mirror and was hit a second later; she wore a lap and shoulder belt, hands on the wheel, head snapped back and then forward; no LOC; no airbag deployment; two vehicles; the police estimate 60 km/h. Afterwards she climbed out and walked to the curb
rows.zh: 在红灯前停车，从后视镜里看到皮卡，一秒后被撞；系着腰肩安全带，双手扶着方向盘，头先后仰再前冲；无昏迷；无气囊弹出；两辆车；警方估计时速 60 km/h。事后她自己爬出车外走到路边

rows.en: 29 years old

sets.rxEn: On the spinal device with oxygen, Entonox and acetaminophen given
sets.rxZh: 已在脊柱固定装置上并吸氧，已给 Entonox 和对乙酰氨基酚

vitals.noteEn: Set 1 is the baseline BEFORE any protocol drug (required before analgesia). BGL and temperature are not indicated (alert, no diabetes, no fever). RTC interval 5-6 minutes. Reassess ABCs, the spinal restriction, the pad and all interventions after every move and each 5-6 minutes. Set 2 (en route, about 6 minutes after set 1). Pain after Entonox and acetaminophen: abdomen 4/10, neck 3/10. Contractions continue about every 6 minutes; one more small stain on the pad. Trend: SBP drifting down (102 to 98) and pulse up (110 to 114) - still above 90, so no bolus yet; keep the Hypovolemia interventions and recheck. If SBP falls below 90 the PCP bolus trigger applies.
vitals.noteZh: 第 1 组为给任何协议药物之前的基线（镇痛前必须完成）。血糖和体温无指征（清醒、无糖尿病、无发热）。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。每次移动后及约每 5-6 分钟复评 ABC、脊柱固定、护垫及各项处置。第 2 组（途中，约在第 1 组后 6 分钟）。给 Entonox 和对乙酰氨基酚后疼痛：腹部 4/10，颈部 3/10。宫缩仍约每 6 分钟一次；护垫上又多了一小块血渍。趋势：收缩压缓慢下滑（102 到 98）、脉搏上升（110 到 114）——仍高于 90，所以暂不补液；保持低血容量处置并复评。若收缩压跌到 90 以下，则触发 PCP 补液。

rows.en: Healthy, uncomplicated pregnancy
rows.zh: 健康，孕期一直顺利

rows.en: Neck pain, no headache, no numbness or tingling
rows.zh: 颈痛，无头痛，无麻木或刺痛

rows.en: No shortness of breath
rows.zh: 无气促

rows.en: Heart racing, no chest pain
rows.zh: 心跳快，无胸痛

rows.en: Lower abdominal cramping, no nausea or vomiting, small amount of vaginal bleeding, no fluid leaking, baby moving less than usual since the crash, no urinary symptoms
rows.zh: 下腹绞痛，无恶心呕吐，少量阴道出血，没有液体流出，撞车后胎动比平时少，无泌尿症状

rows.en: Seat-belt bruises
rows.zh: 安全带瘀青

rows.en: Neck pain and low back ache, no limb pain
rows.zh: 颈痛和腰背酸痛，四肢不痛

rows.en: Nil, no diabetes
rows.zh: 无，无糖尿病

rows.en: No visual changes, no ringing in the ears
rows.zh: 视觉无变化、无耳鸣

rows.en: Collar in place, midline tenderness over the lower cervical spine, no step-off, no head or face injury
rows.zh: 颈托在位，下颈段中线压痛，无台阶感，头面部无损伤

rows.en: Faint seat-belt redness running diagonally across the chest, non-tender, clear, equal air entry 6 sites
rows.zh: 一道斜行的安全带浅红印，无压痛，清晰，6 点进气对称

rows.en: Gravid, fundus between the umbilicus and the xiphoid, bruise across the lower abdomen above the pubic bone, tender over the uterus, firm during a contraction and soft between, not distended by bowel gas, small amount of bright red blood on the pad, no fluid leaking
rows.zh: 妊娠子宫，宫底在脐与剑突之间，耻骨联合上方下腹部有一道瘀青，子宫区压痛，宫缩时变硬、间歇时变软，没有肠胀气造成的膨隆，护垫上有少量鲜红色血迹，没有液体流出

rows.en: Stable, no tenderness
rows.zh: 稳定，无压痛

rows.en: Mild low back ache, no step or deformity felt at the lift
rows.zh: 轻度腰背酸痛，搬动时未触及台阶或畸形

rows.en: CSM intact, no injury
rows.zh: CSM 完好，无损伤

rows.en: CSM intact, no injury
rows.zh: CSM 完好，无损伤

exam.noteEn: En route head-to-toe, on the spinal device.
exam.noteZh: 途中从头到脚检查，在脊柱固定装置上。
